h-megourmet.com が、うぐいすを1948年（昭和23年）に広島ラー.en: h-megourmet.com reports Uguisu as one of the three stalls that gave birth to Hiroshima ramen in 1948 (Showa 23), that the founder learned soup-making in Manchuria and then started a stall in Nakashinchi before moving to Nagarekawa, pork-bone-shoyu chūka soba, spring-onion chūka soba and oden, and late-night hours (20:00–26:00). A park-side blog supports a late-night bowl in Nagarekawa and a nostalgic taste.

himeji-festa（播州室津・吉田水産の直営店、グランフェスタ6番街、浜焼.en: Confirmed by himeji-festa (run directly by Yoshida Suisan of Banshu Murotsu; Gran Festa 6-ban-gai; hama-yaki), the official maruhou.owst.jp (hama-yaki at every seat; seasonal all-you-can-eat November–May; cooked from the tank after ordering) and himeji588 (¥1,000 oyster set plus free steamed oysters for an Instagram follow; Murotsu oysters).

himeji-spice・tanosu・kisspress・tekuteku が.en: himeji-spice, tanosu, kisspress and tekuteku confirm: the owner; experience at the cave café TEEDA; opened 13 July 2025; Honmachi 68, Himekoji 2F (an old house about 70 years old); the origin of the name; a 100% plant-based menu; taco rice ¥1,500; rice-flour and okara muffins; care for nut allergies (no almond flour); a bring-your-own tie-up with KUUHAKU COFFEE. Full GF or allergy safety is not asserted.

himeji588（2016）は店主金井千秋（千秋ママ）、母からの約6年前の継承.en: himeji588 (2016) confirms: the owner, 金井千秋 ("Mama"); took over from a parent about six years earlier; 8 seats; Tajima chicken slaughtered that morning; skewers from ¥130. The ma8coro blog records that hine-pon is pre-prepared so it comes out fast, and the grilled bone-in mature-hen thigh (no source says the shop originated it).

hiramipan.co.jp(公式)は2011年3月創業・2017年9月1日に.en: hiramipan.co.jp (official) confirms: founded March 2011; Hiramipan Co. established 1 September 2017; representative 平見高広; a renovated Taishō-era ironworks; 'I don't want to be just a bakery / like a picture-book author's books or a fashion designer's clothes, no uncool bread'; also runs a creperie, gallery and pizzeria. food-japon backs up the Ghibli-like exterior and croque madame / breakfast from 8 am.

hitosara は現店主・松下素久(1987年石川生)が京都・大阪の割烹で修業.en: Hitosara confirms the current owner 松下素久 (born 1987 in Ishikawa) trained at kappo restaurants in Kyoto and Osaka and carries on the previous generation's Kaga cuisine with a sibling; 25 seats; steamed dishes, soups and meat grilled on stone. gorp (official) backs up the previous owner's uncompromising devotion to flavour, daily market buying and the processes of simmering, resting and steeping. The 1979 founding and the previous owner's given name were not confirmed, so left vague.

hitosara: 店主・畑純平（1974年奈良生まれ）。学生時代のアルバイト調.en: hitosara: owner Hata Junpei (born 1974 in Nara). Started cooking in a student part-time job, qualified as a cook, managed restaurants, then went independent. A certified sake sommelier, with the house's own sake 'Ura Shinomine'. Yamato vegetables, Yamato chicken and local fish; assorted vegetable sashimi; live horse-mackerel sashimi.

hitosaraは日本料理・懐石/会席、上階のウイスキーバー、瀬戸内の魚、冬のふ.en: hitosara confirms: Japanese cuisine, kaiseki and banquet courses; a whisky bar upstairs; Seto Inland Sea fish; in winter, fugu (tessa), oysters, conger eel and duck hot pot. The years in business ("decades") and "over 100 dishes" could not be confirmed in sources, so each was softened.

hitosara人物ページ（生年月日・二代目・人柄）、magazine.hito.en: Confirmed by the Hitosara profile page (date of birth, second generation, personality), magazine.hitosara (about 50 years in business, i.e. since around 1970; raised in Shiso; over 20 years after training in Kyoto and Kobe; the family's own rice from Shiso), the official news/631 (wild conger eel 5–10 times the price; sewage-treatment risk; steaming), and favy (a Hyogo restaurant guide; Kansai TV's Yo-i Don).

hitosara店舗ページ（有本良・1985年兵庫・Hummingbird 20.en: Confirmed by the Hitosara shop page (有本良; born in Hyogo in 1985; joined in 2018 from Hummingbird 2000), the official site (the shop that originated anago-meshi; ginger in the sauce; grilled then steamed; 1 min walk from Omizo-suji), tanosu (fresh conger eel all year, rare even in the city; the original sauce brushed on and turned 2–4 times) and kisspress (12 years; three ways to eat it).

hotpepper と gnavi が城山公園内・1905年（明治38年）創業、.en: Hot Pepper and Gurunavi back up its location in Shiroyama Park, founding in 1905 (Meiji 38), the tradition that its name comes from Emperor Meiji's words 'What a view!', kaiseki of Shinshu ingredients, and room for up to 200 people.

intojapanwaraku・weekend-kanazawa: 店主・西村純.en: intojapanwaraku and weekend-kanazawa: owner Nishimura Junya trained 7 years at the famous 'Chikuwa' and opened in July 2022 in 'Toryanse KANAZAWA FOODLABO' in Katamachi (Kanazawa's first oden stand). The finishing dashi omelette is ¥600 (2 eggs, oden dashi only). The dashi is Rausu kombu + bonito + Ono soy sauce. House-made fish cakes with Kaga lotus root or red pickled ginger. The principle: 'precisely because we're a newcomer, the real flavour'.

irohado.com/en は1925年12月木曽（鬼無里）創業、パン・和菓子.en: irohado.com/en says it was founded in December 1925 in Kiso (Kinasa), switched from bread and Japanese sweets to oyaki in the 1960s; fourth-generation president 伊藤博武; about 130 employees; the Nakamise shop opened in May 2020; Grand Prix at the 75th Japan Food Selection (May 2024). shun-gate reports that a vegetable oyaki is hand-wrapped in about 20 seconds, a skill that takes about a year to learn; Oyaki Farm makes 8,000–14,000 a day; and the president's comment that they go well with beer and coffee.

irukara・reo-gourmet・boooonで確認：オーナー和田幸夫（松.en: Confirmed on irukara, reo-gourmet and Boooon: owner Wada Yukio (born in Matsumoto → Nagano; to Tokyo for interior design; scaffolder 6–7 years; hotel food service, then 4 years of lunches borrowing a bar's daytime → independent). Concept Mr Sunday Trip; the firm Sunday Retro Pudding (with cinnamon or Yawataya Isogoro shichimi); coffee jelly with Matsuda milk from a 100-year-old Omachi dairy; daily single-origin coffee.

iseshima 115013: 地元の魚介類を使った海鮮居酒屋、海鮮丼が人気、.en: iseshima 115013: a seafood izakaya using local seafood; the seafood bowl is popular; open at lunch, daytime drinking welcome; #solo diners very welcome. Tabelog 24015561: genres seafood, tempura, izakaya; seafood bowl, Ise lobster sashimi, premium nigiri.

it-marketing・ヒトサラ・検索で、安田忠正は1968年兵庫県生まれ、ホ.en: it-marketing, Hitosara and searches confirm: 安田忠正, born in Hyogo in 1968, cooked for professional baseball players at a hotel, then went independent with live cooking; Kiko Live Food runs Omotenashi Kikou, Bettei Tanikatsu and Senhime Chaya; listed in a 2016 Hyogo restaurant guide; chairs the Hyogo specialty products association. Tatsuriki's official site confirms the July 2024 opening on Egret's 4th floor.

ja.wikipedia は不室屋が慶応元年(1865)創業・久右衛門が尾張町に.en: Japanese Wikipedia confirms: Fumuroya was founded in Keiō 1 (1865); 久右衛門 settled in Owari-chō and the heir 六右衛門 began making fu; the name comes from Fumuro village; sudare-fu; over 150 years. co-trip backs up a townhouse in Higashiyama's Higashi Chaya district, tatami, gold leaf, the famous shiratama fresh fu (bean paste / kinako / mitarashi) and seasonal fresh-fu sweet soup.

jisyameguri・るるぶは、店主が名店『翁』のそば打ち名人・高橋邦弘の直弟.en: jisyameguri and Rurubu report that the owner is said to have learned from a direct disciple of the soba master of the famous 'Okina', in-house stone-milled pesticide-free buckwheat from Gunma, about 12 table seats, and lunch only until sold out. kyotopi introduces an inconspicuous frontage, duck seiro, grilled miso and winter sobagaki zenzai.

jouhou.nagoyaが昭和48年(1973)創業・北区清水・かき揚げ丼(特.en: jouhou.nagoya confirms founding in Showa 48 (1973), Shimizu, Kita-ku, kakiage-don (the tokujō with about twice the shrimp), serving in order of ordering rather than seating, closing when ingredients run out, and the 2019 Michelin Plate listing. The official tp-mitsumura site confirms the location at 3-19-18 Shimizu, Kita-ku and 'closes when the ingredients run out'.

jouhou.nagoyaで2024年5月9日開店・西区堀端町（筋違橋交差点南側.en: jouhou.nagoya confirms the opening on 9 May 2024, Nishi-ku (south side of a nearby crossing), the owner's Instagram @tsukasaorange, a jidori shoyu ramen of Nagoya Cochin and Kyo-Akajidori, house-made noodles and Seto pork chāshū. Tabelog reviews confirm a married couple running it on opening day and a queue of several people 20 minutes before opening (no mention of selling out).

jouhou.nagoyaは米粉100%・小麦不使用（生地もカスタードも）、北海.en: jouhou.nagoya says: 100% rice flour, no wheat (in both batter and custard); run by a rice farmer in Rankoshi, Hokkaido (the fifth generation of a farm); the parent shop in Hokkaido opened in March 2021, and the Nagoya stand in Osu on 7 February 2025. nhkomorebi reports no wheat, oats or buckwheat, and that a customer with a wheat allergy checked with staff and ate with peace of mind. Vegewel #2544 lists the GF menu, the Osu address, 10:00–20:00 and stand service.

jp.japan-glutenfree.com（京都GFリスト、★★★★、米粉チ.en: jp.japan-glutenfree.com (Kyoto GF list, ★★★★, rice-flour chicken specialist, GF buns +¥200, 5 counter seats), osumituki.com (opened 2021/9/30, address, prices, from Saipan's LOCO & TACO) and Tabelog / Retty listings agree.

junkissa.jpは1984年（昭和59年）、アバンティ開業と同年に、当時2.en: junkissa.jp records that in 1984 (Showa 59), the same year Avanti opened, the then 23-year-old 'mama' opened it and has kept the deep space hung with crystal chandeliers for about 40 years. kyotreat reports Showa-kissa menu items such as lemon squash in a retro glass with a flower-shaped base and curry rice with an egg yolk dropped on, and warm hospitality.

kafe.biogaia.jpがL.ロイテリ菌ヨーグルトと1917年広島・野村家.en: kafe.biogaia.jp states yoghurt with L. reuteri and that the fifth generation recreated the 'oldest in Japan' recipe that originated with the Nomura family of Hiroshima in 1917. goguynet reports the fermentation lunch of September 2025 (amazake butter chicken curry, sticky bowl).

kagaya.co.jp と 100bangai: 和倉温泉『加賀屋』が運営する.en: kagaya.co.jp and 100bangai: a Japanese restaurant run by Wakura Onsen's 'Kagaya', inside Kanazawa Hyakubangai 'Anto'. Kaga local cuisine and kaiseki with seasonal ingredients sent direct from producers. Kaga's jibuni is the signature. (Specific menu names such as the 'Kagaya set' were not confirmed this time, so generalised.)

kaisei-toba.com: 鳥羽一番街3F、鳥羽駅近く、お客様の要望で開業.en: kaisei-toba.com: Toba Ichiban-gai 3F, near Toba Station; opened at customers' request; memories of a trip; heart and soul in every meal; seasonal seafood bowls, the Isooke set (abalone sashimi), Matsusaka beef set, tonteki. Tabiiro/search: opened July 2025.

kaname-kanazawa記事はカホン(打楽器)由来の店名、能美市出身の岡田.en: A kaname-kanazawa article confirms: the name comes from the cajón (a percussion instrument); representative Okada, from Nomi City, joined as a founding member about 18 years ago and became representative about 9 years later with a renovation; a weekly seed lunch (about ¥1,750, sells out within an hour); pesticide-free brown rice from the company's own paddies, water from Kawachi village, and seasonings from Nakasho, founded 129 years ago.

kanazawa.cc は昭和41年(1966)創業・継ぎ足しの鰹と昆布のダシ・.en: kanazawa.cc confirms: founded Shōwa 41 (1966); a topped-up bonito and kombu dashi; an L-shaped counter of 17 seats; local regulars; obanzai such as melting roast pork and sashimi. iijikanazawa backs up the Nishimachi Yabunouchi-dōri address, the topped-up dashi of bonito and Rishiri kombu, and oden such as large shinoda-maki and shellfish.

kanazawabiyori は、愛知県産うなぎ・国産炭で高温短時間→約1時間休.en: kanazawabiyori confirms: Aichi eel, Japanese charcoal, high heat for a short time → rested about an hour, then grilled again with sauce; a sauce of Ono soy sauce and starch syrup topped up for over 50 years; grilled loach ¥120 (a sweeter sauce than for eel). ohmicho-ichiba backs up that the shop is on the first floor of Omicho Ichiba-kan.

kanazawadays.com confirms メレンゲ生地の小麦粉不使用お.en: kanazawadays.com confirms wheat-free okonomiyaki with a meringue batter (gluten-free, per reviewers); opened December 2020; 34-2 Shimotsutsumicho near Omicho Market; Noto pork and Kanazawa vegetables; sets include Kanazawa vegetable salad soba; okonomiyaki by day / teppan bar by night; all counter seats. tacsp.net notes lunchtime drinks ¥300; Tabelog lists the shop as [moved] (old address 34-2 Shimotsutsumicho) with no new address given.

keizai.biz が、オーナー小谷建治氏、2023-10-17開業、英国風パ.en: keizai.biz confirms: the owner; opened 17 October 2023; 15 years as a bartender at a British-style pub; the philosophy of pairing oden with craft gin; Himeji-style oden in a dashi of Rausu kombu, bonito and tuna flakes with ginger soy sauce; all-you-can-drink of 40 gins for ¥4,000.

keizai.biz・budou-chan が、2017-03-01開業（テンヤ.en: keizai.biz and budou-chan confirm: opened 1 March 2017 (former Tenya site); the owner; about 20 years' training from age 18, including in Izushi; hand-made soba in view through the window; the warabi mochi served since opening; still full at lunch eight years on.

keizai.biz・food-stadium・inshokuten・らくちん公.en: keizai.biz, food-stadium, inshokuten and Rakuchin's official site confirm the Kyoto origin (Bistro Frenchman, 2015), the representative's career, the head chef, the move to the casual-tavern format, and the Himeji opening date and sales of each shop.

keizai.biz・kisspress・tanosu・budou-chan が.en: keizai.biz, kisspress, tanosu and budou-chan confirm: opened 6 April 2024 in the Omizo-suji arcade; about 6 tsubo with 8 counter seats; ice from Shinshu deep natural water (about 250 m); completely unheated fresh syrups; open all year; plans for fruit sandwiches and tea. The owner's given name is not public in any article, so only the surname is given.

keizai.biz・まねき食品公式・budou-chan が、2024-03-.en: keizai.biz, Maneki Foods' official site and budou-chan confirm: opened 22 March 2024; Maneki Foods (founded 1888, originator of station soba, from 1949); the company president; eight wines supervised by a celebrity; the former jewellery shop site on Miyuki-dori (Liv Along); terracotta interior; shrimp soba.

kinseigroup公式historyで彩色ラーメンきんせいの創業=平成13年.en: The official kinseigroup history confirms Saishiki Ramen Kinsei was founded on 8 November 2001 (Heisei 13) in Sakaemachi, Takatsuki; the origin of the name, 'I want to create ramen in bright colours, like Venus'; house-made noodles; and pioneering chicken salt. takatsuki-scramble confirms the golden salt (golden, light chicken bones, refined, counter only, queues at lunch), and the Kyoto Station Building Ramen Koji page confirms the 10F shop, 'Osaka Takatsuki ramen where you can fully enjoy the dashi', and the signature golden salt. The old citation vacan was 410 Gone and was replaced.

kisspress が、祖父母の戦後居酒屋→割烹天平→2010年グリル天平への継.en: kisspress confirms: the grandparents' post-war izakaya, then Kappo Tenpei, then Grill Tenpei in 2010; the concept of a table shared by three generations; the origin of the name; pesticide-free, home-grown vegetables and Shiga Koshihikari rice; very close to Himeji Castle (about 300 steps); a children's cafeteria since 2018; Himeji wagyu hamburg steak with a demi-glace made over three days.

kochiki（創業70年）とgoguynetは昭和21年（1946）創業を裏付.en: kochiki (70 years in business) and goguynet confirm founding in 1946 (Showa 21); kochiki records the staff-meal origin of the shumai, eating it with sauce and mustard, and chuka soba with kombu and niboshi. No source confirmed a specific 1952 move, so it was removed.

krkjapan（2022）は神奈川生まれ・姫路育ち、16年の会社員（管理職）、.en: krkjapan (2022) confirms: born in Kanagawa, raised in Himeji; 16 years as a company employee (manager); about half a year persuading family; opened 4 November 2015; ramen that brings to mind the ingredients and the producers; niboshi and jidori chicken. Tabelog records the move and renaming on 23 December 2023, kombu-water tsukemen, and awards at Shikou no Ramen Kansai (runner-up in 2025).

kyo-soku と kyotopi が2024年5月31日開店・木屋町三条・全.en: kyo-soku and kyotopi confirm the opening on 31 May 2024, Kiyamachi-Sanjo, low-hydration whole-grain noodles and aged-soy bonito-kombu-water tsuke-soba. The official PR Times (prtimes 023) states kombu water from Hokkaido gagome kombu and Tosashimizu sōda-bushi, domestic duck oil, Akita Komachi direct from Ogata, and the Mangetsu egg.

kyoto-gourmet.infoで祇園・花見小路(祇園四条駅近く)の深夜営業.en: kyoto-gourmet.info confirms a late-night shop on Hanamikoji in Gion (near Gion-Shijo Station), select shoyu ramen (light Kyoto shoyu with a little back fat, medium-thick noodles, pork loin, menma, white / green spring onion), spicy miso garlic and grated garlic as tabletop condiments, thick chicken ramen, and a layout of counter around a central kitchen + tables along the wall. The owner's name is not public, so null.

kyoto-gourmet・kyotopi・digistyle より、紫野西御所.en: kyoto-gourmet, kyotopi and digistyle confirm a retro Chinese restaurant in a renovated Kyoto townhouse in Murasakino (west of Horikawa-Kitaoji), where you take off your shoes, filling lunches of around ¥1,000, thick chāshū and superb menma in the shoyu chūka soba, and dried tofu brought in from China. A claim that it was formerly a Japanese restaurant could not be confirmed in sources and was removed.

kyoto.tips・kyotopiより、2015年に四条烏丸(中京区)で開業、.en: kyoto.tips and kyotopi confirm the 2015 opening at Shijo-Karasuma (Nakagyo-ku), an owner from a mizutaki specialist, a rich chicken paitan of only domestic chicken and aromatic vegetables with no pork (white = salt / black = shoyu), a bonito-dashi version and an ultra-rich version, a sister shop on Gion Nawate, chicken chāshū, tsukune, wood-ear and spring onion, and medium-thick straight noodles.

kyotokurasu（19091）が1966年創業・祇園白川沿い・初代の芙蓉園.en: kyotokurasu (19091) confirms founding in 1966 on the Shirakawa in Gion, the first owner's training at 芙蓉園, the name from the great-grandmother, the Gion geiko 'Takeka', whose hairpins and combs survive, cooking without garlic, onion or ginger for the sake of the geiko, spring rolls cut in eight, sweet-and-sour pork, roast pork, and visits by Kitaoji Rosanjin and Hashimoto Kansetsu.

kyotopi と gcjapan より、今宮神社の御旅所が店名の由来、江戸期に.en: kyotopi and gcjapan confirm the name comes from the otabi-sho of Imamiya Shrine, a neighbourhood Chinese restaurant in an area that flourished as a merchant quarter in the Edo period and grew quiet with the decline of Nishijin in the Showa era, the Otabi bowl (pork, vegetables and egg in Chinese sauce, about three bowls' worth of rice, very local), free rice refills, delivery in okamochi boxes, and counter + tatami seating with manga, magazines and TV.

kyotopi と公式（キラメキノ未来）より、2013年開業の出水町一号店（河原.en: kyotopi and the official site (Kirameki no Mirai) confirm the first shop, opened in 2013 in Demizu-cho (right by Kawaramachi-Marutamachi), the company's own noodle workshop in Nishikyo-ku with 100% Hokkaido wheat, the salt ramen's toppings (chicken-thigh chāshū, white-haired spring onion, mizuna, chilli threads, lemon, menma), and a chicken-paitan group in Kyoto, Osaka, Shiga and Nara (about 33 shops on the official list).

kyotopi/muchi2が西陣・千本通の約40年続く町中華、『東の河原町、西.en: kyotopi / muchi2 confirm a neighbourhood Chinese restaurant of about 40 years on Senbon-dori in Nishijin, a Showa-era entertainment district once called 'Kawaramachi in the east, Senbon in the west', Nagasaki champon (prawn, squid, kamaboko, chikuwa, pork belly, vegetables) and sara udon (extra-thin fried noodles), the name Gurabaa from Glover House, a wok shooting up flames, about 13 seats, and the Gurabaa bento (sweet-and-sour pork, sara udon, karaage, rice).

kyotopi/osumitukiが2022年11月11日開業、珍元跡地(201.en: kyotopi / osumituki confirm the opening on 11 November 2022 on the former site of Chingen (closed 2018), a regular of 30 years recreating the remembered taste as taught by Chingen's daughter, chicken-bone pork-bone back-fat shoyu with ginger, and a shop connected with the film 'Tampopo'.

kyotopi/retty/58-gourmetが京都を代表する担担麺、細麺にご.en: kyotopi / retty / 58-gourmet confirm it as a representative Kyoto tantanmen, thin noodles in a creamy sesame soup, mild and praised as finishable every time. Tabelog reviews confirm summer chilled tantanmen (broccoli), crab-ankake fried rice and lettuce fried rice.

kyotopiが伏見深草・近鉄高架下(深草泓ノ壺町)、大中/頑固麺出身、カウンタ.en: kyotopi confirms Fushimi Fukakusa under the Kintetsu viaduct, an owner from Daichu / Gankomen, 9 counter seats, aged pork-bone ramen, extra-thick mazesoba and fried rice, and the origin of the shop name, posted at the shop. totteoki / tabelog note a limit of about 20 bowls a day and a frozen-food vending machine.

kyotopiが店主の名門(京都こってりラーメンの始祖)出身、へんてこ醤油(鶏白.en: kyotopi confirms an owner from Meimon (the founder of Kyoto kotteri ramen), Henteko shoyu (chicken paitan + shoyu), a limited spice-curry ramen (chāshū, cheese, fried onion, house spices), and 6 seats → tables added in a 2024 renovation. kyoto-gourmet confirms an alley in Fukakusa / Sumizome, chicken-paitan shoyu and a calm owner.

kyotopiで2026/3/28開業・京都駅八条口圏(南区西九条池ノ内町)・西.en: kyotopi confirms the 2026/3/28 opening, the Kyoto Station Hachijo-guchi area (Nishi-Kujo, Minami-ku), a sister shop of Saiin's 'Ramen Hiro', opening at 7:00, free rice with every bowl, a clear golden pork-bone shoyu, high-hydration flat medium-thick noodles, a three-item menu (chūka soba / chāshū noodles / wakame), and the rice + chāshū + garlic way of eating. The owner's name is not public, so null.

kyotopiで『幻のラーメン』・22時台〜25時頃の約3時間営業・一人営業・約.en: kyotopi confirms 'phantom ramen', about three hours of opening from around 22:00 to 1:00, run alone, sold out after about 35 bowls, a move from Fushimi-ku to Gion First Building B1, TV appearances, mellow back-fat-sprinkled shoyu, thin low-hydration noodles, ¥700 / special ¥900 / chilled in summer. cupmen-review confirms an Acecook supervised cup noodle (2021/10/18) and the owner's name (Kinoshita), added to chef_name. The district name '坊花' was unconfirmed and rounded to Fushimi-ku.

kyotopiは2017年2月開店、カウンター6〜7席、店主一人、三たてを超える.en: kyotopi records opening in February 2017, 6–7 counter seats, the owner alone, a 'five-fresh' idea beyond the usual three (freshly milled, freshly rolled and so on), made, cut and boiled after ordering in about 20 minutes, about 170 g for ¥1,500, and 100% buckwheat soba. kyotoyoublog introduces soba and sobagaki at the centre and three ways of eating.

kyotopiは店主が信州（長野）出身、山梨の蕎麦店で修行、2010年に御所南・.en: kyotopi introduces an owner from Shinshu (Nagano), training at a soba shop in Yamanashi, opening in 2010 at Gosho-minami / Marutamachi, ni-hachi soba (8 buckwheat : 2 wheat) milled in-house on a stone mill every morning, sudachi soba from May to September, and duck zaru and duck nanban. A Michelin Bib Gourmand listing.

kyotopi・ekiten・食べログが、四条大宮の昭和レトロな食堂、暖簾と日替.en: kyotopi, ekiten and Tabelog record a Showa-retro canteen in Shijo-Omiya, a noren and a daily whiteboard, chicken-bone shoyu chūka soba (about ¥550 / chāshū, menma, spring onion, pepper), variations such as miso champon, a dashimaki set at about ¥500, and cash only.

kyotopi・fantabi・複数レビューより、京都駅近く下京区、朝7時開店の.en: kyotopi, fantabi and several reviews confirm Shimogyo-ku near Kyoto Station, a popular morning-ramen shop opening at 7 a.m., a shellfish-dashi salt soup of clam, short-neck clam and scallop, clam ramen and shellfish-dashi noodles (with shellfish aromatic oil), thin straight noodles using Hokkaido Yumechikara, and shellfish-dashi spicy miso too.

kyotopi・genjitsutouhiより、2019年に三条河原町へ一号店、.en: kyotopi and genjitsutouhi confirm the first shop at Sanjo-Kawaramachi in 2019, the Teramachi shop in 2022, and branches in Saiin and Gion too; a light clear broth of duck and Daisen chicken (shoyu / salt); the special shoyu with a double soup and pork and chicken-breast chāshū; a rich seafood-and-pork-bone tsukemen only at Teramachi; and a location in front of 京都大神宮.

kyotopi・keiji-project より、大阪発の行列人気店、京都初出店.en: kyotopi and keiji-project confirm: a popular Osaka queue shop, first opening in Kyoto on 12 September 2025 (Shijo-Kiyamachi, right by Kyoto-Kawaramachi Station), foam-style chicken paitan of only domestic chicken and water simmered over 8 hours and frothed with a blender, medium-thick wavy noodles, low-temperature chicken chāshū (breast / thigh), and variations: chicken salt, chicken shoyu, Fromage, Truffle, Red, Black and Green.

kyotopi・kyototwoが、2016年開業、山利商店(宮川町)の白味噌を.en: kyotopi and kyototwo report the 2016 opening, white miso from Yamari Shoten (Miyagawacho) used like a sauce, about 25 kinds of oden and extra-large waraji chicken thigh, cappuccino-style miso soup, fresh-fu dengaku, and a Michelin Bib Gourmand.

kyotopi・noodlersより、西院(右京区)、和食店のような静かな佇まい.en: kyotopi and noodlers confirm: Saiin (Ukyo-ku), a quiet frontage like a Japanese restaurant, MSG-free clear style, two lines — chicken soba and aged chicken paitan (the paitan restrained in sweetness with a slightly bitter finish), chicken chāshū and chicken tataki described as 'chicken-cuisine level', house-made noodles, and a bargain ¥300 butter rice with chicken and roast pork.

kyotopi・noodlers・genjitsutouhi・食べログより、壬生.en: kyotopi, noodlers, genjitsutouhi and Tabelog confirm: the Fushimi shop of a group with a Mibu main shop (+ Nishiki and others); remodelled into the rough, Tsubame-Sanjo-style 'Goriki' with rare chāshū changed to belly braised pork; the dedicated-noodle Kami Jiro (200/300/400 g); back fat with Kyoto Gokko soy sauce; and ginger instead of garlic to suit everyone.

kyotopi・o-ensokuが、西七条の家庭的なとんかつ食堂、擂りごまをソー.en: kyotopi and o-ensoku record a homely tonkatsu canteen in Nishishichijo, the touch of mixing ground sesame into the sauce, the signature 'Katsuhiro set' (extra-large fried prawn + fillet cutlet), fillet so tender you hardly need teeth, a thin, light coating, and an atmosphere loved by locals.

kyotopi・食べログより、2009年に一乗寺『夢を語れ』系として伏見に開業、.en: kyotopi and Tabelog confirm opening in Fushimi in 2009 in the Ichijoji 'Yume wo Katare' line, a leading Kansai Jiro-style shop that has expanded, meal tickets + the call of vegetables, garlic, back fat and stronger seasoning, noodle amounts of 200/300/400 g, and pork ramen with about 200 g of chāshū.

kyotopi・食べログ・JR東海travelが、2018年開業『第二章』の熟成.en: kyotopi, Tabelog and JR Tokai travel record the aged-pork tonkatsu of the 'second chapter' opened in 2018, hibernation ageing (21–45 days at about −1 °C), Kagoshima (南州) and Chiba (林) SPF pork, rib loin and chateaubriand, low-temperature frying in rapeseed oil at 150 °C, and bagna cauda.

kyotopi・食べログ・Rettyより、六角通(新京極)、L字カウンター約10.en: kyotopi, Tabelog and Retty confirm Rokkaku-dori (Shinkyogoku), an ultra-compact space with an L-shaped counter of about 10 seats + one table for 4, a crank-shaped back entrance, house-made wavy noodles of domestic whole-wheat flour, free large portions, free rice before 14:00, and seafood shoyu tsukemen.

kyotopi記事が2019年4月開業、烏丸鞍馬口(同志社近く)、店主の極鶏出身.en: A kyotopi article confirms the April 2019 opening, Karasuma-Kuramaguchi (near Doshisha), the owner from Gokkei, a light clear chicken broth + seafood (niboshi, bonito, mackerel, Rausu kombu), noodles from Asakusa Kaikaro, chilled salt soba and a salt tare aged one month.

kyotopi（5WVKH）が屋号も看板もないB1F店・木屋町三条・高瀬川沿い・.en: kyotopi (5WVKH) confirms a basement shop with no name and no sign, Kiyamachi-Sanjo by the Takase River, choosing noodles, soup and toppings at the ticket machine, Royal Copenhagen / Staub tableware, roast tomato and more. A Gurunavi interview and group commentary confirm it is in the same group as Menya Takakura Nijo and Wajo Ryomen Sugari.

kyotopi（GZjPd）が力餅の系譜（1889年豊岡の菓子屋に始まりフランチ.en: kyotopi (GZjPd) confirms the Rikimochi lineage (beginning at a confectioner in Toyooka in 1889, spreading across Kansai by franchise, now fewer than 10 shops); this Fukakusa shop opened in 1966 (Showa 41) by Seiji-san; a light chūka soba at about ¥680 (like udon broth, thin straight noodles, thick chāshū, two kinds of kamaboko, Kyoto negi, menma); a big inari at about ¥150 (black sesame, carrot, burdock); and a Showa atmosphere with a TV and regulars.

kyotopi（QkH9w）が2018年4月開店・JR西大路駅徒歩1分・開店祝い.en: kyotopi (QkH9w) confirms the April 2018 opening, 1 minute on foot from JR Nishioji Station, congratulatory opening flowers, a café-bar interior, a 2nd floor, and tip-cut menma. osumituki (106373) confirms a chicken paitan of three kinds of jidori including Nagoya Cochin simmered about 8 hours, garlic and ginger, and noodles from Mennya Teigaku. The parent brand is Fukakusa Seimen Shokudo in Fushimi.

kyotopi（eptC6）と osumituki（223370）が店主は地球規.en: kyotopi (eptC6) and osumituki (223370) confirm the owner trained 13 years at Chikyu Kibo / Sora, the opening on 6 October 2025, Nishishichijo, Shimogyo-ku (the former Akamon site), 12 counter seats, Jiro-style with extra-thick hand-rubbed noodles, and a call board. Search confirms the owner's name, Takuya Kozasa, and the basic make-up of 300 g / 2 slices of pork.

kyotopi（taoZO）が一乗寺の行列店『びし屋』の2号店・百万遍（京大近く.en: kyotopi (taoZO) confirms: the 2nd shop of the Ichijoji queue favourite 'Bishiya'; the former site of a curry shop in Hyakumanben (near Kyoto University); opening on 10 October 2025; talked about before opening; three kinds (abura soba / spicy / back-fat vegetable); house-made noodles; ¥750 basic; how-to-eat POP; and tabletop seasonings. osumituki (223472) confirms the Jiro-style back-fat vegetable version.

lade.jp（食べログ記録）が築70年の古民家改装・白壁地区・尼ヶ坂駅至近・2.en: lade.jp (Tabelog records) confirms: a renovated 70-year-old house; the Shirakabe district; right by Amagasaka Station; opened November 2005 / reopened after renovation October 2025; head chef Fukute Haruhiko; binchōtan counter grilling; ichiya-boshi; Hinai-jidori / Nagoya Cochin / Satsuma-jidori; Kumamoto horse sashimi; wagyu; a design where every seat faces the garden; and a glass floor over garden stones.

leafkyotoで2026/4/27開業・中京区高倉通二条西入・『京中華 牧定.en: leafkyoto confirms the 2026/4/27 opening, Takakura-dori west of Nijo, Nakagyo-ku, run by 'Kyo Chuka Makisada', 10 counter seats, Makisada ramen ¥1,100 (Makisada's staff-meal spring-onion soba rebuilt), Kyoto-style shoyu with spring onion and shredded chāshū, set +¥300 (rice / shumai), shumai with water chestnut, a summer chilled bowl at ¥1,200, and the owner's words about a shop loved across generations. shiyakusho-lunch confirms the single ramen, the set and the location.

lei 小麦を使わない国産ビストロ 秋葉原.en: lei, a domestic-ingredient bistro that uses no wheat, Akihabara

life-designs.jpで総料理長は『あいちの名工・近澤総料理長』で徳川美.en: life-designs.jp confirms the executive chef is 'Aichi Master Craftsman, Executive Chef Chikazawa', who also serves as head chef of the restaurant at the Tokugawa Art Museum (the name in the bio was wrong). The ssu blog and Tabelog confirm the opening on 18 March 2022, the three brands Yaohiko Honten, Hanakikyo and Nakamata, bonito shaved from 100 katsuobushi, wanuki butter dorayaki, Japanese afternoon tea and 112 seats. The dorayaki's '2 minutes' is held back as needing a source, cited to hanako.

local-primeはオーナー兼料理長・博多勝也、築100年以上の古民家、城壁.en: local-prime confirms: the owner and head chef, 博多勝也; an old house over 100 years old; located northwest along the castle walls; Daimyo Tsuzura (10+ dishes plus matcha fondue); the matcha sauce perfected by the owner's partner; mizuhiki and baran work modelled on Himeji Castle. tanosu confirms that Daimyo Tsuzura changes daily and the handmade sesame tofu.

locipoで1972年創業（西区上名古屋3-13-30）、2代目 小塩清貴が2.en: locipo confirms founded in 1972 (3-13-30 Kami-Nagoya, Nishi-ku); second-generation Oshio Kiyotaka took over at 23 and runs it with the mother (the senior okami) and wife Kimiko; five noodles (udon, kishimen, soba, Chinese, miso) made by hand during the mid-day break; and a menu expanded to over 30 items. Retty confirms curry-katsu udon as the specialty and aprons handed out when ordering.

ma8coroブログが、旧『なかもと』の跡地・常連継承・鍋を囲むL字約6席・約3.en: The ma8coro blog confirms: on the site of the former "Nakamoto", taking over its regulars; about 6 seats in an L-shape around the pot; about 30 ingredients; yuba, grilled green onion, ginkgo, tsumire and bamboo shoots; local sake "Naruto-tai" and "Miyakobijin". Miyakobijin is read "miyakobijin". The owner's name is not public.

ma8coro：駅前町の橋本ビル2階、妻が居酒屋・夫が階下でラーメン店、沖縄のゆ.en: ma8coro: Hashimoto Bldg 2F, Ekimae-cho; one partner runs the izakaya, the other a ramen shop downstairs; laid-back Okinawan music; Harima local sake at reasonable prices (Oku-Harima junmai ¥500, Sennenichi ¥600, etc.); a conversation with a German guest about sake prices. Listed on Tabelog as opened 3 October 2025.

macaroni(2023.3): 「銀之塔」は1955年開店のシチュー専門店、.en: macaroni (2023.3): "Gin no Tō" is a stew specialist opened in 1955, with a Showa-flavored front; near the Kabukiza and loved by actors; since its founding the menu has been only stew and gratin; stew in a clay pot, Parmesan gratin, mini set. Tabelog: Ginza 4-13-6; 74 seats; daily 11:30–20:00 (shortened hours); closed 12/30–1/3; prices revised from September 1, 2026. October 2026 reviews: beef stew ¥3,300, beef & tongue ¥3,500, three small dishes, free rice refills, sherbet with a reservation the day before.

manpuku・kaname・公式Wixサイト confirm 元看護師のオーナ.en: manpuku, kaname and the official Wix site confirm: an owner who is a former nurse; a preventive-medicine motive; concern that allergies, mental illness and cancer are increasing in children; the name from snail + Naoe and a snail logo; a container shop; pesticide-free rice flour and soybeans; free-range eggs; no white sugar (sudaki cane sugar, maple); dorayaki of fermented bean paste + shiratama flour; dagashi-level prices. Wix confirms wheat as an occasional treat and the 'thank-you day' with spelt on Sundays.

muchi2ブログより、2013年1月に下鴨で開業、『元祖京都らーめん』を掲げ、.en: The muchi2 blog confirms the January 2013 opening in Shimogamo, billing itself as 'the original Kyoto ramen', chicken-bone shoyu + sprinkled back fat, thin curly noodles, a pork-bone version (+¥20), a fried-rice set, and a clean, surprisingly roomy interior with courteous service.

musicbird・iimono.town・かいてん/へいてん24が、Forwa.en: musicbird, iimono.town and Kaiten/Heiten 24 confirm: run by Forward ball LLC; opened 13 May 2026; honetsuki-dori began at Ikkaku in 1953; mature hen and young chicken; seasoning measured to the milligram; Sanuki Cloudy. The founders' names were corrected from the Wikipedia article on honetsuki-dori.

musubi-co(公式)は創業22年・モットー『真心むすびます』・軟水と強火・.en: musubi-co (official) confirms: 22 years in business; the motto 'made with heartfelt sincerity'; soft water and high heat; craftsmen shape by hand without moulds; up to 8,000 a day; two shops, Kanazawa Station and Omicho. Tabelog backs up the Omicho shop's gold-leaf soft serve (¥900) and heart-shaped Noto beef croquette (¥200).

myhimejimapのインタビューで店主・浅見義人（姫路出身）、エスニック店→.en: A myhimejimap interview confirms: the owner, 浅見義人 (from Himeji); an ethnic restaurant, then about 8 years at a Michelin-starred French restaurant in Osaka; returned home on a mentor's advice; the name Aigrette = egret (from Shirasagi Castle, i.e. Himeji Castle), likened to Fernand Point's La Pyramide; the Honmachi 68 address; a partner is a sommelier. tekuteku-himeji confirms eggplant curry on the 22nd of each month, a natural-wine evening on the 20th, and vegetables from Yunomae, Harima-nada fish, Tajima chicken and Himeji wagyu.

naa7s・weekend-kanazawa・ishikawa-style: 2.en: naa7s, weekend-kanazawa and ishikawa-style: opened on 19 July 2024 on the first floor of Omicho Ichiba-kan (M'za side). Supervised by 'Raamen Hayashida' and a sister to 'Menya Kosuke' in Shinbo, Kanazawa (opened February 2024). A seafood soup from blackthroat-seaperch backbones simmered in the shop daily + house-made salt sauce; the special has 4 slices of chashu and more. Also oyster salt and soy sauce versions. Thin straight noodles from Kanno Seimen. Promoted as a new Omicho speciality.

nagano-gondo（インタビュー）・hahahaishya・食べログで確認.en: nagano-gondo (interview), hahahaishya and Tabelog confirm: 47 years since coming down from Togakushi, the home of soba; at the Gondo arcade by the entrance to Nagano Aioi-za; 11 counter seats; the owner alone. 'Nothing special about us, but we do our very best to make good soba.' Tororo soba (botchi-mori, egg yolk), celebrity autographs, Omakura (9 bundles) and soba water.

nagano-webtownで裏路地・権堂駅と善光寺から各徒歩約6分・サンセット.en: nagano-webtown confirms: in a back alley, about 6 minutes' walk from both Gondo Station and Zenkoji; Sunset Plaza 103; 7 seats (3 at the counter, 4 at tables); the owner cooks and serves alone; Richard Ginori, Wedgwood and Riedel tableware. The seasonal pastas and gelatos are based on Tabelog reviews.

naganogourmet（2019/04/23）は建物が施主の祖父（1979年.en: naganogourmet (23 April 2019) says the building was the calligraphy school run by the owner's grandfather (who died in 1979 aged 93), that former pupils from 50–60 years ago visit, and that tea is carefully brewed. sweets.nagano confirms house-made cakes such as roll cake, tarts, clafoutis and cheesecake. The owner's name 'Hisako' and 'uses home-made pottery' appear in no source, so both were removed.

nagatabe・boooon が店内石臼挽き（入口から見える）、チェーンではな.en: nagatabe and Boooon back up stone milling in the shop (visible from the entrance), an independent shop rather than a chain, and a daily lunch at ¥980 on weekdays and ¥1,130 at weekends (cold or hot soba, mini tempura bowl, chilled tofu, soba dumplings, pickles).

nagono.jpのインタビューで松浦仁志・1970年愛知生まれ・祖母の弁当がき.en: A nagono.jp interview confirms Hitoshi Matsuura: born in Aichi in 1970; a grandmother's bento as the spark; the French Pavilion at Expo 2005 Aichi (three-star level); time in France; Celeste and Hakuunkan before going independent in September 2013; a terrine of 18 pesticide-free vegetables poached in Japanese dashi and seasoned only with Sicilian salt; a roughly 380-year-old earthen storehouse renovated by hand; terre × storehouse; and the Tomato Festival. The official site confirms the September 2013 opening, organic farm vegetables from Mie, fresh fish from Mikawa Bay and Nagoya Cochin.

nagono.jpインタビューでオーナー桑原祥秀・料理長刀根清和（天ぷら歴38年.en: A nagono.jp interview confirms the owner, head chef Tone Kiyokazu (38 years in tempura), the move from Sakae to Nagono, the thin batter and original corn-oil blend, wine pairings with Champagne / Sauvignon / Bordeaux, and the signature tempura of nori × yuba × Hokkaido sea urchin. A 2017 blog confirms the Kyoto-machiya-style frontage, a U-shaped counter of 13–14 seats and dinner with wine at a little over ¥10,000.

nagoya-meshiが1922年築・1979年まで裁判所・第貳號法廷を利用し.en: nagoya-meshi confirms: built in 1922; a courthouse until 1979; a café using Courtroom No. 2; a 2024 filming location for the NHK drama 'Tora ni Tsubasa'; mixed sandwich ¥600. The opening year (2003) and exact prices for ogura toast and coffee could not be supported and were left vague.

nara-gourmet.com: 70年以上続く老舗寿司屋; 店主 cooks.en: nara-gourmet.com: a long-established sushi shop of over 70 years; the owner cooks alone and the okami (proprietress) warmly runs the front; horse mackerel and filefish in the tank; a white-wood counter, sunken-kotatsu tatami room, a large hall on the 2nd floor. naralunch.com: chirashi with freeze-dried tofu over shiitake and shredded omelette; nigiri ¥1,430 / chirashi and tuna bowl ¥1,750 / udon ¥550–660.

nara-gourmet: ならまちの昭和レトロな食堂、テーブル5卓、大和肉鶏カ.en: nara-gourmet: a Shōwa-retro diner in Naramachi with five tables; Yamato chicken cutlet, hamburg with demi-glace, over 20 set meals. naralunch: reasonable and unpretentious amid the many pricey tourist places; about 15 set meals plus over 20 single dishes.

nara-gourmet: 夫婦の細めの十割蕎麦、安曇野産の更科ブレンド特注品、.en: nara-gourmet: a couple's thin 100% buckwheat soba, a custom sarashina blend from Azumino, a refined dipping sauce of bonito, urume-bushi and Rausu kombu, soba-making in the spirit of 'true flavour comes from the heart'. naralunch: opened 1989; along Yasuragi-no-Michi, with an inconspicuous entrance that's easy to walk past.

nara-gourmet: 明治から続く奈良・吉野の果樹園発祥。三条通に始まり大.en: nara-gourmet: born from a fruit orchard in Yoshino, Nara, dating from the Meiji era. Started on Sanjo-dori and expanded to Osaka and Tokyo. Fruit sandwiches on brown-sugar bread, over 10 kinds of shaved ice from May to October, made fresh to order; takeout at the front, café at the back.

nara-gourmet: 近鉄奈良駅近く、小西通りと東向商店街をつなぐ路地の2.en: nara-gourmet: near Kintetsu Nara Station, upstairs in a lane linking Konishi-dori and the Higashimuki shopping street, in the former kissaten 'Akadama'. The second shop of Furukoto. Shaved ice named after figures of the Asuka and Tenpyō periods (Ōama and others), ancient foods such as so, and Mahoroba beer.

nara-gourmet: 近鉄奈良駅近くの鶏専門店。奈良のブランド鶏「大和肉鶏.en: nara-gourmet: a chicken specialist near Kintetsu Nara Station. Nara's brand chicken 'Yamato nikudori' bought from the farm every morning, also served as sashimi and tataki. Yamato shirako with ponzu (a rare cut, rich and creamy, with grated radish and chili), chicken-broth ramen, oyakodon with fertilised eggs, Nara sake.

narabftc・small-life・くるみの木公式で、鹿の舟（2015年開業.en: narabftc, small-life and the Kuruminoki official site confirm 'Kamado', the dining room of Shika no Fune (opened 2015, produced by Kuruminoki's Yukiko Ishimura): set meals of Nara rice cooked in a wood-fired kamado at the counter, dengaku, simmered greens and more, in southern Naramachi.

narakko: 中川政七商店運営、奈良市元林院町の町家（床の間・庭）。スタッフ.en: narakko: run by Nakagawa Masashichi Shoten; a townhouse in Ganrin-in-cho, Nara City (tokonoma, garden). 'Whisk-your-own' matcha with staff guidance (¥1,800), seasonal sweet + thin tea (¥1,500), a tea seating (¥3,000), takeaway thick-tea latte.

naraliving: オーナーシェフは心斎橋・祇園で修行し2023年5月ならま.en: naraliving: the owner-chef trained in Shinsaibashi and Gion and opened in Naramachi in May 2023. 100% Japanese-beef hamburgs with three sauces, including Chaliapin. Tabelog: 19 seats. @grille_talo (taro sugimori / 杉森太郎).

naramachiinfo/kansainavi: 2021年1月1日オープン。.en: naramachiinfo / kansainavi: opened 1 January 2021. The owner, 福本, greets guests in formal kimono, lets each choose an Akahada-ware bowl and makes the tea in front of each guest. Pesticide-free Yamato matcha, rice-koji amazake, fermented bean paste. Deer-motif shaved ice (kohakutō deer) and sugar-free fermented bean-paste zenzai.

naramachiinfoで、明治初期創業の呉服店を母体とする甘味処で、築約16.en: naramachiinfo confirms a sweets shop based on a kimono shop founded in the early Meiji era, in a townhouse about 160 years old (Takamikado-cho). Kuzu noodles and kuzu mochi of 100% Yoshino pure kuzu are made fresh after ordering, served with matcha or black syrup.

note.com（chocolat22）は1937年創業、翌年に現店主・宮本久美.en: note.com (chocolat22) records founding in 1937; the next year Miyamoto Ryoichi, grandfather of the current owner Miyamoto Hisami's husband, took it over and learned house roasting from the previous owner of 'Coffee no Mise Unzen' in Karasuma; and in the previous generation's time maiko and geiko often came. discoverjapan-web reports velvet chairs modelled on a train, coffee grinders collected by the previous owner, and handmade menus.

ocha-cha.co.jp: 大和茶・台湾茶・擂茶; reicha loved.en: ocha-cha.co.jp: Yamato tea, Taiwanese tea and leicha; leicha has been loved by the Hakka as a tea of hospitality since the Three Kingdoms period, with over 20 kinds of beans, grains and green tea, no additives, colourings or flavourings. mochiidono.com: a graduate shop of Yume CUBE; shaved ice all year (Asuka Ruby strawberry milk ¥500, hojicha latte ¥400, leicha ¥350), 'fluffy, and it vanishes in an instant'.

oinagoyaが2023年12月オープン・西区城西・旧串よし跡・7:30モーニ.en: oinagoya confirms the December 2023 opening, Josai, Nishi-ku, the former site of Kushiyoshi, hours from 7:30 morning service into the evening, and daily pasta (with soup and salad). A claim that it inherited the old shop's signature pasta could not be supported and was removed.

onwa（オンワ）は奈良市三条大宮町の古民家を改装した100%プラントベース＆グ.en: onwa is a 100% plant-based and gluten-free vegan café in a renovated old house in Sanjo-Omiya-cho, Nara City, aiming for everyone to enjoy a meal at the same table. The signature is the 'Vegan Delight' plate of about 10 items; the matcha chocolate cake with Yamato highlands naturally grown matcha and the vegan Basque cheesecake are popular.

organic-japanのインタビューと公式サイトで、店主・宮原雄太、『おいし.en: An organic-japan interview and the official site confirm owner Yuta Miyahara, the philosophy 'the secret of flavour is subtraction', a policy of handling allergies, gluten-free and vegan, the bimonthly 'Yurari Ennichi' on the second Sunday, house-made shio-kōji and shōyu-kōji from naturally grown rice and sun-dried salt, and prices affordable for young people.

osumituki/genjitsutouhiが2011年12月10日開業、家系.en: osumituki / genjitsutouhi confirm the opening on 10 December 2011, pork-bone shoyu without calling itself iekei, pork bone + chicken bones simmered two days, house-made noodles of domestic (Hokkaido) wheat (smooth, flat), an L-shaped counter of about 12 seats, and tsukemen (4 slices of chāshū, yuzu rice).

osumituki/kyo-sokuが店主さい氏の高安15年・祇園『麺屋一乗』オ.en: osumituki / kyo-soku confirm owner Sai's 15 years at Takayasu and ownership of Gion's 'Menya Ichijo', the opening on 21 May 2024 at Sanjo-Omae (near Nijo Station), wagyu beef-tendon ramen (sweet, creamy pork bone), free spicy garlic chives, and 8 counter seats.

osumitukiで2022/5/16開業・左京区百万遍(今出川通沿い、京大近く.en: osumituki confirms the 2022/5/16 opening in Hyakumanben, Sakyo-ku (on Imadegawa-dori, near Kyoto University), an abura soba / mazesoba specialist from Osaka, a student discount, larger portions up to a challenge size, and a free campaign for the first 50 (until 5/22). The official roman-japan site confirms the philosophy 'because it's simple, we value the taste of the ingredients' and whole-wheat thick noodles, and the company page confirms founding in November 2020 with headquarters in Osaka.

osumitukiで2026/2/22開業・左京区下鴨/北大路通(京都府立大近く.en: osumituki confirms the 2026/2/22 opening, Shimogamo / Kitaoji-dori, Sakyo-ku (near Kyoto Prefectural University), about 7 tables and 14 seats, extra-thick abura soba with a house-made sweet-savoury soy sauce and aromatic oil, noodles made by Mennya Teigaku (founded 1931), toppings (chāshū / braised pork / menma / seasoned egg / nori / white negi), larger portions from 200 g ¥850 to 500 g ¥1,000, and as-is → changing the flavour with chilli oil and vinegar. The owner's name is not public, so null.

osumitukiで2026/2/7開業・北区西加茂/大宮・『毎日食べられるラー.en: osumituki confirms the 2026/2/7 opening, Nishigamo / Omiya, Kita-ku, 'ramen you can eat every day', a clear pork broth (only arm meat and back fat, no pork bone), Gokko soy sauce, house-made noodles (25% hydration, rested overnight, with egg white), chāshū amounts (¥700 30 g / ¥950 150 g / ¥1,200 210 g), and modelling on Daiichi Asahi / Ramen Fuji. kyo-soku supports the location, the nostalgic taste of the clear pork broth and the generous chāshū. The owner's name is not public, so null.

osumituki・kyotopi・noodlers より、2025年10月22.en: osumituki, kyotopi and noodlers confirm: opened on 22 October 2025 as a renewal of its predecessor Fukakusa Seimen Shokudo (closed end of September 2025, popular for chicken paitan); rich pork-bone shoyu of pork bone + chicken bones; two low-temperature chāshū (smoky pork and black-pepper pastrami); spinach, white negi and three sheets of nori; medium-thick straight noodles from Mennya Teigaku (founded 1931); mazesoba and karaage at about ¥100 each continued; free large noodles with a student discount; near Fushimi Fukakusa / Fujinomori Station.

otona-no-nagoyaが20年超の経験・完全予約制・魚ごとの塩と熟成の黄.en: otona-no-nagoya confirms over 20 years of experience, reservations only, a golden ratio of salt and ageing for each fish, and an emphasis on the counter. mopeco confirms Mikawa Isshiki kuruma prawns served two ways (ice-shocked and steamed), a remark declining TV appearances, and two Michelin stars in 2019. jouhou.nagoya confirms Espacio Nagoya Castle 4F, the 1 October 2025 opening, 8 seats and a counter borrowing Nagoya Castle as scenery.

otto2008.com（自社サイト）は本店を株式会社otto運営と裏付ける。ホ.en: otto2008.com (the company's own site) confirms the main shop is run by otto Co. Hot Pepper records Himeji Noren-gai, the Shin Festa Building, 1 min from the station, Himeji oden from ¥176 (homemade ginger soy sauce) and kushikatsu from ¥132. tanosu confirms castle-shaped konjac and bokkake.

par-pleの記事で、2025年6月3日に韓国料理店『アッス』が昼の新業態とし.en: A par-ple article confirms that on 3 June 2025 the Korean restaurant 'Assu' opened a new lunchtime format serving only a ¥1,800 set (one main + four obanzai), with the obanzai made by the owner's mother, who has taught cooking classes.

potel.jp（ポmagazine）は店主が元・広告業で、飛騨高山で食べた蕎麦.en: potel.jp (Po magazine) writes that the owner was formerly in advertising, was moved by soba eaten in Hida-Takayama, was refused as an apprentice ('there's no point copying; try it yourself'), was self-taught for about two years from books, eating out and practising at home, opened in 1999, and keeps to stone-milled 100% buckwheat. Tabelog and osumituki report a townhouse, duck seiro, spicy-daikon soba and more.

prtimes.jp と straightpress、tamari-ya.com.en: From prtimes.jp, straightpress and tamari-ya.com: a rice farmer in Tamari, Takehara (a marginal village with a high ageing rate) using home-grown pesticide-free rice makes additive-free, gluten-free rice-flour donuts (fermented donuts, old-fashioned). No preservatives or colourings, oil that resists oxidation, organic toppings where possible. The ekie Hiroshima Station shop opened on 25 April 2025.

reo-gourmet・note・hahahaishya・まいぷれで確認：202.en: Confirmed on reo-gourmet, note, hahahaishya and Mypl: opened April 2022; 726 Yokosawa-machi, Nagano City, across from Yubuku Shrine; a two-storey townhouse with a manga corner on the first floor; Judee Sill's 'Heart Food' playing on a Toshiba CD player and Bose Bluetooth; breakfast from 8 am; Chinese zongzi set, brown-rice latte, lemon cake; the name Sirafu means 'sober'.

reo-gourmet・食べログで確認：善光寺西側、湯福神社隣接、昭和30年代築.en: Confirmed on reo-gourmet and Tabelog: west of Zenkoji, next to Yubuku Shrine, a renovated old house built in the 1950s–60s, slippers inside, copper-griddle pancakes, fresh-pasta lunch, cat-themed interior, Kenyan tea shaved ice in summer. Address: 723 Yokosawa-machi, Nagano City. The origin of the name (a Spanish theory) could not be backed up, so it was removed.

retty.news・web-komachi・reo-gourmet が、鉄道会.en: retty.news, web-komachi and reo-gourmet back up: leaving a railway-company job to go independent, early retirement around age 50, training prompted by a retirement gift, the 67-degree theory and low-temperature, residual-heat cooking, four pork brands (Shinshu SPF, Chiyo Maboroshi, Azumino free-range and Yamato pork), choosing the cut from a block of meat, and Daifukuya (a 100-year-old used-book shop and café).

rettyが旧名『らー麺創房 日本一 ぱこぱこ』→現名『らー麺創房 ぱこ』、あっ.en: retty confirms the former name 'Ramen Soubou Nihonichi Pakopako' → the current name 'Ramen Soubou Pako', premium salt ramen of a light soup with thin curly noodles + mizuna, the gentle-shoyu super-niboshi chūka soba, and Saiin (Ukyo-ku).

rurubu・naramachiinfo・くるみの木公式で、鹿の舟の茶房『囀』（.en: Rurubu, naramachiinfo and the Kuruminoki official site confirm 'Saezuri', the tea house of Shika no Fune (opened 2015, produced by Kuruminoki's Yukiko Ishimura); a Taishō-era building; designed by 中村好文; logo by 望月通陽; the origin of the name (everyone in one boat towards the future); and desserts that use whole seasonal fruit.

sateiyuusui.jp(EN): 店主 Toshihiro Matsuok.en: sateiyuusui.jp (EN): owner Toshihiro Matsuoka; at the foot of Mt. Wakakusa, the entrance to the Kasugayama primeval forest. narakko: the 'Nara no Megumi gohan' has no meat, egg or dairy, with tea rice, nyūmen (Miwa sōmen) and seasonal Nara vegetables. Warabi mochi of pure bracken starch, finished after ordering.

savorjapan と hitosara が料理長・中村義信（1976年長野県.en: savorjapan and Hitosara state head chef Nakamura Yoshinobu (born 1976 in Nagano Prefecture; trained in Nagano and Tokyo; opened in 2005; moved to Patio Daimon in 2014 and added Tempura Kakure Shunka). The Patio Daimon official site says the building, 'Yokikan', is a mid-Meiji reception hall restored over 100 years later. The hahahaishya blog reports the move to the second floor of the annex after a fire and signature dishes such as 'the chef's ohagi'.

seesaaブログ・宮島観光協会・広島県『たてものがたり』で、杓子問屋だった築2.en: A seesaa blog, the Miyajima Tourist Association and Hiroshima Prefecture's 'Tatemonogatari' confirm a townhouse over 200 years old, once a rice-paddle wholesaler, renovated and opened as a gallery café in April 2003; handrails and a counter decorated with rice paddles; natural-yeast bread (La Pain Juju); Pakistani curry; pizza toast with Yotsuba cheese; a chiffon cake set and ozenzai. The opening date can be supported only as far as 'April'.

shinise.tv が1924年（大正13年）創業・京都中華発祥の店・創業者.en: shinise.tv confirms founding in 1924 (Taisho 13), the birthplace of Kyoto Chinese, founder Hamamura Hozo, third generation Hamamura Yoshiyuki, Kyoto Chinese that holds back on garlic and oil and uses chicken-bone and kombu dashi, a light seasoning rooted in geiko culture, and the signature karashi soba. kyotopi (7lvle) confirms the Fuchomae shop moved from Kawaramachi about five years ago (around 2014).

shinise.tv は1897年(明治30)和田長平が小松駅前で創業し鉄道の延.en: shinise.tv confirms: founded in 1897 (Meiji 30) by 和田長平 in front of Komatsu Station, moving to Kanazawa as the railway extended; six generations of owners' names on the signboard; the third generation 吉田太郎吉 founded the Kadochō association, at its peak over 30 shops. weekend-kanazawa backs up the renovation on 15 July 2020 (evening hours and drinks added), mizore udon and duck jibu; co-trip backs up the location near Omicho and the chewy Kanazawa udon. The number of generations could not be pinned down, so left vague.

shinise.tvは小菅亭を1895年（明治28年）創業・130年超の老舗とし.en: shinise.tv describes Kosugetei as a long-established shop founded in 1895 (Meiji 28), over 130 years old; in 1941 fire regulations moved it from the Zenkoji grounds to Higashi-no-mon-cho; it served soba to Emperor Shōwa and Prince Takamatsu and supplied the Zenkoji Gokaichō. i-turn and the official site confirm coarse-ground Japanese buckwheat (mainly from Shinshu and Hokkaido) and duck dishes. Detailed dashi ratios and a line saying 'check allergies before ordering' could not be confirmed, so they were removed.

shinise.tv・narakko・下御門商店街公式によれば、鶴屋徳満は明治3.en: According to shinise.tv, narakko and the official Shimomikado shopping street site, Tsuruya Tokuman is a long-established shop founded in Meiji 31 (1898), independent from Tsuruya Hachiman of Osaka. The main shop is on the Shimomikado shopping street (29 Shimomikado-cho, Nara City), renovated in 2022 with a tea room. The famous 'Aoni-yoshi', originally rakugan, is a two-colour bar sweet made with kuzu, a presentation sweet connected to Princess Arisugawa's visit to Chūgūji. For the 1300th anniversary of the Heijō capital it made the five-colour 'Goen Kyokusui no En'.

shinise・retty・自社ECサイトが江戸期（1700年代）創業、18代目.en: shinise, Retty and the company's own online shop back up a founding in the Edo period (the 1700s), the 18th generation, the shop dog Kentaro, and the famous green onion–miso–cheese oyaki and nozawana oyaki. When it started making oyaki is not stated, so it was written loosely.

shiojitei.jp/cuisine/kiyoishi.html: 料理人が.en: shiojitei.jp/cuisine/kiyoishi.html: the chefs go to the Toshijima market in person to buy ingredients directly; eat each season's food in its season; Ise lobster, abalone, Matsusaka beef; ingredients also used as offerings to the gods; deft knife work in front of you.

small-life/nantokanko: 2011年12月開業、奈良公園内の.en: small-life / nantokanko: opened December 2011 in a renovated old house in Nara Park, near Kasuga Taisha. A chef who trained in Italy. About 15 quiches (conger eel and burdock, scallop and lemon cream, apple, etc.), red-wine cheesecake. Pastry of fertilised eggs, wholemeal flour, rye and cultured butter; organic vegetables mainly from Nara (Uratsuji Farm and others).

small-lifeの記事で、やすらぎの道沿い、店内は竹づくし、赤提灯『おでん・.en: A small-life article confirms: along Yasuragi-no-Michi; the inside is all bamboo; a red lantern reading 'oden & udon'; oden ¥100–400; salmon rice balls; the oden pot across the counter; open 17:00–26:00 (closed Tuesdays).

snowmonkey・kaiseki-tsumugi公式・patio-daimo.en: snowmonkey, the kaiseki-tsumugi official site, patio-daimon and a prefectural game blog back up Machida Tetsuya (born 1980, from Nagano), Machida's wife 由起子, training at Tsurukō in Kanazawa, opening in March 2022, a Taishō-era storehouse in Patio Daimon, 100% buckwheat soba, and Utsukushigahara Plateau venison with Nagano honey and balsamic.

sobauchi-japanは粕谷俊明が高校時代から通った戸隠の宿坊『山里』で曽.en: sobauchi-japan records that Kashiya Toshiaki trained for about 1 year 8 months under Sonehara Takehiko at the Togakushi temple lodging 'Yamazato', frequented since high school, and opened in 1994; the Togakushi style of rolling round with a single rolling pin, which machines cannot reproduce; about 70% buckwheat; and bocchi-mori portions. A Hankei (Kyoto Shimbun, hankei500) headline: 'On days when I'm not in the right frame of mind for making soba, I sometimes close the shop.'

sobaweb報告で自家製粉の二八そば・細打ち・黒い星が少ない白色系・喉越し良く.en: A sobaweb report confirms in-house-milled nihachi soba, thin-cut, a whitish type with few dark specks, smooth to swallow, the duck dipping soba well reviewed, and fair prices. An nta article confirms a sweet, gentle dashi of thick-shaved aged bonito and the duck dipping soba. 4travel confirms it closes when the soba sells out and gives generous portions (plain soba about ¥650). 587-3 Daimon-chō, on the south side of Zenkoji Daihongan.

sweetsguide.jp と lumierellc.net によれば、Mie.en: According to sweetsguide.jp and lumierellc.net, Miel Yakigashi Koubou is an allergy-friendly baked-sweets workshop run by Lumiere LLC (Shikama-ku Kamo 339-8). No egg, dairy or wheat is brought in; made with rice flour, potato starch, soy milk, sugar, rice or rapeseed oil, almond and aluminium-free baking powder. Offers butter-free madeleines, baked doughnuts, cookies, soy-milk pudding and allergy-friendly cakes. Founded from the wish that children with allergies could eat the same treats as everyone else. The representative's name is not listed.

tabelog 24018534: JR鳥羽駅2分の食事処、生牡蠣・浜焼き・刺身.en: Tabelog 24018534: a restaurant 2 minutes from JR Toba Station; raw oysters, grilled seafood, sashimi, shellfish, Ise lobster. Reviews: the real taste of Toba while waiting for a train; the shellfish and Ise lobster are delicious.

tabelog 24020560: 2019年の大晦日から焼肉創の裏に増設、締め.en: Tabelog 24020560: added behind Yakiniku Sou from New Year's Eve 2019, for a bowl to finish the night; rich coarse-filtered shoyu ramen, Matsusaka beef offal ramen (¥1,100), fried gyoza, famous chicken wings. Hot Pepper: win an arm-wrestling match for a discount.

tabelog 24020730: 2024年1月1日オープン、中華料理店トント.en: Tabelog 24020730: opened 1 January 2024 in the former Chinese restaurant Tonton, near Toba Station; large and extra-huge portions, free extra-large rice; fried chicken, miso katsu, tonkatsu and fried shrimp set meals.

tabelog が2012年3月11日開業（夫婦・町家）、nagano2shin.en: Tabelog backs up an opening on 11 March 2012 (a couple, in a townhouse); nagano2shin backs up the end of pizza service on 27 November 2021 and weekend takeout during the transition; naganogourmet backs up the move to a takeout sandwich shop that tends to sell out; hahahaishya backs up eat-in pizza at TIKU-Plus (tomato, cheese and basil ¥1,550). The origin of the cheeses (Okayama, Hokkaido, Nagano) could not be confirmed, so it was generalised.

tabelog は東山(ひがし茶屋街)の一軒家・町家・全29席(カウンター9/テ.en: Tabelog confirms: a detached townhouse in Higashiyama (Higashi Chaya district); 29 seats (9 counter / 4 tables / 16 in the 2nd-floor tatami room); hand-made soba and thin Kanazawa-style wheat udon; grated yam, kakiage, cold soba; no reservations; closes when sold out. Gurunavi backs up the basic information. The owner's name is not public.

tabelogで2024年4月6日オープン、18席（カウンター8・個室4・他6）.en: Tabelog confirms the opening on 6 April 2024, 18 seats (8 at the counter, 4 in a private room, 6 others), Izumi, Higashi-ku, right by Hisaya-odori Station. Gurunavi's kodawari page and the official site confirm hitsumabushi of domestic eel (binchōtan-grilled), Minami-Uonuma Koshihikari cooked in a clay pot, and seasonal kaiseki courses. The owner named in the shop name is not public, so null.

tabipressoで、フェリーから徒歩約8分の昔ながらのお好み焼き店、パイプ椅.en: tabipresso confirms an old-style okonomiyaki shop about 8 minutes on foot from the ferry, a simple, cluttered feel with folding chairs, Hiroshima-style layering, large good-quality oysters and a sweetish sauce. Anago chikuwa was unconfirmed and removed.

tanosu・kisspressで、梅澤糧穀（1920年創業）の福沢町の倉庫を改.en: tanosu and kisspress confirm: a renovated warehouse of Umezawa Ryokoku (founded 1920) in Fukusawa-cho; reopened on 29 July 2024 by the previous owner's daughter after about nine years, at first run alone; pesticide-free "Yume-hana" soybeans from Yumesaki; house-made yuba sashimi and Taiwanese-style soy milk.

tanosu・local-prime・budou-chan・公式(うさぎ)より。.en: From tanosu, local-prime, budou-chan and the official (Usagi) site. Opened 15 April 2022 on 2F of the Kamihata Building in front of Sanyo-Himeji Station. Known for a homemade black beef curry (three days' preparation), developed by the owner of Shokusaiya Usagi after researching curries across Japan, and five colours of cream soda. About 70 Fukunaga Green (melon + vanilla) a day. The number of spices varies by source: about 30, or 8–9.

tanosu・tekuteku両記事：オーナーはマクロビとの出会いから約2010.en: Both tanosu and tekuteku articles: the owner started making sweets around 2010 after discovering macrobiotics; active at the Children's Theatre in 2017; reopened on 1 April 2020 as a café and rental space in a renovated former inn at Higashi-Nobesue 1-69; a daily vegetable lunch using organic vegetables from Himeji Yuuki Yasai no Kai; baked sweets of brown-rice flour and okara (no wheat); the shoes-off rental space is used for concerts, exhibitions and more. The owner's real name could not be confirmed and is left out.

tanosu・食べログ・公式サイトで、株式会社HILO（代表 田中洋生）が平成1.en: tanosu, Tabelog and the official site confirm: HILO Co., Ltd. (田中洋生, representative) founded in June 2005 (Heisei 17); the representative is the second son of the owner of "Honke Tanaka no Yaki-anago", which closed in March 2019 (Reiwa 1); the main shop seats 35 (5 counter, 6 table, 24 tatami); a Q'Ul Himeji shop opened in April 2016 (Heisei 28).

tanosu（威海市で10年修行・現地で開業経験・牛骨＋約20種漢方・花椒・中国.en: Confirmed by tanosu (10 years' training in Weihai; ran a shop there; beef bone plus about 20 medicinal herbs; huajiao; staff from China; about 50 ingredients), kansai-kaiten (opened April 2026; first in Himeji; Shirasagi Bridge / Uzumi Gate site; about 60 ingredients) and budou-chan (half-price coupons for two pre-opening days). The number of ingredients varies between 50 and 60 by source.

tekuteku-himeji（東京出身・フランス料理修行・結婚を機に姫路へ・2.en: Confirmed by tekuteku-himeji: from Tokyo; trained in French cooking; moved to Himeji on marrying; opened 27 July 2012; moved from Kita-Hirano to Kamiyacho in June 2021; animal-shaped cutlery rests; oyster dishes; "true to deliciousness".

tera-buddha が善光寺39永代宿坊の一つ、体験型宿坊、笹寿司・胡麻豆腐.en: tera-buddha backs up: one of Zenkoji's 39 permanent temple lodgings; a hands-on temple stay; two styles, traditional shojin of sasa-zushi, sesame tofu and yuba, and the Italian-style 'THE SHOJIN'; use by companies, hospitals and sports groups combined with zazen.

the-nicole.com（自社サイト沿革）に、オーナー堀口微笑琉（1979年.en: the-nicole.com (company history) records owner Horiguchi Bishoru (born 1979 in Nishijin, training 1999–2006, Sorcier Umeda 2008, Kitchen&Cake NICOLE 2015, THE NICOLE Nishijin 2019, Menya Bishoru 2022, Nicole Naturelle 2023) and, for Nicole Naturelle, 'no egg, dairy, wheat flour or animal fat', 'gluten-free', 'vegan' and '100% domestic rice flour'. kyotopi.jp introduces the Western-confectionery × spice-curry hybrid format. Tabelog supports the address, hours and cash only.

toba-iwashitei.com: 答志島から活きた鰯を仕入れ生簀で保管、鰯.en: toba-iwashitei.com: live sardines bought from Toshijima and kept in a tank; with sardines freshness is everything, a specialist's skill; 3 minutes' walk from Toba Station. Tabelog 24001485: more than 50 sardine dishes (sashimi, kabayaki, sweet-simmered, fish balls, steamed, tempura and more).

toba.gr.jp/stay/1799: 天保元年(1830年)創業の老舗旅館.en: toba.gr.jp/stay/1799: a long-established inn founded in 1830 (Tenpō 1), 3 minutes' walk from Toba Station, overlooking Toba Bay. todaya.co.jp/tenchikai: an open live kitchen of about 10 m, a local-fish butchering show, hand-made stone-oven pizza, Japanese and Western dishes.

tobahotel.co.jp/cafe-lounge: オーシャンウイング入口.en: tobahotel.co.jp/cafe-lounge: on the entrance floor of the Ocean Wing, overlooking Toba Bay; lunch, seasonal afternoon tea and hotel-made sweets, by reservation until 17:00 the day before; a bar counter of a single slab of Mie horse chestnut. Tabelog: reopened after renovation on 25 March 2024.

tobahotel.co.jp/mondomisaki: オーシャンウイング3階.en: tobahotel.co.jp/mondomisaki: third floor of the Ocean Wing; resort washoku; Miketsukuni; the chefs go by boat to the Toshijima market; enjoyment from rare finds; Ise lobster, abalone, Matsusaka beef, Kumano beef, Ise red chicken, Matsusaka pork.

tobayakatabune.jp: 三重県唯一の屋形船、マリン沖田が船上での食.en: tobayakatabune.jp: the only houseboat in Mie Prefecture; Marine Okita opened it in 2014 with a dedicated boat after 60 years of serving meals on board; third-generation head chef Sasaki Daisuke; a rooftop observation deck; grilled Ise lobster, abalone and oysters.

tokaichi.comで加藤氏の経歴（広島駅前の店や原宿店を経て2020年3月.en: tokaichi.com confirms Kato's career (a shop in front of Hiroshima Station, a Harajuku shop, then opening in March 2020), the reopening on the site of the former Fukuchan with its name carried on, the oyster-and-lemon 'Hiroshima Washira no Kessho' sauce, and Sanno-yaki, seared cheese with shiso, shiitake in butter and more.

tokaichi.com及び食べログのレビュー・RCC記事で1946年10月創業.en: tokaichi.com, Tabelog reviews and an RCC article confirm founding in October 1946 (opened by the previous owner after repatriation from China), its spot in front of the Tokaichimachi tram stop, house roasting, the Moon Blend (from the former 'Moon' at Hiroshima Station), the Tokaichi service, and regulars aged 3 to 94.

torusが海から直接引く海水生簀（伊勢海老も泳ぎ、注文でお造りに）と元海女スタ.en: torus confirms a tank fed directly with seawater from the sea (Ise lobster swim in it too, and become sashimi to order) and the perfect grilling of a former ama diver on the staff. chirick describes large clams, hiogi scallops and turban shells grilled boldly right in front of you (no description of salt or soy seasoning by ingredient could be confirmed, so that line was removed).

v-trip/initialdmenが西院・五条通(阪急西院近く)、背脂醤油の『.en: v-trip / initialdmen confirm Saiin, Gojo-dori (near Hankyu Saiin), the back-fat-shoyu 'Ono ramen' (pork-bone based), snappy low-hydration straight noodles, the light 'Kyoto ramen', a free boiled egg on weekdays, and an atmosphere somewhere between a canteen, an izakaya and a ramen shop.

v-trip・kyotopi・gcjapan より、1974年創業・二条駅近く・.en: v-trip, kyotopi and gcjapan confirm founding in 1974, near Nijo Station, a Michelin Bib Gourmand, a queue-forming neighbourhood Chinese restaurant run by parent and child over two generations; at first mainly neighbourhood-Chinese standards, but the second generation went to Sichuan and introduced Sichuan cooking; the specialties terri-don / terri-don kinshi / hell portion, mapo tofu with Omi beef, tantanmen and suanla noodles.

vegansweets.jp（公式）・shop.vegansweets.jp・k.en: According to vegansweets.jp (official), shop.vegansweets.jp, kameoka-up and giftmall, representative Fujito Yoshiaki began a gluten-free, vegan diet after health problems following marriage and childbirth, and launched Vegan Sweets Courier in August 2015 wanting to spread 'guilt-free vegan sweets with no wheat (gluten-free), dairy (casein-free), egg or white sugar' (Courier Inc., Fukuine Goshonouchi-cho, Higashiyama-ku, Kyoto). The philosophy: 'what matters is not what you take in but what you leave out'. The signature 'Kurure' gets natural colours without colourants.

watobi.jpが花市銀蔵氏（碧南出身・16歳で大阪で割烹/寿司修業・1983.en: watobi.jp confirms Hanaichi Ginzo (from Hekinan; trained in kappo and sushi in Osaka from age 16; opened in Nishi-ku in 1983), no sign out front but a board under the eaves reading 'untouched, untasted', a policy of no kombu dashi, front-of-house by the chef's wife Toshie, daily buying at Yanagibashi Central Market, and cooking to order. menage.jp suggests a Michelin star, nagoya-meshi a handwritten menu of opening days, and hobogifu a wait of about two years.

web-komachi と mypl が2022年3月19日の善光寺仲見世でのオ.en: web-komachi and mypl back up the opening on Zenkoji Nakamise on 19 March 2022, operation by Oimo Biyori (main shop in Azumino), aging for over 60 days, and the 3 mm Zenkoji Kenpi made with a home-built machine. Kenpi flavours: chili pepper, honey butter, nori salt and sweet sugar.

web-komachi・rurubu・食べログで確認：大正期に清水民蔵が旅館を創.en: Confirmed on web-komachi, Rurubu and Tabelog: an inn founded in the Taishō era by 清水民蔵, renamed Izumiya Ryokan in 1950; the fifth generation, Shimizu Akira (about 30 years in Japanese cuisine), reopened it in April 2022 as a daifuku-and-whisky bar (a return to the origins). About 60 whiskies; the starter is a daifuku (can be taken home); the irori hearth is lit in winter.

web-komachi・ten-japan（吟屋グループ公式）・goguynet.en: Confirmed on web-komachi, ten-japan (Ginya Group official), goguynet and weekend-kanazawa: the Nagano branch is run by the Ginya group (Kawamoto Tenshi) under the supervision of Chuka Soba Kibi's Watanabe Yasuyuki; opened 12 December 2025 in the Gondo arcade (former Kaburamura site). The first Kanazawa shop opened in September 2025, created by Kanazawa's Menya Taiga. Light Chinese soba of hand-crumpled high-hydration noodles ¥900; a soup of pork, chicken and vegetables simmered 10 hours.

web-komachi・まいぷれ・ナガラボ・公式で確認：オーナーシェフ永岡祐二（.en: Confirmed on web-komachi, Mypl, Nagalabo and the official site: owner-chef Nagaoka Yuji (trained in Italy and at THE FUJIYA GOHONJIN) and Nagaoka's wife Kana (from HEIGORO) opened on 25 January 2019 in Hakoshimizu, Nagano City. An old house with herringbone floors, reservations only, the chef goes deep-sea fishing personally (winter yellowtail, blackthroat seaperch, bigfin reef squid), caponata of swordtip squid, and from 12 February 2020 sweets also by reservation.

web-komachi・長野CVBで確認：善光寺門前の築約100年古民家、無添加.en: Confirmed on web-komachi and Nagano CVB: an old house about 100 years old by Zenkoji; about 30 kinds of additive-free hand-made chiffon (6–8 a day); free-range eggs; closes when sold out; the strawberry parfait uses strawberries from Nakano City, Nagano, served December to end of May. The name 菓恋 means 'fell in love with sweets' (the 'cute' theory was wrong, so removed).

web-komachi（p71893）は新小路カフェを1960年代の紙問屋倉庫（.en: web-komachi (p71893) describes Shinkoji Cafe as a converted 1960s paper wholesaler's warehouse (SHINKOJI North Building), run by three homemakers, using carefully chosen ingredients, house-made miso, Koshihikari from Aga in Niigata and vegetables from partner farms, with a health-minded high-protein, low-calorie menu (fish set ¥880).

weekend-kanazawa と food-japon: 明治42年(190.en: weekend-kanazawa and food-japon: founded Meiji 42 (1909), at the entrance to the Higashi Chaya district. The famous dish is a soy-flavoured black omurice (beef and pork simmered a long time in soy sauce, fried with rice and wrapped in a thin omelette). Simmering takes about 5 hours (another article says 7–8). Hayashi rice, napolitan and more too. About 115 years of history.

weekend-kanazawa と food-japon: 諸江町の手打ちそば.en: weekend-kanazawa and food-japon: a hand-made soba shop in Moroe-machi. Buys Japanese whole buckwheat directly and stone-mills only the day's amount in-house, making thin soto-ichi soba. The origin of the buckwheat is posted by hand at the front (Ōno in Fukui, Oguni in Yamagata, Noto town, Ibaraki and others). Duck dipping soba ¥1,580, cold soba with tempura ¥1,620, summer-only sudachi soba. manpuku-kanazawa backs up prices and location.
