The signature 'Kurahachi-yaki' uses crisp noodles custom-made by a noodle maker, topped with raw egg and cooked to the guest's liking. Plenty of toppings such as oysters, kimchi and avocado. (Pesticide-free vegetables could not be confirmed and were removed.)

公式・街画コム等によると、八丁堀・YMCA専門学校南側の黒基調のお好み焼店。手押.en: According to the official site, a local town-guide site and others, a black-toned okonomiyaki shop in Hatchobori, south of the YMCA college. The signature is meat-and-egg soba with extra-thin fresh noodles, pressed by hand. The super-spicy signature 'Goku-yaki' piles lots of chilli on habanero-kneaded noodles. Seared cheese too. Popular with local office workers.

公式・食べログによると、宮島表参道商店街の自家焙煎珈琲店。古民家風の建物で202.en: According to the official site and Tabelog, a house-roasting coffee shop on Miyajima's Omotesando shopping street. An old-house-style building, with the 2nd floor renovated in October 2024. Also sells roasted beans and handmade cakes. (Oyster pasta could not be confirmed and was removed.)

公式会社概要（2001年5月設立・代表向井昭博・2004年ネット通販・2011年.en: Confirmed by the official company profile (founded May 2001; representative 向井昭博; online sales from 2004; Himeji Castle shop March 2011; a spirit of challenge that does not fear failure; Harima-nada) and searches (Harima White Pearl = virgin oysters that have never spawned, farmed at Ieshima, with little harshness or bitterness). The MAFF Kinki Regional Agricultural Administration Office inbound case-study URL is official but now returns 403, so its text could not be re-fetched.

公式店舗ページで、料理長は金澤忍、みつ川の味と技を継承、金沢では珍しい赤酢のシャ.en: The official shop page confirms: head chef Kanazawa Shinobu, carrying on the flavours and skill of Mitsukawa; red-vinegar sushi rice, rare in Kanazawa; buying from Omicho and Kanazawa Port; the famous blackthroat-seaperch hand roll; original local sake; Michelin Bib Gourmand 2016.

公式沿革・ホットペッパーより、1950年(昭和25)に屋台で創業、一乗寺の八坪店.en: The official history and HotPepper confirm founding in 1950 (Showa 25) as a street stall, settling in an eight-tsubo shop in Ichijoji, one source of Kyoto's chicken-paitan / back-fat ramen. With the creed 'no gimmicks, no cut corners', paitan of whole chicken and chicken feet + aged soy tare + back fat added after; the Kawaramachi Rokkaku shop is on the 1st floor of Rokkaku Kaikan.

公式（haru-nara.com）とcoolnaraで、代表は中林大樹、2011.en: The official site (haru-nara.com) and coolnara confirm: owner 中林大樹; opened October 2011; a Naramachi townhouse over 120 years old (tatami room facing the garden). Twice-ground hamburg on an iron plate with demi-glace, head-on fried shrimp you can eat whole, Yamato beef rice bowl, pudding of Uemura Bokujo milk, tartar sauce with Narazuke.

公式（kudzu.co.jp）およびintojapanwarakuで、井上天極堂.en: The official site (kudzu.co.jp) and intojapanwaraku confirm Inoue Tengyokudo, founded in 1870 (Meiji 3), makes Yoshino pure kuzu by the 'Yoshino-sarashi' method dating from the late Edo period. Kuzu mochi is made after ordering and served in about 10 minutes (cold outside, warm inside); also kuzu noodles, kuzu-yu and kuzu udon; the main shop is on the former site of Tōdaiji's west great gate.

公式（machishin）はまちづくり振興機構運営、大手門駐車場内・本町68、喫.en: The official site (machishin) confirms: run by the Urban Development Promotion Organization; inside the Otemon car park, Honmachi 68; café (coffee, cappuccino, etc.); a Yamazaki convenience corner; free wheelchair loans; Himeji Castle goods. The Himeji tourism site lists almond toast ¥458 and rice-koji amazake ¥356.

公式（owst）とホットペッパーが、昭和26年（1951年）創業・流川の老舗で創.en: The official site (owst) and HotPepper report an old Nagarekawa shop founded in Showa 26 (1951), 68 years in business, carrying on the previous generation's taste unchanged; soup simmered over 12 hours and a secret tare aged 3 weeks; over 20 side dishes (fried rice is popular); and its place as a finishing bowl until 3 a.m.

公式（owst）とモワ企画の告知が、2025年12月10日に本通4-1で開業、モ.en: The official site (owst) and a Mowa Kikaku announcement report: opened on 10 December 2025 at Hondori 4-1; run by Mowa Kikaku (a young company with several formats in and outside the prefecture); the Legend Dream Gyoza (Aichi pork, Aomori garlic, from about ¥109); unusual gyoza such as tom yum, mapo, coriander and cheese; 50,000 sold over 5 days at Osaka Craft Gyoza Fes 2026; low prices of ¥99–109 a gyoza and beer at ¥190-odd; and the motto 'filling the heart and the stomach'. The phrase 'safe, delicious, fast', winged gyoza and big chicken cutlet could not be confirmed in any source and were removed.

公式（owst）：兵庫県姫路市立町71、播磨うまいもん居酒屋、穴子（焼き1,08.en: Official site (owst): Tatemachi 71, Himeji, Hyogo; an izakaya of Harima local food; conger eel (grilled ¥1,080 / tempura ¥880 / chazuke ¥690); Himeji oden (ginger soy sauce); the homemade shrimp shumai (¥470) is popular. Tabelog: sourced from Murotsu and Boze ports and contract farmers; 20 seats. ma8coro: the chef-owner recommends the shumai. ameblo: covered in celebrity autographs.

公式（spirit.html）で『純粋に食を楽しむ』理念、愛知の香り米に赤酢2種.en: The official site (spirit.html) confirms the philosophy 'simply enjoying food', rice of Aichi fragrant rice with two red vinegars + white vinegar, and Yamako tuna. The Tabelog relocation page confirms the opening in Shinsakae on 1 June 2017 → move to Nishi-ku on 17 May 2022, Joshin Station, and a 2019 Michelin listing (Plate). Firm claims of Ise Bay / Mikawa Bay, karasumi hand rolls, Kuwana clams and piece counts could not be supported by sources and were generalised or removed.

公式（yukou-kiyo.com）が麺屋優光グループ2号店、仲間思想、店長名を.en: The official site (yukou-kiyo.com) confirms the Menya Yukou group's 2nd shop, the companion philosophy, the shop being named after its manager, noodles made every morning at the company's own noodle works, and chāshū simmered over 2 hours with the thickness chosen at the counter. kyoto.tips and search results confirm the opening on 1 October 2018 in Ichijoji, and that the No. 1 'Gift' is a shoyu ramen of short-neck clam and flying-fish dashi; the menu is Gift / Simple / Shirushi at ¥800 each.

共用フライヤーで唐揚げ・天ぷらと同じ油を使う。マキシマムの原材料にも要確認。.en: Shared fryer, same oil as karaage and tempura. Check the ingredients of the "Maximum" seasoning too.

内戦下のグアテマラで育った店主は『毎週のように校門にばらばらの遺体が捨てられてい.en: The owner, who grew up in Guatemala during the civil war, recalls a boyhood when 'almost every week dismembered bodies were dumped at the school gate', and decided to leave, not expecting to live to 25. Married a wife from Hiroshima and came to know the memory of the bombing through atomic-bomb survivor parents-in-law and the wife's Christian community.

内戦下のグアテマラに生まれ育ち、高校卒業後に出国。米ニューオーリンズの叔父のもと.en: Born and raised in Guatemala during the civil war, and left the country after high school. Trained at Italian and French restaurants under an uncle in New Orleans, learning the basics of cooking such as knife work and handling meat. While working at an upscale hotel in Honolulu, met and married Makiko, a native of Hiroshima, and moved to Hiroshima in 1995. Then trained at the renowned Hiroshima okonomiyaki shop Hassho (Yagenbori) before going independent, opening a shop near JR Yokogawa Station in 2000.

冷しかき揚げそば（430円)など、コストパフォーマンスの良いメニューと、コシのあ.en: Hands-on reviews praise good-value dishes such as cold kakiage soba (¥430) and the firm bite of the noodles.

善光寺参拝後に身体を温め、心を整えるための食を提供。お朝事の終了時刻に合わせて開.en: Food to warm the body and settle the mind after visiting Zenkoji. It opens to match the end of the morning service, aiming to give a taste of shojin as the close of the visit.

What it serves is solely 'Kyoto downtown betayaki', neither Osaka- nor Hiroshima-style. Little cabbage, a firmer batter cooked crisp and fragrant on the griddle is the essence. The owner stands at the counter and cooks them one at a time on the griddle in front of you — the closeness of a small okonomiyaki shop is the charm. In the Kiyamachi / Pontocho area, it keeps its noren up late into the night.

Expanded to Chiba in 2010 but struggled, and developed a kombu-dashi 'Kansai Mild'. Calls itself one of the Big 3 of ankake spaghetti alongside Yokoi and one other. 奈良グルメ図鑑・店舗STORES・公式で、大正2年（1913）創業で元々は餅屋、.en: The Nara Gourmet Guide, the shop's STORES page and the official site confirm: founded in Taishō 2 (1913), originally a mochi shop; the tea house 'Rokubōan' in a Naramachi townhouse; the famous 'Naramachi dango' (Yamato tea, miso and azuki on uirō) and 'Kōshin-san', modelled on the migawari-zaru charm; warabi mochi and shaved ice.

奈良地酒めぐり.en: a tour of Nara local sake

奈良市紀寺町565-1、2025年11月7日オープン。国産米粉100%・無添加・.en: 565-1 Kidera-cho, Nara City; opened 7 November 2025. A specialist in chewy bagels of 100% Japanese rice flour, additive-free and gluten-free. The owner is a former firefighter and paramedic who discovered rice-flour bread in October 2024 and started from scratch. Parking for one car behind the shop. Rice-flour bread classes too.

奈良新聞の記事で、1971年創業、村上義廣・三和子夫妻が54年営み、2025年9.en: A Nara Shimbun article confirms: founded in 1971; the couple 村上義廣 and 三和子 ran it for 54 years; in September 2025 the couple's eldest son 力 became the second generation; menma and wakame brought back after 30 years; and the chashu returned to the founding method, simmered over 5 hours with Kōchi ginger, chicken carcasses and chicken feet.

奈良時代、遣唐使によって日本に伝えられた豆腐文化.en: tofu culture, brought to Japan by envoys to Tang China in the Nara period

契約農家からの無農薬野菜を多用しており、野菜の質と鮮度へのこだわりは高い。コース.en: Heavy use of pesticide-free vegetables from contract farmers, with high standards for vegetable quality and freshness. The course includes plenty of vegetable dishes.

奥村社長は「生まれて初めてラーメンを食べられて、感動したと言ってくれる人もいる。.en: President Okumura says, "Some people tell us they were moved to be able to eat ramen for the first time in their lives. We'd be happy if it reaches many people"

奥浅草の静かな一角にある本格インドカレー屋さん.en: "an authentic Indian curry shop in a quiet corner of Oku-Asakusa"

女性に人気！コリコリ肌にいい.en: Popular with women! Crunchy, good for the skin

女性に人気！肌にいい！.en: Popular with women! Good for the skin!

女性に人気！解熱の作用アリ！.en: Popular with women! Said to bring down fever!

妥協しない技で寿司に向き合い、心を込めておもてなし致します.en: We face the sushi with uncompromising skill and welcome you with all our heart

妥協のない仕込みと旬の食材が織り成すおもてなし.en: hospitality woven from uncompromising preparation and seasonal ingredients

姫路の名物・穴子（アナゴ）を使った穴子丼。天ぷらや揚げ物、丼ものも提供する。.en: Conger-eel bowls using anago, a Himeji specialty. Also tempura, fried dishes and rice bowls.

姫路の地酒と姫路おでん本舗.en: Himeji no Jizake to Himeji Oden Honpo

姫路まちづくり振興機構の公式ページと好古園資料で、好古園は1992年開園・総面積.en: The Himeji City Urban Development Promotion Organization's official page and Koko-en materials confirm: Koko-en opened in 1992, covers 3.5 ha and was laid out on the site of the west residences; Kassui-ken is the garden's restaurant, serving conger eel dishes, the Hime set meal and more.

姫路みたい特集・神戸新聞(Yahoo!転載)・BASE通販より。NPO法人姫路こ.en: From a Himeji Mitai feature, the Kobe Shimbun (via Yahoo!) and BASE online shop. A Type-B continuing-employment support farm (Yamada-cho Makino 619-1) run by the NPO Himeji Kokoro social-welfare organization. Sells gluten-free "Poritto" snacks made from naturally grown rice flour (bronze at the 2022 Habatake contest) and dried rice-flour noodles directly and online. Holds a Hatake Café once a month.

姫路れんこん饅頭かにあんかけ.en: Himeji lotus-root dumpling with thick crab sauce

姫路地区手をつなぐ育成会.en: Himeji District 'Hand in Hand' support association

姫路城〜姫路駅 · ベジ・グルテンフリー.en: Himeji Castle to Himeji Station · vegetarian and gluten-free

姫路城下町という歴史的な街並みの中に、ブラックを基調とした都会的な外観とオレンジ.en: In the historic castle-town streets, the urban black exterior and orange neon tubes stand out, and passers-by drawn in by the sweet smell of baking have become a familiar sight.

姫路市亀井町、瀬戸内海の恵みを活かした海鮮料理店.en: Kameimachi, Himeji: a seafood restaurant making the most of the Seto Inland Sea

姫路市十二所前町、播磨灘産穴子を専門とする.en: Juniisho-mae-cho, Himeji; specialises in Harima-nada conger eel

姫路市本町68 家老屋敷B棟.en: Honmachi 68, Himeji; chief-retainer residence building B

姫路市本町（姫路城前）.en: Honmachi, Himeji (in front of Himeji Castle)

姫路店の「朝フレンチマン」（平日午前・10:00〜、¥770）はホットサンド＋サ.en: The Himeji shop's "Morning Frenchman" (weekday mornings from 10:00, ¥770) comes with a hot sandwich, salad and a drink. It drew attention as a morning menu unique to the Himeji shop, timed to the building's opening hours.

姫路経済新聞(3周年記事)・TANOSU取材・公式サイトより。店主貝塚暁子さんが.en: From the Himeji Keizai Shimbun (3rd-anniversary article), a TANOSU feature and the official site. The owner, 貝塚暁子, opened in 2019 (3rd anniversary on 8 August 2022). "Organic junkie" with homemade koji seasonings and organic ingredients. Wheat flour and sugar avoided as far as possible; sweets use barley flour and are gluten-free; the pound cake is 100% Kyushu barley flour.

姫路経済新聞・Kiss PRESS・Food Diversity・公式サイトより.en: From the Himeji Keizai Shimbun, Kiss PRESS, Food Diversity and the official site. A former izakaya owner opened on 21 March 2023 in Shirakuni-kitashinmachi. A fully vegan restaurant supervised by Tokyo's Saido. The signature "sai-men" are colourful noodles made from vegetables. Sweets are made by Ibuki of Okayama, free of animal ingredients and the 8 major allergens. The name comes from 菜 (vegetables), sai-men, Saido and sai (rhinoceros) (official).

姫路経済新聞・budou-chan: オーナー見満みなみは2012年に製菓学校卒.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun and budou-chan: the owner, 見満みなみ, graduated from confectionery school in 2012, studied pastry and cooking in Germany and France for about 8 years, and on 1 October 2025 opened "Miinas", a gluten-free organic café, at Shikisai 638-1, Himeji (right by JR Yobe Station, Aoyama-kita Bldg). About 31 tsubo, 6 tables, 16 seats; everything available to take away. Serves bagels and burgers of 100% domestic organic rice flour. A pet-grooming salon (深山梨江) is attached, separated by a wall.

姫路経済新聞・tanosuで、2025年11月28日開業、店長 菅原早穂子、自家.en: The Himeji Keizai Shimbun and tanosu confirm: opened 28 November 2025; the manager; house-roasted, house-ground almond butter (Classic/Crunch); almond-milk soup; butter chicken curry with 18 spices, almond butter and almond dukkah.

姫路経済新聞：料理長・大庭拓哉（和食歴30年）、店長・松岡加奈子、2025年11.en: Himeji Keizai Shimbun: head chef 大庭拓哉 (30 years in Japanese cuisine); manager 松岡加奈子; opened 27 November 2025; in the Gran Festa basement; fish from the ports of Murotsu, Boze and Shikama; whole sea bream tempura, Himeji oden, live conger eel. KissPress: the name comes from the owner's surname, written in hiragana. Himeji Festa official site: Gran Festa 5-ban-gai, opened 27 November.

姫路駅直結の地下街グランフェスタ内にあり、雨の日でも濡れずにアクセスできる利便性.en: Inside Gran Festa, the underground mall connected to Himeji Station, so you can get there without getting wet on rainy days; popular with business people and travellers for the convenience.

季節に移ろい暦があるように.en: just as the seasons turn and the calendar moves on

季節のプリンは卵・乳を含む可能性。ぽりっと・米粉麺は植物性。.en: The seasonal pudding may contain egg and dairy. Poritto and the rice-flour noodles are plant-based.

季節の和菓子と選りすぐりの日本茶、抹茶。喫茶では季節の和菓子と薄茶のセットのほか.en: Seasonal Japanese sweets with selected Japanese teas and matcha. Besides sets of a seasonal sweet and thin tea, there's a 'whisk-your-own' matcha experience and a full tea seating (seasonal sweet, thick tea, dry sweets, thin tea), plus white shaved ice in summer. Takeaway thick-tea lattes too.

季節の商品。一晩かけて抽出したエルダーフラワーエキス、と店の説明。花・砂糖・炭酸.en: Seasonal. Elderflower extract steeped overnight, the shop says. Flowers, sugar and soda, with no animal ingredients. Ask about the house-made syrup's ingredients.

季節の小鉢 / 本日の鮮魚四点盛り / 特選黒毛和牛のすき焼き / ツナとアボカ.en: Seasonal small dish / four kinds of today's fresh fish / special Japanese black wagyu sukiyaki / taco-style tuna and avocado salad / shrimp tempura and corn fritter / shibazuke grated-daikon udon / warabi-mochi.

季節の有機野菜のせいろ蒸し.en: seasonal organic vegetables steamed in a seiro

季節の野菜と牛肉の個別陶板.en: individual ceramic plate of seasonal vegetables and beef

季節の野菜をたっぷり使い、20種類以上の食材を一皿に盛り込む『おばんざいランチ』.en: The 'obanzai lunch', with plenty of seasonal vegetables and over 20 ingredients on one plate. The 'low-salt lunch' with Hiroshima rice or brown rice, held to 2 g of salt or less, is also a signature.

季節の食材をふんだんに使用した特別コース。※要予約。11:30〜14:30。.en: A special course making generous use of seasonal ingredients. *Reservation required. 11:30–14:30.

季節の食材をふんだんに使用した贅沢なコース。18:00〜21:30、2〜4名様。.en: A luxurious course making generous use of seasonal ingredients. 18:00–21:30, 2–4 guests. The ¥13,200 course includes a cake with a message for birthdays and anniversaries.

季節の食材を活かしたフランス懐石おまかせコース。 烏賊を細麺状に仕立てた『烏賊の.en: A French-kaiseki omakase course built on seasonal ingredients. Memorable dishes lightly cross the line between French and Japanese, such as 'squid sōmen' with squid cut into fine noodles, spiny lobster gratin and sea bream chazuke.

季節の食材を生かした会席料理（¥3,800の「金城」から¥9,900の「福寿」ま.en: Kaiseki built on seasonal ingredients (from the ¥3,800 Kinjō to the ¥9,900 Fukuju). Starter, sashimi, grilled dish, seasonal dish and dessert, overseen by head chef Chikazawa, who is recognised as an Aichi Master Craftsman.

季節もの。2024年10月の店頭ボードに掲出。.en: Seasonal. Posted on the in-store board in October 2024.

季節や仕入れ状況で.en: depending on the season and sourcing

季節折々のおいしさを、くつろぎながら.en: each season's flavours, enjoyed at your ease

季節限定。カレーのとろみに小麦粉。.en: Seasonal. Wheat flour thickens the curry.

季節限定。価格は店内表示のみ。おでん出汁＝昆布・鰹節・醤油（小麦）。.en: Seasonal. Prices shown only in the shop. Oden broth = kombu, katsuobushi, soy sauce (wheat).

季節限定。牡蠣は北海道厚岸町産と店の掲示にある。つゆは小麦醤油。.en: Seasonal. The shop's notice says the oysters are from Akkeshi, Hokkaido. The broth is wheat soy sauce.

季節限定の「根付き天然せりそば」（鰹出汁の温つゆに天然の根付きせりと豚バラ肉）が.en: The seasonal "wild seri soba, roots and all" (wild seri with roots and pork belly in hot bonito-dashi broth) was judged to surpass the standard of a standing-soba shop.

季節限定（4月〜10月）。なすを揚げるため小麦の混入、つゆも小麦醤油。.en: Seasonal (April–October). The eggplant is fried, so wheat contamination, and the broth is wheat soy sauce too.

宇宙一のまぜそば.en: the best mazesoba in the universe

宇治金時ミルク.en: Uji matcha, sweet beans and milk

宇田川町 / 渋谷駅徒歩5分.en: Udagawacho / 5 min walk from Shibuya Station

守り続け、磨き続けてきた老舗の味.en: an old shop's taste, kept and polished over the years

安くてうまい、気軽に立ち寄れる街の中華立ち飲み屋として地元に根付いてきた。.en: Rooted locally as a cheap, tasty neighbourhood Chinese stand-up bar you can drop into easily.

安心して食べられる.en: you can eat with peace of mind

安政元年.en: the first year of the 安政 era

安曇野のジャズファンブログが、店主自作管理のJBLランサーからジャズが流れ、オー.en: An Azumino jazz fan's blog backs up an owner who plays jazz through JBL Lancer speakers the owner built and maintains, and who talks about audio and the history of Zenkoji. ekiten and Retty back up hand-made soba (Nagano buckwheat) along Nakamise and entrances on two sides.

安曇野市に本拠を置く信州の郷土食専門店。 長野・善光寺の仲見世通り（参道）に漬物.en: A Shinshu local-food specialist based in Azumino City. It has a tenant shop on Zenkoji's Nakamise-dori (the temple approach) inside the long-established pickle shop Takahashi Shoten. The main shop is in Swan Garden Azumino, famous for letting you grill the oyaki you buy at an irori hearth where a charcoal fire burns all year.

完全なグルテンフリー専門店であるかどうかは確認が取れていません.en: it has not been confirmed whether it is a completely gluten-free specialist

完全な肉料理専門店のため、植物性食材のみのコースは提供されておらず、ヴィーガン対.en: A meat-only restaurant, so there is no plant-only course; vegan handling is impossible.

完全に独立した厨房で調理.en: cooked in a completely separate kitchen

完全グルテンフリー米粉パン専門店.en: a fully gluten-free rice-flour bread specialist

完全ヴィーガン。動物性原材料・乳製品・精製糖・うまみ調味料・アルコール調味料は不.en: Fully vegan. No animal ingredients, dairy, refined sugar, MSG or alcohol seasonings.

完全予約制かつ少人数対応の個室あり。食材は予約ごとに個別調達するスタイルで、事前.en: Reservations only, with private rooms for small groups. Ingredients are sourced individually per booking, making it easy to pass on detailed requests in advance.

完全予約制で少人数制のため、事前に食の制限を伝える余地がある。オーナーが素材を個.en: Reservation-only with small numbers, so there is room to explain dietary restrictions in advance. A small independent shop where the owner picks ingredients individually, so it may be flexible.

完全予約制のおまかせ懐石で、予約・来店ともに日本語対応が基本。英語メニューや英語.en: Reservation-only omakase kaiseki; booking and visiting are basically in Japanese. No information on an English menu or English-speaking staff.

完全予約制のため、事前にアレルギー・食材の希望を伝える機会が確保されている。少人.en: Reservations only, so there is a guaranteed chance to pass on allergies and ingredient requests in advance. Small (15 seats), so the chef can easily consider each guest's situation.

完全予約制の懐石料理店。英語メニューあり（訪日外国人向け対応）。靴を脱いで入店す.en: A reservation-only kaiseki restaurant. English menu available (for overseas visitors). Tatami rooms where you take your shoes off. Cards accepted and set up for overseas guests, but communication is mainly in Japanese.

完全予約制の高級イタリアン。日本語での事前コミュニケーション（アレルギー等の申告.en: An upscale reservation-only Italian. Advance communication in Japanese (declaring allergies and so on) is essential; no confirmed information on English service.

完全予約制の高級鉄板焼き店で、英語メニューや英語対応スタッフの情報は確認できず。.en: An upscale reservation-only teppanyaki; no information on an English menu or English-speaking staff could be found. Booking and visiting in Japanese seem to be assumed.

完全十割玄蕎麦 — つなぎ粉を一切使わず、国産玄蕎麦粉100%だけで打った蕎麦。.en: Pure 100% genso-ba — soba made only from 100% Japanese whole-buckwheat flour, with no binder flour at all. The owner stone-grinds heirloom whole buckwheat bought from contract farmers in Niigata and Nagano, and makes the noodles fresh after every order.

完全禁煙。個室あり（2〜4名・4〜6名・VIP 4〜8名）。テイクアウト・デリバ.en: Completely non-smoking. Private rooms (2–4, 4–6, VIP 4–8 people). Takeaway and delivery (Uber Eats) are available, so ingredients can be checked at home with a takeaway.

完全紹介制・会員制で、既存客からの紹介なしでは予約不可。日本語対応が前提の非常に.en: Introduction and membership only; cannot be booked without a referral from an existing guest. A very exclusive full-omakase restaurant that assumes Japanese.

完全紹介制・完全オマカーセのため、予約時に食の制約を細かく伝える機会があり、シェ.en: Being introduction-only and fully omakase, there is a chance to explain dietary restrictions in detail at booking, and the chef can consider individual handling.

完全菜食の店。クリームは植物性。ただしパンは食パン＝小麦。.en: A fully plant-based shop. The cream is plant-based. But the bread is shokupan = wheat.

官公式サイト(mu-sea.com)と伊勢志摩観光ナビ、食べログで確認：2013.en: Confirmed on the official site (mu-sea.com), the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and Tabelog: founded December 2013; the Toba Station branch opened on 7 March 2021; house-roasted coffee and spice-curry bread; a seaside roastery.

定休日（但し祝日の場合は翌日）」.en: closed (or the next day if a holiday)'

定番の酢味噌に麦味噌を使う場合＝小麦。醤油も同様。.en: If the standard vinegared miso uses barley miso = wheat. Same with soy sauce.

定番メニューがベジタリアンで、ヴィーガン対応もしてもらえます.en: the standard menu is vegetarian, and they can do vegan too

定食 ¥1,200。つけ醤油＝小麦。.en: Set meal ¥1,200. Dipping soy sauce = wheat.

定食 ¥1,300。つけ醤油＝小麦。.en: Set meal ¥1,300. Dipping soy sauce = wheat.

定食・ポークカツカレー・家庭料理.en: Set meals, pork-cutlet curry, home cooking

実家が魚屋兼仕出し業という食の環境で育ち、夫の病気を機に2000年に自身の店を開.en: Grew up around food in a family that ran a fish shop and catering business, and opening a shop in 2000 after a husband's illness was the starting point as a cooking expert.

実店舗はございません。通販をご利用ください。」.en: We have no physical shop. Please use mail order."

客席にも持ち込み禁止をご協力いただいております.en: we also ask that outside items not be brought to the tables

宮島かき氷処.r: みやじまかきごおりどころ

宮島の海で獲れた新鮮な穴子と牡蠣を、訪れる人にその場で味わってもらうこと。.en: Letting visitors taste, on the spot, fresh anago and oysters caught in the sea off Miyajima.

宮島クラフトコーラ「Musetta Cola」。スパイス・レモンのシロップ。原材.en: Miyajima craft cola 'Musetta Cola'. A syrup of spices and lemon. Ingredient label not confirmed.

宮島・厳島神社のすぐ近く、賑わう商店街から少し離れた静かな一角に建つ古民家を生か.en: An ocean-view café in an old house in a quiet corner a little away from the busy shopping street, right by Itsukushima Shrine on Miyajima. In a characterful space that keeps the old beams and pillars, antique furniture, sofas and refined tables are arranged, and every seat looks out on the great torii and the Seto Inland Sea. The 1st floor is the café, and the 2nd floor is run as 'private inn lente' with two rooms.

宮島・表参道商店街（清盛通り近く、厳島神社参道）.en: Miyajima, Omotesando shopping street (near Kiyomori-dori, the approach to Itsukushima Shrine)

宮島博多屋ブログとnohgakuで、表参道で唯一の宮島牡蠣生産者直営店であること.en: The Miyajima Hakataya blog and nohgaku confirm it is the only shop on Omotesando run directly by a Miyajima oyster producer, relatively cheap because run by the producer, grilled fresh at the front (plump), the recommendation to eat them whole with a toothpick and no seasoning, and a creamy, pleasantly salty taste.

宮島名物のお好み焼きともみじ饅頭を組み合わせた独自のおやつ『おこもみじ』を考案し.en: Devised 'Okomomiji', an original snack combining Miyajima's famous okonomiyaki and momiji manjū, and registered it as the shop's trademark.

宮島産の穴子と牡蠣を使った郷土料理。看板はあなごめしや焼き牡蠣などの穴子・牡蠣料.en: Local dishes using Miyajima anago and oysters. The signatures are anago and oyster dishes such as anagomeshi and grilled oysters.

宮崎の冷や汁は麦味噌が伝統＝大麦。焼き鯵・鰹だしも入る。.en: Miyazaki hiyajiru traditionally uses barley miso = barley. Also has grilled horse mackerel and bonito dashi.

宮崎の冷汁は焼き魚（主に鯵）と味噌が基本。麦味噌の場合、麦＝大麦は日本の表示義務.en: Miyazaki hiyajiru is basically grilled fish (mainly horse mackerel) and miso. If barley miso, barley isn't subject to Japan's mandatory labeling.

宮崎の甘口醤油で作る自家製醤油餡＝小麦。.en: House soy-sauce glaze made with Miyazaki's sweet soy sauce = wheat.

宮崎の甘口醤油（マルタニ醤油）を使用＝小麦。.en: Uses Miyazaki's sweet soy sauce (Marutani soy sauce) = wheat.

宮崎は麦味噌の産地であり、なめろうの味噌が麦味噌なら大麦＝グルテン。.en: Miyazaki is barley-miso country; if the namero's miso is barley miso, barley = gluten.

宮崎は麦味噌文化圏、味噌の種類を要確認。だしは鰹。.en: Miyazaki is barley-miso country; check the miso type. The dashi is bonito.

宮治グループ公式で運営会社・5店舗・四間道の隠れ家立地・『贅沢な大人のためのやき.en: The official Miyaji Group site confirms the operating company, 5 shops, a hideaway location in Shikemichi and the concept 'a yakitori shop for grown-ups who enjoy luxury'. nagoya-meshi confirms binchōtan grilling, Nagoya Cochin tataki, crisp / juicy skewers and a course with non-skewer dishes in between. Mikawa red chicken and a cheese starter could not be supported and were removed.

宮治グループ公式（miyaji-grp.net）で会社所在地・50年・5店舗・コ.en: The official Miyaji Group site (miyaji-grp.net) confirms the company address, 50 years, 5 shops and the concept. Gurunavi confirms 'Kawachi duck tataki = Fugetsu's signature', fully private rooms throughout and menu items such as duck shabu-shabu. Published sources do not explain the origin of the name Fugetsu.

市川屋珈琲は、京都・東山の清水焼の窯元が集まっていた界隈に2015年に開いた喫茶.en: Ichikawaya Coffee is a coffee shop opened in 2015 in the Higashiyama, Kyoto neighbourhood where Kiyomizu-yaki kilns once gathered. The building was the Kiyomizu-yaki workshop and home of owner Yosuke Ichikawa's grandfather, where Ichikawa also lived. This roughly 200-year-old Kyoto townhouse once faced demolition, but out of the wish 'to keep this place', Ichikawa decided on a full renovation costing about four times a new build. Rebuilt by the Kyoto townhouse builders (京町家作事組), it was reborn as a large townhouse café looking onto a courtyard garden. In the Ichikawa family, both the grandfather and father were Kiyomizu-yaki potters, and the elder brother has also followed the path of ceramics. Only Ichikawa loved coffee, enough to roast as a hobby from student days, and after 18 years of training at the famous Inoda Coffee went independent and opened this shop.

店が「塩とコショウでシンプルに味付け」と明記しており、タレを使わない。醤油・小麦.en: The shop states it is 'seasoned simply with salt and pepper', with no sauce. No soy sauce or wheat. But sauce skewers are grilled on the same grill, so with severe celiac disease, check whether a separate grill can be used.

店のカードに原材料が印刷されており「カカオマス・ココアパウダー・きび糖・豆乳・コ.en: The shop's card prints the ingredients: "cacao mass, cocoa powder, cane sugar, soy milk, coconut oil, egg, rapeseed oil, wheat flour" = uses wheat flour and egg. A real example to note: even at a macrobiotic-branded shop, the baked goods are wheat. Card from August 2016.

店のサイト: 和食の店 青地、四季折々の旬の食材を使った美味しいお料理をアットホ.en: Shop site: Aochi, a Japanese restaurant; delicious dishes made with the ingredients of each season, enjoyed casually in a homely atmosphere; opened 12 March 2013; closed Tuesday and Wednesday since May 2022; 9 counter seats and two tables for four; on the north side of the second street east off Naniwa-suji, going north from the Nishi-Ohashi crossing; about 3 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi Stn exit 2. Menu examples: Akashi wild sea bream sashimi; Chiba bonito sashimi or tataki; hamo seared, or blanched with plum; aori squid sashimi; hairy crab with sanbaizu vinegar; Kamo eggplant simmered with myoga; lotus-root manju; celery with miso-vinegar dressing; salt-grilled extra-thick asparagus; simmered rockfish; gindara saikyo-yaki; anago kabayaki; young ayu tempura or kara-age; Tajima chicken salt-grilled or kara-age; bite-size wagyu fillet katsu; natto zosui; anago rice; prices vary with the day's stock. Tabelog: Daiichi Goda Bldg 1F, Shinmachi 1-30-6, Nishi-ku, Osaka; Mon 17:00–22:30, Thu–Sun 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesday and Wednesday; closed over the New Year holidays; reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master); no e-money or QR; 10% service charge; 16 seats (8 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; children welcome; BYO allowed; opened 12 March 2013. Reviews (January–October 2026): always full of regulars, some older; matsutake dobin-mushi; summer eggplant; shishamo; chicken; bamboo shoots simmered with wakame; kizushi; raw oysters; sashimi; mentaiko with a little karasumi; white sesame and celery salad; grilled duck with island garlic; zosui; natto zosui; reasonably priced seasonal tempura; plenty of sake; a phone call when a seat opened; both the chef and the owner pleasant; about ¥8,000–15,000 a person (Tabelog).

店のサイト: 大阪堀江 創作串揚げ 勝新、大阪市西区北堀江1-10-2 都市開発.en: Shop site: Osaka Horie creative kushiage KATSUSHIN, unit 101, Kitahorie 1-10-2, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 18:00–23:00 last entry, closes at 24:00; closed Sunday; ends when the day's ingredients sell out. Kushiage halfway between kushikatsu and tempura; vegetarian and gluten-free catered for; skewers for children; kushiage of seasonal produce bought at the market that day; omakase kushiage course (say when to stop; roughly 10, 15 or 20 skewers); 100% Tsuno rice oil from Wakayama Prefecture; wheat allergy and gluten-free catered for (tell the staff if you would like this). Tabelog: Horie Kushiage KATSUSHIN, 113 m from Yotsubashi Stn; Mon–Sat 18:00–01:00; closed Sunday; reservations accepted; cards (JCB, AMEX), QUICPay and QR accepted; 10 seats; non-smoking. Reviews (October 2025–September 2026): rice-flour batter and rice oil, light and not heavy; finished with a torch; omakase, stop when you like; courses of 10, 12, 13, 15 or 20 skewers; about ¥300 a skewer; salad and fried zucchini to start; angel shrimp, wagyu tenderloin, kisu with crab and mitsuba, lotus root with shiso and minced meat, potato with truffle butter, octopus with Brussels sprouts, Kawachi duck with porcini, whelk with maitake, firefly squid with bamboo shoot, nama-fu with vinegar miso and ikura, abalone with canola blossoms, roast beef wrapped around foie gras, eel chazuke, dessert skewers; sesame salt, dashi soy sauce, sauce, lemon; aosa dashi chazuke; one person runs the shop and it is always full, so booking is a must; a regular since the opening ten years ago; a chateaubriand skewer for the 10th anniversary; some found the batter hard and gritty.

店のサイト: 宇治香園 大阪心斎橋店、昭和21年に心斎橋筋に日本茶専門店を構え、.en: Shop site: Uji Koen Osaka Shinsaibashi shop; set up as a Japanese tea specialist on Shinsaibashi-suji in 1946 (Showa 21), with a tea room at the back; shop 12:00–19:00, takeout 12:00–18:30, tea room Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays only 14:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30); closed over the New Year holidays; the tea room closed for renovation until 31 October and reopens on 1 November; a tea room serving Japanese tea brewed in a kyusu; takeout drinks and matcha soft serve; the tea-brewing class "Ichiwan Chakai" is suspended. Company information: Uji Koen Co., Ltd., founded in Keio 1 (1865); Kyoto head office and factory, and the Osaka Shinsaibashi shop. History: began as a tea peddler in Yamashiro, Kyoto; exported to the United States from about Meiji 11 (1878); the Osaka Shinsaibashi shop in Showa 21 (1946); a Japanese-tea tea room in Heisei 15 (2003); iF Design Award in Reiwa 3 (2021); 160th anniversary and Good Design Award in Reiwa 7 (2025). Tabelog (corporate member): Shinsaibashisuji 1-5-19, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Shinsaibashi Station Exit 6 along Shinsaibashi-suji towards Namba; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 5 counter seats; non-smoking. Reviews (October 2021 to October 2025): rich matcha soft serve heaped with matcha powder (¥400 in December 2023, ¥500 in August 2025), a matcha-and-milk mix, matcha latte; in the tea room at the back, gyokuro brewed with an hourglass timer, with refills; hojicha; hojicha roll cake; matcha ice cream; hojicha and gyokuro tea bags; a bench at the shop front.

店のメニューが「ドレッシングなし（ハーフ）380円」と明記。葉物のみでドレッシン.en: The shop's menu states 'no dressing (half) ¥380'. Just leaves, so without dressing there's no wheat and nothing animal. The regular version is ¥580.

店のロゴはキッチンカー時代から使い続けている馬のモチーフ。「自由に動き回る」イメ.en: The logo is a horse motif used since the food-truck days. It embodies the image of 'moving around freely', and local media described the timing of opening in the 2026 Year of the Horse as 'a lovely coincidence'.

店の一番人気。自家製タレは醤油＝小麦。塩の串もタレ串と同じ焼き台のため要注意。.en: The shop's most popular. The house sauce is soy sauce = wheat. Salt skewers go on the same grill as sauce skewers, so take care.

店の中央に胡麻油、芝麻醤、豆板醤、醤油など10種類以上の調味料が置かれ、客が自分.en: More than ten condiments such as sesame oil, sesame paste, doubanjiang and soy sauce sit in the middle of the shop, and each customer mixes a personal sauce (shared condiments and utensils).

店の中央に胡麻油や芝麻醤、豆板醤、醤油などの調味料が10種類以上置かれ、自分でオ.en: More than ten condiments such as sesame oil, sesame paste, doubanjiang and soy sauce are set in the middle of the shop so you can make your own original sauce (¥200 per person for two plates, refills free).

Opened in Toshimatsu, Saeki-ku in November 2022.

店の公式サイト・コラム（cafe-de-f.jp）とグルテンフリーガイド（emp.en: According to the shop's official site and column (cafe-de-f.jp) and a gluten-free guide (empacede), an owner from Iwate Prefecture and the owner's daughter opened it in spring 2024 in 春日, Bunkyo-ku. A homey café particular about Japanese rice flour, Iwate products (Iwaizumi yogurt, Morioka rice-flour cold noodles), no additives and low sugar; it caters to customers with gluten intolerance or celiac disease, but states that "not every item is gluten-free" and "we cannot fully accommodate allergies".

Developed an okonomiyaki free of the 7 major allergens in 2013, gluten-free in 2015 and low-carb on 1 October 2017. The gluten-free type uses batter and noodles with no wheat flour or wheat-derived ingredients. All require reservations.

店の英文表記が SWEET BEANS WITH RICE FLOUR DUMP.en: The shop's English label states SWEET BEANS WITH RICE FLOUR DUMPLING AND CHEST NUT = the shiratama is rice flour, no wheat. Only azuki, sugar, chestnut and rice, with nothing animal. ¥1,000 in a 2026/03 review, ¥1,100 in 2025/11.

店の説明：和風だしで炊いた旬のお野菜。和風だし＝かつお・白だしの可能性が高くヴィ.en: Shop's description: seasonal vegetables simmered in Japanese dashi. Japanese dashi = very likely bonito or shiro-dashi, so not vegan; with shiro-dashi or soy sauce, wheat as well. Also ask about gelatine.

If celiac, check directly with the shop. Also check what grain the "grain salad" uses. Card from August 2016.

The shop is a skewer specialist that slowly grills Hinai-jidori, shipped direct from Akita every morning, over binchotan charcoal; it was fully renovated and reopened in March 2025.

A counter-only sushi bar with an eye-catching neon sign; its feature is a new kind of sushi experience in a flashy, pop space. At night drinks and creative snacks; at lunch seafood bowls, lunch nigiri and the famous bara-chirashi.

水道橋店は2015年8月15日にオープンした2号店で、本店は中目黒にあります。.en: The Suidobashi shop is the second, opened on August 15, 2015; the main shop is in Nakameguro.

水道橋店は、そばを自動で茹で上げてすすぐ「そばロボット」を導入したいろり庵きらく.en: The Suidobashi shop became the fifth Irorian Kiraku to bring in a "soba robot" that automatically boils and rinses soba. It can boil about 150 servings an hour, with a boiling time of about 100 seconds.

水道橋発のインドカレー店「インド富士子」～現地での体験に裏打ちされた個性的な南イ.en: "India Fujiko, an Indian curry shop from Suidobashi: a hidden gem serving curry fans distinctive South Indian plates backed by experience in India"

白飯のみ、味付けなし。大230円・中180円・小130円。.en: Plain rice only, unseasoned. Large 230 yen, medium 180 yen, small 130 yen.

白飯のみ、調味なし。.en: Plain white rice only, no seasoning.

白飯のみ。ただし揚げ場と同じ厨房のため微量混入は要確認。.en: Plain rice only. But it shares a kitchen with the fryer, so check for trace contamination.

白飯のみ。ただし注ぐ出汁は醤油入り。.en: Plain rice only. But the dashi poured over contains soy sauce.

白飯のみ。つゆをかけなければ小麦・動物性なし。.en: Plain rice only. Without the broth poured over, no wheat and nothing animal-derived.

白飯のみ。共用の盛り付け場所＝要確認。.en: Plain rice only. Shared plating area = check.

白飯のみ。味付けなしの炊いた米で小麦も動物性もなし。.en: Plain rice only. Unseasoned cooked rice, so no wheat and nothing animal-derived.

白飯のみ。店のこだわり表記に「お米：山形県 やまがた自然農場 産地直送はえぬき」.en: Plain rice only. The shop's notes on its ingredients say "Rice: Haenuki, shipped direct from やまがた自然農場, Yamagata". Plain rice; the shop names its grower.

白飯のみ。炊いた米に何も加えていないので小麦も動物性もなし。.en: Plain rice only. Nothing is added to the cooked rice, so no wheat and nothing animal-derived.

白飯のみ。麦の混合なし。.en: Plain rice only. No barley mixed in.

白飯のみで味付けなし。昼ランチではラーメンに無料で付く。.en: Plain rice only, unseasoned. Comes free with ramen at lunch.

白飯のみなら小麦不使用・植物性。.en: Plain rice alone is wheat-free and plant-based.

白飯の小盛り。味付けなし。.en: A small portion of plain rice. Unseasoned.

白餡と栗を合わせた和風フレーバー。.en: A Japanese-style flavour pairing white bean paste and chestnut.

百万遍・田中門前町（左京区、京大近く）.en: Hyakumanben / Tanaka Monzen-cho (Sakyo-ku, near Kyoto University)

皆さんの心がリセットできるような場所になれたら.en: I hope it can be a place where everyone's heart can reset

皇族や、吉田茂・佐藤栄作といった歴代首相をもてなしてきた由緒ある料亭として知られ.en: Known as a distinguished ryotei that has entertained members of the imperial family and prime ministers such as Yoshida Shigeru and Satō Eisaku.

皮うすくして中身多きはおやきなり.en: thin skin and plenty of filling: that is oyaki

皮がコップ代わりになっており.en: the peel serves as the cup

皮の種類が未記載、共用フライヤー。.en: Type of wrapper not listed; shared fryer.

皮も羽根も小麦。タレも小麦醤油。.en: Both the wrapper and the crisp skirt are wheat. The sauce is wheat soy sauce too.

皮＝小麦、カスタードに卵と乳。.en: Pastry = wheat; egg and dairy in the custard.

皮＝小麦、ラー油ソースに醤油。.en: Wrapper = wheat; soy sauce in the chili-oil sauce.

皮＝小麦、餡は豚肉入り。.en: Wrapper = wheat; the filling contains pork.

皮＝小麦、鰻のタレも醤油。.en: Wrapper = wheat; the eel sauce is soy sauce too.

皿のガレットで味わうコース料理.en: a full course enjoyed on a single plate of galette

皿をパレットに見立て.en: treating the plate as a palette

皿をパレットに見立て、指で調理しながら食べるのがインド流.en: The Indian way: treat the plate as a palette and 'cook' with your fingers as you eat

盛り付けがとてもきれいで独創性があり.en: the presentation is beautiful and original

盛り合わせは一部たれ。.en: Some of the platter is with sauce.

盛合せには入れられない品。.en: An item that can't be included in the assortment.

監修シェフ（渡邉保之・中華そば きび）.en: supervising chef (Watanabe Yasuyuki, Chuka Soba Kibi)

目にも美しい和食ビーガン.en: Japanese vegan food that's beautiful to look at

看板ではグラノーラ、公式サイトの説明では雑穀米。どちらも麦類の可能性（押麦・もち.en: Granola on the sign, mixed-grain rice in the official site's description. Either may contain barley or oats (pressed barley, mochi barley, oats).

看板に「昼ランチ 各種ラーメン ライス サービスします」。サービスのライスは白飯.en: The sign reads 'Lunch: rice free with any ramen'. The free rice is plain white rice only, with no wheat and nothing animal-derived (the ramen itself is not OK). The free lunchtime rice is plain white rice.

看板の『まきさだラーメン』は、母体の創作中華店『京中華 牧定』でまかないとして出.en: The signature 'Makisada ramen' is the spring-onion soba once served as a staff meal at the parent creative-Chinese restaurant 'Kyo Chuka Makisada', rebuilt as ramen.

看板の『亮昌ぎょうざ』。鰹だしをベースにした合わせ和だしで上品に仕立てた京もち豚.en: The signature 'Sukemasa gyoza'. Minced Kyoto mochi pork refined with a blended Japanese dashi based on bonito, combined with fragrant Kujo negi, with a hint of miso from the old shop 'Yamari' as a hidden seasoning, wrapped in special chewy wrappers.

看板のまきさだラーメンは醤油ラーメンで、醤油（しょうゆ）ベースのタレを用いる。通.en: The signature Makisada ramen is a shoyu ramen using a soy-based tare. Regular soy sauce contains wheat, so it doesn't suit those avoiding gluten.

看板のウインナー珈琲は珈琲＋ホイップ生クリームで、乳製品を含みます。植物性ミルク.en: The signature Viennese coffee is coffee + whipped fresh cream, so it contains dairy. No mention of plant-milk substitutes or vegan handling could be confirmed. Check directly before visiting.

看板のカルニータスバーガーは豚肩肉をオレンジとスパイスで低温コンフィ風に火入れし.en: The signature carnitas burger is pork shoulder cooked confit-style at low temperature with orange and spices, also served as a rice bowl.

看板の季節のフルーツサンドは月替わりで旬の果物を使い、開店前から行列ができるほど.en: The signature seasonal fruit sandwich uses the fruit of the month and is so popular that a queue forms before opening. It is widely known as 'the fruit sandwich shop'.

看板の汁なし担々麺は『芳醇醤油』と『濃厚ゴマ』の2系統で、香り高さが評判。親店『.en: The signature brothless dandan noodles come in two lines, 'aromatic shoyu' and 'rich sesame', praised for their aroma. There are sides such as Singapore aubergine curry, inherited from the parent shop 'Himawari'.

看板の熟成醤油らぁ麺に加え、濃厚鶏白湯、自家製胡麻だれと香味油の胡麻担々、A5ラ.en: Besides the signature aged-soy ramen, it offers a wide range from rich chicken paitan and sesame tantan with house-made sesame sauce and aromatic oil to 'A5 wagyu ramen' topped with A5 wagyu roast beef. It also has a permanent 'vegan paitan ramen' and 'vegan tantan ramen' with no animal ingredients, catering for plant-based visitors.

看板は、月ごとに移ろう旬のフルーツをふんわりした食パンとコクのある生クリームで挟.en: The signature is the 'seasonal fruit sandwich': seasonal fruit that changes each month, between fluffy white bread and rich fresh cream. Carefully made, from choosing and cutting the fruit to the sweetness of the cream, it's so popular that a queue forms before opening. The coffee is roasted in-house daily on the shop's roaster and slowly brewed by flannel drip. There are three blends — Ichikawaya Blend, Seiji (celadon) Blend and Umamachi Blend — each served in Kiyomizu-yaki cups made by the father or brother. Even the cups are designed for each blend: the Ichikawaya Blend cup has a thin rim and thick base for ease of drinking and heat retention, and the Seiji Blend cup a wide mouth to lift the aroma. There are also items such as an egg sandwich and demi-glace omurice.

看板は「京のあさごはん」。焼き鮭か焼き鯖を選べる京の朝ごはんセット、地元の豆腐店.en: The signature is 'Kyoto breakfast'. A purely Japanese menu made with care from the morning: a Kyoto breakfast set with a choice of grilled salmon or grilled mackerel; soy-milk yuba porridge topped with plenty of rich soy milk and fresh yuba from a local tofu shop; and a dashimaki set starring a fluffy rolled omelette. At lunch the signature is a set of colourful obanzai, letting you taste Kyoto home cooking with care put into every dish, down to the dashimaki, soup, seasonal small dishes and pickles. In the afternoon, gentle sweets such as handmade pudding, pudding parfait and seasonal cakes are popular too.

看板は『熟成醤油らぁ麺』。国産鶏からていねいに引いた澄んだ鶏清湯に、鰹節・煮干し.en: The signature is 'aged-soy ramen'. A bowl of clear chicken broth carefully drawn from domestic chicken, layered with a Japanese dashi of bonito flakes, niboshi and kombu, with a mellow aged-soy kaeshi. Clear yet deep umami and the rich aroma of aged soy sauce are the essence.

看板はずばり『べた焼き』。たっぷりの刻み九条葱をのせるのがこの店の流儀で、油カス.en: The signature is simply 'betayaki'. Piling on plenty of chopped Kujo negi is this shop's way, and you can add toppings such as aburakasu, egg and kimchi. It comes out crisp, fragrant and light. For starters there are griddle dishes such as tecchan (offal) with vegetables, salt-grilled yam and thin-grilled beef.

看板はカルニータスバーガー。豚肩肉をオレンジとスパイスで低温コンフィ風にじっくり.en: The signature is the carnitas burger: pork shoulder slowly cooked confit-style at low temperature with orange and spices until tender and falling apart, also served as a rice bowl. Others include a bacon cheeseburger, double cheeseburger and BBQ cheeseburger. The buns are house-made brioche, the patties hand-chopped beef, and bacon, smoked brisket and the sauces are all made in the shop. House-made cola and ginger ale too.

看板はデンマーク産ナチュラルクリームチーズを使ったクリームチーズもみじ饅頭で、な.en: The signature is a cream-cheese momiji manjū made with Danish natural cream cheese; its smooth, rich flavour is popular and it often sells out. There is a wide range of others, such as smooth bean paste, coarse bean paste, custard cream, chocolate and rum-soaked raisin, and 'Okomomiji' (the shop's registered trademark), crossing Miyajima's famous okonomiyaki with momiji manjū, is a specialty too.

看板は一杯の中華そば。澄んだ黄金色のクリアな豚骨醤油スープで、豚骨の力強い旨味を.en: The signature is a bowl of chūka soba. A clear, golden pork-bone shoyu soup that lets you feel the powerful umami of pork bone while holding back the salt and soy, a bowl that isn't heavy even in the morning. The noodles are high-hydration, flat, medium-thick, with a springy bounce and smooth slurp. The chāshū is pork belly cut to order, so you can enjoy thin and thick slices.

看板は油そば。中太のちょい縮れ麺を醤油ベースのタレと植物油で和えたスープのない一.en: The signature is abura soba. A soupless bowl of medium-thick, slightly curly noodles tossed with a soy-based sauce and plant oil, topped with menma, spring onion, shredded nori and chāshū. The standard way to eat it is to change the flavour midway with vinegar and chilli oil — 'delicious twice'. Choose soy sauce or salt sauce.

看板は特製チャーシューラーメン。真っ黒に見える濃色の醤油スープ（鶏の旨味も効いた.en: The signature is the special chāshū ramen. A dark shoyu soup that looks jet black (brown, with chicken umami), thin-sliced chāshū arranged like petals, plenty of green onion, and thin straight noodles.

看板は鰹昆布水つけそば。北海道産がごめ昆布と土佐清水の鰹（宗田節）からとった昆布.en: The signature is bonito-kombu-water tsuke-soba: custom medium-thin noodles with whole-grain flour steeped in kombu water drawn from Hokkaido gagome kombu and Tosashimizu bonito (sōda-bushi), eaten with a dipping sauce of aged soy sauce and domestic duck fat. The regular aged-soy chūka soba (¥900–1,000) is a light, refined bowl of clear yet powerful soup drawn from domestic chicken, bonito and niboshi, scented with yuzu.

看板もなく蔦に覆われた外観で、知らないと店だと気づかずに通り過ぎてしまうほどの隠.en: Introduced as a hideaway with no sign and an ivy-covered front, so hidden that you'd walk past without knowing it's a shop.

看板デザートの固めの『サンデーレトロプリン』には、シナモンまたは八幡屋礒五郎の七.en: The signature firm 'Sunday Retro Pudding' can be topped with cinnamon or Yawataya Isogoro shichimi: an unexpected mix of sweet and spice.

看板メニュー。乳・卵（プリン）使用。パフェにコーンフレークが入る店が多く、入れば.en: The signature dish. Uses dairy and egg (pudding). Many shops put cornflakes in parfaits, which means wheat and malt. Check. 2019 listing (before tax).

看板メニュー「中黄金うな重」は、炭焼きうなぎと名古屋コーチン卵のだし巻き玉子を一.en: The signature unajū (中黄金) is popular as a dish combining charcoal-grilled eel and a rolled omelette of Nagoya Cochin eggs in one go.

看板メニュー「大名つづら」の中身は仕入れた食材によって毎日変わる。胡麻豆腐は手作.en: The contents of the signature "Daimyo Tsuzura" change daily with what is bought. The sesame tofu is handmade and praised as needing no sauce.

看板メニュー「絶望のスパゲッティ」は1994年、新宿新店舗開業時の新メニュー開発.en: The signature "Despair Spaghetti" was born in 1994 from new-menu development for the opening of a new Shinjuku shop. At first it didn't sell at all, but after media people tried it and raved, orders rose and it grew into the most popular dish, with queues.

看板メニューに豚肉・卵・中華そば・かつお出汁が使われ、同じ鉄板で肉や卵を焼くため.en: The signature dish uses pork, egg, Chinese noodles and bonito dashi, and meat and egg are cooked on the same griddle; no information on separate plant-only cooking could be found.

看板メニューの「おむすび御膳」（2,000円・税込）。 お櫃で炊きたてのご飯を用.en: The signature "omusubi set meal" (¥2,000 incl. tax). Freshly cooked rice comes in a wooden tub, and you shape your own onigiri with the shop's original mold, mixing and matching from seven fillings: a hands-on meal.

看板メニューのきりたんぽ鍋は、比内地鶏から取った出汁に野菜・まいたけ・しらたきと.en: The signature kiritanpo hot pot combines a Hinai-jidori stock with vegetables, maitake, shirataki and chewy "kiritanpo"; it is one of the Ministry of Agriculture's "100 Regional Dishes".

看板メニューは『熟成醤油』のかえしを用いる。一般的な醸造醤油は小麦を含むため、醤.en: The signature menu uses an 'aged soy' kaeshi. Ordinary brewed soy sauce contains wheat, so it's reasonable to judge on the assumption of wheat from the soy sauce.

看板メニューは約10品を盛り合わせた「Vegan Delight」プレート（タコ.en: The signature is the 'Vegan Delight' plate of about 10 items (tacos, soy-meat karaage, a hamburg, chili con carne, daikon mochi and more). Among sweets, a matcha chocolate cake using naturally grown matcha from the Yamato highlands, a dairy-free vegan Basque cheesecake and beautiful tarts are popular.

看板商品の『然』カステラは卵黄のみを使用し、卵・砂糖・小麦粉・牛乳・水飴で作られ.en: The signature "Zen" castella uses only egg yolks: a paper-baked castella made from eggs, sugar, wheat flour, milk and starch syrup.

看板商品のジャンボめろんぱんは通常のメロンパンより3倍長く生地を発酵させることに.en: The signature jumbo melon pan insists on fermenting the dough three times longer than an ordinary melon pan, and that method creates a texture crisp outside and fluffy inside.

真心むすびます.en: made with heartfelt sincerity (a pun on 'tying' rice balls)

真鯛とタコのチリトマトラーメン.en: sea bream and octopus chili-tomato ramen

真鯛又はスズキのポワレ.en: poêlé of sea bream or sea bass

着物姿のバリスタがラテアートを作るのが浅草らしい下町ならではの特徴で、2018年.en: A barista in kimono making latte art is a feature of Asakusa's shitamachi; since opening on August 24, 2018 it has always been a busy, popular café. In 2022 a second shop, "Pechka Sukemasa Coffee", also opened in Asakusa.

矢場とん公式沿革によると、1947年に鈴木義夫が『矢場のとんかつ』として創業（南.en: According to Yabaton's official history, founded in 1947 by Suzuki Yoshio as 'Yaba no Tonkatsu' (near a tram stop on Otsu-dori; the name comes from Yaba, today's Osu area). Incorporated in 1953; opened the Yaba-cho main shop in 1970 and became 'Yabaton'. About 30 shops nationwide, plus Thailand (2014) and Taiwan. Miso katsu was inspired by a customer dipping tonkatsu into a doteni pot. A stall at Nagoya Stadium for 27 years, 1972–96. The Kinshachi Yokocho shop is in the Yoshinao Zone.

知る人ぞ知る腕利き職人.en: "a skilled craftsman known to those in the know"

知ればもっと美味しくなる.en: the more you know, the tastier it gets

知多牛のシャトーブリアンを中心とした完全オマカセコース。シャトーブリアンの海苔巻.en: A full omakase course centred on Chita beef chateaubriand. The signature is chateaubriand rolled in nori (with spring onion and miso). One course uses about 500 g of meat, including rare cuts such as the pointe (a rare part of the fillet).

石川県唯一の五ツ星お米マイスター、米粉100.en: Ishikawa's only five-star rice meister, 100% rice flour

石窯で焼き上げた全粒粉バンズ.en: whole-wheat bun baked in a stone oven
石窯で焼き上げた全粒粉バンズ.r: いしがまでやきあげたぜんりゅうふんばんず

砂糖・みりん不使用、鰹出汁をたっぷり.en: no sugar or mirin, plenty of bonito dashi

磨き抜かれた技とおもてなしの心.en: polished skill and a spirit of hospitality

磯辺揚げの衣＝小麦、ちくわのつなぎにも澱粉。.en: Isobe-age batter = wheat; starch in the chikuwa binder too.

磯辺焼きは醤油ダレ＝小麦。.en: Isobe-yaki has a soy-sauce glaze = wheat.

祖父の工房だった築200年の町家が取り壊されかけたとき、市川さんは『この場所を残.en: When the 200-year-old townhouse that had been the grandfather's workshop was about to be demolished, Ichikawa, out of the wish 'to keep this place', went ahead with a full renovation at about four times the cost of a new build.

神保町（神保町駅北側、千代田区神田神保町）.en: Jimbocho (north of Jimbocho Station, Kanda-Jimbocho, Chiyoda-ku)

神徳特製の中太麺を魚介と豚骨のＷスープで提供.en: Jintoku's special medium-thick noodles served in a double soup of seafood and pork bone

神戸新聞（1959年創業・駅地下・まねき食品継承・2019年10月前経営者死去・.en: Confirmed by the Kobe Shimbun (founded 1959; in the station basement; taken over by Maneki Foods; the previous operator died in October 2019; reopened March 2020; a sauce-then-dashi style started by customers; four kinds of bonito dashi; 松本恵美子), himeji.jp (Takopia became Takopii; Gran Festa) and kisspress (about 800 servings on weekdays, about 1,200 at weekends; tendinitis; three months' training).

神泉（渋谷区円山町）／渋谷駅徒歩9分.en: Shinsen (Maruyamacho, Shibuya-ku) / 9 min walk from Shibuya Station

神泉（渋谷区道玄坂、神泉駅・渋谷駅から徒歩圏内）.en: Shinsen (Dogenzaka, Shibuya-ku; walkable from Shinsen and Shibuya stations)

神田三崎町、千代田区（水道橋駅徒歩3分）.en: Kanda-Misakicho, Chiyoda-ku (3 min walk from Suidobashi Station)

神田三崎町・西神田（水道橋駅と神保町駅の間）.en: Kanda-Misakicho / Nishi-Kanda (between Suidobashi and Jimbocho stations)

神田三崎町（千代田区）、水道橋駅西口近く.en: Kanda-Misakicho (Chiyoda-ku), near Suidobashi Station west exit

神田猿楽町（神保町駅・水道橋駅間）、千代田区.en: Kanda-Sarugakucho (between Jimbocho and Suidobashi stations), Chiyoda-ku

福々まんじゅうの原料は膨張剤以外は保存料などの添加物を一切使用せず、小麦と砂糖と.en: "Our Fukufuku manju are made simply from wheat, sugar and bean paste, with no preservatives or other additives apart from the raising agent" — signature bun is wheat-based and housemade.

福井ソースカツ丼と越前おろしそば。薄く大きなロース肉にきめ細かいパン粉をまとわせ.en: Fukui sauce katsudon and Echizen oroshi soba. The standard is to have them as a set: a thin, large pork-loin cutlet in fine breadcrumbs, dipped in rich Worcestershire sauce and laid on rice, together with a refreshing Echizen oroshi soba piled with bonito flakes, green onion and grated daikon.

福井出身者が試食して「本物の味」と太鼓判を押したと地元ブロガーが報告している。.en: A local blogger reports that people from Fukui tasted it and vouched for it as 'the real taste'.

福岡・博多の名門もつ鍋から暖簾分け（2007年開業）.en: A licensed offshoot of a renowned motsunabe house in Hakata, Fukuoka (opened 2007)

私しか作られんからね.en: "nobody but me can make it, you know"

秋刀魚のコンフィの塩ラーメン.en: salt ramen with Pacific saury confit

秋田直送の比内地鶏と備長炭焼きへのこだわりを軸に、秋田郷土料理を提供する.en: Serves Akita regional food, built around Hinai-jidori shipped direct from Akita and binchotan grilling

秘伝のタレ＝小麦醤油。.en: The secret sauce = wheat soy sauce.

秘伝の味噌の種類が非公開。.en: The secret miso's type isn't disclosed.

移転前の情報は最新のものとは異なります」.en: The information from before the move differs from the latest'

税サ別、サービス料500円/人。鉄板フレンチのおまかせ。2025年の食べログ投稿.en: Tax and service extra; service charge ¥500/person. Teppan-French omakase. A 2025 Tabelog post shows a deeply flavoured soup, fish on a corn base, abalone, a small hamburger, milt and more (the hamburger bun is wheat). Mention gluten when booking.

The brand name 'BEIKA = rice confectionery' refers to rice-flour sweets (not an actual rice-cracker maker). The story begins with 'the curiosity of one confectioner', and the workshop and shop is in a renovated Kyoto townhouse over 100 years old. It buys raw rice from farmers and bakes baumkuchen with rice flour freshly milled in-house. Freshly milled rice flour holds a different amount of moisture, and the moist texture is its greatest point of pride. On 29 March 2023 it had a limited-time stand at JR Kyoto Isetan, selling gluten-free rice-flour baumkuchen.

酒糟は米由来だが、中国酒の醸造に麦麹を使うものがある。.en: The wine lees come from rice, but some Chinese wines are brewed with wheat koji.

酒蒸しに醤油を落とす店が多い＝小麦。かつお節使用でヴィーガン不可。醤油なしにでき.en: Many shops add soy sauce to sake-steamed dishes = wheat. Uses katsuobushi, so not vegan. Check whether it can be made without soy sauce.

酒蒸しは酒と塩のみの場合と、醤油を落とす場合がある。.en: Sake-steamed is sometimes just sake and salt, sometimes with soy sauce dripped in.

酢〆自体は塩と酢だが、〆汁に昆布・味醂を使う店もある。醤油なしで食べられるか要確.en: Vinegar curing itself is salt and vinegar, but some shops use kombu and mirin in the curing liquid. Check whether you can eat it without soy sauce.

酢の原料（穀物酢なら小麦の可能性）未公開。.en: The vinegar's source (possibly wheat if grain vinegar) not disclosed.

酢味噌。麦味噌なら大麦、だし入り味噌なら鰹。味噌の種類を要確認。.en: Vinegared miso. Barley if barley miso, bonito if miso with dashi. Check the type of miso.

酢味噌。麦味噌なら大麦、だし入り味噌なら鰹。要確認。.en: Vinegared miso. Barley if barley miso, bonito if miso with dashi. Check.

酢味噌の味噌が麦味噌なら小麦。要確認。.en: If the miso in the vinegared miso is barley miso, wheat. Check.

酢味噌の味噌種別を要確認。.en: Check the type of miso in the vinegared miso.

酢味噌の味噌種別未記載。.en: Type of miso in the vinegared miso not listed.

酢締め。つけ/かけ醤油は小麦醸造。.en: Vinegar-cured. The dipping / pouring soy sauce is brewed with wheat.

酢飯（米酢・砂糖・塩）は小麦不使用だが、つけ醤油・煮切りが小麦。.en: Sushi rice (rice vinegar, sugar, salt) has no wheat, but the dipping soy sauce and nikiri are wheat.

醤は醤油・干し貝柱・金華ハムが基本。.en: XO-style sauce is basically soy sauce, dried scallops and Jinhua ham.

醤油。生に近い鶏。.en: Soy sauce. Chicken served close to raw.

醤油がまろやかにまとめたスープ.en: a soup rounded off mellow with soy sauce

醤油だれ・小麦衣。乳・卵・魚卵・鶏肉。.en: Soy-sauce sauce, wheat batter. Dairy, egg, fish roe, chicken.

醤油だれ・小麦衣。卵・豚肉・鶏肉・魚。.en: Soy-sauce sauce, wheat batter. Egg, pork, chicken, fish.

醤油とみりんの煮汁に漬ける調理法＝小麦。.en: Steeped in a soy-sauce-and-mirin liquid = wheat.

醤油と砂糖でじっくり煮込む、と店が明記。.en: The shop states it's slowly simmered in soy sauce and sugar.

醤油に小麦の可能性。卵使用。要確認。.en: The soy sauce may contain wheat. Uses egg. To be confirmed.

醤油に微量の小麦.en: trace wheat in the soy sauce

醤油の使用有無については公開情報に記載なし。フレンチ・ビストロ系メニューのため頻.en: Public information does not say whether soy sauce is used. With a French-bistro menu, frequent use is unlikely, but this is unconfirmed.

醤油の種類（小麦含有の有無）について公式情報なし。一般的な日本料理で使用される醤.en: No official information on the type of soy sauce (whether it contains wheat). Soy sauce used in typical Japanese cooking contains wheat.

醤油の香ばしい香り.en: the toasty aroma of soy sauce

醤油は小麦。うに自体は問題なし。.en: The soy sauce is wheat. The sea urchin itself is fine.

醤油をかけて食す。.en: Eaten with soy sauce poured over.

醤油をかけて食す＝小麦。.en: Eaten with soy sauce poured over = wheat.

醤油をつけて食べる（小麦）。かまぼこ自体にも小麦でんぷんが入る製品がある。.en: Eaten dipped in soy sauce (wheat). Some kamaboko also contain wheat starch.

醤油をつけて食べる（小麦）。かまぼこ自体に小麦でんぷんが入る製品もある。.en: Eaten with soy sauce (wheat). Some kamaboko contain wheat starch themselves.

醤油タレや煮物に小麦入り醤油が使用されている可能性が高い。グルテンフリー醤油の使.en: Wheat-containing soy sauce is very likely used in soy-based sauces and simmered dishes. No information on gluten-free soy sauce is published.

醤油ダレ・チャーシューの漬けだれとも小麦醤油。麺＝小麦。.en: The soy tare and the chāshū marinade are both wheat soy sauce. Noodles = wheat.

醤油ダレ漬け＝小麦。.en: Marinated in a soy sauce = wheat.

醤油ダレ＝小麦醤油。麺＝小麦。.en: Soy tare = wheat soy sauce. Noodles = wheat.

醤油ベースの味付けが標準的な居酒屋・海鮮料理店であり、煮魚・タレ類に小麦を含む通.en: An izakaya / seafood restaurant where soy-based seasoning is standard; regular wheat-containing soy sauce is thought to be used in simmered fish and sauces. Gluten-free soy sauce (tamari and the like) has not been confirmed.

醤油ベースの調理が複数メニューに使われており（水ナスしそしょうが正油など）、通常.en: Soy-sauce-based cooking is used in several dishes (e.g. water eggplant with shiso, ginger and soy sauce), so ordinary wheat-containing soy sauce is presumably used.

醤油ベース原型・辛味噌・海老の天然塩.en: soy-based original, spicy miso, prawn natural salt

醤油・たれ類の使用が想定されるが、グルテンフリー醤油（タマリ等）の提供は公式サイ.en: Soy sauce and sauces are presumably used, but gluten-free soy sauce (tamari etc.) is not mentioned on the official site or any booking site. The sauce served with grilled shellfish very likely uses wheat-containing soy sauce.

醤油・だし不使用か.en: free of soy sauce and dashi?

醤油・だし（小麦含有の可能性）の使用有無についての情報は公開されていない。イタリ.en: No public information on whether soy sauce or dashi (possibly containing wheat) is used. Mainly Italian, but with heavy use of seasonal Japanese ingredients, their use as a hidden seasoning cannot be ruled out.

醤油・オイスターソースを使うことが多い。.en: Often uses soy sauce and oyster sauce.

醤油・キムチの調味料に小麦。卵。.en: Wheat in the soy sauce and kimchi seasoning. Egg.

醤油・タレ類の原材料（小麦含有の有無）についてのウェブ上の明記は確認できず。グル.en: No clear statement online about the ingredients of the soy sauce and sauces (whether they contain wheat). It's a gluten-free specialist, but checking the sauces in person is the sure way.

醤油・ナンプラーで味付け。.en: Seasoned with soy sauce and nam pla.

醤油・酢・みりんの漬けダレ＝小麦。素揚げでも共用フライヤー。.en: A marinade of soy sauce, vinegar and mirin = wheat. Even fried plain, a shared fryer.

醤油割下＝小麦、卵とじ。.en: Soy-sauce warishita = wheat; bound with egg.

醤油添えの有無を要確認。.en: Check whether soy sauce comes with it.

醤油漬けの品は小麦。だし入りの浅漬けもある。.en: Soy-pickled items are wheat. Some light pickles contain dashi.

醤油漬けの品は小麦。だし入りの浅漬けもある。要確認。.en: Soy-pickled items are wheat. Some light pickles contain dashi. Check.

醤油漬けの品は小麦。種類を要確認。.en: Soy-pickled items are wheat. Check the kind.

醤油漬け・ぬか漬けなど種類による。要確認。.en: Depends on the kind, e.g. soy-pickled or nukazuke. Check.

醤油漬け・粕漬けは小麦。鰹節をまぶす場合ビーガン不可。.en: Soy-pickled and sake-lees-pickled items are wheat. Not vegan if sprinkled with katsuobushi.

醤油麹＝醤油＝小麦。セット.en: Soy-sauce koji = soy sauce = wheat. Set

醤油（小麦含有）の使用が料理に含まれる可能性があるが、使用する醤油の種類（小麦あ.en: Dishes may contain soy sauce (with wheat), but there is no official word on which soy sauce (with or without wheat) is used.

醤油＝小麦、アイス＝乳。.en: Soy sauce = wheat, ice cream = dairy.

醤油＝小麦。アレルゲン表：小麦・卵・乳・さば・大豆・鶏肉・豚肉。.en: Soy sauce = wheat. Allergen chart: wheat, egg, dairy, mackerel, soy, chicken, pork.

醤油＝小麦。チャーシューの漬けだれも醤油。.en: Soy sauce = wheat. The chashu marinade is soy sauce too.

醤油＝小麦。価格は版面の行対応が不明瞭のため空欄（二二〇〇円前後）。.en: Soy sauce = wheat. Price left blank because the rows on the menu don't line up clearly (around ¥2,200).

醤油＝小麦。岩のり自体は海藻のみ。.en: Soy sauce = wheat. The rock nori itself is just seaweed.

醤油＝小麦。練りわさびにも小麦系のつなぎが入ることがある。.en: Soy sauce = wheat. Prepared wasabi sometimes contains a wheat-based binder too.

醸造アルコールを一切使わず.en: using no added brewing alcohol at all

重度の方はお控えくださいませ.en: those with severe allergies, please refrain

重要：公式アレルギー表ではサラダ本体（ドレッシング抜き）に小麦の表示がない一方、.en: Important: the official allergen chart shows no wheat for the salad itself (without dressing), whereas the Caesar dressing itself is egg

野生・自然の力を宿した食材.en: ingredients that hold the power of the wild and nature

野菜そのままを焼く、味付けなし。.en: Vegetables grilled as they are, unseasoned.

野菜たっぷりだが中華麺は小麦、しょうゆ味のスープも小麦。豚骨・鶏がらの可能性が高.en: Plenty of vegetables, but Chinese noodles are wheat, and the soy-flavoured soup is wheat too. Very likely pork-bone or chicken-bone, so vegans should check.

野菜たっぷりトマトソースパスタ.en: tomato-sauce pasta with plenty of vegetables

野菜と炭火のみなら植物性・小麦不使用。バターや肉と同じ網を使うか要確認。単品の付.en: Vegetables and charcoal alone are plant-based and wheat-free. Check whether butter or the same grill as meat is used. As a single side dish, ¥690.

野菜と酢のみの表記。原料表示は未公開。.en: Listed as vegetables and vinegar only. Ingredient label not published.

野菜のみだが基本素材にあさり・卵が入るためヴィーガン不可。セット.en: Vegetables only, but the base includes clams and egg, so not vegan. Set

野菜のみでも衣は小麦、揚げ油は海老と共用、つゆは鰹だし。.en: Even vegetable-only, the batter is wheat, the frying oil is shared with shrimp, and the broth is bonito dashi.

野菜のみの串。塩焼き指定なら植物性の可能性が高いが、共用の焼き台で肉の脂とタレが.en: A vegetable-only skewer. Salt-grilled, it is likely plant-based, but on the shared grill meat fat and sauce get on it. Check whether it can be salt-grilled.

野菜の割合がとにかく多く.en: a really high proportion of vegetables

野菜の蒸し陶板.en: vegetables steamed on a ceramic plate

野菜をたっぷり使った健康志向のメニューで、外国人観光客にも人気と記載されている。.en: Described as a health-minded menu using plenty of vegetables, popular with foreign tourists too.

野菜を活かした小皿料理が複数あり、野菜中心の食事を好む方には選択肢が存在する。.en: There are several vegetable-based small plates, so there are choices for people who prefer vegetable-centred meals.

野菜テリーヌのだし調理に動物性（鰹・魚介）が使用されており、ヴィーガン非対応の可.en: The dashi used for the vegetable terrine is animal-based (bonito, seafood), so it is very likely not vegan. Vegetarian requests are said to be possible on enquiry, but vegan handling is not stated.

野菜テリーヌは月替わりで旬食材を使用し、テリーヌの名称にある terre（大地）.en: The vegetable terrine changes monthly with seasonal ingredients, layering the terre (earth) in the word terrine with the earth of the storehouse walls, so the place and the food tell one story.

野菜・酢・砂糖・香辛料のみ。日本の醤油漬けと違い小麦を使わない洋風ピクルス。.en: Only vegetables, vinegar, sugar and spices. Unlike Japanese soy-pickled items, Western pickles use no wheat.

野菜料理にこだわり、ベジタリアンメニューがあると明記。塩分2g以下の減塩ランチな.en: Committed to vegetable dishes, and states that there is a vegetarian menu. A full range of health-minded items such as a low-salt lunch with 2 g of salt or less.

野菜炒めの味付けは小麦醤油・ウスターソースが一般的。要確認。.en: Stir-fried vegetables are usually seasoned with wheat soy sauce and Worcestershire. Ask.

金の茶釜の写し.en: a replica of the golden tea kettle

金シャチ商店街公式・食べログによれば、2023年6月16日に名古屋市西区那古野(.en: According to the official Kinshachi shopping street site and Tabelog, a small yakitori shop with 8 counter seats that opened on 16 June 2023 on a 2nd floor in Nagono, Nishi-ku, Nagoya (Endoji shopping street). Grilled over binchōtan, particular about brand chickens such as female Ōmi jidori, Amakusa Daiō and Mikawa red chicken. The owner's name is not published; only the given name 'Masaya' can be confirmed from Instagram (@hanauta_masaya).

金シャチ横丁の主要テナント.en: a major tenant of Kinshachi Yokocho

金シャチ横丁インタビューが1925年創業・2025年100周年・毎年のブレンド調.en: A Kinshachi Yokocho interview confirms the 1925 founding, the 2025 centenary, the yearly blend adjustment, the five points of noodle care (buckwheat flour as dusting flour), Kakukyu Hatcho miso and using the lid as a plate. The president's surname, Machida, matches across sources, but the given name is written inconsistently, so only the surname is given. The buckwheat flour matters for gluten/allergens: people with buckwheat allergy need care.

金シャチ横丁インタビューが伊勢志摩の漁師の息子・2000年名駅西口10坪の鳥開・.en: A Kinshachi Yokocho interview confirms: son of an Ise-Shima fisherman; Torikai, 10 tsubo at Meieki west exit, in 2000; the Nagoya Cochin showdown at Expo 2005 Aichi; founding Progre and rebranding in 2007; and a morning memory of sukiyaki. The official kodawari page states the top gold award at the Tebasaki Karaage Grand Prix three years running and six gold awards in the oyakodon category of the National Donburi Grand Prix (the bio's 'nine' was corrected to the official six).

金シャチ横丁公式が、名古屋城東門・宗春ゾーン内、市内3店に続く4店目、辛さ控えめ.en: The official Kinshachi Yokocho site describes it as being inside the Muneharu Zone by Nagoya Castle's east gate, the fourth shop after three in the city, mild enough for children through older people, and the owner's wish to carry Nagoya food culture and spread it to the world. The official site lists five shops in the city (Chojamachi, Sakae 4-chome, Kinshachi Yokocho, Meieki Sun Road, Terrasse Nayabashi) and sizes from S 250 g to M 1,000 g.

金シャチ横丁公式のニューストピックによれば、オーナー武藤輝将の父は名古屋市北区で.en: According to a news topic on the official Kinshachi Yokocho site, owner Terumasa Muto's father ran the tonkatsu shop 'Nabeya' in Kita-ku, Nagoya, and a week of helping out led to the decision to go into food. The policy is to protect Edomae while taking on challenges, using local ingredients such as Mikawa large clams, Gifu Hatsushimo rice and Nagoya-miso beef, and using red and white vinegar separately. Nigiri with a prawn shaped like the golden shachi is the specialty. The sushi chef at the counter was once a candidate to head a sushi school.

金シャチ横丁公式・食べログ・河口とうふ公式が、1934年（昭和9年）創業、国産非.en: The official Kinshachi Yokocho site, Tabelog and Kawaguchi Tofu's official site support the founding in 1934 (Showa 9), the method of domestic non-GMO soybeans, natural nigari, groundwater and no additives, and the branch in Kinshachi Yokocho near Nagoya Castle.

金沢1号店は現地の人気店「麺屋大河」が手掛けてオープンし、長野店は長野拠点の「吟.en: The first Kanazawa shop was opened by the popular local shop Menya Taiga; the Nagano branch is run by the Nagano-based Ginya group (owner Kawamoto Tenshi) under the supervision of Watanabe Yasuyuki, owner of Tokyo's Chuka Soba Kibi. Opening in Nagano just three months after the first Kanazawa shop drew attention for its speed.

金沢おでん・おばんざいの居酒屋.en: izakaya of Kanazawa oden and obanzai

金沢大野醤油＆焦がしキャラメル.en: Kanazawa Ono soy sauce & burnt caramel

金沢市東山・観音町（ひがし茶屋街周辺）.en: Higashiyama / Kannon-machi, Kanazawa (around the Higashi Chaya district)

金沢発祥（2025年9月）、長野店2025年12月12日開業.en: Born in Kanazawa (September 2025); the Nagano branch opened 12 December 2025

金沢経済新聞 confirms 山崎弘二が運営、洋菓子製造・生産管理の経歴と家業.en: Kanazawa Keizai Shimbun confirms: run by Yamazaki Koji, with a background in Western pastry manufacturing and production management and a family business (Yamazaki Mataichi Shoten, a Kaga lacquerware wholesaler); the 2014 'Conconto' project; opened May 2017; a former textile-machinery company building in Yokogawa (about 15 tsubo, 8 seats); plant ingredients of rice and beans, none of the 7 major allergens, additives kept to a minimum. PR TIMES confirms new products using koji fermentation from 2025.

金沢経済新聞(keizai.biz)は小林順子(製菓学校卒・県内飲食/菓子店・T.en: Kanazawa Keizai Shimbun (keizai.biz) confirms Kobayashi Junko (confectionery-school graduate; worked at restaurants and sweet shops in the prefecture; TV and radio reporter; natural-sweets planner); the motive, surprise at how many food allergies there were at a university-hospital event; opened summer 2014 in Ekinishi-shinmachi; 100% Japanese Koshihikari rice flour; house-made apple yeast; a year of test baking.

金茶寮は昭和8年（1933年）、加賀百万石・前田家の元家老であった横山男爵の別邸.en: Kincharyo is a ryotei inn that opened in Shōwa 8 (1933) in a villa acquired from Baron Yokoyama, a former chief retainer of the Maeda clan of Kaga's million-koku domain. Within a garden of about 1,000 tsubo stand a main building from the Meiji era and sukiya-style annexes. It has built its history as a leading culinary inn of the castle town of Kanazawa.

釜めしの炊き込み調味＝醤油、明太子調味液。.en: The kamameshi is cooked with soy sauce; mentaiko marinade.

釜揚げは麺を締めない＝小麦の風味が最も出る食べ方。つけだしは鰹・いりこ＝魚。.en: Kamaage doesn't rinse the noodles = the way to eat that brings out the wheat flavor most. The dipping dashi is bonito and iriko = fish.

釜焼鳥本舗 おやひなやは、関西圏で急成長する合同会社Forward ball（う.en: Kamayakitori Honpo Oyahinaya is a bone-in chicken izakaya run by Forward ball LLC, a fast-growing Kansai company with many formats (udon, beef cutlet, sushi, tempura, ramen, bars). The Himeji Ekimae shop opened on Wednesday 13 May 2026 at Ekimae-cho 294 B1F. The aim is to spread honetsuki-dori, a local dish from Marugame, Kagawa, to other regions.

鉄板の焼き物。ソース・醤油に小麦の可能性。.en: Grilled on an iron plate. The sauce and soy sauce may contain wheat.

鉄板共用。イカ天とは別物（こちらは衣なし）。.en: Shared griddle. Different from squid tempura (this has no coating).

鉄板料理のタレや仕上げには醤油（小麦含有）が一般的に使われる。グルテンフリー醤油.en: Soy sauce (containing wheat) is commonly used in teppan sauces and finishing. No explicit use of gluten-free soy sauce (wheat-free soy sauce, tamari labelled gluten-free).

鉄板焼きでは同一の調理面を複数の食材・ソースに使用するため、小麦を含む醤油ベース.en: Teppanyaki uses the same cooking surface for several ingredients and sauces, so there is a risk of contact with wheat-containing soy-based sauces and the like. No mention of gluten care on either the official site or booking sites.

鉄鍋ぎょうざとお酒の店.en: Tetsunabe Gyoza to Osake no Mise
鉄鍋ぎょうざとお酒の店.r: てつなべぎょうざとおさけのみせ

銀座ナイン公式: 風鈴屋、GINZA NINE 1号館1F、平日18:00〜24.en: GINZA NINE official: Fūrinya, GINZA NINE Building 1, 1F; weekdays 18:00–24:00 (evenings only), closed weekends and holidays. "Soup slowly simmered from carefully chosen ingredients"; scallions are free, so any ramen can be made a scallion ramen. Recommended: ramen (shoyu, miso, shio), ramen with half curry, seafood ramen, jumbo pan-fried gyoza (5 pieces). Ramen Walker (as featured in Time Out): house-made wavy noodles, natural handmade soup, free coriander on request, house Thai-style chili sauce. Tabelog: cash only; smoking allowed. 2026 reviews: shoyu ramen ¥750, jumbo gyoza ¥550, canned beer ¥400, wakame ramen ¥800; run by an older married couple.

銅板で一枚ずつ丁寧に焼き上げる昔ながらのふわふわパンケーキ（バター・メープルシロ.en: Old-fashioned fluffy pancakes cooked one at a time on a copper griddle (with butter and maple syrup). Lunch sets of fresh pasta at lunchtime too.

銘柄の等級（純米か本醸造か）が不明。純米なら米のみ。要確認。.en: The grade (junmai or honjozo) is unknown. Rice only if junmai. Check.

銘柄・種別の記載なし。純米なら米のみだが本醸造の可能性もあるため要確認。.en: No brand or type listed. Rice only if junmai, but it may be honjozo, so check.

銘柄未記載。麦焼酎なら大麦。.en: Brand not listed. Barley if barley shochu.

銘柄未記載のため清澄剤不明。.en: Brand not listed, so fining agents unknown.

錦水館直営.en: run directly by the Kinsuikan inn

鍋の割下に入る＝醤油、魚の出汁。.en: Goes into the hot-pot warishita = soy sauce; fish stock.

鍋自体は水と鶏のみ＝小麦なしの可能性が高いが、つけだれ（ポン酢）が醤油＝小麦。.en: The pot itself is very likely just water and chicken = no wheat, but the dipping sauce (ponzu) is soy sauce = wheat.

長年変わらない味を守り続けるスタイル。丁寧なカウンター対応。.en: Keeps a flavour unchanged for many years. Careful service at the counter.

長野市ナビ/ブーンで地元(権堂)出身・東京と広島で飲食経験・2022年12月開業.en: Nagano City Navi and Boon confirm: an owner from Gondo; restaurant experience in Tokyo and Hiroshima; opened December 2022; a café–bar fusion; rock-salt Basque cheesecake; the only place in the city serving beans from Tokyo's OBSCURA COFFEE ROASTERS. The name is read as coming from a calico cat (no source for the beckoning-cat idea, so softened).

長野市元善町462、善光寺境内そば。善光寺下駅より徒歩3分。.en: 462 Motozen-chō, Nagano City, by the Zenkoji precinct; 3 minutes' walk from Zenkoji-shita Station.

長野県直送盛りそば.en: mori soba shipped direct from Nagano

門藤は2021年6月22日、姫路城の麓の本町商店街にオープンした本わらび餅の専門.en: Kadofuji is a specialist in real bracken-starch warabi mochi, opened on 22 June 2021 in the Honmachi shopping street at the foot of Himeji Castle. The founder ate warabi mochi all over Japan and, after much trial and error, developed an original recipe using domestic real bracken-starch flour. The signature "Warabi Mochi Zeimi", created in a tie-up with a Michelin-starred chef, is known for its jiggly, melting texture and rich kinako flavour. It has since expanded through franchising to 12 shops nationwide.

開きの多くは塩のみだが一夜干しの調味液は未記載。.en: Most split dried fish are salt only, but the ichiya-boshi marinade isn't listed.

開き干しの塩焼き。魚自体は小麦不使用だが添えの醤油が小麦、焼き台は共用。.en: Salt-grilled split dried fish. The fish itself has no wheat, but the soy sauce on the side is wheat, and the grill is shared.

開店15分前から並んでも2巡目待ちになることがある人気ぶり。著者はとん汁目当てに.en: So popular that even lining up 15 minutes before opening can mean waiting for the second sitting. The writer came for the tonjiru and called it "addictive, with the sweetness of nearly melting onions and rich miso".

開店以来ランチタイムは満席になるほどの人気。8年経った2025年現在も昼時は落ち.en: Since opening, lunchtime has been popular enough to fill every seat. In 2025, eight years on, it still fills up at midday in a calm atmosphere.

開店間もない2026年5月の来店者レビューでは「皮はパリッと香ばしく、かぶりつく.en: A visitor's review from May 2026, just after opening, was favourable: "the skin is crisp and fragrant, and when you bite in, juices and chicken flavour flood out".

開業を記念し、10月16〜17日にはInstagramフォロワー向けに看板の熟成.en: To mark the opening, on 16–17 October it offered the signature aged-soy ramen to Instagram followers for ¥500 instead of the usual ¥900, among other opening promotions through the community and social media.

開業時からの人気デザート「自家製わらび餅」は食事に付き、多くのリピーターに愛され.en: The homemade warabi mochi, a popular dessert since opening, comes with meals and has many repeat fans.

関東の久寿餅は小麦澱粉を発酵させたもの＝小麦由来。.en: Kanto kuzu-mochi is fermented wheat starch = wheat-derived.

関西初の油そば専門店.en: the first abura-soba specialist in Kansai

関連のキーワード: 豚足, 牛すじ煮込み, 牛スジ, 唐揚, 肉汁, ぶり, ト.en: Related keywords: pig's trotters, stewed beef tendon, beef tendon, fried chicken, meat juices, yellowtail, fatty tuna, whelk, escargot, cream croquette, natto; review detail "● stewed beef tendon, ¥396: the sweetly simmered tendon is melting and delicious!" (September 2025 visit).

限定10食。内容は日替わり。要確認。.en: Limited to 10 servings. Contents change daily. Ask.

隅田屋商店は1905年、初代・松五郎が浅草の米屋で修業したのちのれん分けを受け、.en: Sumidaya Shoten is a rice shop opened in 1905 on the banks of the Sumida River by the founder, 松五郎, after training at a rice dealer in Asakusa and being granted the right to open a branch under its name. It built trust through the Great Kanto Earthquake and the severe rice shortages after the war, and under the second generation, 三郎, it lived through the food shortages of the Pacific War and rationing. Today the fifth generation, 片山真一, heads the business. On March 17, 2026, marking 120 years, it opened a directly run showroom shop with an eat-in space in Asakusa, "Okome to Gohan Sumidaya Asakusa", its first venture into restaurants as a rice dealer.

隅田屋最大の特長は商標登録された「古式精米製法」で、一般的な精米が一度で仕上げる.en: Sumidaya's greatest feature is its trademarked "traditional milling method": where ordinary milling finishes in one pass, Sumidaya polishes slowly in 7–10 passes at low pressure.

階のビリヤードのキュー、大きな窓（新幹線ビュー）、1階の.en: floor's billiard cues, a big window (Shinkansen view), the ground floor's

隠れ動物性食材（かつおだし・みりん等）の有無について非公開。精進料理の伝統的手法.en: Hidden animal ingredients (bonito dashi, mirin, etc.) are not disclosed. If it follows traditional shojin methods it is likely vegan-friendly, but this needs checking.

雑穀と豆乳の自家製フォカッチャ.en: house-made focaccia with mixed grains and soy milk

雑穀米には押麦・大麦が含まれることが多い＝グルテン。.en: Multigrain rice often contains pressed barley or barley = gluten.

韓国のりの調味に醤油、たくあんも醤油漬けの場合あり。.en: Soy sauce in the Korean-nori seasoning; the takuan is sometimes soy-pickled too.
