Shop introduction: grilled Japanese sirloin; seafood; fresh pasta; sommelier-selected wines; wooden interior. 2026 reviews: a plan with all-you-can-drink and all-you-can-eat Margherita, about ¥3,000–4,000 (salad, fritto, penne, dessert); grape beer; meat dishes sometimes sold out; noisy with groups; strict about plan time limits.

食べログ: MELT chocolate、大阪市中央区南船場4-7-22 船場N.en: Tabelog: MELT chocolate, Senba NS Bldg 1F, Minami-Senba 4-7-22, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 280 m from Shinsaibashi Stn; daily 11:30–20:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR (cash only); 8 seats; non-smoking; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): a chocolate specialty shop; only two drinks, hot cocoa ¥850 and iced cocoa ¥900, each with chocolate on top that melts in; nama chocolate in classic, 60% cacao, pistachio, coffee and more, about 5 cm across per piece; tables and chairs outside too; at 6:30 pm on a weekday only one kind was left; always a line at the register; black frontage with cacao artwork as the landmark.

食べログ: MENYA MITSUKI、大阪市天王寺区玉造元町3-30、玉造から.en: Tabelog: MENYA MITSUKI, 3-30 Tamatsukuri-motomachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 111 m from Tamatsukuri; daily 11:00–21:30; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 28 November 2025. Reviews (January–October 2026): kombu-water tsukemen (shoyu and salt); start with salt; a chicken-and-salt dipping soup; warm honkatsu dashi; lemon; the special ¥1,430 (pork and chicken chashu, seasoned egg, menma); chicken shoyu ramen ¥890 (clear broth of minced chicken with chicken fat, thin straight noodles, pork and chicken-breast chashu, thick menma, radish sprouts, white leek); seared chashu mayo rice bowl (2 kinds of chashu); ticket machine; 8 counter seats; run by two people; cramped when busy; one found the chashu underwhelming; some days the noodles were unevenly cooked.

食べログ: MITHILA(ミティラー)、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-6-14 平松扇.en: Tabelog: MITHILA, Hiramatsu Ogiya Bldg 2F, 1-6-14 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 45 seats; Mon–Tue 17:00–23:00, Wed–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00; L.O. 22:00; no lunch Mon–Tue; dinner every day of the year; smoking allowed; cards accepted; opened 1 September 1999; features: vegetables, healthy menu, vegetarian menu. Reviews (December 2022 – September 2026): South Indian dishes (dosa with potato masala, rasam); Kingfisher; masala chai; Indian staff, English needed; butter chicken; crisp naan; heat 1–5; tandoori chicken; spinach curry; chicken biryani set; Mithila set ¥880 → ¥1,650 (August 2025); dal curry; keema; standard heat is almost none; rather salty; the biryani is enough for two and can be taken away; papad; mango lassi; mild curries.

食べログ: MONDIAL KAFFEE 328 GUT WOLF、大阪市西区南.en: Tabelog: MONDIAL KAFFEE 328 GUT WOLF, Osakaya Bldg 1F, 1-1-20 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 5; the table gives daily 11:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); irregular closing days; an older listing gives Mon–Thu 10:00–21:00, Fri, Sat and days before holidays 10:00–23:00; opened 23 November 2015; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking on the terrace only; 10 seats (5 inside, 5 terrace); takeaway; house-roasted specialty coffee; a large roaster; house baked goods made daily. Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): the roasting base of the MONDIAL KAFFEE 328 group; the smell of coffee on entering; Ethiopian hand drip; many order dark roasts; brewed to your stated taste; caffè latte ¥600; iced Americano ¥600; chili con carne sandwich; salad lunch with drink ¥1,650; Wi-Fi; beans for sale; few seats, better for takeaway.

食べログ: MUGEN NEXT 無限ラーメン by NEXT Halal、大阪.en: Tabelog: MUGEN NEXT Mugen Ramen by NEXT Halal, 1-19-22 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 10:00–23:00; cards (VISA, Master) accepted; no smoking; opened 20 August 2026. 2026 reviews (August–October): the halal-certified shop of Mugen Ramen Namba Nakamoto; 100% halal ingredients; beef-bone tori-paitan ramen (shoyu) ¥1,180; truffle beef-bone tori paitan ¥1,680; MUGEN NEXT special ¥2,980; beef-bone spicy noodles ¥1,480; meat maze-soba ¥1,150; grilled sea bream and hamaguri salt soba ¥990; roast beef 2 slices ¥360, 4 slices ¥690; melting beef belly 2 slices ¥480, 4 slices ¥890; soft-boiled seasoned egg ¥130; noodle refill ¥150; vegetable gyoza 3 for ¥330; thin straight noodles (2.75 mm) from Mori Seimen Factory; espuma-style foam; roast-beef and chicken-breast chashu; red radish, paprika, broccoli, lemon, menma; free grated garlic; pepper and chili oil on the table; slow at the till; prices on the high side; most diners from overseas.

食べログ: Madera、銀座6-13-4 銀座S2ビルB1F、東銀座駅A1出口.en: Tabelog: Madera, Ginza 6-13-4, Ginza S2 Building B1F, 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A1; 32 seats, semi-private rooms (6 and 8); Mon–Sat 18:00–3:00, closed Sundays and holidays; charge ¥800; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; heated tobacco only; opened February 15, 2023. Shop introduction: a basement in Ginza 6-chome, brick walls and wooden tables; about 100 wines, mainly Spanish; whisky and craft gin; pizza, paella, wine braises and grills. A bottle plan for two ¥7,500 (reservation required). Reviews: on the former site of Aladdin Duo (the spelling in an English review); wine by the glass from ¥1,300; roast lamb; pasta and pizza; in July 2026, oil pasta late at night, tarako pasta with plenty of shiso, paella.

食べログ: Mimi Eden、大阪市西区北堀江2-2-11、Ajiru Kit.en: Tabelog: Mimi Eden, Kitahorie 2-2-11, Nishi-ku, Osaka, Ajiru Kitahorie (apartment building) 1F; 3 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Stn, 5 min from Yotsubashi Stn Exit 5, 8 min from Shinsaibashi Stn; Wed–Mon and holidays 11:00–17:00 (food L.O. 16:30); closed Tuesday; bread-buffet lunch 11:00–15:30 (L.O. 14:30); café 11:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:00); seating may be limited to 80 minutes; reservations accepted (arrive 5–10 minutes early; more than 15 minutes late cancels the booking); cards, transport IC, WAON, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai accepted; 12 seats (tables); non-smoking; Wi-Fi; birthday plates; bread half price after 16:00 (to cut food waste); opened 7 January 2026. Reviews (October 2026): order a main and add the bread buffet (¥700 or ¥770); salad with the bread buffet ¥2,770; the premium course adds desserts; croissants and salt bread fresh every 30 minutes, brought to the table; 10–15 kinds of bread, mostly sweet (focaccia, apple, mango, fig and curry danishes, matcha croissant, mentaiko cheese, corn mayo, bacon sandwich, sweet potato bread, muscat and strawberry fruit sandwiches); French toast, ice cream, cheesecake and tiramisu from the showcase; cookies, brownies, pound cake, banana cake; clam chowder, cream pasta, omurice; a toaster provided; Halloween decorations; full from opening, with some groups sent to terrace seats; bread scarce and dry later in the day, per one diner; one diner found ¥2,000 for a salad plus ¥700 for bread poor value.

食べログ: Mr.R、大阪市中央区高津2-1-15、日本橋駅・谷町九丁目駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Mr.R, 2-1-15 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi and Tanimachi-Kyuchome stations; Mon, Thu and Fri 18:00–6:00 next morning, Tue 11:00–18:00, Wed, Sat and Sun 11:00–6:00 next morning; also listed as bookable from 20:00 and open until 10:00; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 8 seats (counter 5, tables 3); heated-tobacco-only smoking area; opened 21 November 2023. Reviews (December 2024 – August 2026): black tantanmen with soup ¥1,000, heat 4; a rich black-sesame soup; numbing; thin straight noodles; meat miso, dried shrimp, mizuna, takuan; open 22:00–10:00; white at level 5 with seasoned egg; soupless white tantanmen with thick wavy noodles; level 5 +¥100; 20:00–10:00 next morning; plenty of ground sesame; shrimp makes it laksa-like; garlicky karaage; cold versions in summer; a night-shift break; orange-peel water; house chili oil and Sichuan pepper; noodle refills; an izakaya cum tantanmen shop; 20:00–8:00; friendly staff; black tantanmen ¥1,100; just off Matsuyamachi-suji.

食べログ: NEXT□(ネクストシカク)、大阪市中央区難波千日前9-12 道具屋.en: Tabelog: NEXT□ (Next Shikaku), Doguyasuji shopping street, 9-12 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6643-7787; no reservations; Mon–Fri 10:30–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:30); open every day of the year (closed 30 December – 3 January); welcome even just before closing; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 15 seats (counter 6, large table 8); opened 1 August 2021; Hyakumeiten (Ramen OSAKA 2025); site silver-grape.com. October 2026 reviews: oyster paitan; drinks every drop of the oyster-infused soup each time; oyster shoyu ramen; 3 groups waiting at weekend lunch; ticket machine out front; special 'Koeru' (rich oyster, chashu that isn't greasy, change the flavour with spices); oyster paitan ramen with seasoned egg; projection mapping; wait outside and enter when called; those queuing mostly from overseas; the triple-soup 'Koeru' and the oyster-dashi 'Ikasu'; fried oysters with salt and lemon; soft noodles; creamy soup with citrus; shirasu rice bowl (sesame and sauce).

食べログ: Neo Maestro、銀座7-10-12 第二柳屋ビルB1F、新橋.en: Tabelog: Neo Maestro, Ginza 7-10-12, 第二柳屋 Building B1F, 5 minutes from Shinbashi and Ginza stations; 18 seats, private room; daily 11:30–24:00; irregular holidays; cards, IC and QR (Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; ¥5,000–6,000 at night, ¥2,000–3,000 at lunch. Shop introduction (English): cocktails by an owner-chef qualified as a master bartender; amuse, cold starter, poêlé of fresh fish, the day's meat, dessert platter. 2026 reviews: in the basement next to Komoro Soba; at lunch a one-plate meal, one daily pasta, a meat dish and gratin for ¥1,000; chicken with a delicious sauce; slow on full days; one staffer.

食べログ: Niku Teria カルネバッカ、大阪市西区北堀江1-22-26、.en: Tabelog: Niku Teria Carne Bacca, 1-22-26 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station, 5 from Shinsaibashi and Yotsubashi stations; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Wednesdays; cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY) accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats (counter 6, tables 14). Reviews (February–October 2026): an Italian meat bar; starter platter ¥1,500 (pumpkin and sweet-potato salad, potato salad, ham); house charcuterie; chicken, pork and beef platter ¥2,280; the signature beef-tongue stew Hebereke ¥2,600; sirloin-cap carpaccio; beef-tataki salad; shungiku salad; natto ajillo; hamburg; Butcher's Bolognese; meat-topped butter rice to finish; 2-hour all-you-can-drink course ¥5,500; friendly staff; birthday plates arranged; one found a group course underwhelming and a Tabelog booking unconfirmed.

食べログ: OBRA 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区南船場4-12-9 1F、心斎橋駅か.en: Tabelog: OBRA Shinsaibashi, 1F, 4-12-9 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Thu 10:30–19:00 (L.O. 18:30), Fri–Sun and holidays 10:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); opened 4 May 2026; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 20 seats; power and Wi-Fi; takeaway. Reviews (September–October 2026): rich Uji-matcha pudding ¥900 (firm and strong); rich matcha gelato topping +¥250; matcha sauce; matcha Basque cheesecake; hojicha baked cheesecake; Uji matcha latte 'Zuiun' ¥850 (no syrup); mango matcha latte; matcha strawberry latte; iced sencha; peach pudding in peach season; order first, then sit; a calm wooden interior; one found it pricey; one waited a long time.

食べログ: OSAKA きっちん 銀座本店、銀座4-14-19 グレート2F、東.en: Tabelog: OSAKA Kitchen Ginza main shop, Ginza 4-14-19, Great 2F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station; 18 seats; weekdays 17:00–23:00, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00, closed Sun; opened November 11, 2009; official site osaka-kitchen.com. Shop introduction: 15 years in a Ginza back lane; Osaka okonomiyaki and teppanyaki; light okonomiyaki, fluffy inside and crisp outside; freshly cut cabbage. 2026 reviews: omakase course with all-you-can-drink ¥7,000 (starter, tonpei-yaki, beef-tendon yaki, cheese and tofu, octopus, chicken and zucchini, okonomiyaki, coffee jelly); the higher course has wagyu; weekend-only lunch (tonpei-yaki, grilled sesame tofu, 大山 chicken, half and half of mini okonomiyaki and yakisoba); described as a Michelin Bib Gourmand four years running; friendly staff.

食べログ: OSARU Coffee (オサル コーヒー)、大阪市浪速区元町1-.en: Tabelog: OSARU Coffee, 1-7-15 Motomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 308 m from JR Namba Station; daily 8:00–17:00; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 11 seats; no reservations; opened 22 August 2016; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): the ground floor is a coffee-only stand where you sit shoes-off on wooden boxes; iced coffee of the dark roast 'Slow Boat'; 'Magic Hour'; hot Ethiopian; a light Americano without acidity; caffè latte. Plates at the cafe upstairs in the next building: onion and bacon croque-monsieur ¥1,400; hot coffee ¥700; ham and egg sandwich plate (salad, potato salad, yogurt with honey); French toast; croissant; cheesecake. A line of about 15 before Saturday opening; queue on the stairs; don't queue in front of Kumon next door; slow to order when busy; the entrance a little hard to find.

食べログ: Old Cairo Cafe、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-3-21 吉本.en: Tabelog: Old Cairo Cafe, Yoshimoto Bldg 3F, 2-3-21 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 30 seats; daily 12:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30) and 18:00–1:00 next morning (L.O. 0:30); opening days and private hires announced on Instagram; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; no smoking by day (smoking area on the balcony), smoking allowed at night; features: vegetables, healthy, vegan, vegetarian, halal menus; opened 23 August 2020. 2024–2026 reviews: a shisha cafe with an Egyptian atmosphere; shish tawook about ¥1,600; chicken plate ¥1,800; shisha ¥2,200; koshari; service slowed one day by a dance show; lunch plate with rice; learned of it from an Expo food magazine; molokhia soup; ta'ameya (falafel); hummus and pita; kahk; baklava; hibiscus juice; found closed on several visits; booked for the evening; garlic vinegar and chili oil; mint tea.

食べログ: Opuses(オウパセズ、旧店名 Opus)、銀座8-9-4 ザ ロ.en: Tabelog: Opuses (formerly Opus), Ginza 8-9-4, The Royal Park Canvas Ginza 8 14F; 80 seats (60 inside, 20 terrace); breakfast 7:00–10:30, lunch 11:30–14:30, tea 14:30–17:30, dinner 17:30–22:00, Sundays until 21:00; open every day; opened March 20, 2019; particular about fish; breakfast available; allergen labeling. Shop introduction: seafood and vegetables from all over Japan in a special oven; an all-day dining room with unified interior, food, tableware, art and music; a private terrace. 2026 reviews: autumn sharing lunch course ¥4,000 per person (with two drinks; sparkling only once); a pork dish; a shortcake like panna cotta; portions bigger than expected; many tourists staying at the hotel.

食べログ: Osteria Barababao 銀座(オステリア バラババオ)、.en: Tabelog: Osteria Barababao Ginza, Ginza 2-6-5, Ginza Treasure 9F; 56 seats; weekdays 11:30–15:30, 17:30–23:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–15:30, 17:00–23:00; standing corner from the evening; follows the building's hours; no smoking inside, smoking room at the back; opened April 16, 2010; official site osteria-barababao.com. Shop introduction: certified Ospitalità Italiana by the Italian government; recreates a back-lane wine bistro of Venice; Italian staff. October 2026 reviews: weekend prix-fixe lunch (8-starter platter; choose pasta, main and dessert; a pork main); a queue before opening; beer and wine with starters at the standing bar (about ¥5,000 for two); some complaints of rude staff and dry pasta.

食べログ: Osteria da K.[kappa](オステリア ダ カッパ)、.en: Tabelog: Osteria da K.[kappa], Ginza 8-7-2, Ginza 藤井 Building 2, 5F, on Hanatsubaki-dori, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exit A2; 18 seats (8 counter); Mon–Fri 18:00–22:00, Sat 17:00–21:00, closed Sundays and holidays; irregular holidays; allow 2–2.5 hours; opened August 25, 2014. Shop introduction: the Italian restaurant of Michelin three-star "Sushi Yoshitake"; fish from the same middlemen as top sushi shops; uni pasta; acqua pazza of kinmedai or nodoguro; abalone ragù; chef Katsunari Isogai (English spelling). 2026 reviews: today's carpaccio, burrata, trippa, cold spaghetti with Hokkaido uni and fresh nori, seafood ragù, carbonara risotto, horse-meat carpaccio, mussels in white wine, roast beef; run by a married couple, so order all at once.

食べログ: PANAME CREPES DE PARIS 大阪店、大阪市中央区西.en: Tabelog: PANAME CREPES DE PARIS Osaka, 1-10-41 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station (behind Hotel Nikko); daily 10:00–23:00; irregular closing days; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; heated tobacco only; 15 seats; listed as able to cater for vegetarians; English menu; children welcome; takeaway; opened 26 April 2023. Reviews (September–October 2026): a stylish Parisian interior and pretty tableware; salmon royale; a slightly spicy minced-meat galette; lots of cheese; filling enough for a meal; fifty-fifty; chocolate crêpe with lightly sweet cream; chewy with crisp edges; Dubai chocolate (one found it too sweet); sugar, butter and lemon; one-drink minimum for eat-in; cashless only.

食べログ: PENTHOUSE GINZA hanare:、銀座8-5-9 民友.en: Tabelog: PENTHOUSE GINZA hanare:, Ginza 8-5-9, 民友 Building 3F, 3 minutes from Shinbashi Station exit A5; 23 seats; weekdays 17:30–22:30, closed Sundays and holidays, sometimes Saturdays, irregular holidays. Shop introduction: certified to handle meat for raw consumption; 50th anniversary; sister shop of the members-only steakhouse PENTHOUSE; traditional steak, casually; sirloin crisp on the outside. 2026 reviews: meat carpaccio with myoga, red onion and special ponzu; potato salad; abalone (overcooked); striploin and fillet compared; rice and miso soup; a spicy curry with no fillings; monaka; quiet on weekday evenings; negi-yaki with sauce; beef sashimi; several shops in the same building.

食べログ: PLEIN 銀座本店、銀座7-3-6 銀座髙木ビル9F、銀座駅・新橋.en: Tabelog: PLEIN Ginza Honten, Ginza 7-3-6, Ginza Takagi Building 9F, 5 minutes from Ginza and Shinbashi stations; 15 seats (11 counter, private room for 2–4); terrace seats; Tue–Sat and holidays 12:00–14:30, 18:00–22:30, closed Sun and Mon; opened December 2, 2023; main shop of the PLEIN group; cards and IC accepted. 2026 reviews: unpretentious, authentic French; omakase finished at the counter; efficient service; the familiar chef and staff left in September; frites and confit; a remark that the plates weren't warmed; ¥6,000–8,000 at lunch, ¥15,000–20,000 at dinner.

食べログ: PRESTAU、大阪市西区新町2-17-17、西大橋駅から徒歩5分、.en: Tabelog: PRESTAU, 2-17-17 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 12:00–15:00 (L.O. food 13:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. food 20:00); closed Mondays (Tuesday if a holiday) and one Sunday a month; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 12 seats. Reviews (July–October 2026): a pale blue frontage; an interior of grey stone and concrete; care over tableware; monthly lunch course ¥7,700 (cuttlefish, water aubergine and okra squid-ink risotto with sudachi; sardine with summer turnip and Shira-Kaga ume; linguine of hamo and karasumi; house conchiglie with beef-tongue ragù; charcoal-grilled Moulard duck; pineapple and sansho; petits fours; coffee or herbal tea); short dinner course with drink pairing; swordfish; quail; venison; purple carrot; dessert in three stages; dislikes accommodated if mentioned in advance; delicate seasoning; one found drink service inattentive; one says the venison knife was blunt.

食べログ: PROTEIN LAB 北堀江店、大阪市西区北堀江1-15-19 1.en: Tabelog: PROTEIN LAB Kita-Horie, 1F, 1-15-19 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 050-5596-8859; reservations accepted; daily 10:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed over New Year; cards, e-money (transit IC, iD, QUICPay) and QR (PayPay) accepted; 18 seats; opened 11 June 2017; official protein.co.jp; allergen and calorie labelling. Shop's description: salads and original bowls planned around protein, fat and carbohydrate; choose your toppings; gut-health menu; 'STYLECHOICE' bases with 6 concepts (one a high-protein option for vegans). 2026 reviews (May–September): PROTEIN LAB bowl ¥1,600 (tender chicken breast); Mexican bowl ¥1,480; açaí bowl ¥1,600 (banana, strawberry, blueberry, coconut, kiwi, granola; honey on request); jerky and dried vegetables for dogs; pay first at the till; self-serve water; quinoa; calorie and PFC labelling; many gym-goers; Instagram coupons; also on Uber; even the S size satisfies.

食べログ: Peter(ピーター)、千代田区有楽町1-8-1 ザ・ペニンシュラ東.en: Tabelog: Peter, Yurakucho 1-8-1, Chiyoda-ku, The Peninsula Tokyo 24F, Hibiya Station exits A6/A7; 112 seats (1 private, 1 semi-private room); daily 11:30–14:00, 17:30–22:00; 18% service charge; opened September 1, 2007. October 2026 reviews: from steakhouse to French; Takashimaya original course ¥7,800 (yuba and beet espuma; rye bread; Japanese mushroom soup with white soy sauce and soy-milk foam; Hakodate cod with chestnut cream and a celeriac sauce; Fuji apple tart); poached egg with vin jaune and kinome sauce; steamed flounder; a pink-themed autumn afternoon tea (Oscietra caviar tartlet, black-truffle ham croque, chestnut and framboise).

食べログ: Pivot BASE Cafe & Bar @Dotonbori、大.en: Tabelog: Pivot BASE Cafe & Bar @Dotonbori, Nakaza Kuidaore Bldg 1F, 1-7-21 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 40 seats; daily 11:30–22:30; open every day of the year; no smoking; fully cashless; features: vegetables, vegan menu, vegetarian menu; opened 3 September 2022; site dotonbori-night.com/pivot. Shop introduction: a cafe & bar for new travel experiences; vegan-friendly takoyaki and yakisoba. Reviews (November 2023 – June 2026): lots of drinks; spacious and quiet; ordering by QR; beer and takoyaki set; soup; cold summer-vegetable salt ramen ¥1,780 (no animal ingredients and no dashi; fried aubergine, okra, pumpkin, tomato, mizuna, pickled ginger); rice-flour takoyaki (konnyaku instead of octopus); a vegan restaurant; comes with salad and soup; with a friend allergic to dairy, chocolate ice cream ¥650 and iced tea ¥680; prices on the high side.

食べログ: RAMEN えびの女神、大阪市浪速区元町1-3-12、JR難波駅から.en: Tabelog: RAMEN Ebi no Megami, 1-3-12 Motomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 148 m from JR Namba Station; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Thursdays; no reservations; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; no smoking; opened 12 June 2024. Reviews (March–October 2026): an ise-ebi sign and a stylish interior; Megami set (ise-ebi miso); a rich, creamy soup; seasoned egg, wood-ear, slivered onion; free noodle refills; put rice and cheese into the leftover soup and sear it with the table burner for risotto; ise-ebi powder and chili oil; rice small, medium or large; Kiwami set ¥5,500; shrimp-miso ramen with abalone topping ¥3,000; a soup of 100% ise-ebi; pricey but the staff are kind; Megami set ¥2,000 from the ticket machine (shrimp miso or shrimp shoyu); about 10 counter seats and one table; milky-white soup; medium-thick noodles; bok choy; lemon to finish; rumoured to be the most expensive ramen in western Japan; the ramen is like a starter for the risotto.

食べログ: RIGOLETTO KITCHEN(リゴレット キッチン)、銀座8-.en: Tabelog: RIGOLETTO KITCHEN, Ginza 8-2-1, Nitta Building B1F; 90 seats; Mon–Thu 11:30–15:00, 17:00–2:00, Fri until 4:00, Sat 11:30–23:00, Sundays and holidays 11:30–22:00; opened September 20, 2007; operator HUGE (huge.co.jp); booking app THE HUGE CLUB. October 2026 reviews: hard to get into at lunch without a booking; pasta set ¥1,600 (salad, drink, pasta, dessert; salad with lotus-root chips); shiso and shirasu peperoncino (linguine); Bismarck with prosciutto and soft egg; catalana; arrabbiata; slow when short-staffed.

食べログ: RISTASIX、銀座6-14-10 コートヤード・マリオット銀座東.en: Tabelog: RISTASIX, Ginza 6-14-10, Courtyard by Marriott Ginza Tobu Hotel 1F, 239 m from Higashi-Ginza Station; daily 6:30–10:00, 11:30–22:00; dress code (no overly casual clothes); official site rista6.courtyardginza.com. 2026 reviews: for lunch or coffee; spacious and comfortable; kind staff; there's pho; affordable for a hotel lounge; a holiday-only lunch buffet (Christmas and summer vacation); afternoon tea with a birthday plate; Shine Muscat afternoon tea (weekdays 8/1–10/31, entry 11:30–15:30, 3-hour limit, ¥6,000 incl. tax; chilled white-peach soup; a Champagne cocktail of Ginza honey and Shine Muscat; mousse; tart; cannoli); opened with the hotel's renovation; black and gray with teal accents.

食べログ: ROCO、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-1、毎日17:30〜24:0.en: Tabelog: ROCO, 1-17-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 17:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); cards accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats (counter 6, tables 14). Reviews (September 2018 – June 2025): an interior like an Italian bar; small, chewy, rustic pizzas, formerly ¥500–600 each; margherita; basil pizza; quattro formaggi with honey; mentaiko pizza; ajillo; prosciutto; starter platter; cheap wine; one-drink minimum; one says pizzas were served one at a time to keep them hot; one found the service curt; one found the backless wooden stools tiring; the latest review is from June 2025.

食べログ: Ramen KURUMU、大阪市西区北堀江1-9-11 1F、四ツ橋.en: Tabelog: Ramen KURUMU, 1F, 1-9-11 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 4; daily 8:00–15:00 (ends when the soup runs out; announced on Instagram); irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 11 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 6 October 2023. Reviews (May–October 2026): a queue at 8 a.m. on weekends, about 20 minutes; meat and shrimp wonton noodles (black) ¥1,200; seasoned egg ¥100; meat-based soup and aroma oil with shoyu; medium-thin noodles; leek, menma, nori, thin-sliced chashu; chili oil on the shrimp wontons, black pepper on the meat wontons; 2 meat wontons in the black; light yet good; straight noodles; in at noon, 5 waiting on leaving; two shoyu, black and white; wide chashu; one says the pepper is unnecessary; seasoned-egg salt ramen (white) ¥1,100; yuzu; a little oily; noodles possibly flat; the owner trained at a famous wonton-noodle shop in Tokyo; the name means cloud; ticket machine; 11 counter seats; the black is a clear broth of 100% jidori with shoyu; many overseas visitors; one calls it on the light side.

食べログ: Ramen 兼田、大阪市中央区難波3-2-18 エディオンなんば本店.en: Tabelog: Ramen Kaneda, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 23 seats; daily 11:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:30); open every day of the year; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 1 April 2025. 2026 reviews: chuka soba ¥980, seasoned egg ¥200, seared chicken yukhoe rice bowl ¥500; a strong chicken-based shoyu; smooth, slightly thin straight noodles; pork-belly and rare roast chashu; limited cold bonito-kombu-water tsukemen ¥1,100; one felt the salt tori paitan was thinner than before; spicy tori paitan large ¥1,350; Ramen Ichiza; the cold bonito and kombu water is silky-thick; medium-thick noodles; moist chicken chashu; quiet at weekday lunchtime; strong umami and salt; rich tori paitan; many overseas diners, a short wait; tori-paitan shoyu with egg about ¥1,280; on the salty side.

食べログ: Ramen 華、大阪市西区新町1-33-16 日宝新町ビル 1F、西.en: Tabelog: Ramen Hana, Nippo Shinmachi Bldg 1F, 1-33-16 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–21:30; open every day of the year; no cards, e-money or QR; 27 seats; children welcome. Reviews (July 2023 – October 2026): a clean, stylish, spacious shop; tori-paitan ramen ¥1,000 (thick as potage, truffle sauce, radish sprouts, low-temperature chashu, menma; change the flavour with lemon and black pepper); special; rich shoyu; aged salt; tsukemen; summer cold tori paitan ¥1,050; evening beer set ¥800 (karaage, draught beer, menma); fried rice; thin whole-wheat noodles; noodle refills; one found the chashu tough.

食べログ: Restaurant Miyazaki、銀座3-3-1 ZOE銀座9.en: Tabelog: Restaurant Miyazaki, Ginza 3-3-1, ZOE Ginza 9F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit C8 and Ginza-itchome Station exit 5; 32 seats (tables); private-room fee ¥11,000; weekdays and holidays 11:30–15:00, 17:30–23:00, closed weekends; 10% service charge; cards, IC and QR accepted; opened July 15, 2024; official site cityclub.co.jp/miyazaki/. Shop introduction: "tradition and innovation" championed by chef Osamu Miyazaki, experienced at famous restaurants; lunch from ¥8,800 with two desserts; a lunch with 90 minutes of free-flowing Mumm Champagne. 2026 reviews: foods you dislike checked when booking; salmon mi-cuit; corn soup; poêlé of red sea bream; a main of game or wagyu; roast Ezo venison; a cava toast; two desserts; the chef sees you off.

食べログ: Restaurant つじ川、大阪市中央区南船場3丁目2-28 タイ.en: Tabelog: Restaurant Tsujikawa, Minami-Senba 3-chome 2-28, Taiyo Bldg, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi, Honmachi and Nagahoribashi Stns; Tue–Fri 18:00–22:00, Sat and Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Monday; reservation only; leaving within 2 hours of the booking is not accepted; cash only since the card company went bankrupt on 6 July 2026; no split bills; 5% service charge at dinner; 12 seats (counter 8, table 4); non-smoking; no children; Tabelog Innovative/Creative Top 100 2025; opened 21 April 2014. Shop description: French techniques of deconstruction and reconstruction with Japanese ingredients such as dashi and miso, a seasonal menu that changes about eight times a year, freshly baked homemade focaccia, five desserts, omakase course ¥14,770. Reviews (July 2024–September 2026): warm service from the couple, L-shaped counter, sea urchin and Ezo abalone, sea bream tartare, sautéed scallops, foie gras mousse with persimmon, isaki with burdock, domestic beef fillet, grilled matsutake risotto, eel with truffle sauce over rice, five desserts, focaccia refills, lunch is cash only.

食べログ: SAVATOMY、大阪市中央区安土町1-4-11、堺筋本町駅12番出.en: Tabelog: SAVATOMY, 1-4-11 Azuchimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 12; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00), Sat 17:00–22:30; closed Sundays; cards and QR accepted; 20 seats. October 2026 reviews: a stylish, popular creative-Chinese bar; small plates for two to share; the signature bonito tataki in red sauce (smoky, nicely hot); drool chicken; chicken thigh; anago; corn spring rolls; seasonal oyster spring rolls; shrimp in chili sauce; dim sum; the menu changes with the seasons; weekly lunch; mapo tofu; tantanmen lunch; a premium lunch +¥1,000 (about ¥2,000); 18-year Shaoxing wine (neat or with soda); Italian beer; book for dinner; sometimes a time-limited table; seasoning easy for those who don't like heat; one found a reply to an order check curt.

食べログ: SEIDAKO、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-16-7 ミフネセントラルベ.en: Tabelog: SEIDAKO, Mifune Central Bear Dotonbori 101, 2-16-7 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Thu 12:00–2:00 next morning, Fri–Sun 12:00–3:00 next morning; cash only; smoking allowed; 20 seats. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): a takoyaki izakaya in Amemura; dashi-rich takoyaki, crisp outside and molten inside; salt mayo, salt butter, sauce mayo; lots of snacks; good for daytime drinking; Masachan highball; takoyaki flour to take home (sometimes sold out); cheerful staff; lots of stickers.

食べログ: SHUN SAI KA NAKA、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-12.en: Tabelog: SHUN SAI KA NAKA, Asano Bldg B1, 1-6-12 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; Mon, Tue, Thu and Fri 18:00–2:00 next morning, Sat 17:00–2:00 next morning, Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00 (food L.O. an hour before closing); closed Wednesdays; temporary closures on social media; opened 4 April 2014; smoking at all seats; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 18 seats (counter 6, sunken kotatsu). Reviews (September 2025 – August 2026): a daily menu; seasonal ingredients and lots of vegetables; one says hotel-style Chinese at izakaya prices; roast chashu ¥1,100; squid in Hong Kong sauce ¥1,400; spicy stir-fried oysters ¥1,500; whole steamed Shanghai crab with abalone-liver sauce ¥4,000; sweet-and-sour spare ribs; chicken-neck kara-age; green pepper and beef stir-fry; braised beef; beef tataki; clams with thick glass noodles; water spinach; noodle soup; off-menu fried rice or ramen on request; New Year course with all-you-can-drink ¥6,600; portions just right for 2–3 to share.

食べログ: SONOKO CAFE 銀座店(旧店名 SO CAFE)、銀座5-9.en: Tabelog: SONOKO CAFE Ginza (formerly SO CAFE), Ginza 5-9-1, 銀座幸 Building 1F, right by Ginza Station exit A5; 29 seats (7 counter, 22 table); daily 11:00–20:00; open every day; official site sonoko.co.jp; particular about vegetables and fish, healthy menu, breakfast, allergen labeling, vegetarian menu. Shop introduction: founded by beauty and food researcher 鈴木その子; oil-free, additive-free, carefully chosen ingredients; hamburg steaks of Japanese meat under 500 kcal. 2026 reviews: kombu water before the meal; vegetable plate ¥1,700 (couscous, carrot râpée, marinated mushrooms, mashed potatoes, avocado and tomato, red cabbage, salad); strawberry and tomato amazake smoothie about ¥1,400; the hamburg steak isn't heavy; the set dessert ¥700 is a mini parfait; many women and solo customers.

食べログ: SPICE STAND TONGARI、大阪市西区新町1-14-2、.en: Tabelog: SPICE STAND TONGARI, 1-14-2 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Hommachi Station, 8 min from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, Sun 11:00–15:00, closed Tuesday, some evenings closed irregularly; lunch reservations for 11:00 only; evening cover charge, free with a drink order; cards, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay; 7 seats (counter only); heated tobacco in the evening only; children welcome, mini curry for kids; English menu; opened 8 January 2025. Shop description: spice curry and European-style curry side by side, both on a dashi base; in the evening snacks, fried dishes, pasta, rice dishes, fried Tajima chicken. Reviews (March–October 2026): run by one person; order by QR code; Tongari beef keema and sour chicken ¥1,450; beef keema and pork, coconut pork belly ¥1,550; venison keema and sour butter duck; spiced taco rice; rice sizes named after mountains, from Tenpozan to Everest; fresh vegetables, achar, nuts, fukujinzuke and rakkyo; an egg topping for signing up on LINE; the ¥500 evening table charge waived with a drink; one diner arrived late for an 11:00 booking and waited 30 minutes outside; a sign for game-meat curry.

食べログ: Sakurai (サクライ)、イタリアン・ワインバー・ダイニングバー.en: Tabelog: Sakurai, Italian, wine bar and dining bar, Bravi Soemoncho 5F-E, Soemoncho 3-7, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 3 minutes on foot from Nippombashi Station and about 5 from Namba Station exit 14, Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00, closed Sunday (and sometimes on other days), reservation only, parties of five or more take a course, seat charge ¥550, private rooms ¥550 more per person, one drink each (¥770 per person without one), same-day cancellations charged, cards accepted, no e-money or QR, 18 seats (6 at the counter, 2 private rooms), smoking allowed so no one under 20, opened 17 December 2015, sommelier on hand, bring-your-own allowed. The shop's introduction: authentic Italian cooking by Chef Sakurai, honed over many years; fresh pasta and appetizers, à la carte and courses; 20+ wines by the glass and 300+ bottles; counter and private rooms; jazz. Tabelog menu (updated 4 August 2025): assorted appetizers, crab-miso brûlée, grandma's bagna cauda, Awaji Island onion soup, Bolognese, squid ink pasta or risotto, shirasu and mint lemon butter pasta, Sorrento-style scallop and lemon cream pasta, truffle cream pasta, fresh fish, roast lamb, emperor-style beef fillet, cheese, panna cotta, tiramisu. Reviews (2016 to October 2026): assorted appetizers ¥2,400, Bolognese ¥2,200, emperor-style beef fillet ¥4,300 (September 2024), wine by the glass ¥950 (October 2024), the owner-chef holds a sommelier qualification (2020), a chef who trained in Italy (February 2024), the chef running the place alone on a weekday (October 2024), closed during COVID and reopened (December 2021), a grappa selection, called the best Italian in Minami, though one April 2025 diner found the food ordinary.

食べログ: Salon de The Plaisir (サロン・ド・テ・プレジー.en: Tabelog: Salon de The Plaisir, GATO DM Minami-Horie Koen-mae ground-floor north unit, 2-5-19 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Sakuragawa Station exit 5; Wed–Sun 12:00–20:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays (open on holiday Mondays, closed the next day); latest on Instagram; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (up to 4 per party); no smoking; opened 24 March 2014; official site. Reviews (June–September 2026): seasonal fruit parfaits; Shine Muscat and assorted-grape parfait ¥2,600, ¥2,900 with a drink; Melba-style peach (vanilla and raspberry); melon; blood-orange brûlée; ruby-grapefruit and pistachio brûlée; strawberries in spring; swap milk gelato for deep-steamed sencha gelato +¥50; pistachio-ice-cream crêpe (sold out some days); afternoon-tea set (sandwiches, desserts, freshly baked scones, tea); spicy duck pastrami and cream-cheese sandwich; tomato and cream-cheese sandwich; tea in a pot; one item per person minimum; parfaits come as a drink set; drinks over ¥800 cost extra; one found the glasses smaller than in photos; some days run single-handed.

食べログ: San Antonio TEX-MEX 東京ミッドタウン日比谷店、千.en: Tabelog: San Antonio TEX-MEX Tokyo Midtown Hibiya, Yurakucho 1-1-2, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo Midtown Hibiya B1F HIBIYA FOOD HALL, directly connected to Hibiya Station; 88 seats (18 counter, 70 table); Mon–Thu 11:00–15:00, 17:00–22:30, Fri and days before holidays until 23:00, Sat 11:00–23:00, Sundays and holidays 11:00–22:30; closed when the complex is; opened July 18, 2025; operator createrestaurants.com. October 2026 reviews: chicken fajitas with a spicy sauce; tacos full of fillings; ajillo; beer from 16:00; the staff brought hot sauce; cheerful staff and quick service; full soon at night; generous and good value; split bills depend on the staff.

食べログ: Sophie at EDITION(ソフィ アット エディション)、.en: Tabelog: Sophie at EDITION, Ginza 2-8-13, The Tokyo EDITION, Ginza 14F, 280 m from Ginza Station; 114 seats (136 including private rooms and 6 bar-counter seats); daily breakfast 7:00–10:30, lunch 12:00–15:00, dinner 17:30–22:00. Shop introduction: classic Italian as an urban trattoria; house pasta made by hand every day; Japanese and Italian ingredients. 2026 reviews: four- and three-dish lunches (octopus salad, green-pea potage, three-tomato spaghetti, snow-crab capellini, veal Milanese, crème caramel, cassata semifreddo); marinated yellowtail; roast cod; Mont Blanc; a five-dish dinner (oxtail casoncelli in sage butter, braised beef cheek); Tokyo Tower visible; birthday plates and Polaroids; children on holidays; drinks pricey.

食べログ: Steak＆Pizza BLAZE、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-2.en: Tabelog: Steak & Pizza BLAZE, Queens Court East Bldg 1F, 2-3-2 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 15:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); closed Wednesdays; temporary closing days listed for September; reservations accepted; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats; English menu and English-speaking staff; opened 27 November 2025; courses (BLAZE course ¥6,930 and Manpuku course ¥9,350, both for even numbers; solo course ¥4,290); Neapolitan pizza with dough supervised by a world-class pizzaiolo, and A5 wagyu. Reviews (August–September 2026): many overseas diners; jamón serrano and caprese ¥1,210; 3-starter platter ¥1,200; wagyu tougarashi steak; truffle-scented mushroom and bacon pizza; baked quickly in an oven over 400 °C; Caesar salad with house dressing; pesto pasta salad ¥880; tuna rillettes ¥770; spinach and bacon Spanish omelette ¥880; steak with salt, wasabi, garlic, shoyu and truffle; quattro formaggi with honey; 12 table seats and an L-shaped counter; menu in Japanese and English; a chef who speaks English and Japanese; tougarashi and fillet; about 7 pizzas, 22–24 cm; QR ordering by smartphone; one says value is on the high side.

食べログ: Susan’s MEAT BALL 東京ミッドタウン日比谷(スーザン.en: Tabelog: Susan's MEAT BALL Tokyo Midtown Hibiya, Yurakucho 1-1-2, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo Midtown Hibiya B1F HIBIYA FOOD HALL, directly connected to Hibiya Station; 56 seats; Mon–Thu and weekends 11:00–22:30, Fri 11:00–23:00; closed when the complex is; opened March 29, 2018. 2026 reviews: choose beef, pork or basil-chicken meatballs (or a three-kind plate); pasta, rice or bread with fries or mash; sauces of tomato, chili, mushroom cream or mala tomato; meatball pasta ¥1,000; meatball burger ¥1,050; cheese ¥1,100; Carlsberg ¥650; the pork is the fluffiest; in front of the TOHO Cinemas elevator.

食べログ: THE 9X OSAKA、大阪市北区天満3-1-2 TSビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: THE 9X OSAKA, TS Bldg 1F, 3-1-2 Tenma, Kita-ku, Osaka; 8 min walk from Tenmabashi Station; Mon 11:30–14:30, Wed 11:30–15:00, Thu 11:30–14:30 and 18:30–21:00, Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–21:00, Sat–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 16:00–18:00; closed Tuesdays; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 33 seats (counter 9, terrace 8, tables 16); opened 15 December 2022; official site. Reviews (February–October 2026): shops in Tokyo and Kyoto too; banners promise 'ramen with French elements'; salmon tantanmen (choose heat; like a soup pasta); white salmon ramen (espuma, thin chashu, thick smoked salmon, mizuna, carrot, croutons, burdock chips, balsamic, chili, slightly wavy flat noodles); the white salmon ramen is beautifully colourful; pour soup over the salmon rice in the set; summer cold salmon ramen; basil-and-cheese Genovese maze-soba; basil aedama; seasoned egg; a bar-like frontage; one found it saltier than salmony; staff explain carefully.

食べログ: THE CITY BAKERY BAR & GRILL 銀座インズ、.en: Tabelog: THE CITY BAKERY BAR & GRILL Ginza Inz, Ginza-nishi 2-2, Chuo-ku, Ginza Inz 2, B1F, 144 m from Yurakucho Station; no reservations; hours not listed; opened December 15, 2025; official site thecitybakery.jp. 2026 reviews: open until 23:00 after 21:00 on a Friday; a big space with a café and a bar & grill; plenty of wine; grilled vegetables and sandwiches; no one-drink rule; a place to drink on Sundays; wine from the company's own vineyard; steak; ajillo of chicken neck and chorizo; all-you-can-eat bread; bread to buy; a Philly sandwich; a jazz café-bar at the back; a bread counter and kids' space at the front.

食べログ: THE HOUSE K.MINAMOTO、銀座6-9-8 宗家 源.en: Tabelog: THE HOUSE K.MINAMOTO, Ginza 6-9-8, Soke Minamoto Kitchoan new head-office building 2F–5F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station exit A2; 36 seats (three private rooms for 4, 8 and 10, room charge); Tue–Fri 11:30–20:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–19:00, closed Mon; 10% service charge at dinner; English menu; opened October 19, 2019; official site kitchoan.co.jp. 2026 reviews: wait your turn looking at wagashi in the shop below; sautéed sea bream with watermelon and tomato salad; a modern Japanese space; seasonal fruit soda; the concept "more fruity than fruit", with fruit in every dish; beef stroganoff topped with melon, pineapple, kiwi, apple, Shine Muscat and fig; orange soup; banana pound cake; poêlé of sea bream with muscat; fruit mille-feuille; a bit pricey.

食べログ: THE WINEBASE銀座、銀座4-3-5 ハトリビル3F、銀座駅.en: Tabelog: THE WINEBASE Ginza, Ginza 4-3-5, ハトリ Building 3F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit B2; 18 seats (8 counter, 10 table); weekdays 18:00–3:00, weekends and holidays 18:00–24:00; closed January 1 and the second Sunday of each month; cards, IC and QR accepted; opened December 31, 2020; sommelier on staff. 2026 reviews: a different country featured each month, with local food too (Serbia in April, Moldova next); Serbian reds and whites with hummus; Chinese wine; glasses from about ¥1,500; explanations of grape varieties; gratin; steep stairs; a long, narrow room with four tables for two by the window.

食べログ: TOKYO ALEWORKS STATION TAPROOM エキュ.en: Tabelog: TOKYO ALEWORKS STATION TAPROOM ecute EDITION Yurakucho, Yurakucho 2-9-7, Chiyoda-ku, ecute EDITION Yurakucho under the JR East Yurakucho Station tracks, 1 minute from JR Yurakucho Station; 40 seats (5 counter, 19 table, 16 standing); daily 11:00–23:00; cards, IC and QR accepted; opened August 31, 2020; allergen labeling. Shop introduction: craft beer delivered direct from the company's own brewery in Itabashi; 11 taps changing daily; burgers with 100% beef patties. 2026 reviews: a three-beer tasting flight (Tasty IPA, Downtown Tokyo Brown, Yoyogi Lazy Hazy); Japanese-style potato salad; the recommended roast beef; the flight is sometimes sold out; many foreign customers; some say the beer is underwhelming.

食べログ: The Kitchen Salvatore Cuomo GINZA(.en: Tabelog: The Kitchen Salvatore Cuomo GINZA, Ginza 1-13-15, Daiwa Roynet Hotel Ginza PREMIER 2F; 96 seats (8 private room, 12 terrace, 6 counter); breakfast 7:00–10:30, lunch (weekdays) 11:30–15:30, (weekends and holidays) 11:30–16:00, dinner 17:30–23:00; opened December 1, 2015. Shop introduction: produced by Salvatore Cuomo; wood-fired Neapolitan pizza; open kitchen; dessert buffet. October 2026 reviews: weekday-only autumn lunch buffet ¥2,900 (90 minutes); Peroni on draft; holiday buffet about ¥5,000, preschoolers free; mostly pizza and a small menu; worse once it cools.

食べログ: Turkish Restaurant Istanbul GINZA、.en: Tabelog: Turkish Restaurant Istanbul GINZA, Ginza 7-2, Ginza Corridor-gai 1F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exit C2; 44 seats (8 counter, 36 table); daily 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00; irregular holidays; takeaway; cards, IC and QR accepted; genre note "particular about vegetables, vegetarian menu available"; official site istanbul.co.jp. Shop introduction: founded 1988, Japan's first Turkish restaurant; Turkish chefs; tied up with Güllüoğlu of Istanbul for air-freighted baklava and pistachio paste; all-you-can-drink courses from ¥5,500. October 2026 reviews: starter platter with pita (a spinach dish); kebab platter (beef, chicken, lamb, minced); döner and şiş kebab; cheese spring rolls; spinach crêpe; butter rice; Efes beer; Turkish wine; pomegranate juice; baklava with Turkish coffee; daily lunch (stew of beef-salami sausage and potatoes) under ¥1,500.

食べログ: VIDRIO 銀座三越店(びいどろ)、銀座4-6-16 銀座三越11.en: Tabelog: VIDRIO Ginza Mitsukoshi, Ginza 4-6-16, Ginza Mitsukoshi 11F, connected to Ginza Station by underground passage; 48 seats (semi-private rooms); weekdays 11:00–16:00, 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; no service charge; cards, IC and QR accepted; opened June 27, 2019; official site juraku.com. Shop introduction: winner of the international fideuà contest (Gandia); winner of the Tokyo paella contest (seafood paella); special prize at the international paella contest (Valencian paella); interior inspired by the port town of Gandia; ingredients imported from Spain. September 2026 reviews: marinated sardines with pickled ginger; Galician-style scallops; uni and salmon-roe gratin; paella in small pans to share two kinds (seafood, squid ink); weekend set (paella, tapas platter, ajillo, dessert, coffee); mushroom ajillo; truffle galette (potato and egg); fried squid; Mitsukoshi points and shareholder perks can't be used.

食べログ: Vin Barre Cuisine Regal(レガル)、銀座8-6.en: Tabelog: Vin Barre Cuisine Regal, Ginza 8-6-9, in "Shusse Kaido", the lane between Kenban-dori and Namiki-dori; 28 seats (9 at the 1F counter, 19 at 2F tables); weekdays 18:00–2:30, closed weekends and holidays; 10% service charge. Shop introduction: classic Napolitan; meat grilled on a crystal plate. 2026 reviews: vongole with big clams; smoking allowed in the 2F private room; charcoal-grilled meat; scallops in butter; bagna cauda; raw oysters; carpaccio; a calm space behind a heavy door; some say the rest is ordinary; items out because the oven broke.

食べログ: Värmen(ヴァーメン)、千代田区有楽町1-1-2 東京ミッドタウ.en: Tabelog: Värmen, Yurakucho 1-1-2, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo Midtown Hibiya 2F, directly connected to Hibiya Station; 38 seats (16 table, 8 counter, 6 bar, 8 terrace); weekdays 11:00–15:00, 18:00–22:30, weekends and holidays also 15:00–16:30; when busy, 1.5-hour limit at lunch and 2.5 hours at dinner; opened March 29, 2018; official site varmen.jp. Shop introduction: a collaboration between "ata", the Daikanyama seafood bistro listed in Michelin ten years running, and the Niigata winery "CAVE DOCCI"; seasonal seafood such as bouillabaisse and lobster; a bar at the entrance; a terrace overlooking Hibiya Park. 2026 reviews: Thai-style bouillabaisse; chicken curry and drink set ¥2,000; a platter with couscous; lunch course of starter plus a choice of pasta, gratin or curry; a ¥1,800 lunch of liver Bolognese; before a play; got in without booking at Saturday lunch.

食べログ: Wine Bar NOAM、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-27 日宝.en: Tabelog: Wine Bar NOAM, Nippo New Columbus Bldg 2F, 1-17-27 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station, 6 from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 17:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. food 1:00, drinks 1:30), Sun and holidays 17:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:30); irregular closing days; service charge ¥880; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 20 seats (counter 8, high tables, booths for 2–6); opened 7 April 2019; official site. Reviews (May 2025 – September 2026): champagne by the glass, white, red; soba crackers and coconut chips; strawberry and mascarpone caprese; can't see in from outside but staff are kind and calm; plenty beyond wine; egg sandwich; for a second stop; a pairing course with dinner, a choice of 2 each time; about 10 by the glass; a calm counter; tartare; abalone bruschetta; cold pasta; 3 wine staff; easy to visit alone.

食べログ: Wine Bar ぶしょん(ワインバー・ブション)、銀座5-9-13.en: Tabelog: Wine Bar Bushon, Ginza 5-9-13, Nakamura Building B2F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A3; 30 seats; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:00, closed Sundays and holidays; cards and d-barai accepted; separate smoking area; live music; bring-your-own allowed. Reviews: a basement wine bar surrounded by wine cellars; courses and à la carte; in April 2026, the atmosphere of a nostalgic tavern, with a stylish madame sommelier; a wine list with history, but much is out of stock; in August 2026, the wine and glasses are good but the food is lacking; mostly wines over ¥10,000; ¥15,000–20,000.

食べログ: Wine&Bistro barchetta 汐留シティセンター店(バ.en: Tabelog: Wine & Bistro barchetta Shiodome City Center, Higashi-Shinbashi 1-5-2, Minato-ku, Shiodome City Center 2F (in the row with Menya Takeichi); 24 seats (4 counter, 10 in a fully private room, 10 table); weekdays 17:00–23:00, closed weekends and holidays; opened February 27, 2023. Shop introduction: a tasting of 30 wines for 60 minutes ¥1,200. Reviews: +¥600 per 30 minutes; dishes ¥380–1,880; chicken and vegetable cream stew is the most popular; a remark that the lasagna ¥1,800 was plain and unlike the photo; wine and Champagne on the all-you-can-drink course; the sign is hard to spot.

食べログ: WineBar Pluribus(ワインバー プルリバス)、銀座5-.en: Tabelog: WineBar Pluribus, Ginza 5-11-13, 幸田 Building 4F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 22 seats; Tue 19:00–23:30, Wed–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:30, closed Mon; cards, IC and QR accepted; "vegetable dishes" listed as a genre. 2026 reviews: fine, temperature-controlled wine by the glass; ¥11,000 premium all-you-can-drink; a ¥10,000 course (Léon d'Albret Champagne, Meursault, Aloxe-Corton); Japanese wine too; a calm space.

食べログ: Yabu Distillery Restaurant 養父蒸溜所、大.en: Tabelog: Yabu Distillery Restaurant, Nasa Prime House annex 1F, 4-10-18 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station north exit 12 and Yotsubashi Station exit 1-A; Wed–Sat 18:00–22:00, Sun 12:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; reservations only (phone 13:00–17:00 on open days, or Instagram DM); entry from 10 minutes before the course; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted, no e-money or QR; no service or cover charge; 11 counter seats; no smoking; English menu; no sandals or shorts; children from an age able to eat the course; opened 11 January 2024; official site. Reviews (February–September 2026): a pairing chosen per dish from whisky, wine or non-alcoholic; careful explanations; finger food of red shrimp and sea urchin (yuzu); chilled corn soup with prosciutto; ayu; sea bream with grilled scales; winter melon with green-onion oil; Yabu venison with chimichurri; bluefin tuna aged in Tajima red vinegar; Ezo abalone with escargot butter; Tajima beef rib roast or Tajima duck; Tajima duck ramen to finish, in a size of your choice; 2 desserts; 'Yabu', the distillery's young whisky; Sunday lunch ¥7,800 (August 2026).

食べログ: Za Kitchen、銀座1-6-17、銀座一丁目駅から95m、平日.en: Tabelog: Za Kitchen, Ginza 1-6-17, 95 m from Ginza-itchome Station; weekdays 11:30–14:00, closed weekends, holidays and days before holidays; no reservations; children welcome. Reviews (October–December 2025): a grilled-spaghetti shop in a back lane of Ginza 1-chome (the official name also given as "Za Egg Kitchen"); opened November 2020; almost opposite Ginza Biscuit; a red awning; open only two and a half hours on weekdays; "superb Napolitan" ¥800 (square iron plate, sausage and komatsuna, tomato tang and butter); 6–7 counter seats; run by two women; four dishes ¥800–950, large +¥100; ultra-rich sauce grilled pasta (fried egg, sausage, cabbage, garlic chives).

食べログ: bird's nest、大阪市中央区難波千日前9-17 千日前セント.en: Tabelog: bird's nest, Sennichimae Central No. 2 Bldg 2F, 9-17 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Namba Grand Kagetsu, 4 from Nippombashi Station; daily 17:00–24:00; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats; opened 20 August 2022; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): the sister shop Bird on the ground floor, a calm white-wood counter upstairs; a central grill; courses by reservation only until 20:00, à la carte too after 20:00; courses ¥5,500, ¥8,250 and ¥9,680; Hinai chicken thigh, breast, gizzard, wing, negima, tsukune; Kawachi duck with melon; Awaodori neck; big red aubergine; white mushrooms; chawanmushi with turnip sauce; red-cabbage palate cleanser; onion-gratin croquette mini burger; liver-pâté monaka; fried green pepper with dashi; oyakodon or ramen to finish; corn and chicken kama-cooked rice; Basque cheesecake; skewers firmly salted; good for business entertaining too.

食べログ: conoji、大阪市西区新町2-18-19 三洋ハイツ 101、西長.en: Tabelog: conoji, Sanyo Heights 101, 2-18-19 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori Station and Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 1; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (L.O. food 14:00) and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00); closed Wednesdays and over New Year; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats (counter 14, 3 tables). Reviews (July–October 2026): a U-shaped counter; a calm, stylish shop; at lunch a platter of about 6 starters, bread and a pasta from 2 daily choices (paccheri with minced chicken and aubergine ragù; tagliatelle with meat sauce; pasta with pecorino, black pepper and garlic); about ¥2,000 with tiramisu and cappuccino; at night summer-truffle cream, clams and mussels in tomato and more; chicken-shaped water jugs; one found the explanations hard to hear.

食べログ: gelamu. 心斎橋、大阪市中央区南船場2-6-29 鴨川ビル10.en: Tabelog: gelamu. Shinsaibashi, Kamogawa Bldg 101, 2-6-29 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 251 m from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Wed, Fri–Sun, holidays and days before and after holidays 12:00–22:00; closed Thursdays (may change); no reservations; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY, Alipay, WeChat Pay) accepted; 10 seats; terrace; dogs allowed inside; takeaway and delivery; children and pushchairs welcome; opened 12 July 2025. Reviews (July–October 2026): open until 22:00, handy for dessert after dinner; mango; caffè latte; Latte Noir; pistachio; matcha; Earl Grey; strawberry; walnut; DUO, 2 flavours in a cone; Earl Grey Blanc ¥1,300 (bergamot aroma); matcha affogato; no tasting; a clean, elegant frontage and interior.

食べログ: italy_zoo、大阪市中央区南船場1-7-8 ダイアパレス順慶町.en: Tabelog: italy_zoo, Dia Palace Junkeimachi 1F, 1-7-8 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Wed, Sat and Sun 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30) and 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 21:00), Fri 18:00–22:30; closed Thursdays; irregular closures (Instagram or Google calendar); starter and coperto ¥400 at night; cards and PayPay accepted; 12 seats. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2026): a cafe-like space at the back of the ground floor; antique furniture and dried flowers; animals hidden all over the shop; weekday lunch A set ¥1,300 (salad plate with about 7 vegetable starters and mini soup, pasta); B set ¥1,800; lunch course ¥3,200 (main, dessert, drink; one-drink minimum); spaghettini with house sausage and mushrooms in tomato sauce; linguine with shrimp and zucchini; amatriciana with house ricotta; Chami pork; at night a course of about 11 dishes (chicken consommé, salami and house ham platter, kuruma prawn, hairy crab, hamaguri sformato like chawanmushi, salad with whey dressing, peach cappellini, surf-clam risotto, straw-seared wagyu rump); dessert extra; one found portions small; careful explanations.

食べログ: mill pour (Mill Pour Coffee、ミルポア)、.en: Tabelog: mill pour (Mill Pour Coffee), Cypress Shinsaibashi 1F, 3-6-1 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; weekdays 9:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); weekends and holidays given as 9:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), but the same page notes weekends and holidays shortened to 9:00–18:00 too; open every day except New Year; no cards; e-money and QR (PayPay, d-barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY) accepted; 10 seats (terrace 8 outside, counter 2 inside); smoking on the terrace, not inside; English menu; pets allowed; children welcome; takeaway; official site. Reviews (January–August 2026): a hot, strong long black; black cold brew (M) ¥750, some bitterness, clean, hardly any acidity; iced Americano; iced caffè latte; hot dogs; beans for sale too; a small sign; benches under an awning facing the road; one minded smoke from people smoking outside.

食べログ: motti.cafe、大阪市浪速区難波中3-7-8 難波リーガルハウ.en: Tabelog: motti.cafe, Namba Regal House, 3-7-8 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 405 m from Namba; daily 9:00–18:00, Fridays until 20:00; irregular closing days (check Instagram); no reservations; cards (VISA, Master, JCB), iD and QR (PayPay, d-barai, Rakuten Pay, au PAY) accepted; 11 seats (counter 3, tables for 2); no smoking; opened 20 January 2023. Reviews (August 2025 – August 2026): a small, bright all-white cafe; rounded tables and chairs; white-chocolate cheese terrine; chocolate terrine; brownie; at a lemon fair, lemon cake ¥890 (with honey) and Aid Lemon ¥800; strawberry-milk soda; royal milk tea; café au lait; seasonal fruit menus; messages written on request; one found the seats a bit cramped; one waited about 15 minutes outside.

食べログ: no 29、大阪市西区新町1-31-6、西大橋駅から徒歩5分、精肉販.en: Tabelog: no 29, 1-31-6 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; butcher counter 11:30–20:00; lunch 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 13:30); dinner reservations only, kappo courses (first sitting 18:00–20:00, second 20:30–22:30); irregular closing days; 10% service charge at dinner; cards and PayPay accepted; 8 seats; private room for 8. Reviews (March 2024 – October 2026): a counter behind a heavy door at the back of a butcher's shop; a yakiniku kaiseki; starters; smoked yukhoe and ikura rice; grilled liver; sukiyaki; yakiniku (loin, tongue, leg, intestine, skirt); some courses include all-you-can-eat meat; careful explanations; at lunch skirt 150 g (¥1,580), ichibo 150 g ¥1,980, lean steak, with salad; free refills of rice and soup; extra sauces ¥150 (grated-daikon ponzu and more); one was bothered by the lunchtime service.

食べログ: nöjd ICE CREAM、大阪市西区南堀江2-1-15 スプラン.en: Tabelog: nöjd ICE CREAM, Splendid Horie unit 1, 2-1-15 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–18:00 (L.O. 17:30); closed Tuesdays; phone reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; 10 table seats; no smoking; wheelchair accessible; pets allowed; English menu; takeaway; allergen labelling and vegan, vegetarian and gluten-free options; opened 13 September 2024; official site. Shop introduction: Swedish for 'content'; ingredients and methods kind to the body; lunch too. Reviews (June–October 2026): about 14 flavours; tasting allowed; 1 scoop ¥640, 2 scoops ¥790, 3 minis ¥840; matcha and salted black-cocoa cookie; pistachio and caramel walnut; strawberry and berries; caramel banana with oat milk; corn and caramel popcorn; mango and cardamom sorbet; peach and Earl Grey sorbet (one found the spice weak); quiche-plate lunch with dessert plate ¥1,950 (rich soup, dill salad); chicken-rice plate; Friday–Saturday 8:00–11:00 morning plate ¥1,190 (rice-flour bread or pancakes, Tanba vegetables, soft-boiled egg, Greek yogurt, hand-made juice); carrot cake; pound cake; hojicha latte; in a building set back a little from the main road.

食べログ: oasis GRILL & ITALIAN(オアシス グリル＆イタリ.en: Tabelog: oasis GRILL & ITALIAN, Ginza 1-4-8 1F; 72 seats (2-hour limit when busy); Mon–Thu 18:00–2:00, Fri until 3:00, Sat 18:00–23:00, closed Sundays and holidays; summer break August 8–16; no lunch; opened November 19, 1999. Shop introduction: a whole Nordic-style old house; every booking is a private or semi-private room; 若姫 beef; angel shrimp; grilled dishes. 2026 reviews: hard to find at the end of a lane; the basement private room had a low ceiling and was hot; courses with all-you-can-drink; a 3-hour all-you-can-drink course ¥12,100; customized drinks; generous portions; staff tell you how long dishes will take; flexible about changes in numbers for large groups.

食べログ: orca 銀座醸造所(オルカ、旧店名 ブリューインバー & ナチュー.en: Tabelog: orca Ginza Brewery (formerly Brew in Bar & Nature), Ginza 8-11-12, 正金 Building B1, 6 minutes from Ginza Station, 7 from Shinbashi Station; 33 seats (5 counter, 12 sofa, 16 table); weekdays 16:00–23:00, Sat and holidays 14:00–22:00, Sun 13:00–21:00; official site brewinbar.com. Shop introduction: a brewery restaurant that inherited the space of a long-established bar founded in 1985; freshly brewed beer; New Zealand grass-fed beef. 2026 reviews: about 10 house-brewed craft beers; brewery tours; a three-beer flight ¥2,200; fries (small) ¥900; plenty of starters; many foreign customers; a remark that the wagyu was sold out and the NZ beef sinewy.

食べログ: otto. coffee and sweets、大阪市中央区南船場3.en: Tabelog: otto. coffee and sweets, K's Bldg Shinsaibashi 1F, 3-6-18 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Crysta Nagahori north exit 10; daily 9:00–19:30; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; no smoking; 12 seats (counter 6, tables 6); opened 19 March 2022. Reviews (June–October 2026): terrace-like seats facing the Shinsaibashisuji shopping street (air-conditioned); a bright white-toned shop; firm, eggy pudding with bittersweet caramel; pudding with vanilla ice cream or Mont Blanc cream; Halloween sweet-potato-ice-cream pudding ¥780; purple-potato Mont Blanc mille-feuille (mochi and custard); sweet-potato tart; sugar-butter crêpe; soufflé cheesecake; tacos and Corona; coffee from 2 beans; hojicha latte; Earl Grey ¥550; brunch; dog cookies +¥250; drinks from about ¥500; one says efficient even run single-handed.

食べログ: over the over (オーバー ザ オーバー)、大阪市浪速区.en: Tabelog: over the over, Kunieda Bldg 2F, 2-8-86 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:00); closed Sundays; reservations accepted (phone after 12:00); table charge ¥550; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX), e-money and QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay) accepted; no smoking; 19 seats; private hire for 20–50; BYO allowed; takeaway; vegetarian menu; opened 16 April 2018. Reviews (May–October 2026): ¥8,000 course and anniversary course; a charcoal-batter corn dog (spiced meat inside); yellowtail carpaccio; charcoal-grilled sawara; sweet-potato soup with stracciatella; sansho bolognese; charcoal-grilled Kyoto Hiyoshi pork; black fig with canelé; à la carte crab-miso toast, porcini omelette, grilled-vegetable salad, pork sauté; non-alcoholic gin and tonic; birthday plates; sofa seats first-come even with a booking.

食べログ: patisserie accueil (パティスリー アクイユ)、大.en: Tabelog: patisserie accueil, 102, 1-17-18 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 4, 5 from Yotsubashi Station; Wed–Sun 11:00–19:00; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; cakes can be reserved by phone, eat-in can't; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 4 counter seats; no smoking; takeaway; children welcome; opened 13 June 2014; official site. October 2026 reviews: a case of seasonal cakes; mostly light, airy mousse cakes; Écrin ¥700 (strawberry and mascarpone mousse with passion fruit inside, wrapped in strawberry chocolate); chestnut roll cake ¥680 (Hokkaido fresh cream and chestnut cream); Japanese-chestnut Mont Blanc; muscat mousse cake; chocolate soufflé ¥680; kouign-amann; café au lait ¥600; cappuccino; tea; one recommends going right after opening; one felt the till service could be better.

食べログ: ramen agein、大阪市中央区高麗橋1-6-3 エグザビル 1.en: Tabelog: ramen agein, Exa Bldg 1F, 1-6-3 Koraibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Kitahama Station exit 4; Tue–Sun and holidays 10:00–14:00 (hours differ weekdays and weekends/holidays); closed Mondays (Tuesday if a holiday); closes early when sold out; temporary closures; an opening calendar on social media at month-end (Instagram @ramen_again_osaka, X @Ramen_again); no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 12 September 2024. Reviews (February 2025 – October 2026): already open at 9:55; spicy miso ramen ¥1,380 (branded pork and scallop soup, house miso tare); freshly grilled chashu; change the flavour with spicy powder; 5 waiting before the 11:00 opening; Kuroge wagyu 'kamadama niku niku' 150 g ¥1,000 (not on the machine, on a menu in a file); a little rice; flat chewy noodles; finish with raw egg and shoyu; salt ramen (pork base, thin noodles); yuzu-kosho; app stamps; one says weekdays 10–14, weekends 11–14; one found the shoyu ramen ¥1,100 sourish; firm noodles; chashu rice bowl (branded pork and special egg) ¥350; the miso ramen has straight noodles; one says open Friday nights too; spicy shoyu ramen; the shoyu is sharp with fragrant soup; seared-chashu aroma; shoyu ramen with seasoned egg ¥150; clean umami but lacking depth and character, one says; counter only; one suspects the queue is due to slow turnover.

食べログ: salmon atelier Hus(サーモンアトリエ・フース)、千.en: Tabelog: salmon atelier Hus, Uchisaiwaicho 1-7-1, Chiyoda-ku, Hibiya OKUROJI; 11 seats (7 inside, 4 terrace); Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30, 17:00–23:00, Sundays and holidays until 22:00; irregular holidays; opened April 12, 2023. Shop introduction: a specialist in salmon from Arctic Norway; Italian, French and Japanese styles; unusual Norwegian beers; cocktails; sake. October 2026 reviews: lunch (¥1,500 before tax, with salad and soup, drinks ¥200): harako-meshi, salmon pasta (flat noodles), salmon steak, a limited curry; seasonal Norwegian beer (rosé); vinho verde; few seats, so book.

食べログ: toiru cafe、大阪市中央区博労町3-6-8、心斎橋駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: toiru cafe, Bakuromachi 3-6-8, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; 8:00–20:00 (food last order 19:30); reservations accepted; cards, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay and Alipay accepted; 20 seats; non-smoking; pets allowed; takeout; menus in English, Traditional Chinese and Korean; children and strollers welcome; wheelchair accessible; opened 27 November 2025. Hot Pepper: Mon and Wed–Sun 8:00–20:00, closed Tuesdays, soft serve until 19:30 on Mondays, a special menu for dogs. Reviews (August–September 2026): soft serve with a dog's face, 12 dog breeds and 2 cats, Yorkshire terrier chocolate and Pomeranian vanilla ¥690 each, soft serve ¥750 and scone ¥450, cup or cone, ordering at a self-service touch panel, rich milk flavour, the look varies, full on a Sunday.

食べログ: vege eats、大阪市中央区博労町1-5-15、堺筋本町駅から徒.en: Tabelog: vege eats, 1-5-15 Hakurocho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 9:00–19:00; closed Saturdays, Sundays, holidays, Obon and New Year; reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master), PayPay, d Barai; no e-money; 10 seats; non-smoking; opened 11 October 2021. Shop description: a salad and sandwich specialist; vegetables bought direct from farmers, some grown in-house; salad bar; homemade sweets and drinks; eat-in and terrace seats. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): fill-a-cup salad bar, S ¥550 and L ¥880, +¥150 if the lid will not close, one bread included; breakfast until 10:30 with a drink; drink add-on ¥120; lettuce grown indoors by pesticide-free hydroponics; leafy greens, tomatoes, broccoli, edamame, seaweed, kinpira, okara salad, sweet-potato salad, potato salad with shibazuke, carrot rapée, caponata, multigrain rice, oatmeal, pasta, salad chicken, roast ham, boiled eggs, crab-stick seafood salad; rice-flour muffins and steamed breads (called gluten-free by reviewers), pound cake, garlic French bread; tuna salad sandwich; cold-brew coffee; crowded with nearby office workers from 12:00; much takeout; picnics in Utsubo Park.

食べログ: И、銀座7-11-14 GINZAカムイビル2F、銀座駅から徒歩5〜.en: Tabelog: И (enu), Ginza 7-11-14, GINZA Kamui Building 2F, 5–6 minutes from Ginza Station; 8 counter seats; Mon, Tue, Sat and holidays 17:30–23:00, Wed–Fri 17:30–2:30; opened May 8, 2026; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: the third shop of the Daikanyama TACUBO group; à la carte Italian (courses too); TACUBO's dessert shop on 1F; chilled corn soup topped with uni; drinks from around ¥3,000; ¥30,000–50,000; prices aimed at inbound visitors.

食べログ: あかよろし、大阪市東成区東小橋3-17-4、鶴橋駅から徒歩3分、月・.en: Tabelog: Akayoroshi, 3-17-4 Higashi-Obase, Higashinari-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Tsuruhashi Station; Mon–Tue 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:30, Fri–Sat 17:00–2:00 next morning, Sun 11:30–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; cards, transit IC and QR accepted; opened 28 October 2022. Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): a small shop down an alley; run single-handed; Ganso Chuka Soba ¥890 (a clear shoyu soup of Tosa Hachikin chicken, little oil, thin smooth noodles, wood-ear, leek, menma, cabbage, soft-boiled egg, melting chashu); Akayoroshi soba ¥1,200 (plenty of vegetables, strong garlic, rice to finish risotto-style); tomato ramen; sesame ramen; offal ramen with nira, egg and ginger; summer hiyashi chuka ¥980 (20 a day; sesame sauce and mustard, diced chashu, cucumber, shredded omelette, red pickled ginger); big platters of obanzai at night; oden; sake; set of 2 obanzai, beer and ramen; fried rice; counter and tables.

食べログ: あきしの、銀座4-3-5 ハトリビルB1F、銀座駅から76m、14席.en: Tabelog: Akishino, Ginza 4-3-5, ハトリ Building B1F, 76 m from Ginza Station; 14 seats (6 counter, 8 table); reservations accepted; cards: JCB, AMEX, Diners; no e-money or QR; no smoking; review budget ¥8,000–9,999. Reviews (2022–2026): run by a married couple, many regulars, customers of 10+ years, dobin-mushi (matsutake), sashimi platter, corn shinjo, heshiko, pickles, crab-shell gratin, shrimp shumai, an omakase of pike conger, clear soup and sashimi, Inaniwa udon, sudachi and kabosu highballs.

食べログ: うどん・そば処 勝衛門、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町7-10、06-621.en: Tabelog: Udon & Soba Katsuemon, 7-10 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-5670; no reservations; Mon, Tue, Thu and Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–3:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–6:00 next morning; closed Wednesdays; 10 seats. Reviews (June 2024 – February 2026): udon from ¥500; sea-urchin cream udon ¥1,200 (rice and cheese into the leftovers for risotto); late-night udon and soba in Minami's nightlife district; one says it's station-stand quality at double the price; open until 3 a.m.; reasonable; cheerful staff, easy to go in alone; oden too; ticket machine, but orders by voice too; kakiage udon ¥650 served in about a minute; many people from nearby shops; gentle Kansai dashi; udon, soba, katsudon; a katsudon neither too sweet nor too salty; udon with good bite; next to a club, busy late at night but quiet earlier.

食べログ: うどん処 SOU 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-7-11 日宝ロ.en: Tabelog: Udon Dokoro SOU Shinsaibashi, Nippo Royal Bldg 3F, 2-7-11 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Tue–Sun 20:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. 4:30); closed Mondays; reservations accepted; cover charge ¥300; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter 8, one table for 4); Sanuki udon focused on dashi, until 5 a.m. Reviews (March–September 2026): medicinal hot-pot course (a mountain of vegetables, house Chinese-style soup, chicken, pork and beef, egg dip, udon to finish); 3rd floor of the Nippo Royal Bldg; a calm bar-like space; mentaiko cream udon ¥1,380; kamatama; karaage; karaoke; cold pork-shabu udon ¥1,180; kombu and sea-bream dashi; hand-made Sanuki udon; smoking at all seats; free karaoke; sports on screens; plenty of snacks; ume udon (a big umeboshi and lots of wakame); good dashi.

食べログ: うれしい居酒屋 酒歌、大阪市西区新町2-19-20 大阪屋西長堀ビル.en: Tabelog: Ureshii Izakaya Saka Song, Osakaya Nishi-Nagahori Bldg 1F, 2-19-20 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 291 m from Nishi-Ohashi; Mon–Sat 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 15 seats (counter 9, tatami 6). Reviews (July 2023 – June 2026): a small izakaya at the back of a building; walls covered in stickers and posters; a friendly owner; first-timers made welcome; cheap small plates, so you can try lots even alone; yum woon sen with plenty of coriander; khao soi (shrimp, coconut soup, fried noodles, rice into the leftover soup); Chicken Hero; takuan and cream cheese; tuna with grated yam; salted snap peas; salt-grilled yagen cartilage; mushrooms grilled in anchovy butter; corn tempura; cash only.

食べログ: うを卯、大阪市西区北堀江2丁目3-13 レスポワール北堀江１F、西大.en: Tabelog: Uwo U, Les Poir Kita-Horie 1F, 2-3-13 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min south of Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 3; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–20:30; closed Sundays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 10 counter seats. Reviews (2014 – October 2026): an eel restaurant founded 1946; Kanto style (steamed, then grilled over Kishu binchotan); the sauce kept since the founding; grilled to order; unadon ¥1,800 (July 2026); jumbo unaju ¥3,600; Gomori-ju (eel and grilled liver) ¥2,200; Wakayama sansho; weekday Kimagure lunch (chicken-katsu rice bowl small ¥700, regular ¥900; kara-age ¥900); charcoal-grilled chicken set meal; busy around Doyo no Ushi; run by two people; Instagram @uou_horie_unagi.

食べログ: おいしい酒と料理 なかよし 日本橋店、大阪市中央区千日前2-3-1.en: Tabelog: Oishii Sake to Ryori Nakayoshi Nippombashi, Seven Bldg 1F, 2-3-1 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; Tue–Sun and holidays 17:00–23:30 (food L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 17 seats (counter 6, tables 8); seasonal fish bought at market by the owner; over 40 sakes in a dedicated fridge; over 80 shochu; over 15 umeshu. Reviews (February–September 2026): sashimi platter (5 or 7 kinds: tuna, yellowtail, sea bream, salmon, marinated mackerel, octopus, squid); dashimaki on a hot iron plate with dashi poured over; house zaru tofu; shirasu with grated daikon and ponzu; fried hatahata; asparagus or aonori-and-onion tempura; pressed mackerel sushi; anglerfish liver with narazuke; crab miso; simmered wakame and bamboo shoots; beef cutlet; run by two people; dishes take a little time; one found many sakes sold out.

食べログ: おそば 照庵 銀座、銀座7-2-12、60席(カウンター8、2階30.en: Tabelog: Osoba Shoan Ginza, Ginza 7-2-12; 60 seats (8 counter, 30 on 2F, a private room for 6, a tatami room for 8, sunken kotatsu); Mon–Fri 17:30–2:30, closed weekends and holidays; 15% service charge; particular about sake and shochu; all-you-can-drink by asking the manager after 16:00; opened November 7, 2011. 2026 reviews: open until late; soba; tendon; squid tempura; oden; bonito with ginger; squid sashimi; corn tempura; beef tofu; vinegared tuna; seiro (some days no black seiro); Nabeshima; an L-shaped 8-seat counter and 2F; a handmade copper oden pot; dashimaki ¥1,200; tsukune ¥440; warm service; a small late-night charge; comes twice a month for the seiro and black seiro.

食べログ: おでん すみ吉、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-3-3 オー・エム・ホテル日.en: Tabelog: Oden Sumiyoshi, Hotel Nikko Osaka Bldg B2F, 1-3-3 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 148 m from Shinsaibashi; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and days before and after holidays 12:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:30; closed Wednesdays; 10% service charge (none at lunch); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 17 seats; opened 15 September 2019; official site. Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): one says it follows on from Takokichi, which closed in 2019; 3 dashi matched to the ingredients; the special creative oden potato ball; potato with butter; Kuroge wagyu shabu-shabu-style oden; special creative oden 'secret daikon' (white-miso dashi and pork belly); octopus; atsuage; konnyaku; red-pickled-ginger tempura; whale koro; egg; dashimaki; seasonal starters and sashimi; seasonal tempura; clay-pot rice to finish; house Yukimi Daifuku; lunch seasonal tempura gozen ¥2,480; Tosa sake; house ginger ale; private rooms; one found portions modest; courteous service.

食べログ: おでんのハチマル、大阪市中央区日本橋1-23-33、近鉄日本橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Oden no Hachimal, 1-23-33 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; daily 18:00–1:00 next morning; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 9 seats (counter 7, tables 2); no smoking (ashtray outside). Reviews (April–August 2026): a sister shop of the fish-cake maker Hachimal Kamaboko; a gentle Osaka oden dashi you could drink; 5-item platter (daikon, beef tendon, egg, atsuage, mochi kinchaku); yuba; corn; duck; leek kinchaku; shirataki; sea bream with salt and lemon; shiitake; takoyaki; shumai floating in dashi with black pepper; freshly fried fish cakes (with wood-ear and more); dashimaki wrapped in a cherry leaf; ginger tempura; corn tempura; firefly squid in shoyu; hiyashi chuka or chazuke to finish; seasonal sake; apple-vinegar sour; smartphone ordering (one says an order never arrived); calm and clean; fine alone.

食べログ: おにぎり三昧 ちゅん太郎、大阪市中央区南船場4-10-21 日宝エコ.en: Tabelog: Onigiri Zanmai Chuntaro, Nippo Eco Bldg 1F, Minami-Senba 4-10-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Yotsubashi Stn Exit 1-a, 4 min from Shinsaibashi Stn Exit 3; daily 18:00–24:00; irregular closures; reservations accepted; cards accepted; no e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 7, tables 8); non-smoking (ashtray outside); children and strollers welcome; opened 11 February 2021. Shop's introduction: an onigiri specialist with seasonal fish, meat and vegetable dishes, food to go with drinks and onigiri to finish, non-drinkers welcome, hard to find at the back of the building but solo diners welcome. Reviews (April 2025–September 2026): organic Koshihikari from Okayama; egg-yolk miso, mentaiko butter, house tuna mayo, cream-cheese miso, okaka, ume, tenmusu; a sticky "nebaneba" soup, soup with big clams, Senba soup; firefly squid, dashimaki, fried chicken, mackerel grilled with miso, white miso with dried persimmon, agedashi tofu, oden, sashimi platter; organic, pesticide-free ingredients; run alone by a young man; the one plate (three small onigiri) only when the owner has time; courses by advance reservation; in April 2025 a limited onigiri lunch 13:00–15:00 (one plate ¥1,500 or a pork kakuni set).

食べログ: おはら、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-9-5 日宝三ツ寺会館 1F、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Ohara, Nippo Mitsudera Kaikan 1F, 2-9-5 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 8 min south-west of Shinsaibashi; Mon–Sat 18:30–1:00 next morning (L.O. 0:30); closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (two tables for 4, counter 4); smoking allowed.
