食べログ: よもだそば 銀座店、銀座4-3-2 銀座白亜ビル1F、松屋通り沿い、.en: Tabelog: Yomoda Soba Ginza, Ginza 4-3-2, 銀座白亜 Building 1F, on Matsuya-dori; 14 seats (counter); daily 7:00–22:30; opened April 28, 2012; official site yomoda-soba.com. October 2026 reviews: Yomoda curry ¥720 (spicy and soupy, with a hint of tomato); burdock-tempura soba ¥620 (sweetish, gentle broth); big kakiage soba with half curry; weekly shimeji and maitake tempura soba; inari; ticket machine and served right away; crowded with foreign tourists; complaints that the soba went soft and the tempura soggy; one customer understood it opened at 10:00.

食べログ: らぁめん しゅき、大阪市東成区東小橋3-14-10、鶴橋駅から徒歩2.en: Tabelog: Raa-men Shuki, 3-14-10 Higashi-Obase, Higashinari-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Tsuruhashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–0:30 next morning, Sat–Sun 11:00–0:30 next morning; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 11 seats (counter 7, one table for 4); opened 10 June 2020. Reviews (August 2025 – October 2026): tori-paitan shoyu and salt; rich yet clean; the light salt ramen is clear-tasting; special shoyu ramen; the shoyu tsukemen is sharp and salty; one rates it among the top 3 tsukemen in Japan; seasonal cold editions (autumn sanma and mushroom cold ramen ¥1,580: dashi of Rausu kombu, sanma flakes and dried shiitake; fried enoki, maitake tempura, simmered shimeji and shiitake, chicken chashu, shredded white leek, mitsuba, yuzu); seasoned egg ¥150; raw egg; nori; salt-tare chicken starter with bottled beer; free kimchi; a short queue at lunch.

食べログ: らぁ麺 はやし田 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-10-1 道頓堀観.en: Tabelog: Raa-men Hayashida Dotonbori, Dotonbori Kanko Bldg B1F, 1-10-1 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 16 seats (counter); daily 11:00–23:00; no reservations; opened 11 February 2022; official site ramenings.com. 2026 reviews: under the Glico sign; summer-only yuzu-scented cold ramen ¥950 (yuzu jelly); the kamatama is discontinued; a soup of duck and 'Daisendori' chicken; special tsukemen ¥1,250, large +¥150, red-yolk oyakodon ¥350; a clear soup; a brand of INGS Co. (Shinjuku), its first franchise in Kansai; shoyu ramen ¥900 (pork-shoulder and chicken-breast chashu, menma, leek); special shoyu ¥1,200 (firm thin whole-wheat noodles, a 'Maximum Koitama' seasoned egg, chicken chashu); TKG; tori paitan (like a potage); ticket machine; cold ramen with oyakodon ¥400; rare chashu; a kind owner; light; avoiding the lunchtime queue; maze-soba and an egg with truffle sauce.

食べログ: らぁ麺 晴れルヤ、大阪市浪速区大国町1-1-13 藤元ビル 1F、大.en: Tabelog: Raa-men Hareruya, Fujimoto Bldg 1F, 1-1-13 Daikokucho, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; right by Daikokucho Station exit 5; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:15), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:30; opened 22 November 2024; e-money and QR (PayPay) accepted, no cards; 12 seats (counter 8, one table for 4). Reviews (January 2025 – October 2026): rich, frothy tori-paitan ramen; the special adds seared chashu, steamed chicken, seasoned egg and red onion; tori-paitan miso (simmered-egg miso ramen ¥1,300, minced meat and chili threads); back-fat shoyu ramen with thin menma tips; maze-soba ¥1,250 (with seared-chashu rice); special garlic maze-soba; half black fried rice; friendly staff; one found the soup lukewarm.

食べログ: らぁ麺や 続、大阪市浪速区難波中2-1-12、なんば駅から228m、.en: Tabelog: Raa-men ya Tsuzuku, 2-1-12 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 228 m from Namba Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:30–22:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 18 May 2022. Reviews (July–October 2026): tsukemen ¥980; even 450 g of noodles went down lightly; changed from the previous tsukemen shop; one calls the tsukemen characterless; chashu-men large (2 portions of noodles); counter only; ticket machine outside; self-serve water; a lightish soup strong in seafood umami; medium-thick straight noodles; the chashu is good too; leek; tsukemen double with extra leek; flat noodles with wheat flavour; a light shoyu-based dipping soup; soup-wari; with the large size there isn't enough dipping soup; one found the fishiness and bitterness strong.

食べログ: らーめん あじどの、大阪市中央区千日前1-4-10、9席、月〜金17.en: Tabelog: Ramen Ajidono, 1-4-10 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 9 seats; Mon–Fri 17:00–5:00 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–5:00 next morning; L.O. 4:40; no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; smoking allowed (ashtray on request at lunch); opened 8 August 2011; meal-ticket system. Reviews (December 2022 – September 2026): seasoned-egg ramen ¥1,000 (firm noodles, light, fewer noodles); Yokohama iekei leaning Kansai; rich tonkotsu shoyu; extra-thick wavy noodles; a small ticket machine outside; leek ramen; a sharp shoyu; smallish amounts of soup and noodles; ramen ¥950 (strong, firm, extra); salty but smooth; black nori; doubanjiang, vinegar, sesame, garlic, pepper and pickles on the table; nori and spinach; slightly wavy noodles; beer.

食べログ: らーめん ときまる、大阪市天王寺区小橋町13-4 天王寺ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Ramen Tokimaru, Tennoji Bldg 1F, 13-4 Obasecho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Kintetsu Osaka-Uehommachi and subway Tsuruhashi stations; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30 and 19:00–23:00; closed Sundays; lunch only on holidays; closes when the soup runs out; reservations accepted; no cards or e-money; 7 counter seats; opened 11 December 2016; official tokimaru.com. Reviews (May 2023 – July 2026): half-price shoyu ramen for the anniversary; LINE stamp card; extra vegetables; gyoza; light shoyu; burdock, cabbage, bean sprouts, leek; paid with PayPay (2023); on Sennichimae-dori; Tokimaru shoyu ramen ¥780; flat medium-thick whole-wheat noodles; a triple soup of bonito, kombu and pork bones; pork-belly and loin chashu; soft-simmered burdock; summer-only okra; Chinese yam, kimchi and tofu summer cold noodles; mushroom miso ramen; spicy miso kimchi ramen; nibotton; one found the niboshi strong and salty; tsukemen 100 g ¥900; tonkotsu seafood strong in bonito; the tonkotsu shoyu mildly spicy; tsukemen 1.5 portions.

食べログ: らーめん なんぞ屋、大阪市生野区桃谷2-6-16、近鉄鶴橋駅東口から.en: Tabelog: Ramen Nanzoya, 2-6-16 Momodani, Ikuno-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Kintetsu Tsuruhashi Station east exit; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Tuesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 11 seats (counter 5, one table for 2, one for 4); opened 4 October 2015. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): built on a chicken-and-pork paitan; chicken & pork ramen; chicken & pork with fish; spicy chicken & pork; chicken & pork curry ramen ¥1,000 (choose heat); curry tsukemen; garlicky chicken & pork garlic ramen; chicken & pork vegetable ramen ¥1,060; light shoyu ramen with bean sprouts; house-made medium-thick noodles; tender chashu; superb menma; chashu rice bowl; one bowl per person; run by two people; one found the chicken and pork weak in the spicy version; a milky, mellow soup.

食べログ: らーめん まぜそば あらし 東心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-.en: Tabelog: Ramen Mazesoba Arashi Higashi-Shinsaibashi, 2-5-16 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; listed as daily 12:00–7:00 next morning (L.O. 6:30); no smoking; listed as accepting cards and QR payment; opened 1 October 2026. October 2026 reviews: moved about 180–200 m west within Higashi-Shinsaibashi; signature maze-soba small 100 g (oil + salt tare ¥1,000), 200 g ¥1,200; 4.25 mm thick flat wavy noodles; braised-pork chashu, leek, mizuna, egg yolk, fish powder, shredded nori; chicken fat and salt with the aroma of shrimp and scallop; house-made whole-wheat noodles supervised by Hayashi Seimenjo; Taiwan maze-soba, curry Taiwan and salt Taiwan ¥1,200 each; toppings (diced chashu ¥400, seasoned egg ¥150, egg yolk ¥100 and more); large 300 g +¥100, extra 400 g +¥200, small 100 g −¥200; Menya Arashi of Nagoya; ordering by QR code; clumsy right after opening; 2nd-floor seating; one listing gives hours 12:00–19:00 (L.O. 18:30); cash only; shichimi and kombu vinegar on the table; Instagram @n.arashi0803.

食べログ: らーめん 兆、大阪市中央区平野町2-5-14、淀屋橋駅から徒歩約6分.en: Tabelog: Ramen Cho, 2-5-14 Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 6 min walk from Yodoyabashi Station, 5 from Kitahama Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–23:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 22 seats (ground-floor counter 4, 2nd-floor tables 18). Reviews (May–August 2026): a yellow 'garlic ramen' sign and a clear vinyl entrance; ramen ¥750 (light; asked whether to add garlic; garlic pieces at the bottom of the bowl); ramen set meal with rice and daikon pickles ¥900; jjigae ramen; miso ramen; seasoned egg; nostalgic chashu with strong shoyu; one found the garlic weaker than expected; one wished the soup had more depth; a bowl after drinking.

食べログ: らーめん 吉山商店 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-1.en: Tabelog: Ramen Yoshiyama Shoten Namba Ramen Ichiza, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6536-8440; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:30; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 7 June 2019; official yosiyama-shouten.com. 2026 reviews (February–October): roasted-sesame miso ramen ¥1,150; leek chashu mayo rice bowl ¥400; Sapporo-style wavy noodles; thick chashu; rich seafood roasted-sesame miso ¥1,030 (nori, menma, leek, half a seasoned egg); limited cold abura soba ¥950 and leek-meat rice bowl ¥350; roasted-sesame miso premium pork-belly chashu-men; yellow medium-thick wavy noodles; wood-ear; piping-hot soup; the aroma of sesame; a strong miso yet a light finish; a soup with seafood; one found the miso too strong.

Shop introduction: listed in the Michelin Guide Tokyo eight years running; 15+ paellas; the name means "full belly". October 2026 reviews: duck and porcini paella; lobster paella; angel-shrimp caldo; beef-tongue ajillo; grilled spear squid; goat-cheese salad; cod aioli and seasonal-vegetable gratin; 10-dish course ¥11,000; portions adjusted to the number of people; cramped seats; many birthday customers; described as a Bib Gourmand eight years running.

食べログ: アンティカ オステリア ダル スペッロ、大阪市中央区難波4-7-5.en: Tabelog: ANTICA OSTERIA DAL SPELLO, Koei Bldg 1F, 4-7-5 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station exit 13; Mon, Wed, Fri–Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:30 (food L.O. 21:30), Thu 12:00–14:00; closed Tuesdays and 1st and 3rd Wednesdays; opened 9 June 2018; reservations accepted; cash only; no service or cover charge; no smoking; 10 seats (counter 4, 2 tables); particular about wine; official site. Reviews (January–July 2026): a sister shop of SPELLO in Sakaisuji-Hommachi; chewy hand-made pasta; carpaccio; seafood and seasonal vegetables; meat dishes; over 30 Italian wines; lunch ¥1,800; lunch course by reservation ¥2,500, ¥4,800 with drinks (starters with crab, onion and corn soup, onion focaccia, oyster and bottarga pasta, poêléed sea bream, coconut tiramisu); Shogoin turnip soup; oyster pasta; roast chicken; one person in the kitchen, so service is unhurried; tables close together; one found it good value but ordinary in taste.

食べログ: イタメシヤ フジ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-10 リップル周防町.en: Tabelog: Itameshiya Fuji, リップル周防町 1F, 1-6-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Station, 6 min from Shinsaibashi Station; Tue–Thu 17:00–23:00, Fri 17:00–24:00, Sat–Sun 15:00–24:00; closed Mondays; reservations accepted; no service charge; cards, transport IC, iD, QUICPay, PayPay, d Barai, Rakuten Pay and au PAY accepted; 16 seats (counter 10, one private room for 6); non-smoking (smoking area outside); children welcome; opened 27 January 2020. Shop's introduction: beef, pork and lamb grilled over charcoal, crisp and fluffy pizza, 18 selected wines. Reviews (September 2023 – October 2026): the Fuji platter of 8 appetizers, smoked chicken wings smoked in front of you, a charcoal-grilled platter of 3 (Angus outside skirt, beef tongue), pizza stretched and baked to order (Margherita; sakura shrimp and bamboo shoots), aglio e olio, cold tomato cappellini, cold squid and sudachi pasta, horse mackerel and mitsuba pasta, abalone risotto with liver soy sauce, eggplant Bolognese, acqua pazza, venison, figs with prosciutto and mascarpone, a roast beef course; happy hour until 18:00 with a wine decanter at ¥400; all-you-can-drink available; even with the master working alone there was no long wait, and prices are reasonable.

食べログ: イタリアンダイニングDONA 有楽町店、千代田区有楽町2-7-1 有.en: Tabelog: Italian Dining DONA Yurakucho, Yurakucho 2-7-1, Chiyoda-ku, Yurakucho ITOCiA B1F; 71 seats; daily 11:00–22:30; closed when ITOCiA is; opened October 12, 2007; operator towafood-net.co.jp. Shop introduction: chewy house fresh pasta delivered direct to the shops; plenty of Japanese vegetables; affordable wine and small plates; prosciutto. 2026 reviews: lunch comes with salad or soup and a drink (pumpkin potage); tarako with squid, shiso and nori ¥1,150; mushroom and shiso with soy sauce, made spicier; uni and asparagus in tomato sauce with tiramisu; wine and starter set ¥1,000 (tomato and mozzarella, pâté, salmon); a checked interior; some mention dust by the windows.

食べログ: イタリアンバル食堂チャコ、大阪市浪速区難波中3-9-7、南海なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Italian Bar Shokudo Chako, Nambanaka 3-9-7, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Nankai Namba Stn; Mon, Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 12:00–23:00 (open straight through); L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30; closed Tuesday; weekday lunch only for private-hire bookings; reservations accepted (normally up to 4 people); one-drink minimum at dinner; about 2 hours 20 minutes when busy; cover charge ¥450 (not charged with a course); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 18 seats (counter 10, tables 8); non-smoking (smoking area outside); children welcome; guests asked to avoid strong perfume; allergen ingredients can be left out, but complete removal and freedom from cross-contamination are not guaranteed; opened 26 August 2024. Menu (updated 16 October 2026): foie gras terrine and prosciutto bruschetta ¥880, sea urchin and potato cream ¥1,600, A4 Kuroge Wagyu roast steak 200 g ¥3,200, Aomori mussels steamed in white wine ¥1,200 (risotto ¥700), fresh pasta from Awaji Noodles, Wagyu Bolognese ¥1,480, courses with free-flow drinks ¥5,500 and ¥6,600. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): risotto after the mussels, risotto from the acqua pazza broth, seasonal blackboard specials, burrata with melon, whole roast onion, the Rossini only from the second visit, order meat dishes early because they take time, lively, kind female staff.

食べログ: イタリア料理 小西屋、大阪市西区新町1-23-9 2F、西大橋駅・四.en: Tabelog: Italian Ryori Konishiya, Shinmachi 1-23-9 2F, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi and Yotsubashi Stns; Mon and Wed–Sun 18:00–22:00, closed Tuesday; lunch suspended from April 2026; open days announced on social media; seasonal omakase courses ¥6,500, ¥8,000 and ¥10,000; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 16 seats (6 counter, 10 table); private hire up to 20; non-smoking (smoking area outside); children welcome; rooibos tea instead of water; opened 23 September 2016. Shop introduction: fresh fish, organic vegetables and meat sent directly from Tango, the owner's home region; a daily menu that changes with what comes in; wines chosen by the owner; anniversary surprises. Reviews (August 2025–October 2026): tenth anniversary; a kitchen run by one chef; carpaccio of four fish; chilled pasta (smoked salmon, shrimp, shirasu, grilled eggplant, tomato purée; pesto with myoga); clam pasta; meat sauce; chicken gratin; pizza; wild boar; prosciutto and cheese; rock oysters; sea urchin; a ¥6,500 course (heart-shaped mousse, tuna with pickles, garlic toast, pasta with bottarga, grilled shimaaji, panna cotta with pineapple sorbet and Shine Muscat grapes); an assortment of Tanba vegetables; always full; second floor up a narrow staircase; a repeat diner who played with the owner's daughter; a pizza made that was not on the menu.

食べログ: イルピアット、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-30 清水町ビル1F、長堀.en: Tabelog: Il Piatto, Shimizumachi Bldg 1F, 1-6-30 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; Mon, Wed–Sat and days before holidays 17:00–1:00 next morning, Sun and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays; booking recommended; seat charge ¥200 per person (¥250 for online bookings); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; no smoking (ashtray at the entrance); private hire for 8–10; opened 28 July 2004; official site. Reviews (2021 – October 2026): the famous starter platter (over 10 items); roast duck; risotto to finish; cod roe grilled with herb butter; pasta loaded with cheese; a large counter extended into the next unit; a lively atmosphere; one found the freshly grated Genovese light on basil with firm noodles; four-cheese pizza; roast Kuroge wagyu; wines off the list if you state your taste; limited fresh-porcini peperoncino; seafood bouillabaisse and squid-ink pasta in big portions; seats a little cramped; attentive staff; anchovy and garlic pizza; a send-off; hard to find; good value.

食べログ: イル・バロッコ 有楽町店、千代田区有楽町2-1-16、84席、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Il Barocco Yurakucho, Yurakucho 2-1-16, Chiyoda-ku; 84 seats; daily 11:00–22:00; irregular holidays; opened December 9, 2009; operator giraud.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: sparkling wine half price at happy hour; Parmesan served separately on request; lamb and plum in a red-wine braising sauce; snack-size Margherita; pasta and a drink ¥1,800; garlicky dishes; a wide range of wine; ¥2,000–4,000.

食べログ: イワシトルネード、大阪市中央区北浜東5-4 コーシン北浜 B1F、北.en: Tabelog: Iwashi Tornado, Koshin Kitahama B1F, 5-4 Kitahama-higashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 353 m from Kitahama Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 19:00–23:00, Sun 11:30–14:30; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; children welcome. Reviews (January–October 2026): a hidden basement spot in the office district; ramen at lunch, the bar BULLSEYE at night; a counter lined with whisky; the menu changes weekly, check Instagram; order verbally, no ticket machine; shellfish-dashi salt ramen with mixed rice ¥1,200; leftover soup over the rice, chazuke-style; curry-flavoured tori-paitan ramen ¥1,100; Heartland beer ¥700; cold clear salt broth of seafood dashi (cold or hot, shoyu too); slightly wavy medium-thick noodles; chicken breast; grilled pork; shredded nori; onion; radish sprouts; the deep, clear umami of the cold shellfish-dashi ramen; nira and ginger oil; cold grated-yam ramen ¥1,100 (flat medium-thick noodles, grated yam, chicken breast, grilled gizzard, red onion, radish sprouts; one disliked the finishing powder); cold ume-kombu edition (gizzard confit, chicken thigh, fish powder); shrimp-miso paitan ramen ¥1,200 with a curry note; a free seasoned egg for the first anniversary; some days run single-handed; 10–15 minutes until served.

食べログ: ウェンディーズ・ファーストキッチン 日比谷シャンテ前店、千代田区有楽.en: Tabelog: Wendy's First Kitchen Hibiya Chanter-mae, Yurakucho 1-6-1, Chiyoda-ku; 80 seats; daily 7:30–22:00; opened November 18, 2016. October 2026 reviews: spicy chicken burger; fries (choose a flavor); iced coffee; ¥1,300 for a set; a bit pricier than other fast food; lots of seats; good service; right next to the main entrance of Midtown Hibiya.

食べログ: ウエストウッドベーカーズ、大阪市西区南堀江1-16-9、四ツ橋駅・な.en: Tabelog: WEST WOOD BAKERS, 1-16-9 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; from Yotsubashi and Namba stations; daily 9:00–16:00; open every day of the year; doughnuts on weekends and holidays only; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 18 seats; English menu; children welcome; opened 8 May 2013; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): an American bakery cafe; 20–60 minutes' wait at weekends; parasols lent to those queuing; bacon-and-egg pancakes ¥1,250; iced caffè latte ¥500; croque madame breakfast set on house natural-yeast bread ¥1,485; avocado mozzarella cheeseburger; truffle fries (one didn't care for them); rocket, prosciutto and strawberry salad; French toast with vanilla ice cream; order 2 burgers and staff will cut them; weekend doughnuts about ¥300–400; English-speaking staff; no queue at 9:00 on a weekday.

食べログ: エッセンス テラスダイニングバー、銀座3-11-8 第六丸嘉ビル1F.en: Tabelog: essence Terrace Dining BAR, Ginza 3-11-8, 第六丸嘉 Building 1F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A7; 27 seats (terrace seats); weekdays 11:00–14:30, 17:00–23:00, Sat 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:00, closed Sun (open Sunday and closed Monday if Monday is a holiday); cards and PayPay accepted; official site essence-ginza.co.jp. Shop introduction: a chef versed in traditional yōshoku; yōshoku-based cooking unbound by genre; charcoal grilling for the mains; a terrace. 2026 reviews: beef-tendon soup with the pasta lunch, kimchi cream pasta, pasta topped with hamburg steak to finish a course, retro pudding, birthday plates, ¥1,000–2,000 at lunch, ¥6,000–8,000 at night.

食べログ: エルベ、銀座3-13-17 山田ビル1F、東銀座駅から徒歩1分・マガ.en: Tabelog: Elbe, Ginza 3-13-17, Yamada Building 1F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station, behind Magazine House; 26 seats (6 counter); Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri 11:30–15:00, 17:30–21:30, Sat evenings only, closed Wed, Sun and holidays; cards and IC accepted. 2026 reviews: beef stew made with sake instead of red wine, in a clay pot; the beef-and-tongue "mix"; plenty of meat even in the small pot; tofu salad at lunch (tofu, edamame, hijiki, carrot); stewed hamburg steak; bread and cabbage; at night cottage cheese, prosciutto, potatoes with grainy mustard, peach-and-cheese caprese; kabuki actors and women in kimono among the customers.

食べログ: エル・チャテオ 銀座店、銀座3-2-12 銀座T8ビル1〜2F、銀座.en: Tabelog: EL CHATEO Ginza, Ginza 3-2-12, Ginza T8 Building 1F–2F, 1 minute from Ginza Station; 78 seats (counter, sofa, tables); weekdays 11:00–15:00, 17:00–23:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–15:00, 16:00–23:00; ¥550 dinner charge (not for courses or party plans); opened April 3, 1996; official site juraku.com. Shop introduction: the traditional Spanish home cooking of "VIDRIO"; paella that twice won a world contest in Spain; dishes from ¥500; courses from ¥6,600 with 8 dishes including seafood paella and 2 hours of all-you-can-drink. October 2026 reviews: duck breast and truffled-mushroom paella; lunch set of paella, tapas platter and a drink; seafood and squid-ink paella (with mayonnaise sauce); a lunch course with steak ¥3,850; full with bookings; sometimes a 10-minute wait.

食べログ: オステリア ダ アダ、銀座6-4-3 GICROS 4F、60席(テ.en: Tabelog: osteria da Ada, Ginza 6-4-3, GICROS 4F; 60 seats (5 tables with 16 seats, the rest standing); daily 11:30–15:30, 17:30–23:00; standing only at lunch; the standing counter can't be booked; private room minimum ¥75,000; opened November 16, 2019; operator miki-international.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: wine by the glass ¥300–900; counter starters ¥300–450; pasta ¥1,500; bonito and sweet-shrimp carpaccio; seafood platter; clams steamed in white wine; prosciutto; colorful vegetable starters; lemon pasta; tiramisu; full at 19:00 on Saturday; also a shop in Shinjuku.

食べログ: オステリア ミオ・バール、銀座3-11-8 第6丸嘉ビル2F、東銀座.en: Tabelog: Osteria Mio Bar, Ginza 3-11-8, 第六丸嘉 Building 2F, 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 36 seats (semi-private rooms); weekdays 11:30–14:30, 17:30–22:30, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:30, 17:30–22:00, closed Sun; closed October 24 and 26, 2026; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened May 13, 2013; 13th anniversary. Shop introduction: sommelier-chosen wines and Italian home cooking; organic vegetables delivered weekly from Miyazaki; this month's recommended course (8 starters, porcini risotto, roast Ezo venison). 2026 reviews: pasta lunch ¥1,500–1,600 (with 5 starters and coffee), arrabbiata, Ezo-venison ragù, seafood peperoncino; at night the course has fresh-fish carpaccio, marinated vegetables, house pickles, frittata, house pâté, gratin.

食べログ: オラ タコス バー、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-1 コスミビル 1.en: Tabelog: Ola Tacos-bar, Cosmi Bldg 1F, 1-17-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6, at the FamilyMart corner, look for the neon 'Tacos'; Tue–Thu 18:30–1:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 18:30–3:00 next morning, Sun 18:30–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays; opened 5 April 2001; about 20 seats; terrace; cards accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed; listed as able to cater for vegetarians; hand-made tortillas; about 30 salsas; tequila and mezcal bought direct from Mexico; official site. Reviews (October 2025 – September 2026): chorizo tacos; braised pork-sparerib tacos ¥880; refried-bean and pulled-pork tacos; cheese tacos; chicken tacos; garlic-mushroom quesadilla (half ¥880); shrimp and avocado cocktail ¥1,320; habanero sauce; tequila soda; non-alcoholic Virgin Chi Chi and cranberry cooler ¥600; dishes may run out late; booking recommended.

食べログ: カドヤ食堂 クリスタ長堀店、大阪市中央区南船場2 クリスタ長堀B1F.en: Tabelog: Kadoya Shokudo Crysta Nagahori, Crysta Nagahori B1F, 2 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 114 m from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 28 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 1 April 2020. October 2026 reviews: a tangy tsukemen; strong soup; not as moving as the main shop but good; superb seasoned egg; in without waiting, no time limit; tsukesoba; glossy noodles; a branch of a famous shop; order verbally; melting pig's trotters (salt, garlic, doubanjiang); chewy high-hydration noodles; a slightly sweet shoyu dipping soup; plenty of chashu; large size; takes about 15 minutes; wheat flavour; soup-wari; tsukesoba ¥1,550; chashu mayo ¥300; one says the noodles are softer and thinner than at the main shop.

食べログ: カドヤ食堂 総本店、大阪市西区新町4-16-13 キャピタル西長堀.en: Tabelog: Kadoya Shokudo head shop, Capital Nishi-Nagahori 1F, 4-16-13 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori Station exit 4-A; Mon and Thu–Sun 10:00–15:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (counter 6, two tables for 4); no smoking; opened 6 November 2001, renewed 30 June 2010; Tabelog Ramen WEST Hyakumeiten 2018–2022, OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023–2025. October 2026 reviews: a 55th visit; Nagoya Cochin chicken rice, weekends and holidays only, 10–15 a day; aroma of burdock; chuka soba; tsukemen extra-large ¥2,680; regular 200 g, large 300 g (+¥700), extra-large 400 g (+¥800), with more in the dipping soup too; hand-made wonton salt; hand-made medium-thick noodles; 16 people at 12:05 on a weekday, seated 12:44; tsukesoba regular ¥1,880; Nagoya Cochin seasoned egg ¥350; strong Cochin umami; shoyu with vinegar tang and chili; smooth house-made medium-thick noodles; 40 people at 13:30 on a Sunday, a 2-hour wait; golden-gleaming noodles; Ramen Walker Hall of Fame; sunshade umbrellas; a 30-minute wait; hand-made wonton noodles; chashu, wontons, seasoned egg, menma, leek, nori, naruto.

食べログ: カフェ コロンビア、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-11-15 1F・B1F.en: Tabelog: Cafe Colombia, 1F and B1F, 1-11-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 218 m from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 11:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:30); no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 16 seats; takeaway. Reviews (January–June 2026): a simple white-toned cafe; big windows; easy alone; upstairs, a shop of the bag brand BAG'n'NOUN; Colombian coffee ¥600; frothy Colombian mocha latte; affogato; spiced hot chocolate; iced Earl Grey; cream chiffon cake ¥450; rare cheesecake with lemon and berry sauce; cash only; e-cigarettes allowed (one says up to 3 per person); Wi-Fi; entrances from both Nagahori-dori and the street north of Unagidani; friendly staff.

食べログ: カポ・クラッセ、大阪市中央区南船場1-17-5 2F、長堀橋駅から2.en: Tabelog: CAPO CLASSE, 2F, 1-17-5 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 205 m from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Sundays; online reservations; cards accepted (one says cash only at lunch); 16 seats. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): an Italian restaurant up the stairs on the 2nd floor; run single-handed, and efficiently; always busy at lunch; A lunch ¥1,200 (today's starter platter, e.g. Spanish omelette, potato salad, chicken breast; house bread; pasta with tomato, oil or cream sauce); tuna and mushroom cream sauce; shirasu and okra cabbage oil sauce; coffee ¥100; Italian dried pasta cooked firm; à la carte and courses at night; blue-cheese caprese.

食べログ: カレーや デッカオ、大阪市中央区南船場3-8-5 南船場ビル 2F、.en: Tabelog: Curry Ya Dekkao, Minamisenba Bldg 2F, 3-8-5 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon, Wed, Fri, Sat and holidays 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 15:00), Tue and Thu 11:30–15:30 and 18:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed Sundays; no cards; PayPay accepted; 13 seats (counter 9, one table for 4). Reviews (September–October 2026): 2nd floor up a hard-to-spot entrance; Sri Lankan curry adapted for Japanese palates; Dekkao special ¥1,300 (chicken and a daily curry); mini ¥1,250 (3 side dishes); greedy Dekkao special ¥1,650 (chicken, 2 daily curries, 4 sides); 4–5 daily curries (komatsuna and pork keema, coconut tuna, clam and tomato, spicy squid +¥100, a vinegared pork dish); one chicken drumette in the chicken curry; sides (coconut furikake, stir-fried aubergine, tomato salad, coconut mizuna); try each first, then mix it all; smiling staff; a queue before opening.

食べログ: カレー屋 みーやん、大阪市中央区難波4-8-11、近鉄大阪難波駅8番.en: Tabelog: Curry Ya Miyan, 4-8-11 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Station exit 8 and Namba Station exit 13; Fri–Sun 11:30–15:00 (ends when sold out); no cards, e-money or QR; 13 seats (counter 8, tables 5). Reviews (March 2025 – August 2026): weekend-only combination curry; 3 kinds ¥1,300; beef-pork and spring-cabbage keema; new-potato and new-onion potage; pork green keema; grilled cheese +¥100; gentle yet deep; may underwhelm heat lovers; spinach potage; beef-pork tomato keema; a pop-up curry in borrowed premises, Fri, Sat and Sun only; the main shop is Rakurakuza; seasonal ingredients; Chinese-yam achar; one item sold out, so charged ¥1,200; a kind owner; behind Shochikuza; scallop potage; beef-pork-shrimp tomato keema; beef-pork citrus keema; corn potage; grilled corn ¥200; mix it all together; not hot; sweetness and depth; nori potage; beef-pork red-miso keema.

食べログ: カンティーナ シチリアーナ トゥット イル マーレ 銀座4丁目、銀座.en: Tabelog: Cantina Siciliana Tutto Il Mare Ginza 4-chome, Ginza 4-13-3 2F (22 seats on 2F, 26 on 3F); from Higashi-Ginza Station exit 3, go along Kobikicho-dori to a pink house; 48 seats; daily 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:30; closed at New Year; coperto ¥400 at dinner only; cards and PayPay accepted; opened September 20, 2013. Shop introduction: Sicilian food behind the Kabukiza; famous for rich red-shrimp sauce with house busiate, and Trapani's seafood couscous; the main shop is listed as a Michelin Bib Gourmand. October 2026 reviews: 3F booked out with all-you-can-drink (Peroni on draft); a two-pasta course; traditional Sicilian pasta and focaccia at lunch; orange cake; bistecca with potatoes; complaints of cramped, noisy seats, slow service and a one-drink rule with soft drinks around ¥800.

食べログ: カンティーナ ヴィニエトゥッティ、築地2-12-16 イースト銀座び.en: Tabelog: CANTINA VINI TUTTI, Tsukiji 2-12-16, East Ginza Building 1F, 3 minutes from Tsukiji Station; 21 seats; weekdays 11:30–14:30, 17:00–23:00, Sundays and holidays 17:00–23:00, closed Sat, irregular holidays at night; opened September 22, 2013; cards, IC and d-barai accepted. 2026 reviews: nicknamed "Tutti"; a wooden front with a red noren; sofa seats along the wall; lunch with a weekly pasta; house Bolognese and avocado lasagna ¥1,300 (with salad); pay cash at the table at lunch; à la carte centred on pasta; ¥1,000–2,000 at lunch, ¥4,000–6,000 at night.

食べログ: キッチンべる、港区新橋2-19-6 新和ビルB1F、24席(カウンタ.en: Tabelog: Kitchen Belle, Shinbashi 2-19-6, Minato-ku, 新和 Building B1F; 24 seats (7 counter, 4 tables); Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:30, closed Sun. 2026 reviews: a yōshoku restaurant run by a married couple; 1–2 minutes from JR Shinbashi Station Ginza exit; omurice, hamburg steak, Napolitan, fried oysters, mix and match freely; on-hamburg ¥1,400; omurice with hamburg steak ¥1,300; hamburg steak with crab cream croquette ¥1,300; Napolitan with chicken cutlet; dry curry with ham cutlet; menchi-katsu; fried pike conger; comes with miso soup; big portions; for when the shop upstairs has a queue.

食べログ: ギンザ カンセイ、銀座7-12-1 藤高ビル2・3F、銀座駅B3・B.en: Tabelog: GINZA Kansei, Ginza 7-12-1, 藤高 Building 2F–3F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exits B3/B5 and Higashi-Ginza Station; 14 seats, a fully private room; Mon–Sat 12:00–15:00, 18:00–22:00, closed Sun; opened April 1, 1990; cards accepted. Chef profile (English): Mikiyasu Sakata, over 40 years of French cooking, a Ministry of Agriculture "Ryori Masters" chef, cultural ambassador for Iwate and Miyagi, dedicated to Japanese ingredients. 2026 reviews: opened in Aoyama in 1990 and moved to Ginza; vegetable-centered, not heavy courses; white asparagus and shirasu salad; truffle pâté; foie gras with truffle; whipped butter with six herbs; chef's omakase ¥33,880 (tax incl.).

食べログ: クセが強い麺屋 れいわ、大阪市中央区博労町4-7-1、本町駅から36.en: Tabelog: Kuse ga Tsuyoi Menya Reiwa, 4-7-1 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 364 m from Hommachi Station; Tue–Sat 12:00–14:00 and 19:00–23:00 (lunch sometimes skipped); closed Sundays and Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; 9 counter seats. Reviews (March–October 2026): a shop full of JoJo figures; the owner serves in character, draining the noodles with flourishes and lines; every ramen ¥2,000 (noodle refills and toppings free, such as cheese and nori); miso tonkotsu (rich and creamy); coriander ramen; maze-soba ¥1,500 (tomato maze-soba with free rice, cheese and kimchi); a ¥1,000 lottery with no blanks; one group at a time, about an hour per group; no reservations, 1–2 hours' wait; cash only; in September 2026 no lunch, open from 19:00 until sold out.

食べログ: クレープリー・アルション、大阪市中央区難波1-4-18、50席(5名.en: Tabelog: Creperie Alcyon, 1-4-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 50 seats (no bookings for 5 or more); Mon–Fri 11:30–21:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–21:30; L.O. 20:30; lunch 11:30–15:00 (Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–17:00); cafe and takeaway until 20:30; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; features: vegetables, healthy, vegetarian menu; Tabelog Sweets WEST Hyakumeiten 2023 and 2026; French wheat flour, Échiré butter and salt. 2025–2026 reviews: avocado and roast-pork quiche; milk-jam crêpe set ¥1,480; today's starter ¥770; Échiré butter and sugar crêpe; about a 10-minute wait for takeaway; crisp outside and chewy inside; sweet-potato crème brûlée; crêperie lunch ¥2,200 (today's galette on the blackboard: beef stew, mashed potato and cheese); cash only; salad set; steep stairs; tandoori-chicken galette; Mont Blanc.

食べログ: グッチオステリアダマッシモボットゥーラ トウキョウ、銀座6-6-12.en: Tabelog: Gucci Osteria da Massimo Bottura Tokyo, Ginza 6-6-12, Gucci Namiki 4F, 5 minutes from Ginza and Higashi-Ginza stations; 48 seats (40 main, 8 in a private room; room charge ¥25,000); Wed–Sun lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 18:00–22:00 (bar from 17:00), closed Mon and Tue; 12% service charge; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; opened August 2, 2021. Shop introduction: the third in the world after Florence and Beverly Hills; head chef Rafaela De Vita, appointed in 2025. 2026 reviews: the menu changes about every three months; caprese-style macaron; cannolo with prosciutto and cheese cream; grissini; truffled cauliflower gratin; bread of Hokkaido wheat; squid-ink cacciucco; tricolor ravioli; beef cheek in red wine; a non-alcoholic pairing including a hojicha cocktail; lunch ¥12,000 (tax incl., service extra).

食べログ: グラマシー テーブル、銀座5-9-5、銀座駅・東銀座駅から徒歩1分、.en: Tabelog: GRAMERCY TABLE, Ginza 5-9-5, 1 minute from Ginza and Higashi-Ginza stations; 20 seats; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00, 18:00–21:00, closed Sun; at night a 10% service charge and ¥540 charge; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) accepted; opened October 30, 2012. 2026 reviews: a hideaway bistro down a lane; black-toned with big windows and an open kitchen, like a New York townhouse; truffle omurice (limited to 5 on Saturdays); salad and bread; burgers too; staff who remember regulars; some reviews of ¥30,000–40,000 at night; ¥1,000–5,000 at lunch.

食べログ: グリル南風、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-7-4、地下鉄なんば駅25番出口.en: Tabelog: Grill Nanpu, 2-7-4 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk north from subway Namba Station exit 25 across the Dotonbori River; Mon–Sat 12:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), Sun 12:00–14:00; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; no smoking; counter seats. Reviews (July–October 2026): a long-established Western-style diner near Amemura; read 'Nanpu'; a retro atmosphere; local regulars; tonkatsu ¥1,600 (salad, curry-flavoured bean sprouts, yakisoba-like spaghetti); a batter fried crisp at high heat; hamburg steak ¥1,600 and rice ¥250 (spaghetti, fried egg, bacon); Familia lunch ¥1,100 (bite-size katsu, fried shrimp, omelette); comes with mini somen; counter on the ground floor, tables on the 2nd; weekday lunch is good value; a proper demi-glace; ¥1,000 with rice and somen; head-on fried shrimp; 74 years since founding; crab cream croquettes; easy to visit alone.

食べログ: コーヒーショップ エリカ、大阪市中央区難波2-1-14 なんばウォー.en: Tabelog: Coffee Shop Erika, Namba 2-1-14, inside Namba Walk, Chuo Ward, Osaka; 1 minute on foot from Kintetsu Namba Station and subway Namba Station; daily 7:00–22:00; no reservations; no cards; no e-money; QR code payments accepted; 20 seats; separated smoking (8 non-smoking seats added); counter; breakfast served. Namba Walk shop page: Coffee Shop Erika, 1-bangai, café, 7:00–22:00; a coffee stand serving freshly ground coffee to drop into between work and shopping; a horseshoe counter that suits coffee; toast and hot dogs too; right by the ticket gate of subway Midosuji Line Namba Station; counter 21 seats, table 1 seat; smoking allowed; in-shop Wi-Fi; cashless OK. Reviews (October 2024 to October 2026): in front of the Midosuji Line Namba Station ticket gate, beside the escalator to Kintetsu Osaka-Namba Station; Showa retro; order and pay first; smoking allowed at every seat (some say it changed from separated smoking to full smoking, and that under-18s cannot enter); morning 7:00–11:00, a set of mini sandwiches, boiled egg and drink ¥470 (April 2025, January 2026), ¥500 in July 2026; hot dog morning with curry-flavoured cabbage and sausage ¥500; cheese toast set ¥500; mixed sandwich set ¥700; toast sandwich set ¥750; pasta set choosing from 6 kinds ¥1,000; coffee ¥450; iced coffee ¥400; iced café latte ¥450; pancakes in October 2026; some paid with a transport IC card; some call it cheap enough to surprise even Nagoya, some find the cigarette smoke hard, and some found the coffee lukewarm.

食べログ: サイゼリヤ 銀座インズ店、中央区銀座西3-1 銀座インズ1 2F、毎.en: Tabelog: Saizeriya Ginza Inz, Ginza-nishi 3-1, Chuo-ku, Ginza Inz 1, 2F; daily 11:00–23:15; opened November 17, 2011. 2026 reviews: Milanese doria, squid-ink pasta, hamburg steak, draft beer and a decanter of white wine for just over ¥5,000 for three, spaghetti with tarako sauce and shredded nori, Margherita, spicy chicken, small-shrimp salad, focaccia; complaints that the escargots are oily and the squid ink bland; about 20 minutes with 10 groups waiting; people from all over the world.

食べログ: サラマンジェ ド イザシ ワキサカ、銀座7-2-8 TAKAYA-G.en: Tabelog: SALLE À MANGER de Hisashi WAKISAKA, Ginza 7-2-8, TAKAYA-GINZA Building B1F, 4 minutes from Ginza Station; 20 seats; Mon–Sat 11:30–13:30, 18:00–23:00, closed Sun; table charge ¥500; cards and d-barai accepted. Shop introduction (English): chef Hisashi Wakisaka; authentic regional cooking based on the classics; additive-free; Lyon's "tarte praline" (raw almonds peeled one by one, with a red sugar coating). 2026 reviews: moved from Toranomon to Ginza; Lyonnaise cooking; soupe de poisson; salade lyonnaise; boudin noir; quenelles; flounder Dugléré; Japanese-beef bavette; muscat tart; à la carte arranged as a course; another dish instead of the cake; a regular of 11 visits; ¥8,000–15,000.

食べログ: ザ・グラン銀座 ギャラリー、銀座6-10-1 GINZA SIX 1.en: Tabelog: The Grand Ginza Gallery, Ginza 6-10-1, GINZA SIX 13F; daily 11:00–16:00, 17:00–22:00. 2026 reviews: Napoleon pie (flaky pastry, fresh cream, custard, strawberries) with milk tea; easy to get into even on a weekend evening; spacious and relaxing even with children; a Champagne toast; wish there were non-alcoholic beer; also used as a wedding venue and banquet hall; buffet; the fish dish on the course is good.

食べログ: ザ・パントリー 丸の内(The Pantry)、千代田区丸の内3-3.en: Tabelog: The Pantry Marunouchi, Marunouchi 3-3-1, Chiyoda-ku, Shin-Tokyo Building 1F, 5 minutes from JR Yurakucho and Hibiya stations; 30 seats; weekdays 11:00–20:00, with a separate listing of 11:00–18:00 (no days given); closed Saturdays and New Year; official site thepantry.jp; particular about vegetables, vegetarian menu available. 2026 reviews: hamburger set 150 g (with soup and salad) ¥1,880, Jr. size ¥1,580; the day's burger was teriyaki; avocado, tomato and lettuce; light buns; teriyaki sandwich ¥1,380 (four pieces and fries); in front of the International Forum; quiet on weekday evenings.

食べログ: シャナブール銀座、銀座7-6-2 石井ビルB1F、28席(カウンター.en: Tabelog: Shanabool GINZA, Ginza 7-6-2, 石井 Building B1F; 28 seats (8 counter, 20 table); weekdays 17:00–3:00, Sat 17:00–2:00, closed Sundays, holidays and December 31–January 5; opened July 1, 2013. Shop introduction: proper cocktails and restaurant-quality food; a calm interior of reclaimed wood; seasonal recommendations and sommelier-chosen wine. Reviews: cocktails made to any request; a fresh La France pear cocktail; milt and meat dishes; omakase fruit cocktails (non-alcoholic too); mezcal and soda; a back bar up to the ceiling; lively with young customers late at night.

食べログ: ジャッジョーロ銀座、銀座7-10-5 ジ オーブ ルミナスB1F、銀.en: Tabelog: GIAGGIOLO GINZA, Ginza 7-10-5, The ORB Luminous B1F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exit A3 and Higashi-Ginza Station; 20 seats; Tue–Sat 11:30–14:30, 17:30–21:30, closed Sun and Mon; opened July 6, 2007; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: the famous organic-vegetable "15-herb salad" (named for Santa Maria Novella); large and everything-on; takeaway; gentle flavors that make the most of stock and ingredients; a maternity course; non-alcoholic sparkling and wine; a starter of herb salad and prosciutto; ¥10,000–15,000 at night.

食べログ: スタイリッシュグリル Tyu、大阪市中央区博労町3-3-13、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Stylish Grill Tyu, 3-3-13 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 8 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 11:00–15:30 (L.O. 15:00); closed Wednesdays; PayPay only (no cards or e-money); 7 seats. Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026): in Semba's textile district; queues at weekday lunch; coarse-ground hamburg seared on the teppan; Japanese or Western (demi-glace) sauce; wasabi and grated daikon; shiso grated daikon; cheese; bacon; mushrooms; house tomato sauce ¥1,300; hamburg set ¥1,350; +70 g; egg on rice with Oita Ran-oh eggs +¥100; hamburg and pork set ¥2,000; free refills of rice and ginger beef-tendon soup; chicken dishes and limited specials too; friendly staff; before opening or after 14:00 recommended.

食べログ: スタンド ソバ サンカク 南船場店、大阪市中央区博労町4-7-5 T.en: Tabelog: Stand Soba Sankaku Minami senba ten, TS Bldg 1F, 4-7-5 Bakuromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min (310 m) from Yotsubashi Stn exit 1-a, 5 min from Honmachi Stn exit 21 or Shinsaibashi Stn exit 3; Mon and Sun 19:00–3:00; Tue–Thu 11:30–15:00 and 19:00–3:00; Fri 11:30–15:00 and 19:00–5:00; Sat 12:00–15:00 and 19:00–5:00; reservations accepted; private hire up to 20; cards, PayPay and au PAY; no e-money; no service charge; 14 seats (counter 8, three tables for 2, joined for 4–5); 20 standing; ashtray outside, smoking allowed from midnight; no children at night; opened 18 November 2021. Shop introduction: 100% buckwheat soba with seasonal sake, warm soba in katsuobushi broth, daily specials, oden, fried loach, sake from all over Japan. Reviews (August 2024–October 2026): large mori soba ¥1,200 with lotus-root kinpira and hijiki-and-shiso rice; horumon soba ¥1,100; pork and green onion soba ¥1,200; chicken-and-egg soba in thickened ginger broth ¥1,100; bukkake with grated daikon, ume and shirasu ¥1,380; bukkake with grated wasabi ¥1,280; a tororo-and-nori daily special; thick, firm, fragrant soba; rich bonito dipping sauce; thick soba-yu; seaweed, curry and matcha salts; one drink per person at night; dashimaki, tuna sashimi, crab miso, grilled eggplant with butter, grilled salmon, mozuku tempura; a rock-style interior; one diner says the former shops in Awaza, Fukushima and Ura-Namba are gone and the owner has changed.

食べログ: ステーキ 鉄板焼き Teppan&grill R 心斎橋、大阪市西区.en: Tabelog: Steak Teppanyaki Teppan&grill R Shinsaibashi, Yotsubashi GTC Bldg 2F, 1-7-5 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 2; lunch 12:30–17:00 (courses only, 2 or more, online booking 3 days ahead); dinner 18:00–23:30 (food L.O. 21:30); closed Mondays plus two consecutive days a month; reservations take priority; counter for course orders only; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 10% for private rooms, counter hire and New Year; 14 seats (counter 10, sofa private room for up to 5); no smoking; English and Chinese menus; children's course by coupon; opened 16 June 2014; official site. Reviews (December 2024 – May 2026): courses priced by the seafood; starters such as roast beef; sashimi of itoyori or fatty sea bream (white shoyu and ginger); lobster with Américaine sauce; abalone grilled in front of you; flambéed with whisky; the top course has chateaubriand (salt only); garlic rice; white-miso fish soup; dessert; meat and seafood shown on a big platter before cooking; order abalone and get the decorated shell; plenty of wine.

食べログ: ストライク軒 中之島フェスティバルプラザ店、大阪市北区中之島3-2-.en: Tabelog: Strike Ken Nakanoshima Festival Plaza, Nakanoshima Festival Tower West B1F, 3-2-4 Nakanoshima, Kita-ku, Osaka; 106 m from Watanabebashi; daily 11:00–21:00; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; opened 16 June 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): a new branch of a popular Tenjimbashi-suji 6-chome shop; Nakanoshima Straight (shoyu, medium-thick straight noodles, wheat aroma, big chashu, thin menma; also with leek); Nakanoshima Curve (a Sapporo-style miso ramen with a tare blended in Sapporo, egg noodles, a little stronger than Straight); Kamisori Drop (a special salt tare, egg, a mound of leek, like a warm hiyashi chuka); garlic ¥80; karaage and karaage-rice set; highball set; LINE coupons; a clean shop; courteous service; one felt the noodles and soup didn't match.

食べログ: スペインレストラン 銀座エスペロ、銀座5-6-10 B1F、銀座駅徒.en: Tabelog: Spanish restaurant Ginza Espero, Ginza 5-6-10 B1F, 1 minute from Ginza Station; 50 seats; weekdays 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:30, Sat 11:30–16:00, 17:00–22:30, Sundays and holidays 11:30–16:00, 17:00–22:00; no time limit; opened March 30, 2020 (renovation); official site ginza-espero.com. Shop introduction: authentic Spanish food in Ginza for over 60 years; renovated in 2020; a double award at the international fideuà contest in Spain on June 4, 2014; award-winning paella by a chef who is an official judge. October 2026 reviews: a ¥1,600 lunch with a choice (shrimp and mushroom pasta, hamburg steak with prosciutto); queues even on weekdays; paella sold out; salty salad; tomato and anchovy salad; mushroom ajillo; Spanish omelet a little salty; stuffed spear squid with uni sauce; squid-ink paella; crab crêpe.

食べログ: スンドゥブ食堂 駿、大阪市西区新町1-33-15 アップルビル 1F.en: Tabelog: Sundubu Shokudo Toshi, Apple Bldg 1F, 1-33-15 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi Stn exit 2, 5 min from Yotsubashi Stn; daily 11:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00, takeout L.O. also 23:00); reservations accepted (online); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 17 seats (9 counter, 8 table); non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; takeout; menu with photos; opened 16 September 2025. Shop introduction: authentic Korean flavours, casually; a choice of 8 kinds of sundubu; set meals at lunch, Korean dishes such as bossam and chijimi at night; takeout too; Korean soju, makgeolli, highballs. Reviews (October 2025–September 2026): homemade tofu made every morning; broth of Kuroge wagyu bones and tail; homemade tategi; spice levels 0 to 8; over 20 toppings; lunch with rice (large free, or swap for ramen or glass noodles), raw egg, Korean seaweed, kimchi and namul for ¥1,000, ¥1,550 with horumon and clams; at night beef and horumon sundubu ¥1,450, Kirishima black pork sundubu ¥1,550, natto or okra topping ¥100, kimchi chijimi ¥1,210, chive chijimi, mozzarella chijimi, sukiyaki-style bulgogi, kimbap, stone-grilled cheese bibimbap, wagyu yukhoe, ganjang saeu and yangnyeom saeu, shaved ice, draft beer ¥550; vinegar on the table to change the flavour; full of office workers at lunch; open straight through between lunch and dinner; stamp card; the main shop is in Yuzato and this is the second, with a third in Kutarou-cho; the name is read "Toshi", not "Shun".

食べログ: セント・サワイオリオンズ、銀座7-3-13 ニューギンザビル10F、.en: Tabelog: Saint Sawai Orions, Ginza 7-3-13, New Ginza Building 10F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station; 49 seats (8 counter, about 40 sofa); weekdays 13:00–18:00 café time (one-drink minimum), 18:00–23:00 dinner (two-order minimum, L.O. 22:00), closed weekends and holidays; 10% service charge; from November 1, smoking allowed all day and no under-20s (until then no smoking during café time, smoking allowed after 18:00); official site orions.tokyo. Shop introduction: founded 1972; the traditional flavors of world-renowned bartender Sawai; "special roast beef of select wagyu" since the founding; the pâtissier's "pudding parfait"; whisky and about 150 cocktails; the atmosphere of a 1950s European restaurant bar. 2026 reviews: iced coffee ¥1,200; cakes from the affiliated cake shop on 1F can be brought in free until 17:00; charge ¥1,650; pudding ¥2,200; live piano; founded in 1972 by the legendary bartender Sawai; roast beef; spaghetti Vivalentino; pudding finished in front of you.

食べログ: セージ アンド フェンネル、銀座8-2-14 竜王ビル2F、新橋駅5.en: Tabelog: sage & fennel, Ginza 8-2-14, 竜王 Building 2F, 3 minutes from Shinbashi Station exit 5; 16 seats; Sun–Thu 17:00–23:00, Sat 11:00–14:30, closed Fri; cards accepted; shop introduction: courses with big platters of lobster and wagyu, with all-you-can-drink sparkling wine. Reviews (2025–2026): deli plate, bagna cauda, roast duck breast (arugula and berries), lunch of starter, salad, main, pasta and dessert, light with plenty of vegetables, girls'-night omakase course booked through OZmall, ¥3,000–10,000.

食べログ: タイ料理専門店 TAI THAI なんば本店、大阪市浪速区難波中2-.en: Tabelog: Thai restaurant TAI THAI Namba main shop, U-I Bldg 1F, 2-6-15 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka, 050-5868-6983; reservations accepted (recommended at night; may close early); Mon and Wed–Fri 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Tue 17:00–22:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–22:00; 43 seats; opened 29 April 2001; official taithai.jp. Shop's description: certified by the Thai Ministry of Commerce; Thai chefs; over 100 dishes; som tam pu pla ra; caters for vegetarian and halal diners too; weekday courses with all-you-can-drink. 2026 reviews (July–October): poo pad pong curry (rich crab flavour); jasmine rice; glass-noodle salad (spicy); coconut mango ice cream; khao man gai ¥1,280 (Isan-style house sauce); gai pad med mamuang; stir-fried water spinach ¥1,380; pad see ew; tom yum goong ¥1,680; laksa; pad thai lunch ¥1,100 (with spring roll, chicken, salad, soup); coriander only on request; Japanese menu with photos; warm desserts; sticky-rice sweets.

食べログ: タコタコキング 本店のちょっと西店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-8-28.en: Tabelog: TAKOTAKO KING Honten no Chotto Nishi Ten, 1F, 2-8-28 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 18:00–3:00 next morning; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; smoking allowed; 20 seats; takeaway; official site. Reviews (August–October 2026): teppan tables on the 2nd floor; a toy train; an octopus-shaped smoke machine; salt-garlic takoyaki; sauce; fried takoyaki (salt, shoyu, sauce); 2 each of 4 kinds; a set of 16; cheese tororo-yaki; Chinese-yam special; mixed-seafood special; modan-yaki; grilled squid legs; dried-squid tempura; extra-large kara-age; cheese corn; king oyster butter; honey cream cheese; omurice; lively even at 1 a.m.; one says in October a new staff member couldn't get the teppan hot.

食べログ: チキン南蛮専門店 なみ一セヴン、大阪市中央区難波千日前7-4、なんば.en: Tabelog: Chicken Nanban Senmon Ten Namiichi Seven, 7-4 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 278 m from Namba Station; Mon, Tue and Fri 10:30–15:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 10:30–17:00; closed Wednesdays and Thursdays; online reservations; no cards; e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats. Reviews (May–September 2026): a chicken-nanban-only shop in Ura-Namba; ¥1,700; 3 sauces, sweet vinegar, lemon basil and mala; 2 sauces with the large (+¥600); free refills of clay-pot rice, black-pepper pasta, pickles and tartare; miso soup and salad; ¥100 off for following on Instagram; served in about 5 minutes; sometimes a wait at Sunday lunch; run by two people; it used to be about ¥1,000.

食べログ: チョウシ屋、銀座3-11-6、東銀座駅A7出口から徒歩2分、テイクア.en: Tabelog: Choshiya, Ginza 3-11-6, 2 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A7; takeaway only; Tue–Fri 11:00–14:00, 16:00–18:00, closes when sold out; closed Sat, Sun, Mon and holidays. TV Tokyo (2022): a butcher founded in Showa 2; freshly fried croquettes. Zatsuneta: a butcher set up in 1927 by 阿部清六, a cook at the yōshoku restaurant "長楽軒". 2026 reviews: in the lane behind "Ginza Haru-chan Ramen"; croquette, ham cutlet or cutlet in a koppe bun or sliced bread; croquette bun and ham-cutlet bun ¥430 each; croquette alone ¥270; extra sauce made after you order; cut in half on request.

食べログ: ツケメン ロッキー、大阪市中央区谷町1-3-19、天満橋から126m.en: Tabelog: Tsukemen Rocky, 1-3-19 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 126 m from Tenmabashi; daily 11:00–21:00; no cards or e-money; QR (PayPay, Rakuten Pay) accepted; opened 11 February 2022. Reviews (August–October 2026): a rich seafood-tonkotsu dipping soup; chashu in the dipping soup too; thick chewy noodles; tsukemen ¥1,000; chashu ¥350 (grilled and cut thick); large ¥100 (formerly free); special tsukemen (2 slices chashu, 2 sheets nori, seasoned egg); spicy tsukemen (Kara); leek topping; yuzu shichimi on the table; soup-wari; ticket machine; tell staff for PayPay; two say the dipping soup cools quickly; a sister shop exists; one says for tsukemen in Tenmabashi, it's this one; one likens it to Ramen Jet.

食べログ: テンダーロイン(TENDERLOIN)、銀座8-10-8 銀座8丁目.en: Tabelog: TENDERLOIN, Ginza 8-10-8, Ginza 8-chome 10-ban Building B1F, opposite Don Quijote, 3 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 28 seats; weekdays 11:30–16:00, 18:00–6:00, weekends and holidays 11:30–16:00, 16:00–23:00; opened November 11, 2023; official site tenderloin.j-silver.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: 1-pound (450 g) steak ¥2,200 (served in three pieces, medium rare, onion sauce); 400 g hamburg steak with rice ¥2,200; ribeye; chicken; toppings; the wagyu steak is tender; small sides; the large rice is small; open until 6 a.m.

食べログ: ディッシュカリー＆レリッシュ、大阪市中央区南船場1-6-16、火〜土.en: Tabelog: Dish curry & relish, 1-6-16 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Tue–Sat 11:30–16:00 and 16:30–21:00 (until sold out); closed Sundays and Mondays; events and temporary closures; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 seats. Reviews (January–July 2026): a one-person counter; open from lunch to evening; 3-curry platter ¥1,500 (fried egg and 3 pickles); dry keema (numbing like Sichuan pepper); squid legs and basil; potato curry; dry keema curry with turmeric rice; burnt-garlic chicken; menu changes weekly (Instagram); well-balanced spices.

食べログ: トラットリア バール ジョルノ、大阪市西区北堀江1-16-17 アメ.en: Tabelog: Trattoria Bar Giorno, Amenity Kita-Horie 1F, 1-16-17 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 2 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station, about 4 from Yotsubashi; dinner Tue–Sun 17:30–22:00 (quiet around 18:00); lunch Wed, Thu and Sun 12:00–13:30 (until sold out); closed Mondays (sometimes open on holidays); coperto ¥330 at night (Italian salami, grissini, nuts; not for courses); cards and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter 12, tables 8). Reviews (March–September 2026): about 17 years since opening; a calm, grown-up trattoria; detailed notices on the tables and menu; a minimum order per person at night; dishes slow when busy; careful pasta; wine chosen with the staff (bottles from about ¥4,000); fresh-fish carpaccio; ajillo; gratin; motsu nikomi; steamed vegetables; seafood pasta; steak; duck; Sangen pork; Ibérico pork (not every day); courses from ¥6,000; lunch pasta ¥1,300–1,600 with salad, baguette and Italian omelette (anchovy, potato and broccoli in oil sauce; tagliatelle of Mizuho pork belly and Brussels sprouts in tomato sauce).

食べログ: トラットリア・バッフォ、銀座3-12-5 B1F、東銀座駅から徒歩3.en: Tabelog: Trattoria Baffo, Ginza 3-12-5 B1F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 36 seats; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00, 17:30–21:30, closed Mon; cards accepted (VISA, JCB, AMEX), no e-money or QR; separate smoking area; particular about fish; official site baffo-96.com. 2026 reviews: the famous sea-bream collar (smoky aroma and salt); pizza as thin as a gyoza wrapper (caviar and porcini; white fish and arugula); salmon and conger-eel mille-feuille; several complimentary breads; baba; peach compote; attentive service; hard to book; the all-you-can-drink is beer and wine only, and soft drinks may be brought in; ¥6,000–15,000.

食べログ: トレボン、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-9-5 日宝三津寺ビル1F、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Trebon, Nippo Mitsudera Bldg 1F, 2-9-5 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 17:00–23:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats; smoking allowed; counter. Reviews (January–September 2026): a favourite in Amemura; heart; cartilage; grilled lettuce; tonpei-yaki; grilled squid legs; tofu; pickles; booked 2 seats by phone for a second stop; a friendly owner; the teppan right in front; heart ¥500; leek modan ¥1,400; pork and egg ¥1,000; yakisoba ¥1,000; no reservations, got in only 2 times out of 5; staff recommend the heart; a long-established teppanyaki; counter only; lively even at 18:00 on a weekday; popular with locals; yakisoba with aonori and red pickled ginger; grilled meat with plenty of leek; the smell of sauce clings to clothes; first time in 10 years; no reservations, cash only, irregular closing days; phone to check; magic seasoning; Moroccan green beans; konnyaku with ponzu; the grilled lettuce strongly seasoned; cartilage and skin with salt; cabbage tonpei-yaki; off-menu kasu and cabbage stir-fry; tofu; Chinese yam; okonomiyaki; 17:00–22:00.

食べログ: トロワフレーシュ、銀座8-2-8 銀座高本ビル2F(ホテル ザ セレ.en: Tabelog: TROIS FLÈCHES, Ginza 8-2-8, Ginza 高本 Building 2F (at the end of the lane beside Hotel The Celestine Ginza), 4 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 18 seats; Mon–Sat 17:00–22:00, closed Sundays and holidays; opened July 25, 2011; cards and d-barai accepted; ¥30,000–40,000. 2026 reviews: a wide range of daily starters (raw oysters, bonito, ayu, abalone, porcini, milt, turnip); oven-roasted steak where you choose cut and grams (fillet, sirloin, striploin, rump cap, aged heifer); egg-yolk sauce; pudding; fig brûlée; non-alcoholic sparkling; for business entertaining; regulars of 18 and 8 visits; ¥30,000–80,000.

食べログ: ドイツ居酒屋 JSレネップ(ジェーエスレネップ)、千代田区有楽町2-.en: Tabelog: German izakaya JS Renep, Yurakucho 2-1-8, Chiyoda-ku, under the JR tracks on the Bic Camera side, 2 minutes from Yurakucho, Ginza and Hibiya stations; 90 seats (tables only); Mon 16:00–22:30, Tue–Thu until 23:15, Fri and days before holidays until 23:30, Sat 12:00–23:00, Sundays and holidays 12:00–22:30 (closing times vary). Shop introduction: long-established German food; DLG gold-medal ham and sausages; beer-braised dishes and Eisbein; five German draft beers; courses and à la carte. October 2026 reviews: Weizen and dark beer; German potatoes; sausages; German bread; Bitburger; ceramic steins; white and herb sausages with Schweinshaxe; marinated sardines; starter platter; a welcome-party course.

食べログ: ニューベイブ 難波店、大阪市浪速区難波中1-14-12、なんば駅から.en: Tabelog: New Babe Namba, 1-14-12 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Thu 11:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:30), Fri–Sun and holidays 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no service charge; cards, transit IC, e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): thick, tender tonkatsu; loin set meal ¥2,800 (over 2 cm); fillet (regular) ¥3,200; extra fillet ¥1,000; half set meals; Dream Assorted Set Meal of tonkatsu and garlicky pork ginger-yaki; rice in a wooden ohitsu; refills of rice, cabbage and pork miso soup; a range of sauces and condiments; katsu sandwich; up to an hour's wait at lunch; book on Tabelog; staff explain kindly; one found prices a little high; one had hygiene concerns such as glove use at the counter (October 2026).

食べログ: ニューヨークのラーメン屋 アメリカ村本店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-7.en: Tabelog: New York no Ramen-ya America-mura main shop, 1-7-2 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6243-0666; no reservations; Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–23:00, Sat–Sun 11:30–23:00; cards, e-money (transit IC, iD) and QR (PayPay) accepted; 12 seats; opened 19 November 2024. 2026 reviews (April–June): 'suppin ramen', a plain base to which you add the toppings you like, over a trillion combinations; once still locked past opening time; Ari Red; soft-boiled egg and rare chashu; sukiyaki ramen (sweet-sour, rich tonkotsu); cheese chashu rice bowl; the standard double chashu (block and thin-sliced chashu, boiled egg, rich creamy soup); one found it slightly salty; chewy noodles; suppin ¥550; fried scallops ¥280; rare chashu ¥100; red New York-style interior.

食べログ: ヌガ(Le Nougat)、銀座6-12-2 東京銀座ビル1F、東銀.en: Tabelog: Le Nougat, Ginza 6-12-2, Tokyo Ginza Building 1F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A1; 44 seats; weekdays 17:30–24:00, Sat 12:00–16:00, 17:00–24:00, Sundays and holidays 12:00–16:00, 17:00–23:00; open every day except New Year; 10% service charge; cards and PayPay accepted; opened January 15, 2008; live music. October 2026 reviews: antique-style, like a Paris street corner; high ceilings and an elephant ornament on 2F; many foreign customers; queue from before 17:00, full in 30 minutes; à la carte; blackboard specials (carrot râpée, mushroom and watercress salad, horse-meat tartare, cassoulet (a full one serves 4), rabbit saddle with mustard sauce, herb omurice with Okukuji eggs, even venison and bear); bouillabaisse; sautéed Spanish mackerel; 24-month-aged prosciutto; salade niçoise; Ezo-venison loin in pastry; hearty portions; also described as a Michelin Bib Gourmand.

食べログ: ヌードルヤ MEーCHAーKUーCHA、大阪市西区新町3-9-9、西.en: Tabelog: Noodleya ME-CHA-KU-CHA, 3-9-9 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 8 min from Nishi-Nagahori Station; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats. Reviews (April 2025 – September 2026): run single-handed; tom yum noodles ¥990 (creamy, sour and spicy, lots of coriander, straight noodles); porcini salt ramen; tantanmen; sudachi shoyu ramen; tsukemen; daily rice dishes (chicken teriyaki bowl, chashu bowl, green curry); one says no chemical seasonings; the ticket machine takes coins and old ¥1,000 notes; drinks offered to those queuing; sometimes closes without notice.

食べログ: ハードロマンチッカー、大阪市中央区難波1-7-15 江戸安ビル1F、.en: Tabelog: Hard Romanticker, Edoyasu Bldg 1F, 1-7-15 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from the Namba stations; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun and holidays 18:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30); closed Wednesdays (may vary); no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats; heated-tobacco-only smoking area; Tachinomi Hyakumeiten 2025; opened 9 December 2024; official page (peraichi). Reviews (August–October 2026): a sister shop of Oishi Stand; about 8 at the counter and 3 tables; small dishes and fried food; rare Ezo venison steak; a hamburger limited to 3 a day; good value; cream cheese (faintly sweet, with crackers); just off Midosuji near Namba HIPS; no sign, so Instagram says 'please find us'; full inside, regulars made room; ume sour; Shine Muscat and prosciutto shira-ae; komatsuna ohitashi; house-made satsuma-age (cheese, corn, edamame; fried to order); many women diners; orange wine; blue cheese.

食べログ: バル DAKEジャナイ中華 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-.en: Tabelog: Bar DAKE Janai Chuka Shinsaibashi, Kawamura Bldg 1F, 1-14-21 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5590-3436; reservations accepted (courses by the day before); Mon–Sat 16:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:00); closed Sundays and holidays; cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY) accepted, no e-money; 28 seats (including terrace); opened 11 November 2022. 2025–2026 reviews: you choose your own table-charge starter; quick turnover, easy to get in without booking; fluffy freshly steamed shumai; mapo tofu; generous fried rice; gyoza; shrimp mayo; found while looking for somewhere to smoke; friendly staff who use first names even on first meeting; events; a creative-Chinese bar; a casual atmosphere; the light dishes taste good even at the end of a bar crawl.

食べログ: バル＆タパス セロナ、千代田区有楽町1-1-2 東京ミッドタウン日比.en: Tabelog: Bar & Tapas Celona, Yurakucho 1-1-2, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo Midtown Hibiya B1F HIBIYA FOOD HALL, directly connected to Hibiya Station, 5 minutes from Ginza Station; 38 seats; Mon–Thu and weekends 11:00–22:30, Fri 11:00–23:00; closed when the complex is; cards, IC and QR accepted; opened March 29, 2018; official create-restaurants.co.jp. 2026 reviews: "senbero" set ¥1,000 (one drink of sparkling, red or white wine or a highball, plus two chef's-choice pinchos); eggplant picadillo; jamón with carrot râpée; vegetables and cheese; duck pinchos; toasted baguette; wine by the glass ¥390; no otoshi or charge; mostly self-service; easy to visit alone.

食べログ: バンカレッラ ジョイア、京橋3-3-12 山京ビル2F(1階は油そば.en: Tabelog: Bancarella Gioia, Kyobashi 3-3-12, 山京 Building 2F (abura soba on 1F); 24 seats (6 counter, 18 table); lunch weekdays 11:00–14:00; dinner Tue–Thu 17:00–22:30, Fri until 23:00, Sat and holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sun; opened March 14, 2011. 2026 reviews: lunch is only a stewed-hamburg-steak plate; five-starter platter; sausages; crisp-skinned chicken; roast onion; trippa; potato and anchovy gratin; thick-cut Spanish-mackerel carpaccio; pasta; generous pours of wine; friendly staff; booking recommended; the toilet is outside on an upper floor; no basket for bags at the wall seats.

食べログ: バール・エ・リストランテ・タブリエ、銀座3-3-6 銀座モリタビル6.en: Tabelog: Bar Le e Ristorante Tablier, Ginza 3-3-6, Ginza Morita Building 6F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A9 and Ginza-itchome Station exit 5; 30 seats (26 table, 4 counter); a private room for 4 (10% room charge) and semi-private window seats; weekdays 11:30–15:00, 17:30–22:30, Sat and holidays 12:00–15:30, 17:30–22:00, closed Sun; coperto ¥550; ratings and reviews reset because of a move. Shop introduction: grill and Italian; A5 Yamagata beef; snow-crab pasta; black-truffle carbonara; porcini; grilled angel shrimp and lamb; vegetable bagna cauda; wine by the glass from ¥850. September 2026 reviews: a ¥5,000 course limited to three groups a day (a sparkling toast, caviar carpaccio, snow crab in tomato cream, porcini and prosciutto peperoncino, grilled Yamagata beef); allergies checked when booking; lunch course about ¥4,000; uni pasta.

食べログ: パティスリー らねっと、大阪市西区新町1-22-19、西大橋駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Patisserie RAINETTE, 1-22-19 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 4 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi Stn; Mon–Sat and holidays 10:30–18:00 (until sold out); closed Sunday; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 13 seats; smoking area; takeout; opened 1 March 2007. Shop site (無添加スイーツ パティスリーらねっと, additive-free sweets): a café and cake shop in Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, open since 2007, with the motto of making sweets gentle on body and mind. The online store sells black-soybean kinako macarons (farm-direct egg whites, Hokkaido buttercream), cheese marble brownies (Australian cream cheese, Belgian chocolate), a dacquoise roll, caramel pound cake, four kinds of macaron (no colouring or preservatives), assorted baked goods and homemade orange jam. Business operator named in the legal notice: 湯川律子. Reviews (November 2023 – September 2026): a woman owner handles the cakes, café and lunch alone; fruit roll finished to order; cream puffs and pies filled with custard after ordering; apple pie; roll cake with fresh chocolate cream; lemon milk pudding; caramel cheesecake; strawberry tart; soufflé; gratin lunch ¥950 (May 2026); buckwheat-flour pizza ¥890 (June 2024); reasonable prices; cash only; a stop on the way back from the Orix Theater.

食べログ: パパミラノ 東京国際フォーラム店、千代田区丸の内3-5-1 東京国際.en: Tabelog: Papa Milano Tokyo International Forum, Marunouchi 3-5-1, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo International Forum B1F; 60 seats; daily 11:00–22:00; operator Dynac (dynacjapan.com). 2026 reviews: green salad ¥748; ajillo of shrimp, king oyster mushroom and dried tomato (2 slices of baguette) ¥1,078; shrimp and avocado Genovese cream ¥1,628; half-and-half pizza ¥1,738; seafood doria; cold pasta with espuma; lasagna; fried chicken; Italian omelet; tomato spaghetti with eggplant and stracciatella; order by QR code (paper menus too); a queue before opening on performance days.

食べログ: パプリカ食堂 Vegan、大阪市西区新町1-9-9 アリビオ新町1F.en: Tabelog: Paprika Shokudo Vegan, Alivio Shinmachi 1F, 1-9-9 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6599-9788; reservations accepted; 11:30–15:00 (food L.O. 14:00, drinks 14:30) and 17:30–21:30 (L.O. 21:00) except Wednesdays and irregular days (announced on Instagram); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 41 seats (counter 2, hall 25, deck 14); no smoking; opened 17 February 2014; Instagram @paprika_vegan; natural food with organic vegetables; organic wine and smoothies. Reviews (December 2025 – August 2026): popular, so book; the most popular is the soy-meat karaage set meal (fried in good rapeseed oil, with house-made Japanese-style sauce, organic soy-milk mayo and organic sesame); organic salad; low-salt miso soup; pesticide-free brown rice; ordering by QR code; vegan-cheese hamburg steak; soy-meat cheese hamburg lunch plate; goods sold at the front; terrace seats; with a vegan friend; with a vegetarian friend from Australia after 10 years; many overseas diners.

食べログ: ビストロ オザミ、銀座6-10-1 GINZA SIX 6F、銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Bistro Ozami, Ginza 6-10-1, GINZA SIX 6F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A3; 40 seats; daily 11:00–23:00 (lunch L.O. 14:30; dinner from 17:00, L.O. 21:00, 20:30 on Sundays and holidays); open every day; book by 15:00 the day before; opened April 20, 2017; official site auxamis.com/bistro. Shop introduction: traditional bistro food from over 100 years in Paris; about 200 wines, mainly French, from a stock of 40,000 bottles; a Paris-bistro-style interior; events with free-flowing Champagne and pairing dinners. 2026 reviews: choose from a prix-fixe; mussels; jelly; meat; chocolate; the duck was the best; got in without booking at Saturday lunch; affordable for Ginza; some say long gaps between dishes stretched it to three hours.

食べログ: ビストロ ヴォージュ、銀座5-4-15 西五ビル7F(銀座6-4-1.en: Tabelog: Bistro Vosges, Ginza 5-4-15, 西五 Building 7F (moved from Ginza 6-4-16, Hanatsubaki Building 2F), 3 minutes from Ginza Station; 20 seats (4 counter); Mon–Sat 18:00–21:00, closed Sun; service charge. Reviews: a long-established bistro; the famous foie gras salad (a big piece of foie gras on bread); cod and milt risotto; mussels; tuna and avocado tartare; carpaccio; wagyu steak; a generous peperoncino; takeaway available; about ¥3,000 a dish and about ¥14,000 per person, which some find expensive.

食べログ: ビストロ・カシュカシュ、銀座8-6-19 渡辺ビル1F、新橋駅から3.en: Tabelog: Bistro Cache Cashe, Ginza 8-6-19, 渡辺 Building 1F, 310 m from Shinbashi Station; 14 seats (4 counter, five tables for 2); Mon 18:00–21:00, Tue–Fri 12:00–13:00, 18:00–21:00, Sat 18:00–20:00 (irregular), closed Sundays and holidays; table charge ¥500; opened August 18, 1998; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: a bistro in a lane off Shusse Kaido; regulars of 10+ years; cauliflower mousse, venison, truffle risotto, crab miso, uni and caviar pasta, braised beef; course ¥12,000; busy on weekday evenings, quiet on Saturdays.

食べログ: ビストロ＆バー ヴィスコ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-4-23、長堀橋駅.en: Tabelog: Bistro & Bar VISCO, 1-4-23 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon, Thu and Sun 17:00–23:00, Fri–Sat 17:00–2:00 next morning; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; cover charge ¥450; cards and e-money accepted, no QR; 11 counter seats. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): just south of Nagahori-dori; a narrow entrance easy to miss; 21st anniversary in 2026; à la carte of seasonal ingredients; starter of pumpkin soup (chilled in summer) and pâté; starter platter; carpaccio; marinated fish; caprese; quiche of the day; foie-gras omelette; sautéed shirako; prosciutto; karasumi; cutlet; porcini pasta; chewy galette; state your taste and get 2 wines to choose from (Muscadet, Chablis); friendly staff; good for a second stop too; book ahead.

食べログ: ビヤホールライオン 銀座七丁目店、銀座7-9-20 銀座ライオンビル.en: Tabelog: Beer Hall Lion Ginza 7-chome, Ginza 7-9-20, Ginza Lion Building 1F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station; Sun–Thu 11:30–22:00, Fri, Sat and days before holidays 11:30–22:30; open every day; 10% New Year charge 12/31–1/3; no service charge; no reservations (all-you-can-drink courses at the 2F "Beer Restaurant Ginza Lion Ginza 7-chome"); opened April 8, 1934; official site ginzalion.jp. October 2026 reviews: a registered tangible cultural property and a sightseeing spot "you can drink in"; an extra-large Black Label stein (three glasses' worth); the famous currywurst; founded 1934 (Showa 9); designed by Eizo Sugawara; Japan's oldest beer hall, which escaped war damage; heavy arches and scratch tiles; an Art Deco space; a glass mosaic of the barley harvest; green mosaic pillars shaped like barley; prices have gone up; omu-hayashi at the 2F beer restaurant; "Ginza roast beef" cooked in an infrared roaster from 13:30 on weekdays and 12:30 on weekends and holidays; a queue of about 20 at 18:30 on a Friday; fish & chips; fried oysters; many overseas visitors; a tiled smoking area.

食べログ: ピッコロ なんばウォーク店、カレー・オムライス、大阪市中央区難波2.en: Tabelog: Piccolo Namba Walk, curry and omurice, Niji no Machi 1-9, Namba 2, Chuo-ku, Osaka, right by Kintetsu Namba Station and the subway Midosuji Line Namba Station, 10:30–22:00, closed on irregular days and New Year's Day, no reservations, no cards, e-money or QR, 8 counter seats, non-smoking, takeout available. The Piccolo Curry site (the food company ミツヤ食品工業; head office Shinsaibashisuji 2-3-16, Chuo-ku, Osaka; factory in Higashi-Osaka): the shops are Namba Walk (Namba Walk 1-9, 11:00–22:00, last order 21:30), Whity Umeda, Hankyu Kappa Yokocho, JR Osaka Station and Nishinomiya Hankyu, each selling curry to take away and retort curries (you can also eat in). A curry specialist that opened in the Umeda underground mall over 40 years ago, introduced as the "King of Curry" in L Magazine and elsewhere. Piccolo beef curry is thirty-odd spices with fruit, vegetables and beef, simmered for hours and finished with chutney and fresh cream. Reviews (2026): three kinds, Piccolo sauce curry, spicy curry and Piccolo hayashi; the W sauce with two on one plate; katsu curry ¥1,100; omurice (11:00–15:00) with tomato sauce ¥800, curry sauce ¥950 or hayashi sauce ¥1,050; fukujinzuke free, rakkyo ¥110; fast service; the walkway runs right behind the seats; some diners also go to the Umeda shop; one says prices are about 30% higher than before.

食べログ: ピッツェリア ダ ティグレ、大阪市西区新町1-18-13、西大橋駅2.en: Tabelog: Pizzeria da Tigre, 1-18-13 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station exit 2, 5 from Yotsubashi; Wed and Fri–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–21:00, Thu 11:30–14:30; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 13 counter seats. Reviews (April–October 2026): Neapolitan pizza only; wood-fired oven; meal tickets; no reservations; cash only; run single-handed; dough stretched and baked in front of you; done in minutes; margherita ¥1,000; marinara; Ricotta e Cipolla ¥1,500; served uncut with a note on how to eat it; cola ¥300; lots of takeaway; queues at weekend lunch; right after opening is the time to go.

食べログ: ファンサパロット、大阪市中央区日本橋1丁目17-23、06-6631.en: Tabelog: Fansa Parrot, 1-17-23 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6631-6872; reservations accepted; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:00–14:00 and 16:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Tuesdays; cards and e-money accepted; 24 seats (ground floor counter 8 and tables 4, 2nd floor tables 12; private hire up to 15). Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a similar Thai restaurant two doors down; a corner shop; the smile of a Thai male staff member; larb sen; yum woon sen; D lunch (green curry, Thai noodles, boiled egg and vegetable salad) ¥1,100; C set (gapao rice, vegetable salad, braised pork soup) ¥1,100; just before the entrance to Kuromon Market; run by Thai people, Thai heard all around; tom yum goong; green curry; Thai omelette; prices a little high; lunch sets recommended; slow when busy; a Thai Select restaurant; poo pad pong curry suspended; shrimp fried rice; Singha beer; heat not toned down for Japanese palates; many Thai diners too; prices raised.

食べログ: フレッシュネスバーガー 汐留シティセンター店、港区東新橋1-5-2.en: Tabelog: FRESHNESS BURGER Shiodome City Center, Higashi-Shinbashi 1-5-2, Minato-ku, Shiodome City Center 1F; weekdays 8:00–21:00, closed weekends and holidays; opened October 9, 2018. 2026 reviews: fries and beer at happy hour (Hokkaido potatoes sold out); black-wagyu burger; classic avocado cheeseburger set ¥1,322 (with an app coupon); food-court seats hard to find at 13:00; mostly two-seat tables; garden salad burger; fried lotus root and potatoes; rosehip tea.

食べログ: ブラーチェ・エ・ヴィーノ・ジジーノ、銀座3-11-6 鈴木ビル2F、.en: Tabelog: Brace e Vino Gigino, Ginza 3-11-6, 鈴木 Building 2F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station exit A7; 16 seats; Tue–Fri 17:00–22:00 (L.O.), weekends 16:00–22:00, closed Mon and irregular Tuesdays; otoshi ¥300; opened September 25, 2012; a charcoal-grill Italian izakaya, sister shop of "Termini" on 1F; cards and PayPay accepted. 2026 reviews: charcoal-grilled meat platter, grilled vegetables, sea-bream carpaccio, charcoal-grilled wagyu with truffle, choosing wine in the basement cellar, for wine drinkers, a regular of 16 visits, ¥4,000–10,000.

食べログ: プティオザミ、銀座1-4-9 銀座オザミビル1F・2F、銀座一丁目駅.en: Tabelog: Petit Oza Mi, Ginza 1-4-9, Ginza Oza Mi Building 1F–2F, 1 minute from Ginza-itchome Station exit 6; 20 seats; Tue–Fri 11:30–15:00, 17:30–22:00, Sat 11:30–15:30, 17:00–22:00, Sundays and holidays until 21:00, closed Mon; opened March 21, 2016; 10% service charge in bar hours only; cards and PayPay accepted. Shop introduction (English): the casual sister of "Ginza Oza Mi des Vins", now in its 29th year; lunch courses from about ¥2,950; wine by the glass, carafe and bottle. 2026 reviews: roast-beef salad lunch; a course of four starters, poached fish, braised beef cheek and pudding; foie gras hamburg steak; booking recommended; ¥2,000–8,000.

食べログ: ホット クロス 南堀江店、大阪市西区南堀江2-2-11 GATO D.en: Tabelog: Hot Cross Minami-Horie, GATO D.M Minami-Horie, 2-2-11 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 405 m from Nishi-Ohashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 8:00–19:30; closed Tuesdays (open on holidays, closed the next day); closed over New Year; no reservations; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats; no smoking; takeaway; official site. Reviews (July 2025 – September 2026): a bakery cafe known for curry bread; crisp minced-meat curry bread (like a menchi-katsu inside); egg curry bread; curry cabbage dog; curry lunch; bacon baguette; pizza bread; mixed nuts ¥268; cheese fromage ¥328; anpan; sandwiches and a morning menu; eat-in requires a drink order; one says the coffee is good too; a Kita-Horie shop too; one says prices have risen.
