食べログ: ホルモンらーめん 8910 千日前店、大阪市中央区千日前1-8-16.en: Tabelog: Horumon Ramen 8910 Sennichimae, 1-8-16 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; open 24 hours; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 8 October 2022; site 8910.sunlar333-pinoko.com. 2026 reviews (August–October): offal ramen and kalbi rice bowl (salt); the feel of a place where risotto or porridge from the soup is recommended; rich soup without off-smells; piping hot; the Sennichimae shopping arcade; the main shop is in Shimoshinjo, Higashiyodogawa-ku; not a big shop and often quiet; seems thin at first but is just right; choice of red or white (red is popular); bubbling in a clay pot; tender offal; like a hot pot for one; opens early in the morning; heat and fluffy offal; 24 hours; corn topping; after drinking.

食べログ: ホルモンラーメン 8910 ヨーロッパ通店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-.en: Tabelog: Horumon Ramen 8910 Europe-dori, Ookini Kinikini Bldg 1F, 1-16-17 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; open 24 hours; no smoking; e-money accepted; no cards or QR payment; opened 1 April 2023. Reviews (March 2025 – October 2026): limited spicy offal maze-soba ¥1,280 (large at the same price); thick wavy noodles; offal like at a yakiniku restaurant; fried onion; shoyu ramen ¥1,050 (faint sweetness); one said it tastes like instant; spicy kalbi ramen ¥990 (thin noodles, smallish portion); set meals on Saturdays too; one likened it to ramen abroad; the overseas staff are polite; one found the beef-bone paitan lacking; adjust with pepper and shichimi; 8 a.m.; hotter than expected, so an egg was added.

食べログ: ホルモン・ジビエ 明星、大阪市中央区千日前1-2-9 ST千日前ビル.en: Tabelog: Horumon & Gibier Myojo, ST Sennichimae Bldg 1F, 1-2-9 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 116 m from Nippombashi; Mon and Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00), Sat–Sun 15:00–23:00; closed Tuesdays; check Instagram for opening; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; standing for 16; opened 23 August 2022; Tabelog Tachinomi Hyakumeiten 2025. Reviews (September 2023 – October 2026): kangaroo with shungiku namul; no gamey smell to the kangaroo; horse liver safe to eat raw; seared loin yukhoe with egg; more kinds of liver the earlier you go; grilled liver; beef-tongue sashimi; cheek sashimi; venison thigh; wild boar; Matsusaka beef liver; bottled beer; chuhai where you pour your own soda; return empty bottles to the crate yourself; smallish portions; curry at weekends; camel (tenderloin), arrivals announced on Instagram; a queue right after opening; sea-lion sashimi with ginger; badger hot pot in winter; pig's uterus; often full and items sell out; quiet on rainy days; small intestine; lemon sauce; teriyaki heart; pheasant thigh; salt and yuzu-kosho; Nishinari offal; Akaboshi; beef tongue with plenty of leek; garlic small intestine; tsukami; Miyazaki and Matsusaka beef offal; about 100 m north of Gyokusei Ya; a vinyl-curtain entrance; U-shaped counter; videos of 80s–90s kayokyoku; sweet-potato shochu with water ¥500; offal stew ¥480; Matsusaka garlic small intestine ¥580; Miyazaki loin yukhoe ¥980; kangaroo tenderloin ¥720; one says prices weren't marked as pre-tax; plastic cups.

食べログ: ボア・ド・ブローニュ、千代田区日比谷公園1-2 松本楼3F、霞ケ関駅.en: Tabelog: Bois de Boulogne, Hibiya-koen 1-2, Chiyoda-ku, Matsumotoro 3F, near Kasumigaseki and Hibiya stations; Mon–Thu and weekends 11:00–15:30, 17:00–22:00, Fri until 21:30; official site matsumotoro.co.jp. 2026 reviews: on 3F of the historic Matsumotoro in Hibiya Park; the park's greenery through big windows; prix-fixe lunch ¥6,000 (amuse, three breads, soup or starter, main, dessert, coffee); "Forest and Island lunch course" ¥8,000 (chicken pot-au-feu; complaints about the jinenjo ice cream); crêpes Suzette; good for anniversaries.

食べログ: ボタ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-8-20、長堀橋駅から徒歩3分、月・木.en: Tabelog: Buttah, 1-8-20 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon and Thu–Sun 12:00–15:30 (L.O.) and from 18:00, Tue 12:00–15:30; closed Wednesdays; phone to check after 21:30; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter 4, two tables for 2, one for 4, raised area 4); official site. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): an old wooden house down an alley; bare bulbs; cute illustrations; Asian knick-knacks; daily curries (aubergine keema, butter chicken, keema, shrimp coconut, pumpkin butter, squid green curry, vegetable coconut); 2-curry combination; on Sundays a 3-curry plate ¥1,380 (saffron or turmeric rice, dal, pickles); about ¥1,550–1,750 with fried egg and chai; achar; raita; iced cardamom chai; heat can be increased; not too hot, easy to eat; cash only.

食べログ: マイアミパティオ 新橋駅前店、港区新橋2-6-2 新橋アイマークビル.en: Tabelog: Miami Patio Shimbashi Ekimae, Shinbashi 2-6-2, Minato-ku, Shinbashi I-Mark Building 1F; 56 seats; daily 11:00–24:00; no service charge; separate smoking area (smoking at all seats at dinner); official site miami-garden.jp. 2026 reviews: daily pasta (sakura shrimp) with salad and coffee ¥1,200; sets with a starter and drink; lots of salad; easy to sit and relax even after lunch; friendly staff; complaints of cigarette smell even at lunch; restrained flavors.

食べログ: マイアミ・ヴィッラ 有楽町イトシアプラザ店、千代田区有楽町2-7-1.en: Tabelog: Miami Villa Yurakucho ITOCiA Plaza, Yurakucho 2-7-1, Chiyoda-ku, Yurakucho ITOCiA 1F, 1 minute from JR Yurakucho Station central exit; 60 seats (terrace seats); Mon–Thu and Sun 9:00–21:00, Fri and Sat 9:00–22:00; official site miami-garden.jp. 2026 reviews: lunch set with salad and coffee about ¥1,500; Japanese-style pasta (on the salty side, close to soup pasta); takana and bacon with soy sauce; tomato and mozzarella pasta; Margherita; spinach and bacon salad; nearly full even at weekday lunch; 90-minute limit; ordinary taste; service split between efficient and unfriendly.

食べログ: マイティルゥ、大阪市中央区高津3-2-20、日本橋駅から徒歩5分、火.en: Tabelog: Mighty Luu, 3-2-20 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station; Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 and 18:00–23:00; closed Mondays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 18 seats; smoking area. Reviews (February 2025 – June 2026): curry at lunch, a bar at night; chicken curry ¥880 (regular; small, regular, large); slow-simmered tender chicken; a light spice curry with tomato tang; can be made milder; lentil curry; lentil and spinach curry; salmon and potato curry; combinations A, B and C (B is chicken curry with hamburg); hamburg topping; lunch last order 14:30; near the National Bunraku Theatre; one minded a tobacco smell at lunch.

食べログ: マトリキッチン、銀座3-10-14 東銀1ビル2F、東銀座駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Matri Kitchen, Ginza 3-10-14, 東銀1 Building 2F, 5 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 20 seats; Mon, Tue, Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun 11:30–22:00, closed Thu; cards, IC and d-barai accepted; ¥2,000–3,000. 2026 reviews: Russian food; weekday lunch set ¥1,300 (with a drink; mains such as beef stroganoff, salad, borscht); freshly made pelmeni; Russian tea with jam; cheerful women staff who seem Russian; a queue before opening.

食べログ: マリアージュフレール 銀座本店、銀座5-6-6 すずらん通り、銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Mariage Frères Ginza main shop, Ginza 5-6-6, Suzuran-dori, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A1; 37 seats; daily 11:30–20:00; reservations accepted; official site mariagefreres.co.jp. 2026 reviews: brighter since moving from another spot in Ginza; tea served in pots; white tea and flavored teas; about four autumn teas; tea-flavored cakes (choose from four, ¥1,980); a very large iced tea; recommends leaves to suit your taste or milk; a 45-minute wait on busy days, none at 13:30 on a weekday; the air conditioning is strong but was adjusted on request.

食べログ: マルコナ、銀座8-7-7 中央林ビル2F、新橋駅から徒歩3〜4分、1.en: Tabelog: Marcona, Ginza 8-7-7, 中央林 Building 2F, 3–4 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 18 seats; Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00, Sat reservations only, closed Sundays and holidays; opened August 9, 2005; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: Spanish food in a bar-like atmosphere; the owner cooks each order; jamón; seafood paella topped with shrimp; ajillo; starter platter; raisins on the vine with cheese; before concerts at Sumitomo Life Hall; ¥6,000–10,000.

食べログ: メッゼ堀江 トルコカフェ&レストラン、大阪市西区北堀江1-9-14.en: Tabelog: Mezze Horie Turkish Cafe & Restaurant, Pan1914 Bldg 2F, 1-9-14 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6543-1233; reservations accepted; lunch 11:30–15:00, dinner 17:00–22:30 (L.O. 22:00); closed Wednesdays; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 24 seats (3 tables for 4, counter 6, 3 terrace tables for 2); smoking on the terrace only; opened 26 April 2024; official mezzehorie.com. Shop's description: Mediterranean food by a chef from Turkey; halal ingredients in line with Islamic law; for halal and vegetarian diners too; plenty of spices and vegetables; charcoal-grilled kebabs; Turkish desserts. 2026 reviews (August–October): chicken kebab lunch set ¥1,200 (salad, bean and tomato soup, butter rice); an owner-chef with good Japanese; rice refills available; course ¥4,500 (starter platter with hummus, soup, Turkish bread, chicken, lamb and köfte kebabs, Turkish ice cream, baklava and Turkish pudding, Turkish chai); chickpea croquettes; marinated seafood; many overseas diners; a friendly chef; Turkish beer and red wine; the same tomato soup as eaten in Turkey.

食べログ: メリプリンチペッサ 銀座店(旧店名 パッチョ)、銀座1-6-10 銀.en: Tabelog: Meri Principessa Ginza (formerly Paccio), Ginza 1-6-10, Ginza 上一 Building 3F, 1 minute from Ginza-itchome Station; 90 seats (70 table, 10 high table, 10 private room); weekdays 11:30–14:30, 17:30–22:00, weekends and holidays 12:00–15:00, 17:30–22:00; irregular holidays; after 20:00 use the outside elevator; opened July 16, 2012. Shop introduction: Italian with Hiroshima ingredients; "Anchor to the table"; courses of seasonal vegetables, fresh fish and meat with all-you-can-drink; natural wines; interior in Bingo kasuri. October 2026 reviews: on 1F the Hiroshima showroom shop "TAU"; a ¥3,500 lunch course (pizza or pasta, steamed oysters, coffee or tea); people come for the oysters; hard to book on weekends; a course served on big platters to share (caprese of Hiroshima mandarins and mozzarella); course with all-you-can-drink ¥7,700, with sparkling ¥6,600; full even on weekdays.

食べログ: ヤマガタ サンダンデロ、銀座1-5-10 銀座ファーストファイブビル.en: Tabelog: YAMAGATA San-Dan-Delo, Ginza 1-5-10, Ginza First Five Building 2F; 32 seats; Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00, 18:00–22:00, closed Mondays (open on holidays) and at New Year; opened April 30, 2009; official site sandandelo.theshop.jp. Shop introduction: the Ginza shop of Yamagata's Al-chè-cciano (Arkecciano in the English shop introduction); Shonai seafood and Yamagata mountain produce; vegetables and fruit from growers. 2026 reviews: chef Okuda's (English spelling) gentle flavors; pasta from research into yuderon (English spelling); ayu pasta; plenty of non-alcoholic cocktails; Yamagata vegetables and meat; full at opening on weekends; booking essential.

食べログ: ユーミン、大阪市天王寺区空堀町6-1、玉造から227m、毎日11:0.en: Tabelog: Yuming, 6-1 Karahoricho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 227 m from Tamatsukuri; daily 11:00–14:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed 1st and 3rd Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats; smoking area inside; opened 15 June 2012. Reviews (2019 – July 2026): a neighbourhood Chinese diner one block south of Nagahori-dori; run by two people; TV; 15 noodle dishes (ramen, tanmen, gomoku noodles, champon, yakisoba, tsukemen); gyoza; chukadon; fried rice; sets and daily specials; champon (medium-thin straight noodles, a piping-hot rich chicken-bone shoyu soup, pork, shrimp, cabbage, bean sprouts, carrot, onion, leek); half fried rice + champon set ¥1,000; service set (champon and half fried rice) ¥750; gomoku ramen (chicken-bone salt); Kyushu ramen with half fried rice set ¥800 (some days curry fried rice); fried rice ¥600–700 (roast pork, sausage, bacon); 5 gyoza hand-made from the skins up ¥350, gingery; karaage ¥400; yakisoba with a rich sauce; order verbally, pay afterwards; pepper, chili oil and gyoza sauce on the table.

食べログ: ラ ニュイ ブランシュ、銀座7-2-8 東建ビルB1F、銀座駅から徒.en: Tabelog: La Nuit Blanche, Ginza 7-2-8, 東建 Building B1F, 4 minutes from Ginza Station, 5 from Shinbashi Station; 12 seats; Mon–Sat 18:00–2:00, closed Sun; reservations required; opened June 1, 2008; entry may be refused if you smell strongly of perfume, fabric softener, hand cream or cigarettes; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: an owner who knows wine well; by the glass, young vintages and new producers; by the bottle, plenty of 1990s Burgundy; Alsace and Rhône; Haba (English spelling), who speaks French; trippa, pasta, white-truffle risotto; ¥15,000–30,000.

食べログ: ラ・ゴロセッタ、大阪市中央区南船場2-8-13、心斎橋・長堀橋駅から.en: Tabelog: La Golosetta, 2-8-13 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Tue–Fri and Sun 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sat 18:00–21:00; closed Mondays; cards (VISA, JCB) accepted; 18 seats (ground-floor counter 6, 2nd-floor tables 12). Reviews (June 2023 – October 2026): a cute detached house; an Italian wood-fired oven at the back; pizza stained glass; baked in a few minutes; a chewy, fragrant crust with twisted edges; at lunch from a little over ¥1,000 with salad (watercress and more); about 12 kinds including 2 daily; margherita ¥1,200; diavola ¥1,300 (marinara with spicy salami, chili, garlic; heat adjustable); capricciosa; quattro formaggi; bianca of porcini and smoked mozzarella; anchovy; buffalo mozzarella; bases margherita, marinara (no cheese) and bianca (no tomato); marinated octopus; salami; tiramisu ¥500; beer ¥500; wine; busy after 12:00; one found the salad dressing on the salty side.

食べログ: ラ・セヌ(La Scene)、千代田区内幸町1-5-2 メルキュール.en: Tabelog: La Scene, Uchisaiwaicho 1-5-2, Chiyoda-ku, Mercure Tokyo Hibiya B1F; 77 seats (private and semi-private rooms, sofa seats and more); breakfast 7:00–11:00, lunch 11:30–L.O. 13:30, tea time 13:30–17:30, dinner 17:30–21:30, bar 11:30–22:30; open every day; opened December 19, 2023; particular about vegetables and fish; breakfast available; allergen labeling; vegetarian menu available. 2026 reviews: weekend-only lunch set (one drink, choice of four starters, a main of fish, meat or pasta, free bread refills); seasonal tarts; mango-strawberry tea; truffle fries; from Shinbashi Station exit 7 you can get there underground without getting wet; a bright space with natural light; hotel-style service.

食べログ: ラ・プティ・メルスリー ルミネ有楽町店、千代田区有楽町2-5-1 ル.en: Tabelog: la petite mercerie Lumine Yurakucho, Yurakucho 2-5-1, Chiyoda-ku, Lumine Yurakucho, Lumine 1, 4F; 30 seats; daily 11:00–21:00; closed when Lumine Yurakucho is; opened October 28, 2011; official site la-petite-mercerie.jp. 2026 reviews: raspberry soda; afternoon tea even in the evening without booking; Mercerie afternoon tea (choose your cake; a limited Shine Muscat shortcake); Mélusine shortcake with Japanese strawberries; cheesecake; thick-cut bacon and pumpkin doria; bread at lunch; attentive service.

食べログ: ラ・メゾン・ド・ビィ、銀座5-5-12 HULIC&New GINZ.en: Tabelog: La Maison de Bi, Ginza 5-5-12, HULIC & New GINZA MIYUKI5 9F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station; 20 seats, private rooms (2 and 4); Tue–Fri 12:00–20:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–20:00, closed Mon; 10% service charge after 18:00; cards and IC accepted; organic afternoon tea from ¥15,000. Reviews (2025–2026): sweets beyond additive-free; a parfait of Amazon cacao and Balangon bananas; Shine Muscat parfait; light-roast coffee from Kenya and Geisha; hojicha financiers; lunch and dinner courses; a chef who started as a pâtissier.

食べログ: ラーメン EBI パチ、大阪市中央区日本橋2-12-23、近鉄日本橋.en: Tabelog: Ramen EBI Pachi, 2-12-23 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 275 m from Kintetsu Nippombashi Station; daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–22:00; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; counter seats; opened 29 April 2022. Reviews (February–October 2026): many tourists; pay afterwards; Kiwami Kuromon shoyu ramen ¥1,350; choice of chashu: thick-cut pork belly, pork shoulder or beef fat; chicken bones and pork bones with shrimp and scallop; a tare blending several shoyu; one says the shoyu is strong and the shrimp hard to taste; medium-thin noodles of Mie's Ayahikari wheat; big wontons; near Kuromon Market; special shrimp salt; self-serve water; counter only; a clear soup; found closed several times; shrimp flavour; on Kuromon's Nippombashi 2-chome street; a vinyl noren; shrimp salt ¥950; light and gentle; special shrimp salt ¥1,350; sweet-shrimp extract; medium-thin wavy noodles; bean sprouts; yuzu; menu (shrimp salt, shrimp shoyu, Kuromon shoyu, Kuromon tori paitan, Kuromon spicy tori paitan, shrimp miso); pepper, shichimi, sesame and vinegar on the table; 9 counter seats; the owner and one staff member.

食べログ: ラーメン フクロウ、大阪市天王寺区舟橋町15-24、鶴橋から181m.en: Tabelog: Ramen Fukurou, 15-24 Funahashicho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 181 m from Tsuruhashi; daily 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 1 November 2019. Reviews (2021–2026): Jiro style with emulsified tonkotsu; slightly sweet, not too salty; one calls it the best Jiro style in Kansai; the second brand of Menya Fukuhara in Higashinari; soup made with a Robot-Coupe; medium-thick flat straight noodles, smooth rather than chewy; tender chashu; mini 150 g ¥1,000, 200 g ¥1,100, 250 g +¥100, 300 g +¥150; miso ramen ¥1,050; soupless; tsukemen; summer hiyashi chuka; extra slice of chashu +¥200; spicy meat miso +¥200; quail eggs; raw egg; extra vegetables on a separate plate +¥150; toppings chosen on the touch-panel ticket machine, no calls; cash only from 30 January 2026; queues of 10–20 at opening; a narrow pavement busy with bicycles, so queue without blocking the entrance; a clean shop; one says extra vegetables dilute the soup; one says taste and serving time vary by staff; vinegar, fish powder, pepper and chili on the table.

食べログ: ラーメン 横綱 NAMBAなんなん店、大阪市中央区難波5 なんなんタ.en: Tabelog: Ramen Yokozuna NAMBA Nannan, NAMBA Nannan B1F, Nannan Town 11, 5 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6616-9827; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 35 seats; no smoking; opened 19 June 2017; official 4527.com. 2026 reviews (August–September): a small ramen and menma to finish off daytime drinking; unlimited leek; one wished the soup had more depth; choice of noodle firmness and fast service; quick-drink set (draught beer with chashu, menma, seasoned egg, leek and kimchi platter) plus ramen ¥1,380; right by the subway Namba Station ticket gates; at the far end of Nannan Town; one calls it ordinary; chashu-men; ramen and fried rice set ¥1,220; just the right richness.

食べログ: ラーメン 男塾!! 日本橋店、大阪市浪速区日本橋4-15-23、なん.en: Tabelog: Ramen Otokojuku!! Nippombashi, 4-15-23 Nippombashi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 387 m from Namba Station; daily 11:00–22:30; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 7 November 2017. Reviews (January–September 2026): Jiro style on Otaroad; Jukucho ramen with medium noodles; a punchy soup; regretted asking for fewer vegetables; the garlic is very hot; soupless with grated cheese; one member of staff, so a wait; 20–30 minutes' wait on Sundays; call for vegetables, fat and garlic; garlic can be swapped for ginger; fewer noodles and more vegetables recommended for women; kombu salt on the bean sprouts is superb; thick chashu; recommended for Jiro-style beginners too; soupless miso Jukucho ramen ¥1,060; lots of garlic; spicy Jukucho ramen (regular) ¥1,100; extra vegetables, fat and garlic free; one found the seating instructions curt.

食べログ: レ・フレール・アオキ、銀座3-12-6 1F、東銀座駅から徒歩5分、.en: Tabelog: LES FRÈRES AOKI, Ginza 3-12-6 1F, 5 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 10 seats; Tue–Fri 12:00–14:30, 18:30–22:30, weekends lunch and dinner (shorter), holidays dinner only, closed Mon; opened September 7, 2021; cards accepted. Chef profile (English): owner-chef Makoto Aoki, born 1969 in Tokyo; trained at the family's "Ginza Sushi Aoki" and at "L'Oiseau"; went to France in 1995; ran "Restaurant Makoto Aoki" in Paris for 13 years from 2006; opened behind the Kabukiza in September 2021; French wines changing monthly. 2026 reviews: tastes of Paris, cucumber soup, pâté de volaille, cod fritters, beef-tongue brick, girolle risotto, Amami fish with squid ink, Tokachi Ezo venison, chausson; weekday petit lunch course ¥5,000; half glasses from ¥1,250; a regular of 21 visits; some say it's noisy inside.

食べログ: ロオジエ(L’OSIER)、銀座7-5-5、銀座駅から徒歩7分、34.en: Tabelog: L'OSIER, Ginza 7-5-5, 7 minutes from Ginza Station; 34 seats; private rooms (¥11,000 at lunch, ¥22,000 at dinner; ¥55,000 for 2–4); Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00, 17:30–22:00; closed Sun, Mon, some holidays, mid-August and New Year; 15% service charge; cards and QR accepted; parking for 10 cars. Shop introduction: run by Shiseido, on this site since 1973; interior by Pierre-Yves Rochon; executive chef Olivier Chaignon since 2013. 2026 reviews: hairy crab and caviar with turnip mousse; pen shell and geoduck; scale-grilled ayu; roast pigeon (buckwheat flour, leg confit); cheese; persimmon crêpe flambé; the mignardise trolley; a black-truffle course; Grand Cru by the glass; a fish dish with three sauces; the chocolate trolley; 7–8 Champagnes; service that knows regulars' tastes; on the other hand, complaints that many plates were cold and that some staff were cold.

食べログ: ロシア料理 ROGOVSKI 銀座、銀座5-7-10 イグジットメル.en: Tabelog: Russian Restaurant ROGOVSKI Ginza, Ginza 5-7-10, EXITMELSA 7F, 1 minute from Ginza Station exit A2; 76 seats (all tables); weekdays 11:00–16:00, 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; open almost every day (one day each in February and August, and New Year); 5% service charge (not for lunch courses); December–February courses by reservation only; 2-hour limit when busy; opened September 18, 2015; official site rogovski.co.jp. Booking note: cannot accommodate allergies to dairy, green onions, wheat, mushrooms, eggs or pork. Shop introduction: founded 1951, Japan's first Russian restaurant, 75 years this year; court cuisine and regional dishes of Ukraine, Georgia and Uzbekistan; wines from Georgia, Russia, Moldova, Romania and Bulgaria. October 2026 reviews: Katyusha course (6 starters: pickled herring, beet vinegret, marinated mushrooms…; pirozhki; main; dessert; Russian tea); borscht; Ginza course (caviar, vegetable pirozhki, mushroom and chicken pot pie, striploin); beef stroganoff; generous portions.

食べログ: ローマイヤレストラン 銀座店、銀座5-9-17 銀座あづまビル2F、.en: Tabelog: Romaier Restaurant Ginza, Ginza 5-9-17, Ginza Azuma Building 2F, 2 minutes from Ginza Station exit A5; 30 seats, private room (5–6); Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00, 17:30–22:00, closed Sundays, holidays and New Year; no service charge; cards and PayPay accepted; opened March 22, 2019; official site lohmeyer.co.jp. Shop introduction: founded 1925; the famous roast beef; German beer and sommelier-chosen wines; black-wagyu roast-beef lunch ¥5,000 (by reservation); Christmas course ¥9,800. 2026 reviews: lunch from ¥1,300; demi-glace hamburg steak ¥1,500 (with rice, consommé, salad and a drink); weekly red-wine-braised hamburg steak ¥1,400; daily hamburg steak ¥1,400; fresh-fish carpaccio and sausages in the all-you-can-drink course; Schweinshaxe.

食べログ: ヴァンピックル 銀座(vinpicoeur)、銀座4-3-4 銀座居.en: Tabelog: vinpicoeur Ginza, Ginza 4-3-4, 銀座居酒店 Building 2F; 24 seats; Mon and Thu 17:00–23:00, Fri 17:00–23:30, weekends and holidays 15:30–23:00, closed Tue, Wed and irregularly; official site auxamis.com. Shop introduction: charcoal grilling and fine wine; an Alsace wine-by-the-glass fair in October; a Burgundy fair. 2026 reviews: casual French; the sommelier's remarks are fun; a duck or lamb main; meat and vegetable skewers; rice porridge to finish; five-starter platter; grilled Camembert skewer; shiitake; charcoal-grilled venison; mostly counter; quality unchanged for 20 years.

食べログ: ヴァン・ド・レーヴ、銀座1-20-1 オーキッド銀座ビル1F、宝町駅.en: Tabelog: Vin de Rêve, Ginza 1-20-1, Orchid Ginza Building 1F, 4 minutes from Takaracho Station exit A1, 5 from Ginza-itchome Station; 20 seats; weekdays 17:30–24:00, Sat 17:30–23:00, closed Sundays and holidays; opened March 3, 2006; cards and d-barai accepted. 2026 reviews: a 20th-anniversary menu; the usual onion tart and crunchy salad; cheese platter; vegetable platter; Ezo venison; uni risotto; pâté en croûte; wine by the glass (Alsace Riesling, Burgundy, Pomerol); smaller pours on request; the owner's particular tastes; a master who loves Showa baseball; ¥4,000–20,000.

食べログ: 一㐂、銀座5-4-15 西五ビル4F、銀座駅から徒歩1分、20席・個.en: Tabelog: Ichiki, Ginza 5-4-15, 西五 Building 4F, 1 minute from Ginza Station; 20 seats, private rooms (2–8); daily 12:00–14:30 (last entry 13:30), 17:00–23:00 (last entry 21:00); 10% service charge; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: lunch omakase ¥11,000 (chu-toro, squid, amberjack, kinki, kombu-cured sea bream, akami, bonito, surf clam, salmon roe, the Ichiki roll, uni, seared toro, botan shrimp, conger eel, kanpyō roll, tamago, akadashi, Shine Muscat jelly); dinner omakase ¥18,000; matsutake, hairy crab and tilefish in autumn; accommodates fish you dislike; many overseas visitors; some say the one floor staffer can't keep up.

食べログ: 一夢庵 麵、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-3-32 サンプラザ123寿楽ビ.en: Tabelog: Ichimuan Men, Sun Plaza 123 Juraku Bldg 1F, 2-3-32 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6484-3923; Mon–Sat 22:00–7:30 next morning; closed Sundays; no cards; opened 26 November 2021. 2026 reviews (January–October): late-night ramen; rich tonkotsu shoyu with a clean finish; the sweetness of tonkotsu with Kyoto's aged shoyu 'Okko'; moist chashu, soft-boiled egg, leek; wood-ear; crisp chashu; tsukemen recommended too; you want to drink all the soup; run single-handed, so service is curt; served one-handed; fried rice in large only; chashu rice bowl; sweet, spicy, savoury maze-soba; chewy noodles; rich tonkotsu shoyu ramen at ¥1,300 is pricey; medium-thick straight noodles; about 8 counter seats; open until 7:30 a.m.

食べログ: 一番麻辣烫 日本橋店、大阪市中央区日本橋1-3-17 日本橋エンビィ.en: Tabelog: Ichiban Malatang Nippombashi, Nippombashi Envy Bldg, 1-3-17 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 20 seats; daily 11:00–24:00; cards and QR payment accepted. 2026 reviews (July–October): beef-bone soup; rich even at heat 0, like a ramen soup; chili oil on the side; free drink; spice aromas and deep umami; fresh ingredients; a clean shop; came back within a week; a distinctive smell inside; a little over ¥1,000; heat level 1 builds slowly; a few minutes from Nippombashi Station; no queue, so able to choose calmly; unusual soups too; original paitan soup; broccoli recommended; 3rd of 19 shops; heat level 3; free drink over ¥1,000.

食べログ: 一蘭 なんば御堂筋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-4-2 グルカスシティ.en: Tabelog: Ichiran Namba Midosuji, Grukas City Bldg 2F, 2-4-2 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station exit 14; 25 seats (flavour-concentration counter); daily 9:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); open every day of the year; opened 8 August 2019; official site ichiran.com. 2026 reviews: a '100% tonkotsu-free' shop; a soup developed from beef bones and more, so people who cannot eat pork or pork bones can enjoy it too; Arita-ware lacquer-box-style bowls and partitioned counter; creamy like tonkotsu; one said it lacks the punch of real tonkotsu; sweet-savoury beef (Gyu Yaro) instead of pork chashu; chicken base; the red secret sauce; matcha pudding; tonkotsu-free ramen ¥1,280 (¥1,820 with a salted boiled egg and extra Gyu Yaro); no queue right after the 9 a.m. opening on weekdays; notices of 80-minute waits and QR queueing; waits of over 30 minutes; many overseas visitors; noodle firmness chosen on the order sheet; extra garlic.

食べログ: 一蘭 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-3-29 ミヤプラザ心斎橋1.en: Tabelog: Ichiran Shinsaibashi, Miya Plaza Shinsaibashi 1F, 1-3-29 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-1808-2625; no reservations; daily 10:00–6:00 next morning (food L.O. 5:45); open every day of the year; cards and e-money accepted; 40 flavour-concentration counter seats; opened 15 December 2017; official ichiran.com. 2026 reviews (August–September): ramen ¥1,290 at night prices; soft-boiled salted egg ¥180; extra garlic ¥180; the secret sauce at 10× is very hot; low-hydration thin noodles and rich tonkotsu; choose richness and firmness; heat 6; open late on Saturdays; a queue of tourists and Japanese at midnight after the last train; fast turnover; a fast-pass-like system that lets you in without waiting late at night; ticket machine → seat → eat → leave; partitioned flavour-concentration counter; partitions that can't be removed; queue managed smoothly even with a 40-minute wait; order sheet; natural tonkotsu ramen; firm; a mellow, creamy soup without off-smell.

食べログ: 一蘭 道頓堀店別館、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-16、なんば駅14番出.en: Tabelog: Ichiran Dotonbori Annex, 1-4-16 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station exit 14; 82 seats (flavour-concentration counter 30, tables 52); open 24 hours every day of the year; no reservations; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; allergen information available; opened 16 April 2015; official ichiran.com. Official: flavour-concentration counter 24 hours, tables 8:00–23:00; seats and hours may change at short notice. 2026 reviews: crowded even after 8 a.m.; natural tonkotsu ramen ¥1,180; soft-boiled salted egg ¥160; order sheet (richness, garlic, leek, red secret sauce, noodle firmness); a model of Hakata tonkotsu; extra-thin noodles; light and not greasy; tonkotsu without porky smell; noodle refill ¥210; a 10-minute wait even at 2 a.m.; up to an hour's wait in October; tickets and order sheets from the machine while queuing; tables on the 3rd floor; up to 5 children free per adult; mini size; souvenirs on sale.

食べログ: 一轍、大阪市西区京町堀1-12-23、本町駅28番出口から西へ徒歩7.en: Tabelog: Ittetsu, 1-12-23 Kyomachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk west from Hommachi Station exit 28; Nishi-Semba Park; 476 m from Higobashi; Mon and Wed 11:30–14:30, Tue, Thu and Fri 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; closed weekends and holidays; closes when sold out; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 counter seats; opened 12 July 2010. Reviews (February 2025 – October 2026): ramen heaped with chili ¥950; soft-boiled egg ¥50; restrained heat; niboshi ramen; menma; niboshi ramen (niboshi and tonkotsu shoyu); seafood ramen (bonito-flake and tonkotsu shoyu); sea-bream soba (sea bream and tonkotsu salt); chuka soba; No. 1 most popular is niboshi; medium-thin noodles; nori, menma, white leek, radish sprouts, 2 slices chashu and half a soft-boiled egg for ¥900; the seafood ramen is rich and creamy; plum seafood salt ramen with free wasabi; a 10-year regular; lent an umbrella in the rain; founded 2010; the owner recommends the seafood ramen shoyu; in front of Nishi-Semba Park; down a lane; counter only; stylish chairs; touch-panel ordering; check evening hours; the bill comes with the food; pay at the machine at the back; niboshi ramen large with mentaiko rice; refined and sweetish.

食べログ: 三田製麺所 なんば店、大阪市中央区千日前2-11-3 樋口建物1F、.en: Tabelog: Mita Seimenjo Namba, Higuchi Tatemono 1F, 2-11-3 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 54 seats (counter 24, tables 30); daily 10:00–3:00 next morning (food L.O. 2:30); no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 21 July 2012; official mita-seimen.jp. 2026 reviews (August–October): limited niboshi chuka soba ¥1,100 and extra niboshi ¥200; salty, strong niboshi; softish thick noodles; cold spicy tantanmen (soy-milk soup) ¥1,150; ordering by QR code; mizuna, menma, chicken, egg yolk, nuts; Sichuan pepper; cold sea-bream salt tsukemen with everything ¥1,340 (500 g noodles); a chain; busy at lunch; self-serve water; black-bonito tsukemen; a strong dipping soup; soup thinned with broth at the end; limited menu right after opening; noodles free up to 500 g; bonito-flake salt and garlic shichimi; limited niboshi tsukemen; near Amza.

食べログ: 三笠会館 本店、銀座5-5-17、銀座駅から40m、毎日11:00〜.en: Tabelog: Mikasa Kaikan main shop, Ginza 5-5-17, 40 m from Ginza Station; daily 11:00–22:00 (as a building); official site mikasakaikan.co.jp. 2026 reviews: curry at the 1F Italian bar (also said to be famous for karaage); on Namiki-dori; 80 seats by the windows on the mezzanine; pasta lunch ¥2,500 (bread, a dish, pasta, two desserts, coffee); new Awaji Island onions and clams with lemon oil; strawberry shaved ice with condensed milk at the shaved-ice counter 「氷処 三笠」; teppanyaki on 7F (lean meat grilled in front of you, Hokkaido pumpkin soup, garlic rice); a calm Showa atmosphere.

食べログ: 上方レインボー、大阪市天王寺区勝山4-6-3、JR桃谷駅南口から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Kamigata Rainbow, 4-6-3 Katsuyama, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from JR Momodani Station south exit; Mon–Wed and Fri–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Thursdays; temporary closures announced on social media; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 6 seats; opened 24 February 2020. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): Shoyu Animal ¥1,600 (the rich umami and sweetness of a meat soup); iriko shoyu ¥1,000; salt ramen ¥1,000; Antoki no Shio ¥1,600 (tangy red onion); Neo Shio Ramen Apple; curry ramen (seafood dashi and beef fat); house-made thick flat noodles (fettuccine-like); limited tsukemen (Aka Buta DDX with autumn-pear tsukemen ¥1,600; Kurobuta and eel-dashi wasabi tsukemen ¥1,400; fig and octopus summer salt tsukemen ¥1,600; tantan tsukemen); tori paitan now and then; Aka Buta DDX 2 slices of chashu ¥500; Ajitama Arokana ¥200; Kurobuta rice ¥400; Rainbow wonton; large ¥200 (free some days); tablet ordering; staff suggest trying the noodles first with salt and lemon; one found the eel tsukemen a little fishy; doesn't look like a ramen shop from outside.

食べログ: 上野精養軒 松屋銀座店、銀座3-6-1 松屋銀座本店8F、銀座駅直結.en: Tabelog: Ueno Seiyoken Matsuya Ginza, Ginza 3-6-1, Matsuya Ginza main store 8F, connected to Ginza Station, 3 minutes; 50 seats; Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00), Sundays and last days of consecutive holidays 11:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); irregular holidays (following Matsuya Ginza); children welcome, children's menu, baby chairs, strollers welcome; official site seiyoken.co.jp. 2026 reviews: the Ginza shop of a pioneer of French cooking in Japan, founded 1872; crab cream croquettes with a thick coating; retort beef stew ¥1,080 (takeaway); demi-glace beef hamburg steak (thick and coarse-ground, broccoli, carrot, potato); a small entrance but spacious, comfortable seats; couldn't book online even though it showed availability.

食べログ: 世界一暇なラーメン屋、大阪市北区中之島3-3-23 中之島ダイビル.en: Tabelog: Sekaiichi Himana Ramen Ya, Nakanoshima Daibiru 2F, 3-3-23 Nakanoshima, Kita-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Keihan Watanabebashi Station, 8 from Higobashi Station; daily 11:00–22:00; closed over New Year; no cards, e-money or QR; 42 seats; opened 11 February 2014; official site. October 2026 reviews: a sister shop of Jinrui Mina Menrui; a stylish, spacious room on the 2nd floor of an office building; Mr. Children songs and music videos; queues at lunch but fast turnover; smartphone ordering at each table (menus only in the waiting area); Witch's Red ¥957 (sweetish shoyu with shellfish umami, chewy medium-thick whole-wheat noodles, thin-sliced chashu); seasoned egg ¥105; a light bonito-dashi ramen; 5 gyoza ¥200; one found it heavy by the end; kind staff; open all day.

食べログ: 両忘、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-10-17 心斎橋ロヂビル 1F、心斎.en: Tabelog: Ryobo, Shinsaibashi Roji Bldg 1F, 1-10-17 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 7 and Yotsubashi Station; Mon–Fri 17:00–23:00, Sat 12:00–23:00, Sun and holidays 12:00–22:00; irregular closing days; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 counter seats; private hire possible (up to 20); opened 29 April 2023. Reviews (July 2024 – October 2026): Tabelog Yakitori WEST Hyakumeiten 2025; course only ¥13,200; dislikes asked first; Kumano jidori (Mie) and Date chicken (Fukushima); starters include smoked thigh tataki, breast tataki, Senshu fruit tomatoes, grilled aubergine, liver pâté with baguette, donko shiitake; skewers of negima, heart, neck, tsukune with mustard, kinkan with liver, gizzard, thigh, furisode, ume-shiso roll; to finish, 2 kinds of clay-pot rice (chicken soboro; lotus root, hiratake and green pepper; corn in July) with refills; pickles, small dishes, soup; house lemon sour; L-shaped counter; one found the heart tasted burnt; at the end of a passage; a calm atmosphere.

食べログ: 中国四川 旬菜 酒肆 楽山、大阪市中央区北浜3-5-19 淀屋橋ホワ.en: Tabelog: China Sichuan Shunsai Shushi Rakusan, Yodoyabashi White Bldg B1F, 3-5-19 Kitahama, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Yodoyabashi Station exit 8; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 (L.O. 13:45) and 18:00–21:30 (L.O. 21:00); closed weekends and holidays; closed the evening of 2 November for renovation; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 21 seats; private hire up to 20. Reviews (January–October 2026): mapo tofu or tantanmen at lunch (6:4, mapo slightly ahead); a queue from 11:00; quick turnover; house chili oil and numbing Sichuan pepper; mapo tofu with minced meat and douchi; yunbai rou; twice-cooked pork; spicy stir-fried shrimp and cashews; big prawns in chili sauce; chicken breast and zucchini stir-fried with chili; pork fillet stir-fried with douchi; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork; Hong Kong shumai; spring rolls; century egg; Shaoxing wine tasting; Heartland beer; a dim basement in an old building; counter and tables; full with bookings at night; fine for drinking alone too.

食べログ: 中国料理 孫悟空、大阪市中央区南船場1-13-15 長堀三栄ビル1F.en: Tabelog: Chinese cuisine Son Goku, Nagahori San'ei Bldg 1F, 1-13-15 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; no opening hours listed; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking weekdays 11:00–13:00. Reviews (January–October 2026): a queue after noon on weekdays; shrimp and egg rice bowl ¥800–880 (fluffy egg with Tianjin-style sauce, fried shrimp); beef and egg rice bowl ¥800; seafood and egg rice bowl ¥800; champon with thick sauce ¥880; shoyu yakisoba; sara udon; daily specials (mapo tofu and others); salt, pepper, vinegar, sauce and shoyu on the table; opens 11:30; one says closed Sundays, holidays and Mondays; after price rises the menu and prices may differ a little.

食べログ: 中国菜 Yin Yang、大阪市中央区博労町4-3-14 8Rビル.en: Tabelog: Chinese Sai Yin Yang, 8R Bldg 2F, Hakuromachi 4-3-14, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Shinsaibashi Stn; Tue–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 17:30–22:30, Mon and Sat 17:30–22:30 (last order 21:50); closed Sunday; lunch cannot be reserved and is cash or PayPay only; one drink per person; cards, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; 17 seats (counter 7, tables 10); non-smoking; English menu; opened 6 April 2024. Shop's description: gently seasoned Chinese cooking with Cantonese touches, domestic fresh fish and seasonal vegetables bought at the market, natural wine and Shaoxing wine; popular dishes are the assorted appetizers, mapo tofu, tom yum fried rice and a Cantonese-style fresh-fish carpaccio. Reviews (January 2025–October 2026): the second shop of Tokuchaina; on the 2nd floor up the stairs at the back of a building behind the W Osaka; a stylish white-themed room; five-kind appetizer platter, mapo tofu with fermented black beans, squid stir-fried with black beans, black-vinegar sweet and sour pork, shrimp chili, ebi mayo, yurinchi, shrimp dumplings, chicken and water chestnut shumai, oyster shumai, char siu wrapped in a crêpe, spring rolls, noodle soup with green onion and char siu, almond tofu; lunch was the weekly-special Chinese noodles with four small side dishes for ¥1,200; dishes come out slowly.

食べログ: 中華そば うえまち、大阪市中央区上町A番22号、谷町六丁目駅7番出口.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Uemachi, A-22 Uemachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station exit 7; Tue–Sun 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:00; closed Mondays (holidays too); some days no evening service when ingredients run out; closes when sold out; temporary closures on X; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; opened 17 December 2012; Tabelog Ramen WEST Hyakumeiten 2018–2022, OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023–2025. Reviews (March–October 2026): a 63rd visit; tsukemen; a dipping soup balancing sweet, spicy and sour; chewy noodles; melting chashu; the best of the Kadoya line; house-made noodles; shoyu umami with tang and faint heat; 5 people at 13:00 on a weekday, 10 minutes; 11 people at 12:15 on a Sunday, 24 minutes; cash only; tsukemen ¥1,450; glossy flat whole-wheat noodles; 3 kinds of chashu; white leek; menma; in the Kadoya Shokudo tradition but its own; shoyu chuka soba; a sharp shoyu and clear soup; limited chicken-pork and maze-soba; 6 people before 13:00 on a weekday, 30-minute wait; the shoyu ramen a little salty; one says it may move soon.

食べログ: 中華そば しゅき、大阪市天王寺区大道4-10-6、寺田町から105m.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Shuki, 4-10-6 Daido, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 105 m from Teradacho; daily 11:00–24:00; no cards, e-money or QR (one says PayPay worked); opened 12 April 2026. Reviews (September–October 2026): affiliated with Raa-men Shuki in Tsuruhashi; reopened after refitting from Menji Shuki; chashu chuka soba ¥930 (a regular shoyu, thin noodles, overflowing thin-sliced chashu, shredded white leek); spicy mala jan-men ¥1,200 (thick chewy noodles, bean sprouts, chashu, chili, egg yolk; add garlic); cold tantanmen ¥1,200 (thin noodles, spicy meat miso, bok choy, bean sprouts); white-sesame soy-milk cold tantan soba ¥1,380; cold leek edition; noodle refill ¥110 (free for students); gyoza sets; half fried rice ¥530 at lunch; counter only; a few groups waiting even on weekdays; order verbally, pay on leaving.

食べログ: 中華そば なんば楼、大阪市浪速区難波中1-18-14、なんば駅から1.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Nanbaro, 1-18-14 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 111 m from Namba Station; daily 11:00–23:00; no reservations; cards, transit IC, PayPay and au PAY accepted; opened 1 June 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): run by Yoshinoya Holdings; signature clear tonkotsu broth; niboshi paitan ramen ¥900; special clear tonkotsu ¥1,200; light, with chewy thick wavy noodles (July 2025); with the menu revision of 17 September 2026, back-fat chuka soba with rice ¥880 and tsukemen discontinued; savoury-spicy soba ¥1,000 and 5× heat ¥500; chan-kei clear tonkotsu; clear and smooth; medium-thin flat straight noodles; 6–7 slices chashu; thin menma; a perk for following on Instagram; free toppings such as garlic or yuzu-kosho; clear tonkotsu noodles ¥1,000; bottled beer ¥500; snack platter ¥500; one found it salty; a bright yellow sign; close to Nankai Namba Station; change the flavour with table condiments; follow the shop's guide to changing the flavour.

食べログ: 中華そば アサヒ製麺 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Asahi Seimen Namba Ramen Ichiza, Namba Ramen Ichiza, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–21:30; no cards, e-money or QR payment; listed as smoking allowed; opened 23 June 2022; site ramen-ichiza.edion.com. 2026 reviews (June–October): spicy ramen ¥1,150 (with seasoned egg, nira); shoyu ramen ¥980 plus fried rice set ¥400 (light with deep shoyu, thin wavy noodles); shoyu-based tonkotsu; for a hangover; the favourite at Ichiza; Edion's ramen street; one found it rich and greasy; a sweet shoyu aroma; Yoshimoto comedians' autographs; ramen on the 9th floor after the 7th-floor toy department; children's chairs; minced-meat ramen with small rice; curry ramen (big pieces of meat, lots of fat).

食べログ: 中華そば トライ、大阪市天王寺区大道1-7-11、天王寺から522m.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Try, 1-7-11 Daido, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 522 m from Tennoji; Mon–Sat 19:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 1 May 2016. Reviews (March–October 2026): 19:00 until 3 a.m.; Takaida-style chuka soba; after drinking; self-serve drinks; chuka soba ¥700; seasoned egg ¥150; canned beer ¥400; the owner runs it single-handed; chashu-men (regular) ¥900; strong shoyu; medium-thick to thick noodles; leek cut in big pieces; a cheerful owner; on Tanimachi-suji, 6–7 min walk from Tennoji Station; a local ramen of Osaka and Higashi-Osaka; strong shoyu and thick noodles; thick straight noodles; one found the soup lukewarm and the chashu tough and smelly; one says not as strong as it looks; rice balls on the counter; plenty of chashu.

食べログ: 中華そば ニューまるちゃん、大阪市中央区道修町4-7-7 新横堀ビル.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba New Maruchan, Shin-Yokobori Bldg 2F, 4-7-7 Doshomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Higobashi Station, 5 from Yodoyabashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30); closed weekends and holidays; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (March–October 2026): back-fat ramen; all-you-can-eat mentaiko and eggs; a Japanese-style shoyu; a bar at night, ramen at lunch; no photos on the ticket machine; back-fat maze-soba (raw egg) ¥950; +¥250 for unlimited rice and mentaiko; raw egg, furikake, nori; garlic none, a little or regular; slightly thick, slightly wavy noodles; self-service; a faintly sweet soup; mentaiko rice; very satisfying for ¥1,000; next to Inakura; a retro pop sign; an urban interior; counter at the back; 2 tables; a big TV; ramen sauce, apple vinegar, ramen pepper, pickled garlic and shichimi on the table; chuka soba; spicy chuka soba; rich pork-fat ramen; pork-fat maze-soba; Jiro style; Stanira soba (nira, chili, raw egg, ginger, garlic); softish Chinese noodles; plenty of chashu; bean sprouts; nori; a generous owner; soft noodles; the all-you-can-eat alone can be ordered; chuka soba ¥750; unlimited mentaiko TKG ¥250; like Kyushu's sweet shoyu; straight noodles.

食べログ: 中華そば 二誠、大阪市西区立売堀3-8-5、阿波座駅2番出口から15.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Nisei, 3-8-5 Itachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 150 m from Awaza Station exit 2; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a miso specialist run by the shop behind Ramen Kasumi; miso chuka soba (¥900 in 2025); seasoned-egg miso ¥1,050; special Nisei spicy miso ¥1,250 (Nagano white miso and Mie red miso with Sichuan pepper, chenpi and Shaoxing wine for a numbing heat); rich seafood miso; spicy shoyu maze-soba; monthly limited editions (rich black miso, meat abura soba, shrimp bukkake kamatama, ¥1,000 each); flat medium-thick wavy noodles; small rice ¥100 with soup poured over; first bottled beer ¥100 with edamame; one says the miso is thinner and the service curter than at opening; some hours run single-handed.

食べログ: 中華そば 福笑門、大阪市天王寺区上本町5-7-18 西川ビル1F、大.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Fukuemon, Nishikawa Bldg 1F, 5-7-18 Uehommachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Osaka-Uehommachi Station exit 11, 2 min from Tanimachi-Kyuchome Station exit 8; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR accepted; 15 seats (counter 10, one table); semi-private room; no smoking; power outlets; opened 11 June 2016. Reviews (February–October 2026): red neon; graffiti windows; condiments on the table; a menu like a neighbourhood Chinese diner; shoyu ramen and gyoza set ¥1,200; asked about leek and noodle firmness; a Kyoto-like chicken-bone and pork shoyu; medium-thin straight noodles; chashu, menma, leek; thin-skinned gyoza; many regulars; beer set; small karaage; zaru soba; yuzu chuhai; fatty chashu; half fried rice set; extra bean sprouts and leek; a gentle chicken and seafood soup; 3 slices chashu; low-hydration noodles; fried rice fragrant with shoyu; soupless tantanmen and pan-fried gyoza set; extra bean sprouts and leek free at lunch; Fukuemon large everything-on ¥1,200; courteous service; bottled Sapporo Lager; shoyu with extra back fat; a seasoned egg for LINE friends; grated garlic on the table; ultra-tasty back-fat ramen; thin noodles.

食べログ: 中華そば 辻、大阪市中央区釣鐘町1-1-1、天満橋駅④出口から徒歩1.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Tsuji, 1-1-1 Tsurigane-cho, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Tenmabashi Station exit 4; daily 11:00–14:15 and 17:30–21:15; closed the third Tuesday evening of each month; occasional closures; cards, e-money and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted; 11 seats (counter 7, two tables for 2); opened 11 April 2023. Reviews (May–October 2026): register at the touch panel outside, meal ticket inside; popular on social media, so queues; in after about 25 minutes; a spicy chuka soba where chili is the star; beef-offal chuka soba large; a punch rare in Kansai; comparisons with Mongolian Tanmen Nakamoto; the limited Bachiro (extra bean sprouts ¥1,100, a different brand of noodles, dark shoyu, lots of chashu); Bachiro with extra quail eggs; Bachiro with extra offal; TKG with Ryu no Tamago eggs; meat-taku rice bowl ¥550; bacchi-bachi beef-offal chuka soba; summer cold tantan maze-soba (the special has quail eggs and kimchi); special hot-and-sour jan-men ¥1,800; one called the chili and raw-garlic shoyu ramen ordinary; egg yolk; garlic on the table; one was reminded of Mokkosu, which serves thin straight noodles; one found the pork cooking and fat inconsistent.

食べログ: 中華そば 鯵右衛門、大阪市生野区鶴橋2-14-10、鶴橋駅から徒歩4.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Ajiemon, 2-14-10 Tsuruhashi, Ikuno-ku, Osaka; 4 min walk from Tsuruhashi Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sat 7:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30), Sun 11:00–15:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 counter seats; opened 15 March 2026. Reviews (July–October 2026): Tsuruhashi shopping street; horse mackerel from the Tsuruhashi market; fresh horse-mackerel shoyu ¥980 (a creamy, mellow aji dashi); aji niboshi salt ¥930; aji niboshi shoyu ¥900 (sharp shoyu, little oil); limited aji ramen ¥980 (rich and cloudy); Tsuruhashi 2-chome black tsukemen ¥1,250 (aji niboshi and aji-katsu, Shimane twice-brewed shoyu, Rausu kombu, Mongolian rock salt, yuzu-kosho; 200 g, free up to 300 g; now evenings only); house-made medium-thick noodles of Miyake Seifun flour from Ikuno; Kagoshima Sanmi pork chashu; menma; naruto; aji meshi ¥350–380 (wasabi); fried horse mackerel fried to order; TKG; seasoned egg +¥180; chashu +¥300; large +¥150; now opens at 7 a.m.; the menu changes often, check social media; cash only.

食べログ: 中華そばふじい なんば店、大阪市中央区難波1-3-14、06-628.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Fujii Namba, 1-3-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6282-7301; 22 seats; Mon, Wed, Thu, Sun and holidays 11:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00), Fri, Sat and days before holidays 11:00–3:00 next morning (L.O. 2:30); closed Tuesdays; no reservations (same-day queue system at the shop, called by phone or email); may close early when busy; cards and QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 11 April 2013. Official (ra-men.co): 'the nostalgic taste of Showa'; Shimbashi and Shin-Nakano (Tokyo), Ashiharabashi, Namba (closed Tuesdays) and Noda-Hanshin (Osaka). 2025–2026 reviews: a text message an hour after joining the queue; ticket machine; nira soba from 1 July 2026; slotted soup spoons; free egg; firm noodles; garlic powder; the fried rice is the best; cooking visible from the counter; extra leek; vinegar; a 90-minute wait on a holiday; ramen, karaage and fried rice set ¥1,100; a sharp shoyu like Onomichi ramen; 45 groups waiting at 11:30 on a Saturday, about 50 minutes via LINE; little back fat, light; an 80-minute wait; some call it ordinary; one felt ignored by staff; a one-group wait on a rainy evening.

食べログ: 中華バル JAM、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-2 アマキビル 中1.en: Tabelog: Chuka Bar JAM, Amaki Bldg mezzanine 1F, 1-18-2 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nagahoribashi stations; Mon–Sat 18:00–1:00 next morning, Sun and holidays 18:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:00); last entry 24:00 (22:00 on holidays); irregular closing days (check Instagram); may close early if no diners; charge ¥300 and one-drink minimum; no entry under 20; heated tobacco only; 9 seats (counter 5, one table); cards and QR accepted, no e-money. Reviews (April 2025 – July 2026): a Chinese bar in a converted snack bar; mapo tofu ¥1,200; beef-tendon mapo tofu; seafood yakisoba with thick sauce; chashu and lettuce fried rice; shrimp in chili sauce; shrimp mayo; mouth-watering chicken ¥980; grilled shumai of Jinan mochi pork 2 for ¥500; black-vinegar sweet-and-sour pork of Hiraboku Kinka pork ¥1,680; bamboo shoots and firefly squid in Shaoxing wine; Shaoxing-wine 'Dragon' highball; baijiu jasmine highball; the owner studies hard, sourcing and visiting famous restaurants; a warm personality.

食べログ: 中華レストラン味一、大阪市天王寺区下味原町1-20、地下鉄・JR鶴橋.en: Tabelog: Chinese Restaurant Ajiichi, 1-20 Shimoajiharacho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from subway and JR Tsuruhashi stations; Mon, Tue, Thu, Fri and Sun 11:00–21:00; closed Wednesdays and Saturdays; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 32 seats; private hire; smoking allowed. Reviews (April–August 2026): a neighbourhood Chinese diner founded 1985; special sauce yakisoba ¥1,000 with roots in Imazato yakisoba (thick noodles, pork, cabbage, onion, green pepper, large and small shrimp, squid, fried egg, shredded nori); the popular B lunch ¥1,080 (sweet-and-sour pork, karaage, crab omelette, rice, soup); A lunch (sweet-and-sour pork, mapo tofu, shrimp tempura, chashu); crab fried rice ¥800; gyoza ¥370; gomoku noodles; green pepper and pork stir-fry; red counter on the ground floor, tables upstairs; order verbally; one disliked the tempura-like karaage batter; one found portions smallish; gyoza sauce, chili oil, sauce and pepper on the table.

食べログ: 中華料理 とんとん、大阪市西区江戸堀1-21-5 江戸堀コーポ 1F.en: Tabelog: Chinese Ryori Tonton, Edobori Kopo 1F, 1-21-5 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Higobashi Stn on the Yotsubashi Line (338 m); Mon–Fri 11:30–15:00 and 17:30–21:00, Sat 11:30–14:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; private hire possible; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats; smoking allowed; genres Chinese and ramen. Reviews (April 2025–September 2026): the owner cooks alone; Kendo Kobayashi featured it on TV as a local Chinese restaurant; one diner came the day after a TV feature; 3 counter seats and tables for 4 ×3 and for 2 ×1; an ashtray on each table; the service set of curry champon with a small fried rice ¥950; the soup is chicken broth and soy sauce with a blended spicy curry powder; bean sprouts, garlic chives, cabbage, carrot, onion and pork; thin straight noodles; the fried rice is moist and light; Yumen with a small fried rice ¥950; Tianjin noodles and fried rice set ¥1,050; champon; Tanmen; ramen and fried rice set; a daily set; sweet and sour pork set meal; gyoza in the evening only, house-made, full of vegetables with a peppery filling; Tianjin rice; eight-treasure stir-fry; simmered chicken; bottled beer; busy at lunch, quiet just before closing.

食べログ: 中華旬彩 森本、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-4-14 燕京ビルB1F、0.en: Tabelog: Chuka Shunsai Morimoto, Enkyo Bldg B1F, 1-4-14 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5589-2665 (reservations), 06-6252-6022; no reservations at lunch; bookings cancelled if 15 minutes late without notice; daily 11:30–15:00 (last entry 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:00, drinks L.O. 21:30); cards and QR payment accepted, no e-money; 48 seats (small groups may share a table for 6); no smoking; opened 24 June 2015; Hyakumeiten (Chinese WEST 2021, 2023, 2024); site media-up.jp/morimoto. 2026 reviews (February–October): mouth-watering chicken is the most popular (heaped coriander, spicy sauce with lots of sesame); coriander can be swapped for leek; queues at lunch; no queue after 14:00; fluffy egg soup; almond tofu; rice refills available; clay-pot mapo tofu (set meal too); spicy chicken; water spinach; xiaolongbao; draught beer ¥950; bean-sprout fried noodles (yellow nira); rich tantanmen; ¥2,000 each for two sharing one beer.

食べログ: 中華蕎麦 神山 HONMACHI、大阪市中央区南本町3-2-21、本.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Shinzan HONMACHI, 3-2-21 Minamihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Hommachi Station, 5 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00; closed weekends; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 counter seats; no smoking; opened 8 June 2026. Reviews (June–October 2026): kombu-water tsukemen; 2 kinds of wontons; special kombu-water tsukemen; hand-rubbed abura soba; half rice; grilled flying-fish seafood shoyu; house-made high-hydration hand-rubbed flat noodles; shrimp and meat wontons; rare chashu; soft-boiled egg; smooth whole-wheat noodles with sea salt; flat wavy noodles; strong seafood shoyu; shoulder-loin chashu; opened in June; a facade like a Japanese restaurant; ticket machine outside; counter only; kombu-water tsukemen ¥920; moshio seaweed salt; paper aprons; seared chashu rice bowl; a rich yet gentle soup; clear salt; hand-rubbed wavy noodles; big rare chashu; shoyu-based dipping soup.

食べログ: 中華蕎麦 葛、大阪市西区阿波座1-12-21 喜多ビル 1F、本町駅.en: Tabelog: Chuka Soba Kuzu, Kita Bldg 1F, 1-12-21 Awaza, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Hommachi Station exit 23; 11:00 (around 10:45)–16:00; closed Fridays; New Year closure announced; cards and QR accepted, no e-money; 9 seats; opened 25 August 2015; Tabelog Ramen OSAKA Hyakumeiten 2023, 2024 and 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): dashi soba ¥690 (¥550 at opening); a slightly thick shoyu soup of chicken and bonito flakes; tare of dark and twice-brewed shoyu from Hozan in Aichi; a frothy, creamy mouthfeel; house-made medium-thick straight noodles; moist chashu; pepper and yuzu-kosho on the table; about 7 waiting at weekday lunch, 15 minutes; cold noodles and roast-pork rice bowl set under ¥1,000; espuma style; special topping +¥150 for extra chashu and seasoned egg; served in about 5 minutes; first in line at 10:30 on a holiday; 3 waiting chairs outside; about 5 waiting even after 14:00 on a Saturday; plenty of noodles; creamy but not heavy; about 8 waiting at 12:30; rice dishes sold out; bonito flakes at the bottom; smoky seasoned egg and chashu.

食べログ: 中華食堂ノロマツ、大阪市天王寺区上本町6-3-31 ハイハイタウン.en: Tabelog: Chuka Shokudo Noromatsu, Haihai Town B1F, 6-3-31 Uehommachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Osaka-Uehommachi Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closing days vary; reservations accepted; cards, transit IC, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; 18 seats (10 counter seats, two tables for four); non-smoking; children welcome; take-out; delivery; English-speaking staff; photo menu; opened 15 July 2026. Shop text: the taste of Toyonaka's Noromatsu Hanten in Haihai Town; the signature yakimeshi is "fast" and "delicious"; yakisoba with a soy-based Chinese-style sauce and noodles made for yakisoba; chuka soba with a soy-based broth and thin straight noodles, recommended as a set with yakimeshi. Goguynet Tennoji-Abeno (16 June 2026): the second shop of the popular Toyonaka machi-chuka Noromatsu Hanten, which supervises it. (20 July 2026): yakimeshi and yakisoba are the specialties; also tenshinhan, sweet and sour pork, gyoza. Kansai Kaiten (15 July 2026): supervised by Noromatsu Hanten; the two specialties are yakimeshi and yakisoba; chuka soba, miso ramen, stamina ramen, tenshinhan, mapo rice bowl, gyoza. Blog (15 July 2026, pre-opening reception): a franchise shop supervised by Noromatsu Hanten at Hankyu Okamachi Station; from 15 to 17 July a yakisoba and fried-rice set at ¥500; the yakimeshi is the loose, separate-grain kind with a garlic flavour; the chuka soba is a clear soy broth from chicken bones and pork, with medium-thin straight noodles. Reviews (July–October 2026): order by QR code; yakisoba and mini yakimeshi set ¥1,188; chuka soba and garlic yakimeshi ¥1,298; large and extra-large sizes; free refills of egg soup; the yakisoba is thin noodles, add vinegar halfway; the chuka soba is gentle, slightly sweet and old-fashioned; the omurice started as a staff meal; gyoza ¥308; nira-tama ¥638; a medium bottle of Aka boshi ¥638; full at Saturday lunch with a short wait; a line outside in the evening.

食べログ: 中華麺食堂 亀吉、大阪市中央区内本町2-3-8 ダイアパレスビル 1.en: Tabelog: Chuka Men Shokudo Kameyoshi, Dia Palace Bldg 1F, 2-3-8 Uchihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Tanimachi-Yonchome Station, 8 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Tue–Sat 11:30–15:00; closed Sundays, Mondays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 counter seats; no smoking; opened 21 October 2011. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): summer menu; kote-shiro (shoyu) ramen; half-and-half ramen and fried rice; many kinds of ramen and fried rice; black-egg fried rice; always a queue; occasional closures; large fried rice half set ¥1,400; salt scallop; the fried rice comes first; one was told to return the dishes; the tantanmen has a faint aroma of Sichuan pepper; plenty of minced meat; comes with white rice; spicy miso ramen and half fried rice; omu fried rice ¥1,100; on the lardy side; seafood gomoku fried rice ¥1,300, nearly 500 g; white smoke from the wok inside; more dishes after 13:00; a 20-minute wait for the black-egg fried rice; dark shoyu and big chashu.

食べログ: 串カツさくら 南海難波店、大阪市中央区難波3-1-18、06-663.en: Tabelog: Kushikatsu Sakura Nankai Namba, 3-1-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6630-8039; reservations accepted (not on Friday nights, weekends, holidays or busy periods: first come, first served); Mon–Fri 11:30–22:30, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–22:30; open every day of the year (L.O. 30 minutes before closing); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 50 seats (counter 9, tables 29, sunken kotatsu 12); no smoking; opened 11 April 2012. Shop's description: kushikatsu with rice flour in the batter to absorb less oil; 100% vegetable oil changed daily; an ultra-thin coating; the original rice-flour skewers. 2026 reviews (September–October): big skewers; always a queue; narrow seats by the 2nd-floor aisle; beer and kushikatsu slow; 2nd floor at 11:00 right after opening; the top-5 popular skewers; simmered beef tendon and cabbage; quail eggs go well with light shoyu; chicken; fresh shrimp; the beef (medium-rare) is sinewy; the pork dry; the rice-flour batter light and crisp; choose special sauce, roasted salt or white shoyu; doteyaki; kisu; onion; shishito; red pickled ginger; asparagus; fried on the ground floor, so no oil smell upstairs; no heaviness the next day; tulip (chicken wing); one found some a little over-fried.

食べログ: 串焼BISTRO 福みみ 銀座5、銀座5-10-9 銀座YKビルB1.en: Tabelog: Kushiyaki BISTRO Fukumimi Ginza 5, Ginza 5-10-9 Ginza YK Building B1F; daily 16:30–23:15; 56 seats (semi-private sunken kotatsu); cashless only; seat charge ¥660; 10% late-night charge after 22:00; 2-hour limit; shoes off; qualified invoice T1040001010233. FindMeGlutenFree: 32 reviews, 13 safety ratings, GF menu (skewers, salads), "staff responded in English and found dishes safe even for celiac".

食べログ: 九州らーめん亀王 難波NGK前店、大阪市中央区難波千日前10-13、.en: Tabelog: Kyushu Ramen Kiou Namba NGK-mae, 10-13 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4397-6545; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed New Year's Day; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; 28 seats (two tables for 4, one for 8); opened 2 April 2010; official kiou.co.jp. 2026 reviews (January–September): burnt back-fat tonkotsu shoyu (extra-large; extra meat, noodles and vegetables); garlic; chewy thick noodles; an introduction to Jiro style; tomato ramen (3 heat levels; level 2 milder than Shin Ramyun); tomato tsukemen; tomato ramen ¥890; asked your noodle firmness; medium-thin noodles; inbound tourists and nearby office workers; Kiou ramen with half fried rice and a noodle refill (firm is like kona-otoshi); cold abura soba ¥890 and half fried rice ¥490 ordered on a tablet; a sweetish, strong shoyu tare; the Kiou ramen is a rich tonkotsu mellowed for Kansai; creamy with no off-smell; extra-thin straight noodles.

食べログ: 九条まんてん、大阪市西区九条1-11-17、中央線九条駅から徒歩3分.en: Tabelog: Kujo Manten, 1-11-17 Kujo, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Chuo Line Kujo Station; Tue, Wed and Fri 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00, Thu 11:00–15:00, Sat–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–21:00; closed Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats (counter 5, tables); opened 24 June 2023. Reviews (July–September 2026): weekend-only cold hamo and sudachi ¥1,200 (announced by SMS); pay first; hamo dashi; sudachi first on the spoon; ice in the soup; chatting with the owner; cold salt ramen ¥1,200 (medium-thick straight noodles, rare chashu, chicken chashu, chopped onion, half a seasoned egg, tomato ice, menma, leek, yuzu); tomato strength adjusted after feedback; usually run single-handed, so slow when busy; clear-broth soup and carefully chosen noodles; shoyu ramen with egg on rice (branded egg 'Musou Maru'); jidori umami and delicate seafood dashi; pink rare chashu; firm straight noodles; cash only; the cold salt is limited and sells out; salt ramen and rice bowl; a little hard to find; Tajima chicken; Tamba black chicken; real kombu; Kyoto Teigaku vacuum mixer.

食べログ: 二代目憲 hirayama、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-4-6 さよかビ.en: Tabelog: Nidaime Norihirayama, Sayoka Building 2F, 2-4-6 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min on foot from Exit 7 of Nagahoribashi Station, 8 min from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); closed Sundays and on a Monday after a public holiday; closes when sold out; reservations accepted (courses for 2 or more, by the day before); cards accepted; no e-money or QR; appetizer ¥300; 18 seats; smoking allowed. Shop's introduction: authentic Tosa cooking by an owner from Kochi; whole fresh bonito bought by the owner and straw-grilled in front of you; closed on days without good bonito; thick or thin cut, with salt, wasabi or sauce; Kochi ingredients such as Utsubo, Tougoro and Chambara-gai; seasonally sunfish, bear and sea turtle; Kochi sake and shochu (Dabada Hiburi, Suigei); 4 counter seats and 3 tables; private hire up to 20. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): the thick-cut salt tataki is the best; people from Kochi call it the best in Osaka; white shrimp tempura, red beef tataki, grilled eel (shirayaki), straw-grilled mentaiko, Tosa maki, firefly squid, fried oysters, deep-fried eel, steak, tea soba mixed with egg yolk, honey sweet potato ice cream; large portions; smoking allowed; one diner would have liked the ponzu on the side.

食べログ: 五右衛門 ウイング新橋店、港区新橋2丁目 東口地下街1号、JR新橋駅.en: Tabelog: Goemon Wing Shimbashi, Shinbashi 2-chome, Minato-ku, East Exit Underground Mall No. 1, right by JR Shinbashi Station Karasumori exit; 20 seats; weekdays 11:00–22:00, weekends 11:00–21:00; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; official site www.yomenya-goemon.com. 2026 reviews: mentaiko and takana, karasumi peperoncino, pork-shabu pasta, eggplant and mozzarella carbonara meat sauce with a soft-boiled egg, autumn-only mushroom peperoncino, the regular portion is smallish, busy until closing, a short queue at lunch but turnover is quick, ¥1,000–2,000.

食べログ: 五右衛門 日比谷店、千代田区有楽町1-6-1 第2日比谷ビル2F、日.en: Tabelog: Goemon Hibiya, Yurakucho 1-6-1, Chiyoda-ku, 第2日比谷 Building 2F, 2 minutes from Hibiya Station; 30 seats; weekdays 11:30–21:30, weekends and holidays 11:30–22:00; cards, IC and PayPay accepted; opened September 21, 2012; official site yomenya-goemon.com. 2026 reviews: Hakata-style pasta with mentaiko, spicy takana, shirasu and raw egg ¥1,130; tarako pasta (with soup); vegetable peperoncino; order by the QR code on the table; pasta eaten with chopsticks; lunch sets with a drink or dessert; about 20 minutes until served; a queue just after 13:00 on weekdays.

食べログ: 人形町今半 銀座店、銀座6-8-7 交詢ビル5F、銀座駅A2出口から.en: Tabelog: Ningyocho Imahan Ginza, Ginza 6-8-7, Kojun Building 5F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exit A2; 38 seats; private rooms for 2 and 4 (room charge), tatami room; daily 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00 (food L.O. 20:30); 12% service charge (all day); children's menu; official site imahan.com; Sukiyaki & Shabu-shabu Top 100 2024. 2026 reviews: a course in a private room starting with starters and sashimi; melting sukiyaki; premium sukiyaki set (120 g beef and rice); the sauce is a little salty; experienced servers; take off your shoes (slippers if barefoot); many overseas visitors too; after booking, checked carefully by email how severe a fish allergy was; a children's bento; a gift from the shop for a child with a birthday coming up.

食べログ: 人情麺家 牛骨王、大阪市中央区南船場1-12-27 幸福相互ビル 1.en: Tabelog: Ninjo Menya Gyukotsu Ou, Kofuku Sogo Bldg 1F, 1-12-27 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 278 m from Nagahoribashi; daily 11:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); PayPay accepted, no cards or e-money; 9 seats; no smoking (ashtray outside); opened 6 June 2016. Reviews (May–October 2026): the recommended salt beef-bone ramen; a flavour like no other; chewy noodles like Hong Kong wonton noodles; fragrant fried garlic; the owner runs the counter shop single-handed; richer than tonkotsu; tender beef tendon instead of chashu; thin noodles; red pickled ginger and sesame; an overseas diner asked for a handshake; warm service and a send-off; a gentle flavour; paitan ramen; free noodle refills; limited cold noodles (seasoned egg, pork shabu, aosa, nori, leek, lemon); ticket machine; many overseas diners; a soup without off-smells or bitterness; stew-like meat for chashu; straight noodles; noodle refill or rice free at lunch.

食べログ: 人類みなウチのラーメン、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-14-18、080-.en: Tabelog: Jinrui Mina Uchi no Ramen, 1-14-18 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 080-3441-6891; reservations accepted; daily 11:00–22:30; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 27 October 2025. 2026 reviews (June–August): other diners even around 11 p.m.; drank every drop of the regular shellfish-broth ramen; the recommended miso ramen tastes like Tadokoro Shoten; limited cold ramen ¥1,280 (Japanese dashi, cold thick wavy noodles, thin-sliced rare chashu, leek, shiso, radish sprouts, menma, seasoned egg); one was happy the miso returned after the renovation; one called the shellfish broth ordinary and the mentaiko rice out of a tube; cheap-looking decor; one won't return because of the silent service.

食べログ: 人類みな辛さが全て、大阪市阿倍野区阿倍野筋1-2-30 HOOP B.en: Tabelog: Jinrui Mina Karasa ga Subete, HOOP B1F food hall, 1-2-30 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Abeno Station; daily 11:00–23:00 (the shop's account gave 11:00–21:30 as of September 2026); cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 12 February 2023; official site. Reviews (August 2023 – October 2026): the spicy shop of the Jinrui Mina Menrui group; Jinrui Mina Karasa ga Subete 50 (jjigae-soup ramen, chili, chili oil, lots of minced meat, medium-thick noodles, thick chashu) ¥1,100; 30 (shoyu-based spicy soupless) ¥1,000; yukgaejang ramen (one likens it to Mongolian Tanmen Nakamoto); chashu ramen 50; heat none, 1–4, Over and END (+¥200); staff say END is recommended only to those who've eaten Over; one says 2 is already very hot and 1 enough; chashu and soft-boiled-egg toppings; pork rice bowl ¥350; collect with a buzzer in the food hall.

食べログ: 伊勢田 (ISEDA)、大阪市西区新町1-9-14 丸勝ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: ISEDA (伊勢田), 丸勝ビル 1F, 1-9-14 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Nishi-Ohashi and Yotsubashi Stns; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 17:30–24:00 (L.O. 23:00), Wed 17:30–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); irregular closures; reservations accepted; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay; no e-money; 18 seats; smoking at all seats; up to 2 children; no strollers; opened April 2021 (remarks), moved from 2-3-3 Kitahorie. Menu (updated April 2026, tax included): kushikatsu (pork ¥170, beef ¥220, shrimp ¥300, scallop ¥280, Camembert ¥230, vegetables ¥130, red pickled ginger ¥150); horumon skewers ¥200–250; grilled liver ¥700; beef tataki yukhoe ¥890; dote-yaki ¥590; konjac steak ¥580; Chiri-tori teppan hot pot ¥2,980; finisher ¥480; cold kimchi noodles ¥890; kushikatsu set ¥1,800; grilled horumon set ¥1,900; special course ¥7,000. Reviews (April 2025 – September 2026): light, crisp batter; shared sauce with no double-dipping (2025); by April 2026 the sauce is poured over the plate; 10-piece kushikatsu assortment ¥1,690; cash only under ¥5,000; ¥330 table charge; sweet-spicy hot pot of horumon and vegetables, spice adjustable; ramen to finish; risotto with extra cheese; grilled liver with sesame oil and salt; busy on event days because it is near the Orix Theater; a pleasant owner; many regulars, yet a warm welcome; weak ventilation.

食べログ: 伊太そば、港区東新橋1-8-2 カレッタ汐留B2F(汐留横丁)、汐留.en: Tabelog: Ita Soba, Higashi-Shinbashi 1-8-2, Minato-ku, Caretta Shiodome B2F (Shiodome Yokocho), 1 minute from Shiodome Station; weekdays 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–17:00; 250 seats (food court); reservations accepted; opened February 20, 2026; favy.jp. 2026 reviews: an Italian restaurant in Narashino, Chiba, turned into a ramen shop in a TV revival project by Sakagami (of Gindaco); moved to Caretta Shiodome in February 2026; tonkotsu carbonara ramen (creamy tonkotsu with egg yolk, cheese and black pepper, prosciutto, thin, slightly firm noodles; add rice for a risotto finish); lunch set ¥1,350; the special has three slices of chashu and triple cheese; tonkotsu Genovese (basil-scented tonkotsu); the tonkotsu ramen is refined; hiyashi chuka; cold noodles with Shine Muscat or Nagano Purple on ultra-thin Asakusa Kaikaro noodles; porcini mazesoba about ¥1,300; at night "Ita Bar" with pizza and sake; sit anywhere; mobile ordering; no cash.

食べログ: 伝承油そば こぶたのはな、大阪市中央区高麗橋2-3-2、北浜から26.en: Tabelog: Densho Abura Soba Kobuta no Hana, 2-3-2 Koraibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 269 m from Kitahama; Mon–Sat 10:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, holidays 10:30–15:00 and 18:00–22:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (counter 6, two tables for 4); opened 9 May 2018. Reviews (October 2024 – October 2026): densho abura soba ¥890; large ¥150; garlic partway through; one found the large a little small; chicken leek salt soba; rice; pepper, fried garlic, sesame; shrimp-salt abura soba; chili oil and vinegar; rare chashu; large portions; Nippo Koraibashi Bldg 1F; ticket machine cash only; rice sold out; chicken-leek abura soba non-spicy ¥960; densho abura soba slightly spicy ¥890; soft-boiled egg ¥200; quick-drink set ¥1,300 (seasoned menma, minced-meat cutlet); draught beer ¥550; vinegar, sesame and garlic chips on the table; a note on the wall says mix well from the bottom; thin-sliced chashu; lots of shredded white leek; busy at lunch, wait outside; shared tables; leek soba; small but clean and bright; a moderately rich sauce on smooth wavy noodles; spicy leek.

食べログ: 佛蘭西料理 銀座 誠(フランスリョウリ ギンザ マコト)、銀座7-6.en: Tabelog: French Ryori Ginza Makoto, Ginza 7-6-4, Ginza HIT Building B1F; Mon–Fri 18:00–23:00, Sat 18:00–21:30, closed Sun; official site ginzamakoto.jimdo.com. Reviews: opened September 2015, one street behind Namiki-dori; a calm wood-grain room of about 20 seats (a counter at the back, a private room); French you can order à la carte; pigeon and quail pâté; flounder carpaccio with paprika sauce; duck steak (July 2026); veal and lentils in blue-cheese sauce; game; wine pairing; the chef, Makoto (the spelling in an English review), formerly of Apicius (2023).

食べログ: 作ノ作 千日前本店、大阪市中央区難波1-1-1、11席(カウンターの.en: Tabelog: Sakunosaku Sennichimae main shop, 1-1-1 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 11 seats (counter only); Mon–Thu 5:00–2:30 next morning, Fri 5:00–24:00, Sat–Sun 24 hours; no cards; smoking allowed; official osaka-ramen.com. Shop introduction: Osaka's pride, the original Naniwa tonkotsu; besides tonkotsu, shoyu, salt, miso and tsukemen; chashu-men with chashu spilling over the bowl. 2026 reviews: ticket machine in front; L-shaped counter; Naniwa tonkotsu ¥1,080 (¥1,250 with spicy miso); one free noodle refill; 2 slices chashu, 2 of naruto, menma, leek; light Osaka tonkotsu; thin straight noodles; spicy miso hot enough to feel on the scalp; chashu-men ¥2,200; gyoza ¥100 with ramen; one says the gyoza is better; faintly sweet tonkotsu; red pickled ginger, ground sesame and garlic on the table; cold yuzu-lemon ramen ¥1,380 (gingery salt); shrimp-miso abura soba; snack set; tantan tsukemen; one found prices high; a bowl after drinking.

食べログ: 俺たちのカレー家、大阪市中央区難波千日前14-13、南海なんば駅から.en: Tabelog: Oretachi no Curry Ya, 14-13 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–16:30 and 17:30–22:30, Sat 11:00–22:00, Sun 11:00–21:45; open every day of the year; no reservations; no cards; e-money and QR accepted; 10 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 4 April 2016. Reviews (March–September 2026): cheese curry with falling-apart meat; a roux that isn't too sweet; seats a little cramped; katsu curry ¥930; like a nostalgic European-style curry; gentle heat after the sweetness; freshly fried katsu; pickles on the table; ticket machine, quick turnover; a counter shop on Nansan-dori; large katsu curry with sausage ¥1,400; a sweetish, thick roux; many overseas diners; chili sauce; large chicken curry with cheese; mild even at medium heat; English on the table sauces; fried-shrimp curry with soft-boiled egg; 10 seats at an L-shaped counter, 2 staff; the ticket machine linked to the kitchen; the fried shrimp not covered in roux; Osaka-style curry rice; toppings (tonkatsu, chicken katsu, soft-boiled egg, cheese, Kujo leek, spinach, sausage).

食べログ: 個室 炭火焼肉 有田牛 本店、銀座8-2-15 明興ビル2F、コリド.en: Tabelog: Sumibi Yakiniku Arita Gyu main shop, Ginza 8-2-15, 明興 Building 2F, on Corridor-gai midway between Shinbashi and Yurakucho stations, 3 minutes from Shinbashi Station; weekdays 17:00–23:00, Sat 17:00–22:00, closed Sundays and holidays; every seat in a fully private room; smoking at the table allowed; courses require booking; cancellation fee; when booking, note whether it's your first visit and any allergies or disliked foods; opened September 4, 2017; official site platinumfish.jp. Shop introduction: gold at the 2025 World Steak Challenge; black wagyu endorsed by Michelin chefs; the most popular scallion-wrapped tongue eaten with dashi; cold noodles; fresh offal; choose packed meat (à la carte only). 2026 reviews: scallion-wrapped tongue like inari; smoking allowed in private rooms; rare sake not on the menu can sometimes be ordered; charcoal not too fierce, so you can grill slowly; reasonable with all-you-can-drink; good for entertaining.

食べログ: 備長炭やきとり SASAYA 心斎橋本店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-1.en: Tabelog: Binchotan Yakitori SASAYA Shinsaibashi main shop, 1-13-9 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; daily 18:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. food 4:00, drinks 4:30); table-charge starter ¥418; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 17 seats (counter 7, tables 10); smoking allowed; official site. Reviews (April–September 2026): Kishu binchotan; morning-slaughtered chicken; served off the skewer on a plate; neck with leek; heart; bonjiri; chicken sashimi; liver and heart tataki with sesame on Kutani-style plates; seasonal duck in wasabi yukhoe style; edamame; sake; a counter good for conversation; only 2 tables, so book; one called it ordinary; open until 5 a.m., good for a first stop or the last.

食べログ: 元祖 ニンニクラーメン 寺田町、大阪市天王寺区大道4-10-4、寺田.en: Tabelog: Ganso Ninniku Ramen Teradacho, 4-10-4 Daido, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 109 m from Teradacho; Mon–Thu 18:00–2:00 next morning, Fri–Sat 18:00–3:00 next morning; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed. Reviews (April–October 2026): in front of Teradacho Station; a yellow awning with red lettering; red lanterns; a red noren; evenings only; nearly full even after 22:00; the garlic ramen (photo) with lots of chopped garlic in a light tonkotsu soup; smooth wavy medium-thick noodles; miso chashu ramen ¥1,100; chashu ramen ¥1,100; kimchi ramen ¥900; boiled egg; noodle refill ¥300; gyoza ¥300; small rice ¥150 (with kimchi); cucumber kimchi (oi kimchi); a 'no-noodle set meal' of chashu, bean sprouts, kimchi, rice and soup; one wanted more garlic; one says it now closes at 23:00 (April 2026); warm service.

食べログ: 八仙楼、大阪市西成区萩之茶屋1-4-1 太陽ビル 1F、南海・JR新.en: Tabelog: Hassen Ro, Taiyo Bldg 1F, 1-4-1 Haginochaya, Nishinari-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nankai and JR Shin-Imamiya stations; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 11:00–24:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards; 13 seats; opened 10 December 2015. Reviews (August–October 2026): late-night ramen; nearly full at 23:00; medium bottle of Asahi Super Dry; salt tonkotsu ramen; one says every ramen is good; in at 22:00; chuka soba; tender chashu; the recommended Tenryu ramen (rich tonkotsu shoyu, melting chashu); counter only and nearly full; the last stop after drinking; the tonkotsu ramen is rich; noodle refills available; three people before 23:00 on a Sunday; 3 plates of gyoza; used as an izakaya too; the standard ramen with plenty of back fat; tonkotsu umami and sweet fat; not as heavy as it looks; 2 thick slices of pork-belly chashu; lots of chopped leek; crowded with inbound visitors; ramen and fried rice set ¥1,150; large portions; the salt tonkotsu is light; the fried rice a little salty; one says it isn't aimed at tourists; the miso ramen is rich; gyoza.
