Reviews (August–October 2026): red-vinegar rice; 8 counter seats on the 8th floor; omakase of small dishes and nigiri; jade aubergine and Chinese yam; simmered octopus; seared Mie sawara; grilled eel without sauce, crisp skin; kamatoro, otoro, marinated lean tuna; steamed abalone with liver sauce; ikura chawanmushi; spear squid; baby squid; Hokkaido sea urchin with caviar; anago; miso soup of fish trimmings; toro-taku hand roll with iburigakko; an omelette like dessert; one finds the sushi chefs friendly; for anniversaries and dates; omakase ¥19,800; a single-plank hinoki counter; Namba's night view; firm rice with red vinegar aged 10 years; some toppings with white vinegar; wild bluefin tuna; extra liver sauce; red miso soup; Akashi sea bream; herring; barracuda; yellowtail; sweet shrimp.

食べログ: 小料理 たく庵、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-8-14 オーブナテ 5F、.en: Tabelog: Koryori Takuan, Obunate 5F, 1-8-14 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00; closed Sundays; cards AMEX only (earlier noted as cash only); no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 18 seats (counter 6, three tables for 4); particular about sake and shochu. Reviews (January–September 2026): hard to find on a 5th floor but often full; good opening small dish and dashi; sashimi platter (seared amberjack, kombu-cured sea bream, Akashi octopus, itoyori, anago, squid, shirasu); rare chicken tempura with house kombu salt; corn tempura; blanched anago; fried anago and autumn aubergine; shirasu and shiso spring rolls with sake-lees and mushroom sauce; straw-grilled chicken; green peppers stuffed with meat miso; pork-wrapped Manganji peppers; grilled eel liver; wagyu tataki; salt rice ball cooked in an iron pot; shirako or oyster ponzu in winter; sake all-you-can-drink course events too.

食べログ: 小松庵総本家 銀座、銀座5-7-6 i liv 14F、銀座駅A2出.en: Tabelog: Komatsu An Sohonke Ginza, Ginza 5-7-6, i liv 14F, right by Ginza Station exit A2; 40 seats (8 private room, 4 counter, 26 table); weekdays 11:00–16:00, 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; irregular holidays; private rooms carry a 15% service charge and a ¥10,120 room charge; opened August 1, 2019; official site ginza.komatuan.com. Shop introduction: sister shop of a long-established soba shop founded in Taisho 11 (1922); 100% buckwheat soba made by craftsmen from only buckwheat flour and natural water; choice of two sobas; Tokyo soba tasting course, 9 dishes ¥13,000; Tokyo soba lunch course, 6 dishes ¥8,000; course prices revised in August 2025. 2026 reviews: 100% buckwheat soba; comparing origins and seasonings; dashimaki tamago; coarse sobagaki; cream cheese pickled in soba miso; a quiet shop with no background music; some say there's little besides soba.

食べログ: 小洞天、大阪市中央区千日前1-6-10 千寿ビル1F、11席(カウン.en: Tabelog: Shodoten, Senju Bldg 1F, 1-6-10 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 11 seats (counter only); Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR payment; smoking allowed. Reviews (January 2025 – October 2026): a ramen and gyoza shop founded in 1971; a clear light salt ramen; gyoza hand-made by the owner; a 141st visit; 55 years in business; the last stop after drinking; before COVID a husband-and-wife team ran it, and now the owner is training young staff; the wontons sometimes sell out; chashu-men ¥1,200 (¥950 in January 2025); 8 gyoza ¥400; clear chicken-bone soup with a yellow tare and sesame; bean sprouts and leek; wonton chashu-men; wonton noodles ¥1,100; thin straight noodles; salt kaeshi; chicken bones; gyoza that have been in the media.

食べログ: 小澤牧場 牛○、港区新橋1-13-3 新橋ガード下横丁、新橋駅徒歩1.en: Tabelog: Ozawa Bokujo Ushimaru, Shinbashi 1-13-3, Minato-ku, Shinbashi Gado-shita Yokocho, 1 minute from Shinbashi Station; hours not listed; smoking allowed. Reviews (2024–2026): energetic staff; quick service; tasty food; wish there were more sweet-potato shochu; the map location may be off; a popular-tavern atmosphere; cramped seats; endless green peppers; the clutter of the narrow room up the stairs is part of the charm; meat, fish and vegetables, with hearty meat dishes standing out; noodles and rice bowls too; in May 2026, beef-bone ramen and yakisoba after midnight.

食べログ: 小皿kitchen cocoro、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-17.en: Tabelog: Kozara kitchen cocoro, Sanyo Bldg 1F, 1-17-17 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Tue–Sun 11:30–15:00 (lunch) and 17:00–23:00 (dinner); closed Mondays; smoking at all seats; 20 seats; cards, e-money and QR accepted (card receipts by email); listed as able to cater for vegetarians; takeaway and delivery; freshly made chicken-liver pâté ¥350; house oil sardines ¥350; raw oysters direct from producers in winter; shochu and whisky by the bottle. Reviews (September 2025 – April 2026): a red lantern; starter ¥400 at night; chicken-shoyu chuka soba (chicken chashu, thin menma); about 6 lunch choices; young-chicken kara-age set meal ¥800; mille-feuille beef cutlet with grated daikon and ponzu ¥1,200; moo shu pork ¥900; large rice free; iced coffee ¥100; raw oysters; cheap with lots of choice.

食べログ: 小諸そば 歌舞伎店、銀座4-11-7、東銀座駅から161m、平日7:.en: Tabelog: Komoro Soba Kabuki, Ginza 4-11-7, 161 m from Higashi-Ginza Station; weekdays 7:00–20:00, Sat 7:30–17:00, Sun 8:00–17:00; no reservations; looks like standing soba but has seats. 2026 reviews: pork soba; all the scallions you want; conger-eel tempura fried fresh; cold tanuki soba ¥500; ticket machine; tendon set with cold soba; standing and seated; quick even when busy; cheap for the location; firm cold soba with tenkasu.

食べログ: 小諸そば 銀座7丁目店、銀座7-10-13、平日7:30〜20:00.en: Tabelog: Komoro Soba Ginza 7-chome, Ginza 7-10-13; weekdays 7:30–20:00, weekends and holidays 10:00–17:00; no reservations; official site k-mitsuwa.co.jp. 2026 reviews: a standing-soba chain; shoulder-loin katsudon set ¥820 (choose zaru or kake); ticket machine; oyakodon ¥640 (yuzu shichimi, scallions on the table, umeboshi); about 3 minutes from order; busy at lunch with tradespeople and office workers; tendon set with three shrimp; firm soba; Sichuan-style cold chuka soba (lots of cucumber) ¥500; tickets with transit IC.

食べログ: 尾道中華そば 大福、大阪市中央区上汐1-6-5 汐庵 106、谷町六.en: Tabelog: Onomichi Chuka Soba Daifuku, Shioan 106, 1-6-5 Ueshio, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 467 m from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station; Mon, Tue and Fri–Sun 11:30–14:30 and 17:30–22:30, Wed 11:30–14:30; closed Thursdays; no cards, e-money or QR; counter; opened 12 November 2025. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): a gentle flavour; seasoned egg; egg on rice; very good service; hard to find; meal tickets; chashu-men large; lighter than it looks; chuka soba set (chuka soba, rice, egg) ¥1,000 with free rice refills; raw egg or seasoned egg; extra back fat with a service voucher; firm medium-thin straight noodles; chicken-bone shoyu; tang; back fat; thin-sliced pork chashu; menma; the shop's recommended aogappa rice (mayonnaise); menu: chashu-men set, chuka soba set, chashu-men, chuka soba, yakisoba; pepper, shichimi, spicy miso, mayonnaise, red pickled ginger and aogappa on the table; 13 counter seats; the owner and two staff; cheerful service; nearly full even after 13:00; flat noodles; piping-hot soup; chuhai and a snack platter at night; gyoza; a warning that the soup is hot; a sweet, sharp shoyu; garlic chili.

食べログ: 尾道文化ラーメン、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-3-12 トリル心斎橋、0.en: Tabelog: Onomichi Bunka Ramen, Trill Shinsaibashi, 1-3-12 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6241-3866; no reservations; daily 11:30–2:00 next morning; no cards, e-money or QR; 8 seats (counter only); smoking allowed; opened 15 July 2011. 2026 reviews (May–August): choose Onomichi ramen or tonkotsu; the tonkotsu is mild; good chashu; ticket machine; the feel of an old-style Chinese restaurant; shoyu ramen and gyoza; the owner asks your noodle firmness; smooth noodles; light shoyu with back fat; change the flavour with pepper; full of overseas tourists at lunch; tourists pay cash directly rather than at the machine; shoyu-tonkotsu blend; lots of leek; strongly seasoned menma; fragrant, moist fried rice; salt ramen; light and deeply nourishing; Friday Road Show on the TV; Onomichi ramen and a noodle refill; sweet chashu; umami of shoyu and niboshi; mildly spicy.

食べログ: 居酒屋 十兵衛、大阪市中央区南船場3-8-1、堺筋本町駅から徒歩5分.en: Tabelog: Izakaya Jubei, Minami-Senba 3-8-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn, 7 min from Shinsaibashi Stn; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30), Sat 11:00–14:30; closed Sundays and public holidays; reservations accepted; groups of 12 or more by arrangement; private hire up to 20; all-you-can-drink; cards accepted (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners); no e-money or QR; 20 seats; no smoking at lunch only; opened 21 January 2016; corporate-member listing. Shop site: a cheap, good izakaya in Hommachi, Shinsaibashi and Minami-Senba; yakitori (brand-name gaina chicken), kushikatsu and oden as the three mainstays; banquets; all-you-can-drink; the whole menu available to take away; bento sold at the shop front at lunch. Reviews (July 2025–October 2026): always a line at weekday lunch; grilled chicken thigh set ¥850; crisp skin, on cabbage; double and triple too; two of 12 sauces (stamina, salt, spicy, spicy curry, wasabi soy, sweet miso, green onion, ginger, shichimi with yuzu pepper); mixed set; tonkatsu set; chicken katsu; pork thigh; one free raw egg; free refills of rice and miso soup; tamago kake gohan; takeaway chicken-katsu bento ¥600 (with miso soup); the owner alone at night; a long L-shaped counter and two tables of 4 at the back; yakitori (heart, harami, negima, yagen cartilage, seseri); whole grilled chicken thigh; sliced onion; addictive cabbage; kimchi; fried eggplant; horumon with ponzu; plain salt yakisoba; local sake; one diner had to ask twice for the egg at a busy lunch.

食べログ: 屯舎 火鍋＆麻辣湯、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-8-3、長堀橋駅から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Tonsha Hot Pot & Malatang, 1-8-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; daily 11:30–22:00; cards, PayPay and WeChat Pay accepted, no e-money; 46 seats (ground floor counter 6 and two tables for 4; 2nd floor three tables for 4, two tables for 6, private room for 8); smoking allowed; opened 8 January 2019. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): reachable from Crysta Nagahori; never had to wait; garlic; knife-cut noodles and shrimp balls; greens, lettuce, potato, sausage; malatang heat 2 ¥1,270 (thick sweet-potato noodles, winter melon, king oyster mushroom, Chinese yam, white wood-ear); more numbing than hot; up to 2 kinds of noodles; leek and coriander free; mobile ordering; about ¥1,500 even ordering a lot; tomato malatang; even heat 1 is properly hot; over 40 ingredients and 5 heat levels; not priced by weight; glass noodles 80 g; spinach, pumpkin, quail eggs; sesame sauce; hot-pot courses at night; the 2nd floor takes large groups.

食べログ: 山ぎん、銀座8-7-16、新橋駅から302m、20席(カウンター10.en: Tabelog: Yamagin, Ginza 8-7-16, 302 m from Shinbashi Station; 20 seats (10 counter, tables); weekdays 11:30–13:30, 18:00–23:00, closed weekends and holidays; cards accepted. 2026 reviews: a ryōtei-style entrance, Showa atmosphere, vegetable curry ¥1,000 (reportedly cash only), beef-stew set, hamburg steak and steak, complimentary barley tea, traditional obanzai at night (simmered dishes, eggplant nibitashi), horse sashimi, chicken, grilled sablefish, smoking allowed.

食べログ: 山三亭、大阪市西区新町1-5-7 四ツ橋ビルディング B1F、四ツ橋.en: Tabelog: Yamasan Tei, Yotsubashi Building B1F, 1-5-7 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; left out of the Yotsubashi Station exit 2 gate and up the stairs; 124 m from Yotsubashi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00, Sat 11:00–15:00 (Saturday evenings by reservation for 2 or more only); closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats; separate smoking; opened 22 May 2023; Instagram. Shop introduction: authentic Sichuan; signatures mapo tofu and mouth-watering chicken; every lunch ¥1,000, add 2 karaage for ¥200; two dinner courses with 90-minute all-you-can-drink. Reviews (July–October 2026): mapo-tofu set meal (heavy on Sichuan pepper, hot and numbing; one couldn't finish it for the heat); fried-rice set meal (with 2 yu lin chicken); set meals at night too; two-dish set meal ¥1,500 (mapo tofu, yu lin chicken, pickles, free soup refills, one free rice refill); small soupless tantanmen ¥500; Hong Kong-sauce steamed chicken ¥300; spicy shrimp mayo (small) ¥500; century-egg tofu with sesame sauce; shrimp omelette; sweet-and-sour pork; shrimp in chili sauce; spring rolls; shumai; xiaolongbao; run single-handed, so ordering and serving take a little time.

食べログ: 山中製麺所 本町店、大阪市中央区久太郎町2-6-7、堺筋本町駅から2.en: Tabelog: Yamanaka Seimensho Hommachi, 2-6-7 Kyutaromachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 286 m from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 counter seats; no smoking; opened 3 October 2011. Reviews (July–September 2026): meal tickets at the entrance; tonkotsu ramen ¥890; soft-boiled egg ¥100; fried rice ¥400, a large portion; thin noodles and a rich soup; the red pickled ginger is back; much is sold out at night; the shoyu ramen is refreshed with yuzu; plenty of chopped onion; house-made slightly flat chewy noodles; choose firmness; pork rice bowl; unlimited ginger; bari-kata recommended; the shoyu a little sweet; prefers the tonkotsu shoyu; the spicy ramen, 10 a day, sells out before noon; spicy miso ramen ¥1,100, rich tonkotsu with spicy miso; noodle refill ¥100; mega fried rice; wood-ear topping; light gyoza; many office workers, quick turnover; dim lighting.

食べログ: 山形田、銀座3-8-15 アパ銀座中央ビルB1F、30席、平日11:.en: Tabelog: Yamagatada, Ginza 3-8-15, APA Ginza Chuo Building B1F; 30 seats; weekdays 11:00–14:30, 17:00–22:00, weekends 11:00–14:00; irregular holidays; cards: JCB, AMEX. October 2026 reviews: Zao cold jidori soba ¥1,000 (large +¥200), tempura ¥200, mountain-vegetable soba, kakiage, simmered dried herring ¥820, bottled beer ¥780, a woman owner from Yamagata, celebrity autographs, queues at lunch, thick, rustic Yamagata soba.

食べログ: 山桜、大阪市中央区難波千日前13-5、なんば駅から徒歩2分、月・火・.en: Tabelog: Yamazakura, 13-5 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Namba Station; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sat 18:00–22:00 (course L.O. 20:30, food 21:30); closed Wednesdays and Sundays (plus monthly closing days); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter 10, sunken kotatsu 6); private rooms for 2, 4 and 6; opened 1 July 2014. Reviews (September 2025 – September 2026): a basement in Ura-Namba; courses by reservation; ikura with yuba; seared sawara; Indian tuna (lean, chutoro, marinated); nodoguro; Hokkaido hairy crab; kohada; squid; sea urchin; Toyama white shrimp; barracuda; kinmedai; anago; omelette; red miso soup; fruit dessert; red or white vinegar rice to suit the topping; small rice balls; kabosu used often; over 30 sakes matched to taste; easy-to-talk-to staff and courteous service; about ¥15,000–30,000 each.

食べログ: 山系無双 烈火 パナンテ京阪天満橋店、大阪市中央区天満橋京町1-1.en: Tabelog: Yamakei Musou Rekka Panante Keihan Tenmabashi, Panante Keihan Tenmabashi, 1-1 Tenmabashi-kyomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; right by Keihan Tenmabashi Station; daily 11:00–23:00; cards, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted, no e-money; 21 counter seats; takeaway; opened 21 March 2017; official site. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): Yamagata ramen, rare in Kansai; Yamagata Hippa ramen ¥950 (thick chewy noodles, leek, shredded nori, egg yolk, chashu, canned mackerel, minced natto, spicy miso, chicken soup at the bottom, ume-kombu vinegar for the closing rice); the fiery maze-soba Rekka; Rekka ramen (heat 2) ¥950; Yamagata Torichuka (sweetish chicken soup, big pieces of chicken, tenkasu, mitsuba, nori, medium-thick wavy noodles, spicy miso on the side); Yonezawa ramen (light, thin flat wavy noodles); Yamagata spicy miso ramen ¥930 (bonito-flake dashi); summer cold soba; karaage; one says the EPARK time booking didn't work; a free topping with a JAF card; busy at lunch.

食べログ: 岡本商店 はなれ (旧店名 麺屋きょうすけ)、大阪市中央区谷町2-1.en: Tabelog: Okamoto Shoten Hanare (formerly Menya Kyosuke), Fair Stage Otemae Bldg B1F, 2-1-22 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Tenmabashi Station, 7 from Tanimachi-Yonchome Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–23:00, Sat and holidays 11:00–18:00, Sun 11:00–16:00; irregular closing days; ramen at lunch, all-you-can-eat-and-drink izakaya at night; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 15 counter seats; smoking allowed; opened 19 August 2013. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a branch of the shop near Kitahama; free mini rice bowl from 13:30; lots of chashu; one calls the ramen ordinary; basement on Tanimachi-suji; one found the spicy seafood ramen ¥950 (choose your heat) strong without tasting of seafood; tori-paitan shoyu tsukemen (medium-thick straight, chicken fat); set F ¥1,000 (chicken-stew ramen with mini rice bowl or a fried dish); grilled chashu mayo rice bowl; bean sprouts; follow on Instagram for a free ¥100 topping; chicken-stew ramen ¥950 with chashu and egg; lively, kind staff; set D is seafood shoyu ramen with chicken curry rice; karaage; a long menu.

食べログ: 岡本商店 北浜店、大阪市中央区平野町2-3-12、北浜から425m、.en: Tabelog: Okamoto Shoten Kitahama, 2-3-12 Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 425 m from Kitahama; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:30; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 7, tables 8); opened 6 April 2020. Reviews (October 2024 – October 2026): 4 waiting just after 11:00; a free mini rice bowl if you come before 11:30; ramen and chashu rice bowl; an inconspicuous basement spot; tsukemen large 300 g ¥1,000 (2024); extra leek free (2024); full at 11:15; chicken-stew ramen ¥900; sweetness of chicken fat; thin or medium-thick noodles; seared or rare chashu; seasoned egg; firm menma; not heavy afterwards; chicken shoyu; chicken seafood; tsukemen; shoyu ramen and karaage rice bowl; clean; kind staff; rich tori paitan; everything-on +¥300 for 2 kinds of chashu, seasoned egg, nori and leek; limited almond tofu; after 13:30 a free almond tofu or black coffee; the chicken-seafood ramen ¥900 isn't too heavy.

食べログ: 川名、大阪市中央区難波1-1-8、なんば駅から230m、月〜土18:.en: Tabelog: Kawana, 1-1-8 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 230 m from Namba Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–1:00 next morning; closed Sundays; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted; 16 seats; no smoking; counter. Reviews (September 2024 – June 2026): 2nd floor in a narrow alley near Hozenji's Mizukake Fudo; a warm interior rich in wood; scorch marks from the 2002 fire remain on the counter; rum neat; gin and tonic; a short list is part of the charm; an easy-to-talk-to master; dried fruit; quiet despite being near Hozenji Yokocho; a hideaway up the stairs on the left; records playing; roomy seats; seat charge about ¥1,000; a fruit cocktail of crushed grapefruit with vodka and cranberry; a non-smoking bar; stairs barely wide enough for one; an inconspicuous sign; a second door; counter and a table for 4 at the back; about half the guests tourists; a short cocktail with yogurt liqueur; nuts and dried fruit; a reasonable bill; mind the steep stairs; two Bowmores and a cocktail; dried orange; 6 drinks for two at ¥7,500; a classic bar; conversation with the master.

食べログ: 布目の里、大阪市西区新町1-34-20 ノーブルスクエア新町 1F、.en: Tabelog: Nunome no Sato, Noble Square Shinmachi 1F, 1-34-20 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; about 360 m from Nishi-Ohashi Station; no hours listed; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 18 seats (6 at the counter, three tables for 4); non-smoking; private hire possible; website nunomenosato.net (did not connect on 30 October 2026). Reviews (October 2022–October 2026): set meals of vegetables from Yamazoe Village (Nara) and fish shipped direct from Wakayama; ginger pork set, pork steak set (green-onion sauce), Juhosai set (oyster sauce) ¥1,200, simmered fish set ¥1,100, sautéed fish set, grilled fish set, ginger chicken breast, stir-fried vegetable set, vegetable curry, ajillo set, daily special, omakase; ¥100 more in the evening; rice mixed with hijiki, grains or seasonal vegetables, salad, two small side dishes; full by 12:10 on weekdays; the master does all the cooking alone; the staff are kind too; vegetables sold at the door and inside; punch cards; cash only.

食べログ: 帆洲、大阪市西区北堀江1-6-4 アビテ四ツ橋、四ツ橋駅4番出口から.en: Tabelog: Hanshu, Habite Yotsubashi, 1-6-4 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 50 m south of Yotsubashi Station exit 4; Mon–Wed and Fri 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–22:50, Thu and Sat 17:00–22:50; closed Sundays; holidays evenings only (irregular); last entry 21:00–21:30; L.O. 22:25; no Thursday lunch since 2025; book online or by phone; cards and QR (PayPay, Alipay and others) accepted; 20 seats; private rooms for 2–8. Reviews (June–September 2026): a big shrimp sign; courses of 10 or 15 skewers (can change partway); seasonal anago, shrimp, squid, tomato and cheese, sausage, shiso chicken breast, pork, beef, wings, a dashi takoyaki skewer, a dessert skewer; kisu; omakase creative kushiage; sauce, ponzu, rock salt, ketchup, mustard and lemon on the table; served at your eating pace; at lunch, A set with a big prawn and fillet katsu ¥1,200; loin katsu set meal ¥1,200 (rice, miso soup, cold tofu, pickles); limited service lunch ¥800; a quiet, modern shop.

食べログ: 希望新風 谷町七丁目店、大阪市中央区谷町7-3-4 新谷町第三ビル.en: Tabelog: Kibou Shinpuu Tanimachi 7-chome, Shin-Tanimachi No. 3 Bldg 1F, 7-3-4 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 354 m from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station; Tue–Wed 11:30–14:00, Thu–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–22:00, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:00 and 16:00–19:00; closed Mondays and Saturdays; closed over New Year, part of Golden Week and Obon, and irregular days; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 16 seats (counter 8, tables 8). Reviews (March–September 2026): at the Tanimachi 7-chome crossing; abura soba (black, red, white, pink); chuka soba; chicken sesame soba; thick chewy noodles with menma and chashu; weekday lunch, noodles plus one of karaage, fried rice or rice for ¥990 (cash); on Sundays and holidays black abura soba ¥680 (usually ¥850); large maze-soba with half mixed fried rice ¥1,030; kimchi and takana free; chili oil and vinegar on the table; one found the fried rice and karaage so-so; friendly service.

食べログ: 弐箱、大阪市中央区難波千日前6-12 旭光荘 1F、なんば駅・日本橋.en: Tabelog: Futahako, Kyokkoso 1F, 6-12 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; from Namba and Nippombashi stations; daily 18:00–2:00 next morning; irregular closing days; no cards; smoking allowed; 13 seats (counter); official site; the taste of Senshu; 'kashimin-yaki' of a thin batter with cabbage, kashiwa (chicken) and minced beef fat; the second shop of Hako. Reviews (September 2024 – November 2025): a Kishiwada speciality; lighter than okonomiyaki; original kashimin-yaki ¥650; leek ¥980; cheese curry; mochi cheese; cheese tomato; Western-style modan with noodles ¥1,200; uso-yaki of udon, soba and offal ¥1,300; crêpe-batter salad ¥600; squid skewer ¥480; salt-grilled chicken neck ¥600; cucumber ¥350; yakisoba ¥900; yaki udon; natto sobameshi ¥980; simmered beef tendon; ponzu highball; busy even after 21:00.

食べログ: 彩華 大阪上六店、大阪市天王寺区上本町5-3-18、大阪上本町駅・谷.en: Tabelog: Saika Osaka Ueroku, 5-3-18 Uehommachi, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Osaka-Uehommachi Station and Tanimachi-Kyuchome Station exit 11; daily 11:30–24:00; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; smoking area. Reviews (September–October 2026): Saika ramen from Tenri, Nara; Saika ramen ¥900 (small with egg ¥1,000); a shoyu base with house rajan and garlic; stir-fried pork belly, napa cabbage and nira; thin wavy noodles; extra vegetables +¥300 (not offered at directly run shops); extra leek; menma; half fried rice set ¥1,100; half rice set at lunch; mini fried rice ¥400; gyoza with miso sauce; small-shrimp tempura; tenshinhan; garlic on the table; one recommends the noodles firm; quick, friendly staff; one says the garlic smell lasts until the next day.

食べログ: 循誠、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-19-15 UNAGIDANI BLO.en: Tabelog: Junsei, UNAGIDANI BLOCK 1F and 2F, 1-19-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 2; Tue–Sun and holidays, reservations only, lunch from 12:00 and dinner from 18:00; closed Mondays (private hire possible); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; opened 2 August 2019; official site. Reviews (March–September 2026): formerly named Karato; an intercom at a hidden door; shoes off on the 2nd floor; a modern Japanese tatami space; 8–10 counter seats; special omakase course ¥22,000, decided by the day's ingredients; starters (caviar and karasumi, lotus-root chips, kensaki squid, shiso); aged-wagyu tartare with house bread; bone-in kara-age of Daisen chicken with honey and red-wine-vinegar gastrique; fish marinated in aged Shaoxing wine; 48-month Ibérico bellota ham carved in front of you; corn soup; house hand-stretched pasta; sea-urchin brioche; pheasant soup; mahata finished over charcoal; chateaubriand and tuna soup; European-style beef curry topped with a Kobe-pork cutlet; dessert from 5 (Mont Blanc; vegetable dessert of celeriac mousse and burdock caramel); pear, melon and peach juices; tell staff about dislikes in advance; careful explanations.

食べログ: 心斎橋東 焼とりporc、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-18-1 BEST.en: Tabelog: Shinsaibashi Higashi Yakitori porc, BEST PLAZA B1F, 1-18-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; at the crossing of Unagidani Minami-dori and Sankyubashi-suji; daily 17:00–23:00; irregular closing days; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 13 seats (counter 4, tables 11); opened 21 December 2017. Reviews (June–October 2026): a basement hideaway; a Namba shop too; big, juicy skewers; from 2 skewers; seasoning left to the shop; neck; liver; tsukune; big shiitake; shishito; sashimi platter with shoyu, ponzu and condiments; beef dishes; kara-age on a bamboo leaf; a chicken-and-egg rice bowl in dashi to finish; pickles brought as a palate cleanser without asking; sake in clear ochoko; ume-suisho; all-you-can-drink courses; order by smartphone; kind staff who explain carefully; book at busy times.

食べログ: 悦来閣、大阪市天王寺区悲田院町4-24、天王寺から182m、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Etsurai Kaku, 4-24 Hidenincho, Tennoji-ku, Osaka; 182 m from Tennoji; Mon–Sat 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–23:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 34 seats (counter 6, four tables for 6, one for 4); no smoking 11:00–14:00, separate smoking otherwise. Reviews (May–August 2026): a piping-hot miso ramen with plenty of vegetables and sesame-oil aroma; gentle gyoza light on garlic; spacious seats; reasonable prices; green pepper and pork stir-fry ¥1,280; yu lin chicken ¥1,000; vegetable congee large ¥900; draught beer ¥500; pork, glass noodles and vegetables in oyster sauce set meal ¥900 (egg soup, cold tofu, kimchi); 8 daily set meals at ¥900; shrimp and aubergine in thick sauce; one found the rice a little dry; Ura-Tennoji beyond the Hanwa shopping street; fried rice; hot-and-sour soup that's big even in small (tomato, wood-ear, tofu); diners heading home from work; kind service.

食べログ: 情熱のぶた、大阪市西区立売堀4-9-10 プレミアムAWAZA、阿波.en: Tabelog: Jonetsu no Buta, Premium AWAZA, 4-9-10 Itachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 117 m from Awaza Station; Tue–Sun 11:00–15:00 and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; counter; no smoking; opened 28 February 2023. Reviews (September–October 2026): summer-only hiyashi chuka with pork-cartilage chashu; the standard rich tsukemen ¥1,050; the maze-soba is good too; a punch different from ramen; the owner's character and the staff's cheerful atmosphere; one predicts it will become a Hyakumeiten; white rice with maze-soba; seafood tonkotsu ramen ¥970; seasoned egg ¥150; full at 18:30 on a rainy Tuesday; ticket machine; round bowls; a rich, creamy soup; medium-thick straight noodles; rice with ramen, meat and egg yolk; chashu, seasoned egg, wood-ear, nori, lots of leek; special tsukemen; 3 slices chashu; a dipping soup strong in tonkotsu; one called it ordinary.

食べログ: 担々麺くろおに、大阪市北区西天満3-11-3 老松小路D、なにわ橋か.en: Tabelog: Tantan-men Kuro Oni, Oimatsu Koji D, 3-11-3 Nishitenma, Kita-ku, Osaka; 297 m from Naniwabashi; Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00, Sun 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; cards (AMEX) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; opened 5 April 2018. Reviews (2020 – August 2026): a renovated old house; hard to find down a narrow alley, easy to mistake for a home; soupless black-sesame tantanmen (an almost black sesame paste, minced meat, chewy flat noodles, pasta-like presentation, choose heat, rice to finish); white-sesame tantanmen (chicken-based soup); cold white-sesame tantanmen on summer weekday evenings and weekends (chili oil, Sichuan pepper); small size; steamed-chicken topping; mouth-watering chicken; bite-size gyoza; Horo Yoi set and plenty of drinks; one found the soup weak; a calm atmosphere.

食べログ: 担々麺屋 オッソちゃん、大阪市阿倍野区松崎町2-3-20、大阪阿部野.en: Tabelog: Tantan-men Ya Osso Chan, 2-3-20 Matsuzakicho, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 265 m from Osaka-Abenobashi; Mon–Sat 11:00 until sold out (also given as until 15:00); closed Sundays; irregular closures (announced on Instagram); changes on event days; no cards, e-money or QR. Reviews (May–October 2026): known on social media; full within 5 minutes of the 11:00 opening; tom yum tantanmen ¥1,200 (¥1,100 at lunch); hot, numbing, sour and a little sweet; strong Sichuan pepper; supple thin noodles; meat miso; large noodles; ¥1,660 with coriander, seasoned egg and onion toppings; whiteboard specials (spicy leek, shredded pig's trotters, khao man gai); jasmine rice; fragrant chili oil and many flavour-changing condiments, with side plates; hand over menu chips slotted into an order board; staff explain for first-timers; about 8 counter seats and a table by the entrance; may be too hot for those who don't like heat.

食べログ: 挽肉屋 神徳、銀座3-11-16 VORT銀座イースト1F、東銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Hikinikuya Jintoku, Ginza 3-11-16, VORT Ginza East 1F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station (Asakusa line); 20 seats (counter and two tables for 2); daily 11:30–16:00, 18:00–21:00; closed at Obon and New Year; opened April 15, 2022; cards (VISA, Master), IC and QR accepted; a calm Japanese interior. October 2026 reviews: freshly grilled hamburg steaks — 100% beef, a beef-pork-lamb blend, fish (sometimes sold out) — with salt, sauce or mustard; rice bowls; hamburg steak eaten with dashi; free refills of rice and miso soup; a two-kind set ¥1,850.

食べログ: 支那麺 はしご 本店、銀座6-3-5 第二ソワレ・ド・ビル1F、24.en: Tabelog: Shina-men Hashigo main shop, Ginza 6-3-5, Dai-ni Soiree de Building 1F; 24 seats; weekdays 11:00–5:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–21:00; cash only; in August 2009 the main shop on B1F of the Ginza Toshiba Building was merged into this one. 2026 reviews: dandanmen (tantanmen), paigu dandanmen, aromas of sesame, yuzu and curry, thin noodles, tantanmen with thick-cut pork ¥1,200, fried spare ribs, gyoza, zha cai; order after sitting down.

食べログ: 料太、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-15 丸清ビル 4F B、心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Ryota, Marusei Bldg 4F B, 1-17-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 1 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; 18:00–24:00; irregular closing days (check Tabelog online booking); may close when ingredients run out; takeaway available; table-charge starter (included in courses); heated tobacco only; cards (including UnionPay) accepted, no e-money or QR; 6–8 seats; private hire for 6 or more; opened 23 April 2024. Reviews (July–October 2026): 7-dish course with all-you-can-drink ¥11,000; simmered mizuna and beef; octopus and winter melon; mozuku in vinegar; sashimi of tuna, seared barracuda, squid, sea urchin, crab meat with crab miso, horse sashimi; lotus-root manju in kuzu sauce; Saikyo-grilled flounder; tempura of hamo, corn and okra; clay-pot rice with ayu, corn and edamame; house dessert; leftover rice made into rice balls; same-day booking; kamameshi; Kyoto vegetables; open Sunday nights; the owner runs it single-handed; firm-fleshed tuna; fresh sea urchin; well-grilled steak; shows you the ingredient packaging; round taro manju; shirako; abalone with liver sauce; the entrance is a little hard to find; plenty of sake.

食べログ: 料理店オクノ、大阪市浪速区難波中1-16-4、南海なんば駅から徒歩3.en: Tabelog: Ryori Ten Okuno, Nambanaka 1-16-4, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Nankai Namba Stn; daily 12:00–14:30 and 17:00–23:30; irregular closures; lunch by reservation only, omakase of 5 dishes ¥3,500 or 8 dishes ¥5,000; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 17 seats (counter 5, tables of 4 ×3); non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; sommelier on staff; opened 13 September 2023. Shop's introduction: playful Italian from an open kitchen, Italian regional cooking with Japanese, Chinese and ethnic ideas, handmade pasta with sauces that change with the season (Ezo deer, porcini), natural wines chosen by sommelier staff, a daily-changing menu, omakase courses. Reviews (June 2025–October 2026): foie gras omelet, carpaccio, crisp-skinned Spanish mackerel, lamb hamburg, beef cheek braised in red wine, baked cheese stuffed with mushrooms and wild boar, fish and pesto pasta, truffle and pork pasta, homemade ricotta and prosciutto, wine by the decanter, one chef cooking with 20–30 minutes between dishes, a regular since the previous owner.

食べログ: 新橋ニューともちん、新橋駅前ビルB1F、平日8:00〜17:00、祝.en: Tabelog: Shimbashi New Tomochin, Shimbashi Ekimae Building B1F; weekdays 8:00–17:00, holidays 10:00–16:00, closed weekends; a notice that regular hours with a 9:30 opening resume from October 28; cash only; 6 seats; opened September 29, 2023; note: "4th shop of Koenji's 'Tomochin Ramen'". October 2026 reviews: chuka soba ¥850, wakame ¥100, rice free (refills OK), standing counter.

食べログ: 新町あだち、大阪市西区新町3-8-10 エステムコート大阪新町 1F.en: Tabelog: Shinmachi Adachi, エステムコート大阪新町 1F, 3-8-10 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nishi-Nagahori Station Exit 1, 7 min from Awaza Station; lunch Wednesday and Saturday only, everyone starting at 12:00; Tuesday, Thursday and Friday private hire for four or more; dinner Monday–Saturday, first seating 18:00 or 19:00, second 20:30; closed Sundays, holidays and the 1st of each month (menu and tableware change); reservations accepted; allergies and dislikes in the booking request field; no ingredient changes on the day; late arrivals may get fewer dishes; cancellation 50% the day before, 100% on the day; service charge 5% at lunch, 10% at dinner; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 7 counter seats; non-smoking; private hire available; opened 28 February 2020. Shop text: seasonal menus and tableware changed monthly; the chef adds personal twists to dishes learned in training; in the Michelin Guide within a year of opening; the sake-loving owner stocks junmai daiginjo and rare labels such as Jikon as well as seasonal releases. Shop website: seven seats a day; "because we were born and raised in Japan, we want guests to touch the culture and customs handed down from long ago"; entry at 18:00, 19:00 or 20:30, with no turnover; omakase course ¥16,500 (appetizer, a small starter, soup, sashimi, hassun, a substantial dish, a single dish, fried dish, rice, sweet); the menu card deliberately lists only the ingredients; the tableware changes monthly too; sake vessels include Old Baccarat; the clay-pot rice is a blend made for the shop; lunch ¥9,900; closed Sundays and holidays. TableCheck: lunch kaiseki ¥9,900 (8 dishes); dinner kaiseki ¥16,500 (10 dishes); ¥9,900 (8 dishes) at the 20:30 seating only; December ¥19,800 at dinner and ¥12,100 at lunch (snow crab and other seasonal ingredients); give details of allergies and dislikes, as same-day requests may not be possible. Michelin Guide: an owner who loves traditional Japanese culture and weaves New Year, Setsubun and the Doll Festival into the menu. Reviews (May–October 2026): Adachi is the owner; a counter decorated with tea-ceremony utensils; everyone starts together; the Boys' Day festival in May, a Tanabata hassun in July, chrysanthemums for the Double Ninth in September, moon viewing in October; purple sea urchin; steamed abalone rice with liver sauce; red sea urchin, Akashi sea bream, needle squid; salt-grilled ayu; hamo tempura; Miyazaki beef with matsutake; Kagoshima beef with mushroom sauce; clay-pot rice; chirimen sansho; leftover rice made into rice balls to take home; a dashimaki on the house when a diner went back for more rice; sake by the glass; a choice of glass or ceramic sake cups; a lively, fun chef and apprentices; delicate flavours, like being in Kyoto.

食べログ: 新町カリー、大阪市西区新町2-11-12 1F、西大橋駅から282m.en: Tabelog: Shimmachi Curry, 1F, 2-11-12 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 282 m from Nishi-Ohashi; Mon–Sat 11:00–16:00; closed Sundays; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats (counter about 7, one table for 4). Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): opened around August 2025, first anniversary in 2026; a small shop with a green awning; run by two people who remember faces; dashi spice curries; a base of chicken stock with Shodoshima shoyu, or bonito-flake Japanese dashi with soy milk; keema of chicken and pork, or fish (cod); sides (gizzard achar, salmon achar); (chicken stock & Shodoshima shoyu) fish keema + sides (¥1,450); surume squid & clam-dashi Thai curry (¥200); house egg masala (¥200); coriander; shrimp curry Thu–Sat; limited San Gen pork and squid; spicy chicken plate; truffle crackers with house cream cheese; potato salad; cash only.

食べログ: 新鮮処ととろ、大阪市西区新町2-17-10、西大橋駅1番出口から徒歩.en: Tabelog: Shinsen Dokoro Totoro, 2-17-10 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station Exit 1, 7 min from Nishi-Nagahori Station Exit 1; daily 18:00–22:30 (closing time approximate; closes early when ingredients run out); reopened on Tuesday 20 October after hospitalization and recovery; temporarily closed Tuesday 27 October; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; otoshi served; 17 seats (all tables since a September 2018 renovation); private use up to 20; smoking allowed, so under-20s cannot enter; Osaka City premium gift certificates accepted until 15 January 2027. Shop website: 有限会社アイランド・フィールド; hours 18:00–22:30 (closing time approximate); last order 22:00 (horse-meat dishes 21:30); no regular closing day (temporary closures); cash only; a two-dish otoshi ¥550 to start; horse meat from Kumamoto, jidori from Miyazaki, winter oysters from Kurahashi-jima (Hiroshima), rock oysters from Oki (Shimane), fish direct from Onagawa port (Miyagi), Yawatahama (Ehime) and elsewhere; rare regional sake from small breweries, changed each season. Horse sashimi: tongue, barahimo and futaego ¥1,500 each, raw liver ¥2,600 (reservation priority), lean ¥1,700, tategami ¥1,500, sakura-toro rice bowl ¥1,600, platters of 3 kinds ¥3,500, 4 kinds ¥4,000, 5 kinds ¥4,600; ordered on the day it takes 40 minutes to an hour. Jidori specialty: salt-grilled thigh ¥900. Fried fugu ¥990, fugu skin, whale bacon, salt-grilled yellowtail collar, shrimp tempura, chicken kara-age, grilled miso (with buckwheat groats). From 28 October 2026 the autumn–winter specialty, the monkfish hot pot loaded with liver: ¥5,700 a person, or ¥7,000 a person as a set with a horse sashimi platter, both from two servings; the set needs booking by the day before; the head cook can only fillet so many monkfish, so it sells out. Summer: live hamo and onion Awaji hot pot; spring: moray eel from Kochi. Ozeki junmai daiginjo kuradashi nama genshu, poured at only 100 shops in Japan (May 2026); regional sake by the 90 ml glass or the 1-gō katakuchi flask. Closed late August to 10 October 2025 for staff illness, in spring 2026 for surgery and recovery, and from 1 July 2026 for illness and recovery, reopening 20 October. Reviews (December 2021 – March 2026): the monkfish hot pot loaded with liver is rich; follow the house way and put in half without lighting the burner; udon and zosui to finish; more liver broth added when the pot runs low; a soy sauce made for horse sashimi; booked a month ahead; walk-ins were being turned away; signed photos of celebrities; Haruma Miura visited three times; run by an elderly couple; a warm, motherly atmosphere; table seats only, but fine alone; no cards; about ¥8,000–10,000 a person.

食べログ: 日夏屋、大阪市浪速区難波中3-16-11、大国町から426m、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Hinatsuya, 3-16-11 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 426 m from Daikokucho; daily 11:00–23:00; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 14 June 2025. Reviews (June 2025 – October 2026): vegetable ramen ¥1,000, heaped with mostly cabbage; a free noodle refill or rice; ticket machine; light tonkotsu and thin noodles; free rice; a black bowl; a creamy, slightly frothy white soup; thin straight noodles; seared fatty chashu; soft-boiled egg; leek; nori; free rice and kimchi; wrap rice in soup-soaked nori; 5 quail eggs; onion, kimchi, one noodle refill and rice free; doubanjiang, garlic, pepper; one prefers it to Mugen Ramen next door; tonkotsu ramen ¥850; light strength; some saltiness; fried rice; karaage set meal; open late; many overseas staff and diners; courteous service; not greasy, salt restrained.

食べログ: 日本ばし やぶ久 銀座店、銀座3-3-6 銀座モリタビルB1F、30.en: Tabelog: Nihonbashi Yabu Kyu Ginza, Ginza 3-3-6, Ginza Morita Building B1F; 30 seats, private rooms; Tue–Sat 11:00–15:00, 17:00–22:00, Sundays and holidays until 21:30, closed Mon; opened March 4, 2019; official site yabukyu.com. Shop introduction: soba and sake for over 120 years. 2026 reviews: an apron for the curry nanban; black-pork curry bowl set ¥2,200; buckwheat tea; karasumi with daikon; itawasa; curry soba to finish; seasonal vegetable platter; courses for entertaining in private rooms; 2-hour limit; some say the staff are loud; also the Nihonbashi main shop.

食べログ: 日本橋 さか一、大阪市中央区島之内2-11-3、日本橋駅・長堀橋駅6.en: Tabelog: Nihonbashi Sakaichi, 2-11-3 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nippombashi Station and Nagahoribashi Station exit 6; Mon, Wed and Fri 9:30–14:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 7:00–13:30 (continuous); closed Tuesdays and Thursdays (open on holidays) plus irregular days (announced on X and Instagram); the ticket machine does not take ¥5,000 or ¥10,000 notes; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 seats (counter only); opened 20 September 2022; Tabelog 3.64. Reviews (September–October 2026): weekend morning ramen; SNS-only specials (Tachiuo paitan tsukemen with noodles coated in raw egg ¥1,600, crab and scallop salt ¥1,600 with crab miso ¥250, rich niboshi soba ¥1,200 with 70% Himi niboshi, niboshi and scallop salt with fresh aonori ¥1,400, XO maze-soba); cement-coloured soup; niboshi without harshness; rice to finish ¥100; the main is special shoyu; special shoyu ¥1,600; seasoned-egg shoyu; shoyu; medium-thick flat whole-wheat noodles from Menya Teikaku; chashu of pork shoulder, pork belly, chicken thigh and chicken breast; low-temperature chicken breast and hung-roasted pork belly; a chicken and seafood soup; no table condiments; the owner and one staff member; one praises the owner's service; a queue outside at 8 a.m.

食べログ: 日本橋 古樹軒、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-7-1 大丸心斎橋店B2F、.en: Tabelog: Nihonbashi Kojuken, Daimaru Shinsaibashi B2F, 1-7-1 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-3555-1132; no reservations; daily 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); closed when Daimaru Shinsaibashi is; cards and QR payment accepted, no e-money; no smoking; wheelchair accessible; opened 20 September 2019. 2026 reviews (May–October): with price rises, nearly ¥3,000 at lunch; No. 1 most popular, the shark-fin soup rice set ¥3,180, and la zi ji; No. 2, the mapo tofu set (numbing Sichuan pepper); Hirai-style tantanmen (heavy sesame with Sichuan pepper and heat); often seen on Kansai TV; shark-fin rice set and tom yum goong set; self-service, crowded with tourists at weekends; collect with a buzzer; the premium braised whole shark-fin set (¥3,180 incl. tax) with ramen.

食べログ: 日本酒BAR 四季、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-30 オックス周防町.en: Tabelog: Sake Bar Shiki, Ox Suomachi Bldg 2F, 2-5-30 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon–Sat 18:00–24:00 (food L.O. 23:30, last entry 23:00; phone if late); closed Sundays and holidays; opened 2 September 2015; charge ¥300; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 10 counter seats; sashimi platter from ¥1,500 per person to budget (book by the day before); mostly local sake from Tohoku; seasonal fish bought daily; sake beginners welcome. Reviews (January–September 2026): state your taste and get several to try; a Rashomon tasting; bonito paired with sake; red shrimp marinated in sake; Senshu water-aubergine sashimi; squid legs grilled with liver mayo; wagyu sukiyaki-style; black-truffle cream soup; squid-ink yakisoba-style Okinawa soba; tamago kake gohan; events such as fruit nights and brewery visits; 11th anniversary.

食べログ: 日比谷松本楼、千代田区日比谷公園1-2、日比谷駅A14出口・霞ケ関駅.en: Tabelog: Hibiya Matsumoto-ro, Hibiya-koen 1-2, Chiyoda-ku, 2 minutes from Hibiya Station exit A14 and Kasumigaseki Station exit B2; 120 seats; 1F yōshoku grill & garden terrace 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); 3F French restaurant Bois de Boulogne (lunch 11:00–16:00, dinner 17:00–22:00); closed at New Year; 10% service charge (3F only); dinner bookings for 1F only; official site matsumotoro.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: 3F prix-fixe (cèpe blancmange, pumpkin and apple potage, lobster américaine); discontinued Wedgwood plates; only one table on the open-deck terrace can be booked; a 30-minute wait during a park event; paid special seats; the outdoor seats are pleasant; omurice with shrimp and scallops in tomato sauce ¥1,850; banquet plan with all-you-can-drink ¥8,500; sweet Showa-style European curry; poulet, cake and coffee set ¥2,800; choose the omurice sauce and hamburg steak, fried shrimp or crab cream croquette; seated 12 people together.

食べログ: 旬゛喫茶 フツウニフルウツ、大阪市中央区南船場1-15-12 堺筋倶.en: Tabelog: Jun Kissa Futsuni Fruits, Sakaisuji Club building 2F, 1-15-12 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 6 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi or Nagahoribashi Stn (Osaka Metro); daily 11:00–16:00; closing days not fixed; reservations accepted (after booking a seat, items can also be reserved by Instagram message; no same-day bookings); one-hour limit when busy; cashless only; 14 seats; non-smoking; opened 22 February 2024. Shop site (Pan to Espresso to Co.): Jun Kissa Futsuni Fruits listed under other shops (directly run), Sakaisuji Club 2F, 11:00–16:00, closing days not fixed. Menu: fruit sandwich from ¥1,400, Candle mou ¥700, baked goods from ¥350, hand-drip coffee ¥700, tea ¥600, cream soda from ¥850, Japanese mikan juice ¥600, Japanese apple juice ¥600; manga free to read. Reviews (April–August 2026): a building put up as a bank in 1931, Pan to Espresso to on the ground floor, order and pay at the entrance, shelves of manga, many clocks, seasonal fruit sandwiches (fig, orange and kiwi with cream cheese ¥1,400; white peach with Earl Grey cream ¥1,600; American cherry with chocolate cream), Strawberry Milk ¥700, bread from downstairs can be brought up and re-warmed in a toaster, reservations recommended; one diner says cash or PayPay only, another found the peach disappointing and smelled oil from the kitchen below.

食べログ: 旬菜ダイニング らかんか、大阪市中央区南船場2-7-1、長堀橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Shunsai Dining Rakan Ka, Minami-Senba 2-7-1, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 337 m from Nagahoribashi Stn; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:00 and 18:30–23:00; closed Saturday, Sunday, public holidays and over the New Year; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted, no e-money; 12 seats; counter seating; no private rooms; whole-shop booking possible; genres: creative, Japanese, organic. Reviews (May 2023 – September 2026): a shop in a narrow alley, roomier inside than it looks from outside; at lunch a daily set with a choice of fish or meat, two small side dishes, miso soup, brown rice and fruit (mandarin, watermelon, banana); ¥1,000 in 2026 (¥900 in 2024, and an April 2026 review gives ¥900 for the omakase set); herb-and-breadcrumb-crusted salmon, butter-grilled salmon, saikyo-miso grilled Spanish mackerel, mackerel grilled with basil, chicken and vegetable tomato stew, beef stew, mapo tofu, white fish steamed in foil; a daily health tea (mugwort, persimmon leaf, barley); brown rice advertised as the best in Osaka; gentle seasoning; busy with office workers before noon; takeaway available; takeout through Uber during the pandemic; set meals in the evening too (4 side dishes ¥1,650, 8 side dishes ¥2,200, July 2024); a diner back in January 2026 after five or six years found the master and partner unchanged; the owner specializes in astrology (July 2024 review). The official site racanca.com does not resolve (30 October 2026).

食べログ: 明月庵 ぎんざ 田中屋 松屋店、銀座3-6-1 松屋銀座本店8F、銀.en: Tabelog: Meigetsuan Ginza Tanakaya Matsuya, Ginza 3-6-1, Matsuya Ginza main store 8F, directly connected to Ginza Station exit A13; 60 seats (34 table; private rooms for 2, 4 and 6); Mon–Sat 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00), Sun 11:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); children welcome; official site soba-tanakaya.com. Shop introduction: founded 1956; Edomae soba kept true by stone-ground buckwheat flour and the balance of water; tempura of seasonal fish and vegetables fried in taihaku sesame oil; sake snacks; "soba + one dish". September 2026 reviews: small-shrimp tempura seiro (choose nori, katsuobushi or both); mushroom and pork tsuke soba ¥2,079; shrimp and shimeji tempura soba with Suigei; ask if you want to start with salt; iso-jako (hot soba with aosa and chirimen jako); anmitsu; about half full just after 11:30.

食べログ: 明月庵 ぎんざ 田中屋 銀座本店、銀座6-6-19(ソニー通りとみゆ.en: Tabelog: Meigetsuan Ginza Tanakaya Honten, Ginza 6-6-19 (near the corner of Sony-dori and Miyuki-dori), 3 minutes from Ginza Station exit B9; 80 seats (private room for 4); daily 11:30–21:00 (L.O. 20:20); children welcome; official site soba-tanakaya.com; a notice "temporarily closed from August 8". Shop introduction: founded 1956; Edomae soba kept true by stone-ground buckwheat flour and the balance of water; tempura of seasonal fish and vegetables fried in taihaku sesame oil; sake snacks; "soba + one dish". 2026 reviews (September, October): tables and private rooms on two floors; a calm, grown-up clientele; hot soba with good broth; tendon crisp and not oily; yuzu shichimi; start with tempura and sake and finish with zaru soba; autumn bonito, ginkgo, ayu; shochu cut with soba water; Ginza prices; quick service.

食べログ: 昭和双子焼き (旧店名 双子のり巻き)、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-6-.en: Tabelog: Showa Futago Yaki (formerly Futago Norimaki), 2-6-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 min walk from Nagahoribashi and Shinsaibashi stations; Mon–Fri 19:00–2:00 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–2:00 next morning (L.O. 1:30); open every day of the year; starter ¥250; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 8 seats (counter, standing); pets allowed; takeaway; English and Korean menus; picture menu; oden, skewers, Korean food, sake and whisky in a Showa-izakaya atmosphere. Reviews (June 2024 – August 2026): like a Korean street stall; gimbap is the main draw, in many kinds; ordered a half and got a whole roll; sundae platter; bulgogi; jeon; Korean oden; Korean beer and Chamisul; leftovers can be taken away; one found prices much higher than in Korea; friendly staff.

食べログ: 時喰み、銀座3-11-6 鈴木ビル2F、東銀座駅から徒歩3分、10席.en: Tabelog: Tokihami, Ginza 3-11-6, 鈴木 Building 2F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 10 seats (5 counter, 2 tables); Mon–Sat 18:00–23:00, closed Sundays and holidays; opened April 8, 2019; Japanese food and wine, à la carte only; owner-chef Junya Kudo (from Ginza Kudo); has a sister shop; cards, e-money and QR accepted. 2026 reviews: grilled sesame tofu, foie gras monaka, cream croquettes, potato salad, fig and grape with mascarpone, dishes for sharing, same-day booking almost impossible, drinks a bit pricey.

食べログ: 有明そば、銀座3-12-6、東銀座駅から222m、29席(テーブル2.en: Tabelog: Ariake Soba, Ginza 3-12-6, 222 m from Higashi-Ginza Station; 29 seats (20 table, 9 counter); 11:30–14:00, from 17:00; closed weekends and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR. 2026 reviews: two daily sets (¥1,200), tempura set "Ariake" ¥1,200 (shrimp, kisu, shishito), choice of soba, udon or miso soup, menchi-katsu set, tendon ¥1,050, kitsune udon ¥650; at night unohana as otoshi, octopus and tuna sashimi, shishamo, nira-tama, yakitori, beef tofu.

食べログ: 未来軒、大阪市中央区瓦町2-4-10、堺筋本町から467m、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Mirai Ken, 2-4-10 Kawaramachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 467 m from Sakaisuji-Hommachi; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays and holidays; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 16 October 2025. Reviews (April–October 2026): lively at night; pork and bean-sprout stir-fry; mapo tofu; half tantanmen; under ¥2,500 with 2 lemon sours; the tantanmen is rich without being too hot; one calls it authentic Chinese flavour; limited cold tantanmen with chewy noodles; half fried rice set; cold rich spicy tantanmen ¥1,200 with wavy noodles; one wished it were hotter; tantanmen Moto-Aji ¥950; plenty of meat miso; bean sprouts and greens; can't stop drinking the soup; Shin-Aji; miso; shoyu tanmen; hot-and-sour tanmen; one learned it's a sister shop of the Chinese restaurant Koyouju in Hommachi; a neon sign; the entrance set back from the street; 3 groups waiting at 11:40; 5 counter seats, five tables for 4, three for 2; outdoor terrace seats; a distinctive aroma; very thin noodles.

食べログ: 本格炉端焼き人夢叶思ひとむかし、大阪市中央区難波千日前14-26、な.en: Tabelog: Honkaku Robatayaki Hitomukashi, 14-26 Namba Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–23:00, Sat–Sun 7:00–11:00, 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–23:00; no reservations at lunch; 5% service charge at night; cards and QR (including Alipay and WeChat Pay) accepted, no e-money; opened 1 November 2012. Reviews (August 2024 – October 2026): the famous Bakudan don ¥1,800 (¥1,400 in 2024; ikura, tuna, negitoro, sea bream, takuan, shiso, nori, wasabi, sesame-sauce sashimi, small dishes, grated yam, miso soup, white or multigrain rice); three stages, dashi shoyu → sesame-sauce sashimi → grated yam; Gobu Gobu don ¥1,800 (Wakayama shirasu, half raw and half boiled); Senshu anago tendon ¥1,700; bluefin tuna bowl; sanma set meal; large free; weekend breakfast; anago nigiri at night; a sashimi platter under a smoking lid; potato salad; nut salad; shirako mapo tofu; Manganji peppers; gratin; grilled rice balls; queues at lunch; a waiting board; perks for registering on LINE; courteous service.

食べログ: 本町製麺所 中華そば工房、大阪市中央区船場中央1-3-2 船場センタ.en: Tabelog: Hommachi Seimensho Chuka Soba Kobo, Semba Center Bldg No. 2 B2F (moved), 1-3-2 Semba-chuo, Chuo-ku, Osaka; just outside the Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station gate; Mon–Sat 11:00–19:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 23 seats (counter 9, tables 14); no smoking; opened 26 November 2020. Reviews (September–October 2026): cold kiwi ramen ¥1,300; cold rooibos tea; a light cold soup; flat medium-thick noodles; kiwi, seasoned egg, chicken-breast chashu, seared pork chashu, mitsuba, almonds; chuka soba prime (extra chashu and seasoned egg); chose round noodles; additive-free, clean taste; deep umami; juicy chashu; no wait at 13:30 on a weekday; a clear soup with shoyu aroma and sansho; flat or round noodles; rare chashu; long menma; citrus aroma; house-made chewy noodles; change the flavour with black pepper and sansho; chuka soba ¥1,050; the shoyu a little strong; often a notice of closing because the noodles ran out; ticket machine at the entrance; the soupless chuka soba is mixed with egg; sudachi.

食べログ: 札幌らーめん獅子王 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-3-21 NI.en: Tabelog: Sapporo Ramen Shishio Shinsaibashi, NIPPO Tamayacho Kaikan 1F, 2-3-21 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 14 seats (counter); Mon, Tue and Sun 18:00–6:00 next morning (L.O. 5:30), Wed–Thu 18:00–8:00 next morning (L.O. 7:30), Fri, Sat and days before holidays 18:00–14:00 next day (L.O. 13:30); closed 1st and 3rd Wednesdays for cleaning; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 20 May 2016. Shop introduction: wild yet mild; a soup of pork bones and chicken (wings) simmered for a long time; chopped onion; thickened with grated potato; medium-thick high-hydration wavy noodles. 2026 reviews (September–October): ticket machine at the entrance; a short wait when full; rich, wavy noodles; shiitake vinegar; a strong Sapporo-style miso; faint heat; medium-thick noodles; piping hot under lard; corn and garlic; roast chashu, menma, leek, corn; 2 a.m.; miso ramen with soft-boiled egg; the spicy items aren't very spicy; near Kintetsu-Nippombashi Station; miso ramen ¥1,170; seasoned egg ¥160.

食べログ: 東京會舘 銀座スカイラウンジ、千代田区有楽町2-10-1 東京交通会.en: Tabelog: Tokyo Kaikan Ginza Sky Lounge, Yurakucho 2-10-1, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo Kotsu Kaikan 15F, in front of Yurakucho Station; 118 seats (6 counter, semi-private rooms); daily 11:30–21:30 (L.O. lunch 14:00, tea 16:30, dinner 20:00); closed at New Year; 15% service charge; official site kaikan.co.jp. Shop introduction: Tokyo Kaikan's French cooking, with its history and tradition, brought up to date; city views. October 2026 reviews: once a revolving restaurant (it no longer turns); elevator to 14F, stairs to 15F; "Tokyo Kaikan and Me" course ¥6,600 (three amuses including quiche, the traditional double consommé, sole meunière); flounder in white-wine sauce; marron chantilly; free bread refills; every seat faces the windows; a harsh view that you're paying for the location; for birthdays; about ¥18,000 for two.

食べログ: 松屋食堂、大阪市浪速区日本橋西1-8-25、恵美須町から453m、月.en: Tabelog: Matsuya Shokudo, 1-8-25 Nipponbashi-nishi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 453 m from Ebisucho; Mon–Sat 11:30–16:30; closed Sundays and holidays; closes when sold out; no cards, e-money or QR; 9 seats (and 2nd-floor seats); no smoking. October 2026 reviews: the most popular is the omurice; 5 waiting after 12:00, 7 minutes; pay cash afterwards; served in 16 minutes; ramen and fried rice; old-fashioned chuka soba; thick chashu; house-made straight noodles; fried rice large or half size; cheap; two storeys; busy even an hour before closing; omurice ¥900 with Chinese soup; large size too; a shop in a narrow alley; metal chairs; thin egg and ketchup; spicy miso ramen; stir-fried pork, bean sprouts and leek; a dark soup.

食べログ: 桂庵 銀座三丁目店、銀座3-10-14 東銀ビル1F、26席(4人卓.en: Tabelog: Katsura-an Ginza 3-chome, Ginza 3-10-14, 東銀 Building 1F; 26 seats (five tables for 4, one for 2); weekdays 11:00–21:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–17:00; closed at New Year. 2026 reviews: niku seiro (lots of pork, with scallions); the new roast-pork bowl (with a fried egg, half set ¥1,300); mini chicken-bowl set ¥1,200 (freshly fried karaage in a sweet-savory sauce, cash only); katsudon set (¥50 off, ¥1,200); strong Kanto-style broth; soba water; shared tables when busy; open on Saturdays too.

食べログ: 梅丘寿司の美登利総本店 銀座店、銀座7-2 東京高速道路山下ビル1F.en: Tabelog: Sushi no Midori Ginza, Ginza 7-2, 東京高速道路山下 Building 1F, 4 minutes from Ginza Station exit A2; 82 seats; weekdays 11:00–15:00, 17:00–21:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–21:00; closed 1/1; bookings changeable up to 3 days before; official site sushinomidori.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: many overseas visitors; Matsuri course (with dessert; some say the rice is firm); numbered tickets from 16:00 for dinner, about 10 people waiting before 16:00; a staffer first met at the Futako-Tamagawa shop; Akita sake; off-menu squid legs grilled with butter and onion; omakase nigiri and 大名 mackerel; satisfied in the ¥5,000 range; 45-minute limit; a staffer with a harsh tone; special nigiri and draft beer; queued from 11:00, seated after 13:00; nigiri served a few at a time.

食べログ: 楊國福マーラータン 大阪心斎橋店、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-6-16.en: Tabelog: Yang Guo Fu Malatang Osaka Shinsaibashi, 1F, 2-6-16 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Nippombashi stations; 31 seats; daily 11:00–21:30; no reservations; opened 1 July 2022. 2026 reviews (August–October): queues before opening; choose ingredients first, order, then join the line for seats; as much of whatever you like (wood-ear, glass noodles and more); a spiced soup; adjustable heat; tongs to fill a bowl with vegetables, seafood, meat, fish cakes and noodles, weighed at the till to set the price; beef, quail egg, squid, wood-ear, king oyster and enoki mushrooms; busy even after lunchtime; 90% of diners are women; tomato flavour recommended, like tomato ramen; glass noodles; overseas staff with limited Japanese; even heat level 1 is quite hot; sesame sauce tames the heat; lots of vegetables and few carbs.

食べログ: 極味焼肉 牛吾、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-2-13 宝山心斎橋ビル2F.en: Tabelog: Gokumi Yakiniku Gyugo, Hozan Shinsaibashi Bldg 2F, 2-2-13 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Mon–Sat 17:00–24:30, holidays 17:00–22:00; closed Sundays; may close early when sold out (phone to check); reservations accepted; cover charge ¥500; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 20 seats; a hideaway on the 2nd floor of a building; solo diners welcome; tables for 4–6; meat bought direct from wholesalers; courses to fit your budget. Reviews (March 2024 – August 2026): tongue, fillet, lean cuts, the day's cut; sirloin dashi chazuke to finish; good value; thick-cut fillet; ordinary tare; counter; on a full Friday a same-day online booking still worked; nakaochi; kuri; hanger; salted tongue with lemon; tongue root; kimchi platter; thin-sliced premium misuji; offal; ¥1,500–2,000 a plate; the master's recommendations; a good order of service; yuzu-tea rice; one calls the meat ordinary; the manager explains the cuts with gusto.

食べログ: 横浜家系ラーメン 一新家、大阪市浪速区桜川3-1-29、阪神桜川駅4.en: Tabelog: Yokohama Iekei Ramen Isshinya, 3-1-29 Sakuragawa, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; right by Hanshin Sakuragawa Station exit 4, on Sennichimae-dori; daily 11:30–0:30 next morning (L.O. 0:00); closed New Year's Eve and New Year's Day; no cards, e-money or QR; 23 seats (counter 7, tables 16); Kyu-chan pickles, chopped ginger, grated garlic, coarse black pepper and more free on the table. Reviews (October 2023 – August 2026): tonkotsu shoyu or salt; choose noodle firmness, strength and oil; thick wavy noodles (thin too); chashu; quail egg; spinach; nori; MAX ramen; leek ramen salt ¥1,060 (medium +¥100); tantanmen ¥980; miso ramen; rice set with free refills; karaage set; gyoza; chopped onion and sesame free too; free toppings and coupons via the app; friendly staff.

食べログ: 横浜家系ラーメン 幸来家、大阪市西区西本町1-5-20、本町駅から2.en: Tabelog: Yokohama Iekei Ramen Koura-ya, 1-5-20 Nishi-Hommachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 205 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–23:00; closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter 9, tables 7). Reviews (February–August 2026): on the south side of Utsubo Park; an iekei shop frequented by office workers; seasoned-egg ramen ¥1,000 (rich tonkotsu shoyu, thick noodles, spinach, chashu, 3 big sheets of nori, seasoned egg); choose noodle firmness, strength and oil; everything-on; MAX ramen; extra spinach or chashu; half fried rice; small rice free before 18:00; a tea bar of 3 tea bags at lunch; ginger, onion, spicy miso and more on the table; ticket machine; courteous, quick service.

食べログ: 橋本屋、大阪市中央区南船場2-2-21、長堀橋駅から徒歩4分、月〜木.en: Tabelog: Hashimoto Ya, Minami-Senba 2-2-21, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 4 min from Nagahoribashi Stn; Mon–Thu 11:45–13:30; closed Friday–Sunday and public holidays; reopened 8 September 2026; numbered tickets handed out around 10:05; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (counter 6, tables 10); non-smoking; children from school age; The Tabelog Award 2025 and 2026 Bronze; Tabelog Curry WEST Top 100 2026; rated 4.02. Reviews (November 2025–October 2026): people line up from about 9:15–9:55; numbered tickets from about 10:05; one representative for up to 4 people; choose a time and order on the spot and pay cash in advance; come back 5 minutes before your time; slots from 10:50 to 12:20; sold out around number 35; the only dish is Rich Chicken Curry ¥1,400; spice levels 0–3; large rice +¥100; extra chicken; onion achaar; bubbling in a clay pot; tender chicken, soft-boiled egg, marinated tomatoes; a thin, soup-like curry; about 20 whole spices ground in an electric mill for each order; broth from Daisendori and two kinds of whole chicken, Rausu kombu and onions; rice cooked with chicken fat, about 10 spices and onions; a guide to eating it (aroma, the clear top, with rice, and finally tip the rice into the pot and break the egg for a porridge); spice and Sichuan-pepper mills on the table; a dim room that is a bar at night; a gentle owner and pleasant staff; some found one visit enough or the flavour monotonous.

食べログ: 次男坊、銀座1-5-16 第3太陽ビル別館2F、銀座一丁目駅から91.en: Tabelog: Jinanbō, Ginza 1-5-16, 第3太陽 Building Annex 2F, 91 m from Ginza-itchome Station; 20 seats; weekdays 11:30–14:00, 16:00–23:00, closed weekends and holidays; otoshi ¥300; no cards, e-money or QR. 2026 reviews: cold meat soba ¥1,070 (large +¥100; meat, tenkasu, nori, scallions), "Chonanbo" set ¥1,180 (ginger pork, rice, small tanuki soba), dashi rice and zaru soba, fried soba as otoshi at night, itawasa ¥580, spicy fried burdock ¥580, bonito sashimi ¥1,200, sashimi platter ¥1,800, simmered conger eel, squid butter, sea bream, whelk, jazz, full at night with bookings.

食べログ: 歌舞伎茶屋 房の駅、銀座4-12-15 歌舞伎座B2F、東銀座駅直結.en: Tabelog: Kabuki Chaya Fusa no Eki, Ginza 4-12-15, Kabukiza B2F, directly connected to Higashi-Ginza Station; daily 9:00–18:00; no reservations; opened July 20, 2024; official site fusanoeki.fusa.co.jp. 2026 reviews: cold soba with five vegetable tempura ¥990 (thin and firm; onion, carrot and more); an open space in the Kabukiza basement, before or after a show; booked on the opening day of the summer kabuki, large meat soba; coffee in a cup with a topknot-shaped handle; the black tea's aroma is weak; the kakiage with cold soba is good; with hot soba the kakiage soon goes soggy.

食べログ: 汁なし担担麺専門 キング軒 大阪本町店、大阪市中央区船場中央3-3-.en: Tabelog: Shirunashi Tantanmen Senmon King Ken Osaka Hommachi, Semba Center Bldg No. 9 B2F, 3-3-9 Semba-chuo, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 187 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30), Sat 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); closed Sundays and holidays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats (counter 12, tables 6). Reviews (April–October 2026): the Osaka branch of a Hiroshima soupless-tantanmen shop; opened March 2026; choose heat 1–4 at the ticket machine outside (2 is standard); regular ¥800; double King ¥1,150; thin, firm wavy noodles; sesame sauce; meat miso; leek; mix 30 times or more; coriander; celery ¥150; onsen egg ¥100; half rice ¥100 into the leftover sauce (tantan-rice sauce and vinegar); mapo-tofu set meal at night; freshly ground Sichuan pepper, chopped chili and vinegar on the table.

食べログ: 沖縄麺処 天願 南船場本店、大阪市中央区南船場2-8-2 宮本ビル.en: Tabelog: OKIMEN TENGAN Minamisenba honten, Miyamoto Bldg 1F, Minamisenba 2-8-2, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Nagahoribashi Stn, 10 min from Sakaisuji-Honmachi Stn; Mon–Sat and public holidays 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 15:00); closed Sunday and the 2nd and 4th Saturdays; ends when the soup runs out; other irregular closures (check Instagram); no reservations; no cards or e-money, PayPay accepted; 10 seats (counter); non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; easier to get in after 13:00; English menu and photo menu; opened 17 April 2024. Shop introduction: Minamisenba's first Okinawa soba specialist; particular about dashi and noodles; noodles researched with a noodle factory from the blend to the thickness; katsuobushi and kombu with two Okinawan salts and dried shellfish, a little awamori; a clear golden soup. Reviews (April 2024–October 2026): Tengan soba ¥1,200 (three-layer pork and salt-cartilage Soki); salt-cartilage Soki soba ¥950; back fat ¥100; summer-only chilled Churaumi soba ¥980; Aasa soba; small jushi ¥200 with mozuku vinegar; Po-Tama onigiri (Spam and thin omelet), half ¥200, ¥150 at lunch; flat medium-thick noodles; fresh shredded ginger; kamaboko; tied kombu; koregusu and yuzu kosho on the counter; lines of office workers at weekday lunch; orders taken while waiting in line; the Honmachi shop's first anniversary (December 2025).

食べログ: 河童ラーメン本舗 千日前本店、大阪市中央区千日前1-9-12 トマト.en: Tabelog: Kappa Ramen Honpo Sennichimae main shop, Tomato Bldg 1F, 1-9-12 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 27 seats (counter only); open 24 hours; no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; official kappa-hompo.co.jp. Shop introduction: a specialist in back-fat tonkotsu shoyu; 'koime' with the sweetness of back fat and 'assari' with seafood oil; house-made thin straight noodles in 7 firmness levels from 'kona-otoshi' to 'bari-yawa'; free kimchi and fried garlic; free noodle refills 6:00–18:00 at the Sennichimae shop. Official: the original back-fat shoyu tonkotsu ramen; an allergy-care page. 2025–2026 reviews: Kappa ramen (koime) ¥930; karaage and white rice ¥350; two touch-panel ticket machines (left for mobile payment); one found koime too strong; assari with karaage set; no weekday half-fried-rice set at ¥1,000; tsukimi ramen ¥1,100 (limited from 1 September, black with squid ink); nori ¥150; white rice ¥220; customers still coming at 3 a.m.; overseas staff; fried rice and gyoza; black Kappa (garlic oil).

食べログ: 油そば A、大阪市中央区南本町2-6-8、堺筋本町駅から徒歩3〜4分.en: Tabelog: Abura Soba A, 2-6-8 Minamihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3–4 min walk from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–16:00 and 18:00–24:00 (noodle last order 10 minutes before closing); closed weekends and holidays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 8 seats. Reviews (July 2025 – October 2026): a simple abura soba from about ¥500 (150 g, noodles and nori); everything-on (chashu, menma, seasoned egg, nori); medium-thick or thick noodles; regular, large or double (300 g); shoyu or tantan; rich tonkotsu ramen; a weekly free topping (leek, onion, fried onion or fried noodles); tenkasu; Sichuan-pepper chili paste, grated garlic, chili oil, vinegar, shichimi and curry powder on the table; rice; a sweet-savoury sauce that isn't heavy; a friendly owner; full at lunch.

食べログ: 油そば きりん寺 千日前店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-15、26席(.en: Tabelog: Abura Soba Kirinji Sennichimae, 1-4-15 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 26 seats (counter 16, tables 10); daily 11:00–24:00; no reservations; no smoking; no cards, e-money or QR payment; opened 1 June 2023; site suzume-group.co.jp/kirinji. 2025–2026 reviews: what you crave after a gig; queues of overseas diners; vinegar on the chashu is superb; open late; regular size with soft-boiled egg under ¥1,000 (March 2026); garlic; chashu rice bowl; karaage and white rice set; how-to-eat instructions on the walls and tables; ground and 2nd floors; soft-boiled egg, kimchi, extra meat, everything-on; thick chewy noodles; vinegar and chili oil; hooked by the third visit; chashu, menma, shredded nori, sesame; the shopping street along Round1; close to Namba Walk; open until about 1 a.m. (October 2026).

食べログ: 油そば・まぜそば ロマン なんば南口店、大阪市中央区難波5-1-60.en: Tabelog: Abura Soba Mazesoba Roman Namba Minamiguchi, beside the 2nd-floor south ticket gate of Nankai Namba Station, 5-1-60 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–15:30 and 17:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 8 April 2025. Reviews (April–October 2026): near Nankai Namba Station but hard to find; everything-on maze-soba large; half rice to finish; a punchy maze-soba; medium-thick noodles; delivery; chewy thick noodles with meat, egg and special sauce; rice into the leftover sauce; just outside the 2nd-floor south ticket gate; not crowded; not a big shop; a flavour that divides opinion; one was bothered by staff chatter; large portions; two rounds of vinegar as the shop recommends; chili oil; extra sauce; garlic; maze-soba ¥1,000; a small, clean shop.

食べログ: 油そば・まぜそば ロマン アメ村店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-11-9.en: Tabelog: Abura Soba Mazesoba Roman Amemura, 2-11-9 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–15:30 and 17:00–5:00 next morning; no reservations; no e-money, QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 20 September 2026. 2026 reviews (September–October): abura soba ¥850; A set (rice and karaage) ¥300; a digital ticket machine, but just after opening electronic payment didn't work, so cash; add vinegar and chili oil; thick wavy house-made noodles; not greasy for abura soba; live-music venues nearby; first shop in Morinomiya in 2022; branches opened in Kobe Motomachi and Kishiwada the month before; maze-soba ¥1,000 and rice ¥50; about 3 tables and 8 counter seats; water and spoons self-serve; more sauce than expected and strong shoyu; spicy miso and garlic on the table; fish powder and shichimi on the self-serve shelf; tonkotsu ramen from 22:00; tonkotsu ramen ¥900 and leek ¥100; back fat; chashu; a sticker for one free topping; meat-heaped tonkotsu ramen ¥1,100 and soft-boiled egg ¥100; thin straight noodles; garlic, spicy miso, black pepper, ground sesame and chili oil on the table; everything-on abura soba with kimchi and fried onion; Taiwan maze-soba; open until morning.

食べログ: 法善寺 三平、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-9 日宝横丁ビル1F、26席.en: Tabelog: Hozenji Sanpei, Nippo Yokocho Bldg 1F, 1-7-9 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 26 seats (counter 8, tables 18); Mon and Wed–Fri 17:00–23:00 (food L.O. 22:00, drinks L.O. 22:30), Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–15:30 (L.O. 14:45) and 17:00–23:00; closed Tuesdays; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; features: vegetables, vegetarian menu; shop introduction: okonomiyaki with a fluffy batter, mentaiko-butter yakisoba, last entry 22:00. 2026 reviews (June–September): reservation; queues of overseas diners; the beef-tendon, leek and konnyaku is popular; the mix (pork, squid, shrimp) is on the light side; with a colleague from Nagoya; seafood yakisoba; leek tonpei; big shrimp; hard to find in the alleys of Hozenji Yokocho; you can get in right after opening; fast service; big ingredients; modan-yaki; grilled squid (salt and lemon); chicken thigh with ponzu; the fluffiest ever; bonito flakes and sauce.

食べログ: 法善寺 山岡、大阪市中央区難波1-1-14(法善寺横丁の入口)、05.en: Tabelog: Hozenji Yamaoka, 1-1-14 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka (entrance to Hozenji Yokocho), 050-5589-6219; reservations accepted; Mon, Tue and Thu–Sun 17:30–23:00; closed Wednesdays; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; service charge; 10 seats. Reviews (2024–2026): a menu that changes monthly; one wants to visit every season; assortment (unusual fish, small junsai); sashimi adjusted for a bonito allergy; sweet swordfish; grilled anago with plum paste; Yanagawa nabe; about 8 dishes including dessert; omakase only; for drinks, have the taisho choose the sake; the owner cooks almost single-handed; delicate cooking; sashimi on a big block of ice; house-made fruit sours; a rice ball to take home; prices on the high side.

食べログ: 法善寺 鮨 さかた、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-11、050-5597.en: Tabelog: Hozenji Sushi Sakata, 1-7-11 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5597-0299; reservations accepted (not for those who can't eat raw food; treated as cancelled after 30 minutes without contact; cancellation fee); daily 12:00–14:00 (L.O. 13:30) and 17:30–22:30 (L.O. 21:30); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 10 seats (counter only); opened 1 October 2025. 2026 reviews (August–October): Hozenji Yokocho; a pale green noren; a warm wooden counter; washi lighting; Edomae omakase by a young sushi chef; aged sea bream; flounder from Aomori; bonito marinated with katsuobushi; kasugo (young sea bream); never-frozen squid from Kushimoto; anago with tsume sauce made from the bones; nothing ready-made, kanpyo, dashi and desserts all made in-house; omakase ¥14,300; full; lunch course; mostly Japanese diners; low in salt; white-miso pudding; large grains of rice with strong vinegar; oysters; bafun uni added; a friendly taisho.

食べログ: 泰明庵(たいめいあん)、銀座6-3-14、52席、平日11:30〜2.en: Tabelog: Taimei-an, Ginza 6-3-14; 52 seats; weekdays 11:30–21:00 (open straight through), closed weekends and holidays (closed Saturdays too from September 2026); no service charge; founded in 1950 as a fish shop, changed business in 1955. DIME: a long-established shop known for its winter-only "seri curry soba". Reviews: a back street near Taimei Elementary School; busy with office workers at lunch; you can drink from noon; herring and squid tempura, fried eggplant, dashimaki, seri ohitashi, seiro, chicken soba, tanuki soba ¥680 (December 2024); big portions, reasonably priced; mostly Japanese customers.

食べログ: 洋食グリル木村家、銀座4-5-7 銀座木村家3F、銀座駅A9出口すぐ.en: Tabelog: Yoshoku Grill Kimuraya, Ginza 4-5-7, Ginza Kimuraya 3F, right by Ginza Station exit A9; 48 seats (all tables); daily 11:00–15:30, 16:30–20:00 (L.O. 19:00); closed 12/31 and 1/1; no reservations; allergen labeling; English menu; children's menu; strollers welcome; official site ginzakimuraya.jp. Shop introduction: old-fashioned yōshoku with all-you-can-eat Kimuraya house bread; beef stew of quality beef; crab cream croquettes packed with filling. 2026 reviews: beef stew ¥2,900; gratin ¥2,480; chicken and prosciutto salad ¥1,900; baguette fragrant with wheat; slightly sweet round bread; raisins; crab cream croquette and hamburg-steak curry gratin; 10 groups waiting at 13:00, seated in 30 minutes; window seats.

食べログ: 浅草茶屋たばねのし 大阪心斎橋店、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-6-34、.en: Tabelog: Asakusa Chaya Tabanenoshi Osaka Shinsaibashi, 1-6-34 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station; opposite the Daimaru Shinsaibashi car park; weekdays and holidays 11:30–21:00, Sat 11:00–21:00, Sun 10:00–20:00 (L.O. 15 minutes before closing); opened 30 September 2024; no reservations; cards, e-money and QR accepted; no smoking; 8 seats; English menu; takeaway; a Japanese-crêpe specialist using Kakegawa matcha; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): a chain from Asakusa; on Shimizumachi-suji; Kakegawa matcha brûlée (chewy matcha crêpe with matcha custard or cream, strawberries, matcha ice cream, caramelised top); autumn-only Tsukimi brûlée ¥1,250; hojicha and anko butter; Kakegawa matcha soft-serve; matcha latte; hojicha latte; ¥50 off drinks in a set; made in front of you; about 5 tables, full at weekends; takeaway too.

食べログ: 浪花オムライス、大阪市中央区南船場3-11-27 日宝シルバービル1.en: Tabelog: Naniwa Omurice, Nippo Silver Bldg 1F, 3-11-27 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 1; Mon 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–22:00, Tue 12:00–16:00 and 18:00–22:30, Wed 11:00–16:00 and 17:00–22:00, Thu 12:00–16:00 and 17:00–23:00, Fri–Sat 12:00–15:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sun 12:00–20:00; cash only; 6 counter seats. Reviews (July–October 2026): a back-street shop; the signature Naniwa omurice (fluffy egg, rich demi-glace, slow-simmered beef-tendon dote-ni and leek); with cheese too; sizes SS, S and regular (even SS fills you); choose rice amount and toppings; dote-ni on its own (large); hand-kneaded hamburg; the beef steak sometimes sells out; busy at lunch; a short wait at weekends.

食べログ: 浪速氷室、大阪市西区北堀江1-11-3、四ツ橋駅6番出口から徒歩1分.en: Tabelog: Naniwa Korishitsu, 1-11-3 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 6; 12:00–18:00; closed on rainy days; kakigori in summer only; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; a bench for 3; takeaway. Reviews (August–September 2026): an old-style ice shop open only in summer; big blocks of clear ice shaved fine; fluffy, less brain-freeze; ¥360 a cup (strawberry, melon, Hawaiian blue, lemon with house syrup); extra milk ¥100, change from ¥500; lemonade; eaten standing on the pavement; short queues on hot afternoons; many families; a photo caption says 'next time maybe strawberry with extra milk'; the 2026 season ended on 23 September.

食べログ: 海鍋亭 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-5-6 つく志会館 1F、.en: Tabelog: Umi Nabe Tei Shinsaibashi, Tsukushi Kaikan 1F, 2-5-6 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi and Namba stations; Mon–Fri 18:00–1:00 next morning, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:00–1:00 next morning; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 7, two tables for 4); private hire on request; opened 20 November 2023.
