Reviews (August–October 2026): seafood hot pots of shrimp, offal, scallop and oyster; crab-miso gratin; shrimp shabu is popular; smoking allowed; shrimp-shabu course at 18:00 at the weekend; autograph boards; 5 kinds of sashimi (sweet shrimp and more); 2 pieces of sushi; about 1 kg of shrimp (about 10); can be eaten raw; risotto or noodles to finish; cheese; vanilla, chocolate or yuzu ice cream; hearty oyster hot pot ¥2,490 (per person); 3-shrimp tasting ¥990; 3 raw oysters ¥990; tuna yamakake ¥590; scallop skewer ¥490; squid skewer ¥290; 3-piece sushi platter ¥990; 1 kg of oysters; miso-butter soup; bean sprouts, nira, napa cabbage; 3 raw oysters ¥999 (direct from Hiroshima); hearty oyster hot pot ¥2,739; shrimp yukhoe ¥869; 2 pieces sushi ¥759; oyster miso-butter ramen ¥539; miso-butter risotto ¥649; cheese ¥100; pork and vegetables in the oyster hot pot; negitoro and eel hand rolls.

食べログ: 清麺屋、大阪市浪速区日本橋西1-4-8 マンション田中1F、南海なん.en: Tabelog: Seimenya, Mansion Tanaka 1F, 1-4-8 Nipponbashi-nishi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Nankai Namba Station, 5 min from Ebisucho Station; Mon and Wed–Fri 11:00–15:00, Sat–Sun 11:00–16:00; closed Tuesdays; PayPay accepted, no cards or e-money; 13 seats (counter 5, four tables for 2); no smoking; opened 1 November 2013; families and wheelchairs welcome. Reviews (August–October 2026): the southern end of Otaroad; limited tori-paitan curry ball; gentle tori paitan with medium-thick wavy noodles; cold niboshi soba ¥1,250; ticket machine; the two people in the kitchen and front of house are careful; red onion and chashu; strong niboshi; straight noodles; soup poured over rice like a cold chazuke; furikake; chicken-shoyu dipping soup with tenkasu and black shichimi; chicken-shoyu tsukemen (medium) ¥1,330; a shop loved for years; glossy noodles; a dipping soup that isn't too strong; about 15 minutes until served.

食べログ: 湯火功夫、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-6-19、06-6125-5283.en: Tabelog: Tang Huo Kung Fu, 2-6-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6125-5283; 38 seats (counter and tables); Sun–Thu and holidays 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30), Fri–Sat 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); irregular closing days; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 15 November 2019. 2026 reviews (March–October): many Chinese diners; authentic heat and numbing spice; coriander wilts when simmered; a chain with many shops in China; choose ingredients and soup; crab sticks, glass noodles and coriander recommended; adjustable heat; plenty of vegetables; renovated and clean; lots of seafood such as shrimp and octopus; many kinds of noodles; heat level 2 is hot enough; sesame sauce or coriander black vinegar; chicken wings, fried bread, sesame balls; sweet Chinese tea; panda-shaped ingredients; a medicinal-herb flavour; ¥380 per 100 g; soup of beef bones simmered 8 hours, finished with a special sesame and peanut sauce; tasty even non-spicy.

食べログ: 濃厚中華そば よし田、大阪市中央区南船場3-6-25 IBC心斎橋e.en: Tabelog: Noukou Chuka Soba Yoshida, IBC Shinsaibashi east 1F, 3-6-25 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 211 m from Shinsaibashi Station; Mon 11:00–15:30 (L.O. 15:00), Tue–Sat 11:00–17:00 (L.O. 16:30); closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats (counter 12, four tables for 2); opened 25 April 2019. Reviews (August–October 2026): seasonal limited editions; October's sweet-spicy thickened shoyu ramen (from sweetness to heat and umami; garlic, nira, tofu; chunky chashu and back fat; thick wavy noodles; makes you want white rice); September's extra-vegetable back-fat miso butter corn; summer cold editions; a popular shop; thickened numbing-hot shoyu ramen ¥1,350 with rich fried rice set ¥280; like mapo noodles; restrained numbing and heat; small rice free until 14:00; back-fat chuka soba and maze-soba too; ticket machine; one calls it the best shoyu ramen; gentle but with solid shoyu; the fat isn't cloying; noodles with wheat flavour; many men dining alone; quick turnover; one says a strong sansho aroma but not hot.

食べログ: 炭屋 こばこ、大阪市中央区日本橋2-4-10 日本橋ＵＫビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Sumiya Kobako, Nihonbashi UK Bldg 1F, 2-4-10 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nippombashi Station; daily 17:00–24:00 (L.O. food 23:00, drinks 23:30); closes when sold out; irregular closing days; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 18 seats (counter 6, three tables for 4); heated tobacco only inside. Reviews (May 2025 – October 2026): a small yakitori shop just off the shopping street; suited to small groups; skewers with salt, tare or wasabi; gizzard & negima; skin; furisode; tsukune; kokoro; neck; tsunagi; chicken sashimi platter; whole onion grilled with butter and salt-pepper; kara-age; yamaimo yuzu-zuke; chilled tofu topped with shiso; fries; a rich chicken soup with grilled rice ball to finish; katsuobushi TKG; Tanizake (about 80 ml for about ¥600); bottled Sapporo Lager Akaboshi; book ahead; one found service a little slow.

食べログ: 炭火串焼き 日向屋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-3 GROOVE心.en: Tabelog: Sumibi Kushiyaki Hinataya, GROOVE Shinsaibashi East 1F, 1-17-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; daily 16:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); irregular closing days; opened 18 January 2021; 20 seats (counter 8 and tables); cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; smoking allowed. Reviews (April–August 2026): yakitori grilled with care one skewer at a time; pork skewers; spicy offal; fried cartilage; doteyaki; gatsu kimchi; sweet potato with honey mayo; draught beer ¥500 (incl. tax); a brimming highball; a chopstick lottery with messages; strongish seasoning, made for drinking; some found the staff cheerful, others curt and pushy.

食べログ: 炭火焼 鳥清、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-9-13 3F、長堀橋駅5-B.en: Tabelog: Sumibiyaki Torisei, 3F, 1-9-13 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 5-B; Mon–Sat and holidays 17:30–23:00 (L.O. food 22:00, drinks 22:30); closed Sundays; cover charge ¥600 (included in course prices); cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 13 seats. Reviews (September–October 2026): on the 3rd floor of a small building, easy to walk past; courses only, such as ¥5,500; starters; tataki; skewers slow-grilled over charcoal (neck, tsukune); vegetables; grilled quail egg; a very hot chicken soup to finish; extra chicken sashimi; green-plum ice cream; Kirin Lager; small skewers but many of them, so filling; one found them salty; one felt it a little rushed.

食べログ: 炭焼き 銀座まつもと、銀座7-7-19 ニューセンタービル2F、銀座.en: Tabelog: Sumiyaki Ginza Matsumoto, Ginza 7-7-19, New Center Building 2F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station; 36 seats; weekdays 11:45–15:00, 17:30–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:45–15:00 (also listed as lunch only on Sundays and holidays); irregular holidays; ¥500 cover charge at dinner; fully private rooms for 6–20; opened May 10, 2021; official site ginza-matsumoto.com. Shop introduction: 100% black-wagyu hamburg steak grilled over charcoal; lunch course ¥3,000 (starter, house consommé, main, curry rice); wine and seasonal grills and steak at night. 2026 reviews: Japanese black wagyu ground every morning, deep-red and rare inside; a hot iron lid to cook it to your liking; wagyu hamburg steak 200 g ¥2,300; brown rice; three sauces of onion, balsamic and grainy mustard (the mustard goes best); cut at the table; reheated a cooled iron plate; many travelers from overseas; about ¥2,000 at lunch and over ¥6,000 at night.

食べログ: 炭焼鳥miya、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-32 登美弥ビル1F、地.en: Tabelog: Sumiyaki-dori miya, Tomiya Bldg 1F, 2-3-32 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from subway Namba Station exit 14; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–6:00 next morning (L.O. 5:30), Sun 18:00–24:00 (L.O. 23:30); reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking allowed; 16 seats (counter 10, tables 6); salt yakitori, salt tsukune, a 130 g charcoal-grilled speciality. Reviews (November 2024 – January 2026): mostly counter with one table; book for 4 or more; the owner runs it almost single-handed; salt yakitori; chicken sashimi; tataki; yukhoe; daily specials on the whiteboard (octopus, bruschetta, beef tongue, butter-fried king oyster, garlic shrimp); grilled rice ball in house chicken soup; course with all-you-can-drink ¥4,950 (yakitori, chicken sashimi, old-hen ponzu, 2 small dishes, grilled rice ball); solo bookings accepted; superb skin; all-you-can-drink with 3-dish course ¥2,750 (obanzai, 3 recommended skewers); fun conversation with the owner; a long narrow shop; regulars drinking from kept bottles; one felt prices had risen; party course ¥4,000 (3 obanzai, chicken sashimi, 5 skewers or skirt steak, house karaage, chicken-avocado baguette sandwich, grilled rice ball); smoking allowed; can't see in from outside; one called it ordinary.

食べログ: 無限ラーメン 千日前店、大阪市中央区難波1-2-2、毎日11:00〜.en: Tabelog: Mugen Ramen Sennichimae, 1-2-2 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–22:00; cards accepted (VISA); opened 12 August 2023. 2026 reviews (September–October): many overseas diners and prices on the high side; limited ramen over ¥2,000; good beef-bone soup; the loin rice bowl in the set is salty; nearly all overseas diners even on weekdays; plenty of side dishes; electronic payment accepted; rich creamy beef-bone paitan; easy to eat; one had concerns about cleanliness; the tonkotsu ramen is not too strong; noodles slightly firm; a mala-style spicy condiment; frothy creamy soup; two kinds of chashu, seared and moist; soft-boiled seasoned egg; leek; menma; shoyu kaeshi; chicken bones and beef knuckle; back-fat aroma oil; thin straight noodles.

食べログ: 無限ラーメン 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区南船場3-7-24、心斎橋から2.en: Tabelog: Mugen Ramen Shinsaibashi, 3-7-24 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 287 m from Shinsaibashi; no opening hours listed; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 15 September 2024. Reviews (August–October 2026): the most expensive ramen; marbled loin like roast beef; quiet right after opening; usually a queue; frothy soup; rich but not cloying; a slight smell in one of the 2 kinds of chashu; busy around 22:00; beef-bone paitan ramen ¥1,050; chose rich; kiwi ramen; a strong beef-bone flavour; easier to drink than it looks; beef-bone paitan ramen with seasoned egg ¥130; 80% full at weekday lunch; a creamy soup and thin noodles reminiscent of Hakata ramen; slight sweetness; one slice of chashu; set with small melting-chashu rice bowl ¥1,450; toppings differ by shop.

食べログ: 無限ラーメン、大阪市浪速区難波中3-16-7、大国町から429m、毎.en: Tabelog: Mugen Ramen, 3-16-7 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 429 m from Daikokucho; daily 11:00–23:00; irregular closing days; e-money accepted, no cards or QR; no smoking; opened 21 December 2020. Reviews (April–August 2026): aroma of beef bones; beef-bone paitan ramen; spicy beef-bone chashu-men; rich and creamy; roast beef and fatty brisket; set with mini chashu rice bowl; the rice soggy and salty; many overseas staff and diners; a menu for inbound visitors; Sichuan pepper; heat milder than Shin Ramyun; nira; tough, strongly seasoned chashu; one found it underwhelming for ¥1,350; slow service; rich.

食べログ: 焼うおいし川 銀座凛華楼、銀座4-6-16 三越銀座店新館12F、2.en: Tabelog: Yaki Uo Ishikawa Ginza 凛華楼, Ginza 4-6-16, Mitsukoshi Ginza Annex 12F; 24 seats (13 counter, a private counter room for 9); weekdays 11:00–15:00, 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; closed January 1; opened September 25, 2025; official site yakiuo-ishikawa.jp. Shop introduction: "yakiniku that grills no meat" = yaki-uo, eight years in the making by the founder of Tsukiji Aozora; o-toro as "special kalbi"; house condiments and sauces; red-vinegar rice. 2026 reviews: ladies' lunch (rice refills, cold noodles, dessert); fish grilled in front of you, starting with the head; yukhoe-style and sukiyaki-style dishes; raw mehikari; sukiyaki course about ¥4,000 + ¥400 service charge; many customers from Hong Kong and Singapore; a little salty; some waiting.

食べログ: 焼き鳥 熾火、大阪市中央区船場中央4-1-10 船場センタービル10.en: Tabelog: Yakitori Okibi, Semba Center Bldg No. 10 B1F, 4-1-10 Semba-chuo, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 92 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:30–22:30 (L.O. 22:00; lunch 11:30–15:00); closed Sundays; cards, e-money and QR accepted; smoking area in front of the shop; 15 counter seats. Reviews (September–October 2026): yakitori of Banshu Akadori aged 5 days; breast and negima ¥300 each (tare or salt); tsukune; aged thigh tataki ¥780; thigh and breast tataki tasting; crab miso and cream cheese with flaked crab and ikura; chicken liver simmered with sansho; mapo tofu; shrimp marinated in Shaoxing wine; oyakodon to finish; ramen at lunch (tori paitan; tori-paitan chashu-men with pork and chicken rare chashu and seasoned egg ¥1,450; chicken-dashi black-sesame tantanmen; noodles custom-made by Sugano Seimenjo); friendly, courteous staff.

食べログ: 焼肉 Union、大阪市西区新町2-17-5 アクトワン新町 1F、.en: Tabelog: Yakiniku Union, Act One Shinmachi 1F, 2-17-5 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 7 min walk from Nishi-Ohashi Station, 1 min from Life Nishi-Ohashi; Mon, Wed–Sun and holidays 18:00–23:00 (L.O. food 22:30); closed Tuesdays; cards, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; heated tobacco allowed inside; 11 seats (counter 6, tables 5). Reviews (May–October 2026): a stylish yakiniku restaurant; wagyu yukhoe ¥1,600; wagyu skirt-sashimi yukhoe ¥1,600; Kuroge wagyu premium tongue ¥3,500 (limited); top salted tongue ¥2,800; premium skirt ¥2,200; premium lean ¥1,800; top lean ¥1,200; heart sashimi; abu-hatsu; tsurami; mino; kori kori; tongue kalbi; omakase platter (say lean or kalbi); wagyu chiritori nabe (lean and offal, vegetables, extra available); reimen ¥800; yukgaejang soup ¥800; kimchi ¥800; spicy grated-daikon ponzu ¥400; rice ¥350; about ¥10,000 each; same-day bookings possible; pleasant staff.

食べログ: 焼肉とかすうどん 龍の巣 銀座七丁目 G7、銀座7-2-8、銀座駅C.en: Tabelog: Yakiniku and kasu udon Ryunosu Ginza 7-chome G7, Ginza 7-2-8, 5 minutes from Ginza Station exit C2 and Shinbashi Station Ginza exit; 40 seats (20 counter and more, 1 semi-private room); Mon–Sat 17:00–5:00, Sundays and holidays 17:00–24:00; open every day; smoking area for heated tobacco only; children welcome; opened December 21, 2020; official site ryu-nosu.co.jp. Shop introduction: carefully chosen Yamagata beef and wine by the glass; a wide counter, fine alone too; a semi-private room and big tables. 2026 reviews: tender tongue; the famous kasu udon; a guess-the-wine game; otoshi set ¥1,080; ura-harami ¥1,780; bean-sprout namul ¥580; thin-sliced lean tongue with scallions ¥1,780; raw liver ¥1,280; to finish after drinking; late-night hours; cheerful staff.

食べログ: 焼飯と麺、大阪市中央区大手前1-6-3、天満橋から44m、月〜金 1.en: Tabelog: Yakimeshi to Men, 1-6-3 Otemae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 44 m from Tenmabashi; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 17:30–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:00–21:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 14 seats (counter 4, five tables for 2); opened 13 May 2024. Reviews (August–October 2026): ticket machine on the ground floor (cash only, no ¥5,000 or ¥10,000 notes); seats upstairs via steep, narrow stairs; water and returns self-serve; chuka soba and half fried rice set ¥1,280–1,290 (one says it was ¥980 the week before); thin straight noodles with a soba-like texture; a light shoyu soup; 2 slices of rare chashu; thick menma; white and green leek; seasoned egg; fragrant, fluffy fried rice of leek, chashu and egg; some come for the fried rice, others found both bland; the banners advertise fried rice.

食べログ: 焼鳥 御廉、大阪市中央区難波1-3-13、御堂筋線なんば駅B16出口.en: Tabelog: Yakitori Oren, 1-3-13 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Midosuji Line Namba Station exit B16; daily 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); irregular closing days (announced on Instagram); reservations accepted; service charge ¥500; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 14 seats (counter 6, tables 8); opened 1 June 2024; private hire by phone. Reviews (August–October 2026): the owner met a request made in advance; sasami yakitori; liver kamameshi; kamameshi to finish; draught beer from a swing tap; limited junmai daiginjo of Toyo Bijin; 9-skewer yakitori course; half jidori sashimi; the rare cut 'sori'; 7-skewer course with liver sashimi and 3 skewers; negima, neck, chochin, cartilage; reservation essential; the 2nd floor is hot-pot courses only; yakitori at the ground-floor counter; 9 skewers and chawanmushi course ¥3,500; soft-drink refills; fresh liver and tataki; 5-skewer course; kumquats pickled in shoyu; one says fewer dishes for the same price; cream cheese pickled in shoyu; private hire and all-you-can-drink upstairs; 6 seats at an L-shaped counter; neck, heart, wing, gizzard, sasami.

食べログ: 焼鳥と釜飯 なかもと、大阪市中央区難波4-3-23、06-6633-.en: Tabelog: Yakitori to Kamameshi Nakamoto, 4-3-23 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6633-3338; 48 seats (up to 50 seated); daily 17:00–4:00 next morning (food L.O. 3:00, drinks L.O. 3:30); open every day of the year; smoking on the terrace only; 2-hour limit when busy; cards and QR payment accepted (no e-money); opened 4 April 2025. 2026 reviews (January–August): reviews call it 'Yakitori to Kamameshi Gocchin'; a back alley right by Namba Station; red lanterns; a Kyushu-style izakaya; chicken soboro and burdock kamameshi; smoke drifts up to the 2nd floor; mobile ordering; on the site of a former Thai street-food place; SASAYA group; yakitori not on skewers; 3-kind yakitori platter ¥1,320 (ordered after registering on LINE); 3 grilled vegetables ¥1,078; fried mehikari ¥858; edamame as the table charge ¥418; outdoor seats; the kamameshi takes time, order early; meat dishes and vegetable dishes too.

食べログ: 熟成鮨 利他 なんば心斎橋、大阪市中央区西心斎橋2-6-7 s-Fr.en: Tabelog: Jukusei Sushi Rita Namba Shinsaibashi, s-Front Dotonbori 3F, 2-6-7 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka (opposite APA Hotel Namba Shinsaibashi, a grey building beside a car park; new, so may not appear on maps); 236 m from Osaka-Namba; reservations only; dinner from 18:00 and 20:30, weekend and holiday lunch from 12:00; irregular closing days; 5% service charge from December 2025; private hire for 12 or more by arrangement a month ahead; cards accepted (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners, UnionPay), no e-money or QR; 18 seats; private room; opened 1 May 2025. Reviews (September–October 2026): ageing time varied by fish; careful explanations; considerate about photos; a surprise birthday plate; aged-sushi omakase ¥14,800; 10–12 nigiri with sashimi, grilled, simmered and soup courses; one says many overseas diners; sea bream with tosa-vinegar jelly over binchotan; flash-frozen, scored aori squid with Himalayan rock salt and sudachi; striped jack aged 7 days; king crab and snow crab chawanmushi; seared Kesennuma bonito with ginger; dry-aged chutoro on rice at 42 °C; Densuke anago shabu-shabu; the signature botan shrimp with shrimp roe and sea urchin; Saikyo-miso yuan-yaki of yellowtail; kinmedai aged 6 days; amberjack roll with gari, sprouted leek and honey ume; ara-jiru from trimmings grilled 20 minutes and simmered 4 hours; alum-free sea urchin in brine; marinated lean tuna; vanilla pudding; 'ultimate umami with time on its side'.

食べログ: 燙楽屋 麻辣湯、大阪市中央区日本橋1-20-2 1F、06-6556.en: Tabelog: Tangleya Malatang, 1F, 1-20-2 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6556-7168; no reservations; daily 11:00–23:59 (L.O. 23:45); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 25 seats; no smoking; opened 11 July 2025; site 0665567168.com. 2026 reviews (April–August): unlimited coriander; quail eggs; fish-roe kamaboko; sweet-potato noodles; the shrimp is best; one found the soup a little thin; unlimited leek; about ¥2,000 at 30% off; over 70 ingredients; radish cake; shredded kombu; Spam; chewy knife-cut noodles; glass noodles and fu; heat level 2 tastes like a light tonkotsu; weigh, pay and wait with a number tag; minimum weight; near Kuromon Market; 20% off; attentive staff; aprons and baskets; only slightly spicy at first, then gradually addictive; a flavour tuned for Japanese diners.

食べログ: 片岡篤司、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-11 クイント心斎橋ビル 1.en: Tabelog: Kataoka Atsushi, Quinto Shinsaibashi Bldg 1F, Higashi-Shinsaibashi 1-13-11, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 350 m from Shinsaibashi Stn, 229 m from Nagahoribashi Stn; Mon, Tue, Thu–Sun 18:00–23:00; closed Wednesday; reservation only; cards, Rakuten Edy, iD, QUICPay, PayPay and Rakuten Pay accepted; 9 seats (counter 8); non-smoking; opened 17 November 2024. Reviews (January 2025–October 2026): Kataoka, who led Sushi Shizuku Nagahori, went independent; bookings filled more than three months ahead before opening and now there's a six-month wait; book via the OMAKASE site or Instagram DM (@atushi.sushi); a grey Italian plaster wall with the name in vertical stainless-steel letters; several kinds of shari matched to the toppings, firm red-vinegar seasoning, firm and on the large side; sushi course ¥25,000; Akashi sea bream, Awaji squid, Nemuro ikura, charcoal-grilled Chiba hairtail, Kesennuma bonito, Lake Biwa trout, Otaru saury with matsutake rice, marinated tuna, chu-toro, Kishiwada kintaro sardine, Hokkaido botan shrimp, simmered anago; add-ons: toro-taku roll and "adult" ebi mayo; apprentice Kanta; a young taishō; some found it too salty.

食べログ: 牛骨ら～めん ぶっこ志 北浜店、大阪市中央区道修町1-5-12、北浜.en: Tabelog: Gyukotsu Ramen Bukkoshi Kitahama, 1-5-12 Doshomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Kitahama Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–14:30 and 17:30–22:45; closed weekends; no cards, e-money or QR; 11 counter seats; opened 11 July 2016. Reviews (September–October 2026): a beef-bone soup specialist; one says it belongs to the Kokorozashi group; spicy beef paitan with seasoned egg ¥1,100; balance of creamy soup and heat; meal tickets; self-serve water; one says about 8 counter seats; cloudy white soup; 2 slices of chashu; shredded white leek; pea shoots; noodles a little firm; extra-meat beef-bone paitan ¥1,250; white rice ¥100 at lunch; beef-belly chashu; baby corn; house-made straight noodles; check Instagram for Sunday opening; no dairy, light yet rich; roast-pork rice bowl sold out, so roast-beef rice; one found the chashu smelly; beef-bone paitan ramen (seasoned egg) ¥850; good after drinking too.

食べログ: 牡蠣 HachiRou 86、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-2-29 五つ.en: Tabelog: Kaki HachiRou 86, Itsutsuboshi Bldg 5F, 2-2-29 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; east from the GU on Shinsaibashisuji shopping street; Mon–Thu and days before and after holidays 18:00–1:00 next morning, Fri, Sat, Sun and holidays 17:30–1:00 next morning (food L.O. 24:00); reservations accepted (50% for same-day course cancellations); cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 16 seats (counter 6, tables); opened 20 April 2011. Reviews (March–September 2026): oyster tasting; steamed oysters; oyster gratin; fried oysters; oyster jjigae; oysters to enjoy affordably; superb raw oysters; piping-hot fried oysters; a bar-like atmosphere, good for a date; round tables for two; tasting of 5 seasonal raw oysters; one found some oysters fishy; rock oysters from Murotsu (Hyogo) are rich; rock oysters from Naruto (Tokushima) are milk of the sea; ajillo and clay-pot rice (takes 30 minutes, order first); 5 raw oysters; wines to match oysters; oyster pasta.

食べログ: 玉製家、大阪市中央区千日前1-4-4、日本橋駅B28出口から99m、.en: Tabelog: Gyokusei Ya, 1-4-4 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 99 m from Nippombashi Station exit B28; 14:00 until sold out; closed Wednesdays, Thursdays, Sundays and holidays (open during the equinox weeks and Obon); no cards, e-money or QR; takeaway only; Tabelog Sweets Hyakumeiten 2017–2022, Wagashi & Kanmi WEST Hyakumeiten 2023 and 2026. October 2026 reviews: about 20 people 40 minutes before opening, about 40 at opening; served at 3:10; a box of 6 with 3 smooth-bean and 3 kinako; up to 2 of the 3 kinds; made to order; not too sweet, gentle; still good 4 hours later; a 2-hour wait in the rain; coarse-bean kinako and smooth-bean kinako, 6 each ¥1,170; kinako same day, bean paste until the next day; welcomed as a gift; even people who dislike ohagi like these; a 1 hour 45 minute wait; just before selling out; a simple bean paste; smooth like mochi; small, so even 6 are manageable; a faint saltiness in the bean paste; lightly pounded glutinous rice; fine kinako; a 2-hour wait from 16:00.

食べログ: 王冠、うどん・立ち食いそば・ラーメン、大阪市阿倍野区阿倍野筋1-1-.en: Tabelog: Oukan; udon, stand-up soba and ramen; Osaka Abenobashi Station B1F, outside the ticket gates, 1-1-43 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; on the way up the stairs to Exit 1 after leaving the underground central gate; 33 m from Osaka Abenobashi Station; daily 6:00–16:00; closing days not fixed; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; 6 counter seats with standing room in front and chairs at the back; non-smoking. Reviews (September 2024–August 2026): a shop with a noren on the stair landing; open from 6 am; buy a ticket at the machine and hand it over; kake soba ¥320, kitsune soba ¥400, kakiage soba ¥420, kakiage udon ¥420 (a large kakiage with corn and green beans), tempura udon ¥440 (shrimp tempura, kakiage, wakame), tempura soba ¥440, kasu udon ¥550, katsu udon ¥550, curry udon with braised beef, croquette soba, Ekimae soba with yellow Chinese noodles in dashi, soba set ¥500 (soba, rice, croquette), the udon-and-soba set up from ¥450 to ¥500, tsukimi soba set meal ¥530, raw egg ¥90 (earlier ¥70), boiled egg ¥70; the soy sauce goes in first, then the dashi; some praise the light Kansai-style dashi, others find the noodles soft and ordinary; some say the tempura is commercial, others that it is fried in the shop; an older man and a young woman on staff; a Showa-era feel; cash only.

食べログ: 王道家直系 我道家 OSAKA本店、大阪市浪速区湊町1-3-1 リバ.en: Tabelog: Odoya-chokkei Gadoya OSAKA main shop, River Place B1F, 1-3-1 Minatomachi, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; no reservations; Tue–Sun 7:00–3:00 next morning; closed Mondays and the day after holidays (open if Monday is a holiday, closed the next day); no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; in the Minatomachi River Place car park; opened 28 December 2024. 2026 reviews (October and others): chashu-men (large) with everything regular; plenty of spinach; the soup's strength varies by day; opens early in the morning; Odo ramen with medium rice and the famous fried offal; adjusting the soup; one calls it Osaka's No. 1 iekei; sometimes salty; ramen regular ¥1,000 (black bowl with gold rim, rich brown soup, 2 big slices of chashu, spinach, 3 sheets of nori, tonkotsu shoyu, fine droplets of oil, a strong shoyu edge with pork and chicken umami, medium-thick chewy noodles); 15 people waiting after midnight, about 40 minutes; Odoya-certified ramen (firm, regular); seasoned egg; small rice; karaage sold out; self-serve water; smoked chashu-men and chashu rice; a fast-pass system; unlimited garlic, chopped ginger and mayonnaise on the table; one was bothered by smudges on the bowl rim.

食べログ: 珉珉 なんばウォーク店、大阪市中央区千日前1 なんばウォーク、06-.en: Tabelog: Minmin Namba Walk, Namba Walk, 1 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6213-6180; 43 seats (tables only); daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed third Wednesday of odd months; no cards or e-money; no smoking; official minminhonten.com. 2026 reviews (August–October): Minmin after a long time; karaage set meal and beer; stir-fried pork and onion; clay-pot mapo tofu set meal and pan-fried gyoza; tantanmen; unfriendly service; ordering by smartphone; free Wi-Fi; Genghis Khan (lamb) set meal ¥880 (rice, zha cai, egg soup); pork tempura and beer ¥1,200; prices as shown; fried rice ¥770; pan-fried gyoza ¥450; mapo rice bowl ¥850; karaage ¥850; squid and nira stir-fry ¥820; full of office workers at lunch; light, easy gyoza.

食べログ: 珉珉 南千日前本店、大阪市中央区千日前2-11-25、06-6641.en: Tabelog: Minmin Minami-Sennichimae main shop, 2-11-25 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6641-6088; 60 seats (ground-floor counter, tables on the 2nd and 3rd floors); daily 11:30–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); open every day of the year; no smoking; cards accepted; official minminhonten.com. 2025–2026 reviews: gyoza and beer; gyoza ¥450; crunchy cabbage; crab and tofu stew; shoyu ramen and gyoza set ¥990 (clear amber soup, thin straight noodles); beer set ¥1,600 (gyoza, mapo tofu, draught beer); memories from over 20 years ago; narrow counter; sweet-and-sour pork set meal; brusque service; staff speak Chinese to each other; before a show at NGK; 2 servings of gyoza ¥900 and bottled beer ¥670; mapo tofu; twice-cooked pork; nira and liver.

食べログ: 珉龍 長堀店、大阪市中央区南船場1-10-16-102、長堀橋駅から.en: Tabelog: Minryu Nagahori, 1-10-16-102 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 210 m from Nagahoribashi Station; no opening hours listed; PayPay accepted, no cards or e-money; 26 seats; smoking allowed. Reviews (March–August 2026): a party of 8; century egg; jellyfish; karaage; gyoza; shrimp mayo; shrimp in chili sauce; twice-cooked pork; 3 kinds of fried rice; fried rice vermicelli; wonton soup; sesame balls; candied sweet potato; strongly seasoned dishes; fast service; champon and fried rice set ¥980; Kansai-style champon with thick sauce; thin noodles; long-established; yakisoba ¥770; 7 gyoza; karaage ¥880; large portions; clean inside; open all day; many set meals; drinks too; strong on delivery; champon ¥858; one says no children; the shoyu ramen and tenshinhan set is ordinary; seated at 15:00 on a Sunday; set meals around ¥900.

食べログ: 現代割烹 法善寺momo、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-7-10 日宝バイス.en: Tabelog: Gendai Kappo Hozenji momo, Nippo By-Street Yokocho Bldg 1F, 1-7-10 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Namba Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 12:00–14:30 and 16:00–22:00; closed Tuesdays (some Tuesdays à la carte by reservation only from 17:00); irregular closures over New Year, Golden Week and Obon; reservations accepted (preschool children in private rooms only); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 18 seats (counter, private rooms, tatami, sunken kotatsu); no smoking; jazz playing; opened 1 October 2021; weekday-only lunch mini course with seasonal clay-pot rice ¥3,000. Reviews (April–October 2026): beautiful tableware and careful cooking; ¥5,000 is good value; the private room is a bit small; choose the main from 2; fried chicken and fish; fried okra; seasonal clay-pot rice (corn, scallop, shiso), leftovers made into rice balls; at the back of a building down an alley; Japanese food and sake in a private room; ¥5,000 course; lotus-root manju with broccoli sauce; fried sanma salad; seconds of chestnut rice and rice balls to take home; prepared ahead and pre-plated; a harsh review that the egg on rice had set; sashimi (sea bream, amberjack, raw octopus); fried sanma or chicken thigh; chestnut rice; mainly counter with one private room; fast service; Japanese creative cooking; affordable under ¥10,000.

食べログ: 瓦町仔鹿、大阪市中央区瓦町1-4-6 市岡宏産ビル B1F、堺筋本町.en: Tabelog: Kawara Machi Bambi, Ichioka Kosan Bldg B1F, 1-4-6 Kawaramachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn Exit 12, 6 min from Kitahama Stn Exit 5; Mon–Sat and holidays 18:00–22:00; closed Sunday; evenings only; closes when sold out; reservations accepted (2-hour limit when busy); cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted; no e-money; 19 seats (7 at the counter, three tables of 4); private hire up to 20; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 13 October 2015. Official site: Kawara Machi Bambi, opened in October 2015 in a building's basement; original Chinese cooking by 河野幸成, former executive chef of a high-end Chinese restaurant; Chinese food that is not heavy; stocks, chili oil and sauces all blended in-house; seasonal menus; 18:00–22:30 last order; closed Sunday. Menu: steamed chicken ¥770, zha cai ¥550, century egg ¥550, house char siu ¥850, cold sliced pork belly ¥850, pan-fried gyoza ¥500, meat shumai wrapped in yuba ¥880, meat shumai with scallop ¥880, fried chicken thigh BAMBI-style ¥800, yurinchi ¥900, fried crab claws ¥880, black-vinegar sweet and sour pork ¥980, spicy mapo tofu ¥1,200, white mapo tofu ¥1,200, shrimp in chili sauce ¥1,000, big shrimp in mayonnaise sauce ¥1,680, crispy fried noodles with seafood sauce ¥1,580, spicy tantanmen ¥1,100, fried rice (green) ¥950, fried rice with crab ¥2,000, ma lai gao, sesame balls, smooth almond tofu, Shaoxing wine. Reviews (May 2025–August 2026): white mapo tofu and green fried rice, a blackboard menu, horse-meat carpaccio, cold summer stir-fry with green peppers, jellyfish, crab potato salad, beef in sweet miso wrapped in lettuce, almond tofu with brown sugar and Shaoxing wine, xiaolongbao, sansho highball, ice shaped like bears and roses, French-like plating, a friendly manager.

食べログ: 甘党 もぐらや、大阪市中央区難波5丁目 NAMBAなんなん、大阪メト.en: Tabelog: Amato Moguraya, NAMBA Nannan, 5-chome Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; directly connected to Osaka Metro Namba Station; daily 10:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:00); closing days follow Nannan; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 20 seats. Reviews (March–October 2026): takeaway ¥90 a skewer, 3 for ¥270; inside, drinks from ¥500; Moheji-yaki; kintsuba; Fukumochi is coarse bean paste in a chewy skin; the kintsuba is lightly sweet and tastes of azuki; sells out late in the day; takeaway from 10:00; mitarashi dango 3 for ¥270; parfaits; warm mitarashi dango; hojicha; moist dorayaki; mitarashi soft-serve; a 10-minute wait; order while waiting; recommended set B ¥880 (mitarashi dango, kinako kanten, bean paste, shiratama, soft-serve); 4 waiting at 14:00 on a weekday, seated in 5 minutes; courteous, quick service.

食べログ: 白樺、銀座7-2-16 THE CITY 銀座6F、新橋駅から徒歩5.en: Tabelog: Shirakaba, Ginza 7-2-16, THE CITY Ginza 6F, 5 minutes from Shinbashi Station; 7 seats; weekdays 11:30–14:00, 17:00–23:30, Sat 17:00–22:00, closed Sun; opened August 20, 2024; cards accepted; ¥20,000–30,000 at night. 2026 reviews: French eaten with chopsticks, teppan, an L-shaped counter, weekday lunch hamburg steak ¥1,500 incl. tax (four sauces, including mushroom demi-glace), salad, rice, sherbet.

食べログ: 目白 旬香亭 丸の内店、千代田区丸の内3-2-3 二重橋スクエアB1.en: Tabelog: Mejiro Shunkoutei Marunouchi, Marunouchi 3-2-3, Chiyoda-ku, 二重橋 Square B1F, directly connected to 二重橋前 Station; 34 seats (tables, 1 private room); Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–15:00, 17:00–22:00, closed Sun; opened June 1, 2024; official site shunkoutei.jp. Shop introduction: the second shop of Mejiro Shunkoutei, listed in the Michelin Guide Tokyo ten years running; "new yet nostalgic yōshoku". October 2026 reviews: thick, meaty hamburg steak; mixed fry (shrimp, squid, fillet cutlet, croquette) with fried oysters added; mushroom potage with rice; course with all-you-can-drink ¥5,500 (starter, fried scallops, hamburg steak, curry rice); crisp croquettes.

食べログ: 相合餅、大阪市中央区千日前1-7-3(千日前1-5-14から移転)、.en: Tabelog: Aioi Mochi, 1-7-3 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka (moved from 1-5-14 Sennichimae); 209 m from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Sat 17:30–1:30 next morning; closed Sundays; cards (JCB, AMEX, Diners) and QR accepted; 7 seats. Reviews (October 2025 – August 2026): mochi in nighttime Dotonbori; a friendly owner; from 17:00; a break after drinking or a souvenir; one says nearly 70 years of history; additive-free, so it doesn't keep; vacuum-packed mochi; white mochi; shiso mochi; yomogi mochi; grilled mochi (yomogi) ¥200; ohagi 5 for ¥900 (kinako, smooth bean paste, coarse bean paste); nights only; cash or PayPay; founded 1961; Aioibashi-suji shopping street near Hozenji; until 1:30 a.m.; inbound visitors; kusa mochi; takeaway from one piece; a nostalgic atmosphere; grilled mochi piping hot; warabi mochi ¥350; sticks to the bag when taken away.

食べログ: 真夜中キッチン うさぎ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-16-19 日宝周防.en: Tabelog: Mayonaka Kitchen Usagi, Nippo Suomachi Kaikan 1F, 1-16-19 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 389 m from Shinsaibashi; Tue–Sun 0:00–8:00; closed Mondays; reservations accepted; no cards, e-money or QR; 10 counter seats. Reviews (April 2022 – May 2026): open until early morning; omurice; macaroni salad; U-shaped counter; a wide menu; potato salad; red sausages; pork kimchi; sweet-potato highball; one says 23:00–8:00 (2024); no big sign; a noren and sliding door; spotlights; one-drink minimum; lemon chuhai ¥560; omurice ¥700; macaroni salad ¥300 (curry-flavoured); full at 5:30 a.m.; octopus sausages; soup; some have come for over 10 years; stamina; the owner's character; cured mackerel; octopus sashimi; midnight to 8 a.m.; blackboard menu; omurice ¥780; the owner says it's a casual izakaya and a drink order is required; cash only; average spend about ¥1,400.

食べログ: 石挽、銀座3-14-17 コビキス銀座2F、東銀座駅から241m、営.en: Tabelog: Ishibiki, Ginza 3-14-17, Kobikiss Ginza 2F, 241 m from Higashi-Ginza Station; no hours or seat count listed. 2026 reviews: a regular of dozens of visits; katsudon (thin cutlet) in a sweet, rich broth with matcha soba for ¥1,000; egg-drop soba (large ¥850; ¥750 incl. tax in October); mori soba and kake soba ¥600; no soba water; shared tables at lunch; leave as soon as you've eaten; large tororo soba ¥1,000; cold natto soba ¥850 (large +¥100, quail egg).

食べログ: 碧 銀座三越、銀座4-6-16 銀座三越12F、40席(テーブル35.en: Tabelog: Heki Ginza Mitsukoshi, Ginza 4-6-16, Ginza Mitsukoshi 12F; 40 seats (35 table, 5 counter); private room for 8; daily 11:00–16:00 (L.O. 15:00), 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed 1/1 and when Mitsukoshi is; children welcome; opened September 10, 2010. 2026 reviews: the Ginza shop of an Okinawan steakhouse, with many staff from Okinawa too; wagyu sirloin; Kumejima prawns; kuruma-prawn crackers; purple sweet potato; goya champuru; shaved-ice zenzai; 80 g black-wagyu fillet; green-papaya starter; blue tableware; sanpin tea; garlic rice extra; lunch from ¥4,200 (thigh steak); Orion beer ¥900; Aomori garlic.

食べログ: 神戸牛すてーきはうす香西 (コウザイ)、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17.en: Tabelog: Kobe Beef Steak House Kozai (Kozai), 丸清ビル 2F, 1-17-15 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min on foot from Exit 5 or 6 of Shinsaibashi Station; daily 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); open all year (closed 31 December – 2 January); reservations accepted (5 or more by phone); cards, PayPay and Alipay accepted; no e-money; no service charge; 12 seats (two counters of 6); non-smoking; English menu; children welcome. Courses: Kobe beef loin steak course 120 g ¥15,970, with two seafood items ¥18,170, Wagyu ribeye steak course 120 g ¥8,800, lunch Wagyu hamburg course from ¥1,540. Reviews (March 2025 – August 2026): 2nd floor of an old building; Showa-era interior with a touch of the bubble years; corn soup, homemade dressing, shrimp and scallops with lemon butter, grilled vegetables, garlic rice; the hamburg with Andes salt and steak sauce; surprised the price had not changed; lunch is a bargain; the cook at the griddle is friendly and good-looking, one diner says.

食べログ: 神虎 肥後橋店、大阪市西区江戸堀1-14-12 オリザ肥後橋 1F、.en: Tabelog: Kami Tora Higobashi, Oriza Higobashi 1F, 1-14-12 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Yotsubashi Line Higobashi Station; daily 10:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30); may close early when busy; closed 30 December – 3 January; no cards, e-money or QR; 19 seats (counter 5, three tables for 4); opened 11 December 2019; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): tonkotsu ramen from the GIN NO BUDOU group, which runs Zagin and others; three kinds, standard, black (burnt garlic) and red (spicy miso); Kami Tora ramen ¥890; seasoned egg ¥150; leek ¥130; wood-ear ¥130; chashu rice bowl ¥410; 4 gyoza ¥280; noodle refill ¥100 whenever you like; extra fat; noodle firmness; a free chashu rice bowl for new app sign-ups; spicy takana, red pickled ginger, garlic, sesame, chili and Akuma sauce on the table; ticket machine outside; 5 waiting even after 14:00 on a weekday; one found it too strong; one wished the soup were hotter; one says Akatora isn't hot; a courteous apology for a mistaken order; brisk service and a send-off outside.

食べログ: 福太郎 なんばダイニングメゾン店、大阪市中央区難波5-1-18 なん.en: Tabelog: Fukutarou Namba Dining Maison, Namba Dining Maison 8F (Osaka Takashimaya), 5-1-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:00); on weekdays L.O. 14:30, reopening at 17:00; closed on Takashimaya closing days; no reservations; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; no smoking; 15 counter seats; takeaway; free partner parking for ¥3,000 or more; official site. Reviews (September–October 2026): come here when the main shop is crowded; orders taken while queuing; cooked on the teppan in front of you; a fluffy, melting batter; beef-tendon negiyaki; mixed okonomiyaki; pork okonomiyaki; seafood okonomiyaki (shrimp, squid, scallop); squid yakisoba; mixed yaki; kimchi; salad; takes time to cook; many takeaway customers.

食べログ: 立ち呑み クック オッソ オッセョ!、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-1-1.en: Tabelog: Tachinomi Cook Osso Osseyo!, Osakaya Jumbo Bldg 1F No. 7, Jumbo Yokocho, 2-1-13 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; the table gives Tue, Wed, Fri and Sat 18:00–24:00, the note says 3 days a week, Tuesday or Wednesday plus Friday and Saturday; closed Mondays, Thursdays, Sundays and holidays; no basic charge (¥500 for drinks only); no cards; e-money, PayPay and au PAY accepted; smoking allowed; standing for about 10; Korean-speaking staff; listed as able to cater for vegetarians; opened 28 January 2010; blog; the name is Korean for 'welcome'. Reviews (2018 – July 2025): a Korean and Italian standing bar; napa-cabbage kimchi ¥350; water kimchi; spicy jjukkumi ¥780; spicy nakji bokkeum (shirako on days without octopus); shrimp jeon; raw oysters with 3 sauces (including gochujang); steamed pork; strawberry makgeolli cocktail; mapo tofu; easy for drinking alone; one found it a little pricey for a standing bar.

食べログ: 竹葉亭 銀座店、銀座5-8-3、70席(地下テーブル24・1階テーブ.en: Tabelog: Chikuyōtei Ginza, Ginza 5-8-3; 70 seats (24 at tables in the basement, 18 at tables on 1F, 28 in tatami rooms on 2F); weekdays 11:30–15:30, 16:30–21:30, weekends and holidays 11:30–16:00, 16:30–21:30; closed 1st and 3rd Mondays; no reservations; cards and QR accepted; no service charge. 2026 reviews: unaju with liver soup, eel bento ¥4,620, umaki, dashimaki, eggplant with miso, sea-bream chazuke (sesame sauce), fluffy Kanto-style eel, a refined sauce; also a shop at Sogo Yokohama; numbered tickets from a touch panel.

食べログ: 笑心、大阪市浪速区難波中3-3-10 清水ビル1F、なんば駅・南海な.en: Tabelog: Egokoro, Shimizu Bldg 1F, 3-3-10 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba and Nankai Namba stations; Mon–Fri 11:30–14:30 and 18:00–21:30, Sun 11:30–15:30; closed Saturdays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; 16 seats (two tables for 4, one for 2, counter 6); smoking allowed; opened 24 September 2008; famous for champon, a place to drink at leisure at night. Reviews (May–September 2026): white champon set meal ¥950; a rich, mellow tonkotsu soup with finely chopped ingredients; ¥50 for rice to make it a set meal; porridge from the leftover soup; red champon set meal; white champon with fried rice set ¥1,200; vinegar and chili oil as the table guide suggests; sara udon; champon is the thing; order verbally; the red is chicken bones with Sichuan doubanjiang, mildly hot; chewy medium-thick champon noodles; the best champon in Namba; visited for years; a neighbourhood-Chinese atmosphere; near Namba Parks; red and white ¥900 each; white is creamy, red mildly spicy.

食べログ: 筋肉食堂 銀座コリドー店、銀座7-2 2F(エレベーターなし)、銀座.en: Tabelog: Kinniku Shokudo Ginza Corridor, Ginza 7-2, 2F (no elevator), 5 minutes from Ginza Station exit C3; 44 seats (34 sofa, 10 counter); weekdays 11:30–15:00, 17:30–23:00, Sat 11:30–23:00, Sundays and holidays 11:30–20:30; no charge; seat-only bookings 90 minutes when busy; opened November 30, 2018; official site kinnikushokudo.jp. Shop introduction: the signature lean-beef hamburg steak; Japanese-beef steak; high-protein, low-calorie dishes such as salmon; a Ginza-only craft beer; a sparkling-wine coupon; ladies' lunch. 2026 reviews: PFC and calories shown for every dish; lean-meat platter (salt or wasabi); a small protein drink on arrival; charcoal-grilled skinless chicken with wine; the famous 200 g chicken-breast steak is moist; some say value is average.

食べログ: 箱根暁庵 銀座三越店、銀座4-6-16 銀座三越11F、銀座駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Hakone Akatsuki An Ginza Mitsukoshi, Ginza 4-6-16, Ginza Mitsukoshi 11F, 3 minutes from Ginza Station; 34 seats (6 counter, 22 table, 6 semi-private); daily 11:00–21:00 (L.O. 20:30); closed when Ginza Mitsukoshi is; opened September 11, 2010. Shop introduction: milled in-house in a stone mill every day and hand-made in front of you; a head chef taught directly by a soba-making master; broth of several Makurazaki katsuobushi, with different dashi for hot and cold. 2026 reviews: jet-black soba colored with charcoal (smooth and firm); thick white soba water; tororo zaru ¥1,800; duck tsuke soba; you can eat at 16:00, outside lunch hours; many overseas visitors and families; kind staff suggested putting bags on a chair at the counter.

食べログ: 築地すし鮮 総本店、築地1-9-6 アロア築地ビル1F、毎日11:0.en: Tabelog: Tsukiji Sushisen main shop, Tsukiji 1-9-6 Aroa Tsukiji Building 1F; daily 11:00–5:00 the next morning, open every day; 78 seats, private rooms; otoshi ¥550; cards, transit IC and PayPay accepted; qualified invoice T8010001126810. 2026 reviews: market-pick 10 pieces, conger eel and live horse mackerel, grilled tuna, dobin-mushi, akadashi, a ¥5,500 course of sashimi, grilled dish, tempura, chawanmushi, 4 pieces of sushi and miso soup; natto rolls, vegetable tempura, a wide range of sake.

食べログ: 築地玉寿司 築地本店、築地1-9-4、店舗紹介「1924年創業、元祖.en: Tabelog: Tsukiji Tamazushi main shop, Tsukiji 1-9-4; shop description "founded 1924, the original Tsukiji Tamazushi"; 35 seats (22 table, 13 counter); daily 11:00–15:00, 17:00–22:00, closed only on New Year's Day; cards accepted; tatami rooms bookable for 4 or more. 2026 reviews: founded in the Taisho era; marinated tuna and negitoro bowl ¥1,540; complimentary hand roll; conger eel; sashimi platter; Harumi-dori and Lumine shops; a counter-only shop up the stairs next to the main shop.

食べログ: 米菜°sakura 織音寿し(ベイサイドサクラオリオンスシ)、銀座6.en: Tabelog: Bayside sakura Orion Sushi, Ginza 6-12-12, Sakura Marks Ginza 612, 12F, 5 minutes from Ginza Station; 8 seats (counter); Thu–Tue 12:00–13:30, 14:30–16:00, 18:00–22:00, closed Wed and irregularly; 10% service charge; opened July 3, 2020; official site alchecciano.com. Shop introduction: "oil sushi" by world-famous chef Masayuki Okuda (English spelling; Al-chè-cciano); Shonai seafood; over 50 oils and over 100 salts from around the world; bagna cauda of vegetables from the Yamagata main shop; the Kaito course. 2026 reviews: lunch ¥7,700 (sparkling toast, seared nori roll, nigiri with oil and salt, bagna cauda, soup, Yamagata strawberries, Japanese black tea); butterbur-bud tempura; a lecture on olive oil; Ezo purple sea urchin; some say it's a sushi version of carpaccio with too much oil.

食べログ: 紀州和歌山ラーメン きぶんや 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区宗右衛門町1-6.en: Tabelog: Kishu Wakayama Ramen Kibunya Dotonbori, Kibunya Bldg 1F, 1-6 Soemoncho, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6211-8055; no reservations; Mon–Thu and Sun 9:00–5:00 next morning, Fri, Sat and days before holidays 9:00–6:00 next morning; no cards; e-money and QR payment (PayPay, Alipay) accepted; 20 seats (counter 12, tables 8); no smoking. 2026 reviews (July–October): the aged ramen has just the right strength of flavour and fat, good after drinking; no half fried rice, but half karaage; keen staff; the shrimp tsukemen is rich in shrimp aroma and umami; limited Japanese-style grated-yam cold ramen ¥1,210 (¥1,200 per another); watch out for the large pre-tax price and small tax-inclusive price; cold thin noodles (listed as both wavy and straight); grated yam, chicken chashu, tempura egg, myoga; pay cash on leaving; Kishu Wakayama ramen ¥950 (before tax), price raised; one found it bland with lukewarm soup; another says the soup is good enough to drink in one go; many overseas diners too.

食べログ: 老四川、大阪市中央区島之内2-8-18、日本橋駅から419m、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Lao Sichuan, 2-8-18 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 419 m from Nippombashi Station; Mon–Sat 12:00–14:30 and 17:30–20:30; closed Sundays; no reservations; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): braised beef noodles; premium beef noodles and pork-intestine noodles; beef tripe; extra-hot and extra-numbing recommended; a shop run by a cook from Sichuan; always busy; sweat-inducing even at mild; no rice to finish; most diners Chinese and the staff from China too; Chinese on the ticket machine; about an hour from entering to being served; authentic and aromatic; the numbing of Sichuan pepper; tender tripe; full even 30 minutes before closing; each bowl made with care; mala beef noodles; tender beef; chewy noodles; medium numbing, medium hot; one came all the way from Kobe; full even in the rain, a 10-minute wait.

食べログ: 肉とパスタと酒、港区東新橋1-8-2 カレッタ汐留B2F 汐留横丁、.en: Tabelog: Niku to Pasta to Sake, Higashi-Shinbashi 1-8-2, Minato-ku, Caretta Shiodome B2F, Shiodome Yokocho; weekdays 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:30, weekends and holidays 11:00–18:00; opened July 16, 2026. 2026 reviews: Takasaki pasta brought to Tokyo (Takasaki has a big-portion culture); Shiawase no Meatball Pasta Haruna Mori (the spelling in an English review), 600 g ¥1,628, with organic rooibos tea; served in about 10 minutes; the tomato sauce is lighter than expected; mobile ordering in the Shiodome Yokocho food hall; quiet on weekends; extra meatballs for the opening (until July 31).

食べログ: 肥後橋ラーめん亭、大阪市西区江戸堀1-14-1 平和総合肥後橋ビル.en: Tabelog: Higobashi Ramen Tei, Heiwa Sogo Higobashi Bldg 2F, 1-14-1 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Line Higobashi Station; Mon–Sat 11:00–2:00 next morning; closed Sundays; no cards or e-money; QR accepted; no service charge; 24 seats (counter 8, tables 16). Reviews (January 2025 – September 2026): opposite APA Hotel Higobashi; up the stairs to the 2nd floor; busy with nearby office workers at lunch; garlic ramen in the Satsumakko lineage; a light, slightly thick tonkotsu; garlic none, less or more; medium-thick wavy egg noodles; tender, juicy pork-belly chashu; bean sprouts; leek; kimchi and rice included at lunch; the last stop after drinking; spicy miso ramen; some days few kitchen staff, so slow; kind service; one found it too light.

食べログ: 自家製ミートソース potto、大阪市中央区南船場3-6-1 サイプ.en: Tabelog: House Meat Sauce potto, Cypress Shinsaibashi 1F, 3-6-1 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 2; weekdays 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00, weekends and holidays 11:00–22:00; occasional irregular closures; no lunch reservations; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners), e-money and QR (PayPay) accepted; 18 seats (counter 12, terrace 6); smoking and pets on the terrace only; opened 4 March 2013; official site. Shop introduction: house meat sauce of slow-simmered senbon-suji; meatballs of 100% Australian grain-fed beef with cream meat sauce; carbonara; arrabbiata. Reviews (September–October 2026): limited dashi meat sauce (topped with bonito flakes); chewy fresh pasta; whole-wheat noodles available; avocado cream of the month; weekday lunch large free with soup; drink +¥200; QR ordering; one found the oyster and karasumi pasta light on karasumi and the service pushy, with requests to add the LINE account.

食べログ: 芳蘭、千代田区有楽町1-2-9 TS日比谷ビルB1F、月〜土11:0.en: Tabelog: Hōran, Yurakucho 1-2-9, Chiyoda-ku, TS Hibiya Building B1F; Mon–Sat 11:00–2:00, Sun and holidays 11:00–24:00; 33 seats; cash only; smoking allowed. 2026 reviews: miso shumai ramen ¥1,600 (with two big shumai), miso butter and shoyu butter ramen ¥1,350 each (butter added at no extra charge), curry ramen, wonton men.

食べログ: 若水、大阪市西区南堀江1-1-20、06-6541-8951、予約不.en: Tabelog: Wakamizu, 1-1-20 Minami-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka, 06-6541-8951; no reservations; Mon–Fri 11:00–20:00 (L.O. 19:00), Sun and holidays 11:00–17:00; closed Saturdays; no cards or e-money; 8 seats (counter only). 2026 reviews (April–October): a neighbourhood Chinese diner in Amemura; 5-item set meal ¥1,000 (Chinese omelette, happosai, 3 karaage, 2 slices chashu, cabbage); large portions; salt butter-corn ramen and gyoza; long-established; tenshinhan and half shoyu ramen; a short wait when full; mostly male diners and quick turnover; half tantanmen and half shoyu ramen ¥800 (slightly wavy thin noodles, a nostalgic shoyu with sweetness, bean sprouts, nori, thick chashu; tantanmen with a soft-boiled egg); chukadon ¥650; 8 seats; cheap; quick; the atmosphere of an old-style ramen shop; slippery noodles.

食べログ: 華、大阪市西区新町1-8-3、四ツ橋駅2番出口から徒歩2分、月〜土.en: Tabelog: Hana, 1-8-3 Shinmachi, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Yotsubashi Station exit 2; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), holidays 11:30–14:30 and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); closed Sundays; no cards, e-money or QR; smoking allowed; 60 seats; semi-private rooms. Reviews (March 2025 – October 2026): a back-street Chinese restaurant since around 2006; full of office workers at lunch; mapo-tofu rice bowl set meal ¥600; green pepper and pork stir-fry set meal ¥800 (rice, soup, mini ramen, spring roll); happosai set meal; miso ramen and fried rice set ¥850; spicy miso ramen set meal (ask for heat); tenshinhan and chukadon set meals; all-you-can-eat-and-drink with table ordering at night ¥3,580; small dishes may differ from the menu photos; one calls the taste ordinary.

食べログ: 華うさぎ、大阪市中央区南船場3-2-28 日宝タイヨービル 1F2号.en: Tabelog: Hana Usagi, Nippo Taiyo Bldg 1F No. 2, 3-2-28 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 1; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:20 (ends when the rice runs out; no lunch reservations) and 18:00–22:00, Sat 18:00–21:00; closed Sundays and holidays; courses by the day before; 100% same-day cancellation fee; à la carte only ¥550 per person; cards (VISA, Master, JCB, AMEX, Diners) and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 10 seats (counter 6, tables 4); smoking allowed; official site. Shop introduction: affordable kaiseki of seasonal ingredients; fish chosen at Kuromon market. Reviews (February 2025 – October 2026): Hana Usagi tendon (2 shrimp and 3 vegetables) ¥700; kakiage rice bowl ¥800; special tendon A (2 shrimp) ¥1,000; special tempura set meal 'Matsu'; chicken-tempura set meal with mini sashimi; large rice free; with miso soup; pay first at lunch; a light batter with a dashi-rich Kansai-style sauce; one found it a little oily; full after 12:00 at lunch; 'Koi Usagi' set at night ¥3,300; plenty of sake; served sake-lees soup on a cold day.

食べログ: 蕎麦会席 つきじ文化人 凬、築地1-12-16 プレミアム銀座イース.en: Tabelog: Soba Kaiseki Tsukiji Bunkajin Kaza, Tsukiji 1-12-16, Premium Ginza East 1F, 3 minutes from Higashi-Ginza Station; 14 seats; Mon, Tue, Fri 17:30–22:00, Wed, Thu, Sat and holidays 11:45–14:00, 17:30–22:00, closed Sun; reservations from the ¥5,500 course. Shop introduction: carefully chosen buckwheat from all over Japan, stone-ground and hand-made; courses of seasonal fish and vegetables; 10–15 sakes. 2026 reviews: a big kneading bowl in the center; lunch soba ¥2,000 (two kinds of sashimi, fig, eggplant with sesame, maitake tempura, mori soba); a bowl course ¥9,900; lunch bowl course ¥7,700 (sujiko soba, karasumi soba, matsutake soba, two mori eaten with salt or kombu water); dinner is courses only, about ¥7,000; small portions.

食べログ: 蕎麦割烹 橙、銀座5-10-5 スリーY'S & D 3F、東銀座駅.en: Tabelog: Soba Kappō Daidai, Ginza 5-10-5, Three Y'S & D 3F, 139 m from Higashi-Ginza Station; 12 seats (8 counter, private room for 4); Tue–Fri 12:00–15:00, 17:00–22:00, weekends 12:00–22:00, closed Mon; 10% service charge; cards accepted; budget ¥20,000–30,000. 2026 reviews: a soba-and-Chinese restaurant opened by Wakiya (of Iron Chef) out of a love of soba; head chef Mori; a sommelier-manager; soba kappō course ¥15,000 (starter, fried soba gyoza, karasumi soba, egg with shark fin, dongpo pork, tempura, seiro, hot soba, tartary-buckwheat-tea pudding); sukiyaki in a kaeshi warishita; abalone with buckwheat groats; soba gyoza with uni and caviar; shark-fin soba; summer new-soba events; collaborations with Wakiya.

食べログ: 蕎麦粉懐石 銀座てあん、銀座1-20-5 銀座清和ビルB1F、26席.en: Tabelog: Sobako Kaiseki Ginza Tean, Ginza 1-20-5, 銀座清和 Building B1F; 26 seats, private rooms; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00, 17:00–22:00, closed Sundays and holidays; 10% service charge; opened August 19, 2019; official site te-an.jp. Reviews: buckwheat-flour kaiseki made by kaiseki cooks with buckwheat flour from the Shirakami mountains in Aomori; sobagaki; oden-like simmered dishes; soba dressed with egg; simmered clams; soft-shell turtle; squid salad; soba served in a wine glass; duck soba and matcha soba; courses from ¥6,000; fully private rooms for 2–8, good for entertaining; drinks ordered by smartphone; some say the dishes weren't explained.

食べログ: 薪焼 銀座おのでら、銀座5-14-14 サンリット銀座Ⅲ 9F、東銀.en: Tabelog: Makiyaki Ginza Onodera, Ginza 5-14-14, Sunlit Ginza III 9F, 1 minute from Higashi-Ginza Station exit 4; 14 seats (8 counter, tables, private rooms for 4 and 6); daily 12:00–15:00, 18:00–22:00; opened July 22, 2019; 10% service charge; smart casual; cards, PayPay and d-barai accepted; ONODERA group (onodera-group.com/makiyaki). 2026 reviews: the aroma and flame of firewood; fish, vegetables and wagyu grilled over wood; bread; Japanese touches with less butter and oil; Basque cheesecake; the middle lunch course ¥16,500; mention of a Michelin star.

食べログ: 薬膳担担麺 胡仙、大阪市西区北堀江1-2-16 103、予約不可、月.en: Tabelog: Yakuzen Tantanmen Kosen, 1-2-16-103 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; no reservations; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:30 and 18:00–20:30, Sun 11:00–16:00; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 25 seats; no smoking; opened 17 March 2026. 2026 reviews (July–October): Kyoto-style tantanmen; drank all of the medicinal soup; careful explanations for first-timers; summer-only Kyoto-style cold tantanmen ¥1,300 and lettuce fried rice (small) ¥500; a strong presence of sesame and a medicinal-herb flavour; thin noodles; the medicinal vinegar staff recommend; house-made doubanjiang and chili; tastes like a shop in Shijo-Omiya, Kyoto; one says the Sichuan tantanmen tastes of soy milk and is thin; one calls it ordinary; Kyoto style (white) and Sichuan style (red); Sichuan tantanmen regular ¥1,200, large ¥1,400; ordering by QR; over 20 medicinal ingredients; condiments on the table; house-made doubanjiang sold for ¥300; a clean shop.

食べログ: 藍丹らーめん、大阪市中央区瓦町2-3-15、堺筋本町から404m、月.en: Tabelog: Rantan Ramen, 2-3-15 Kawaramachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 404 m from Sakaisuji-Hommachi; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00; closed Sundays and holidays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 7 January 2019. Reviews (September 2025 – September 2026): set back in a building, hard to find; counter only; ticket machine outside; water and oshibori self-serve; shoyu ramen; the only side is rice; seems to be a seafood and pork soup; salty but not harsh; thick grilled chashu; vegetable noodles large ¥950 (crab sticks, wood-ear, roast pork); quieter around 12:30; tantanmen ¥900, not too hot; a big sign; about 15 counter seats facing the wall; bright and clean; Chinese-style lanterns; salt ramen (2 slices chashu, menma, wood-ear, leek, egg, spinach, nori); salty with a kick of pepper; one likens it to a premium Sugakiya; not a bad finish; hot-and-sour noodles ¥900 with fresh tomato; not too hot, just the right tang; one says it's known for reimen; courteous service.

食べログ: 蛸焼とおでん 友の、大阪市浪速区難波中1-8-13、四つ橋線なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Takoyaki to Oden Tomono, 1-8-13 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds from Yotsubashi Line Namba Station exit 32; daily 18:00–5:00 next morning (L.O. 4:00); open every day of the year; table-charge starter ¥440; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; 20 seats; opened 26 April 2019. Reviews (July 2024 – October 2026): shellfish-dashi oden; small portions, cut to suit the party size; comes with the shellfish used for the dashi; unusual items such as pea shoots and bean sprouts; konnyaku with mustard miso; takoyaki made to order; eat them with salt to taste the dashi; takoyaki with shellfish dashi poured over; a range of seasonings; water octopus; snapping-turtle hot pot in winter; seats fill fast; calm even alone; a Shinsaibashi shop too; one prefers it to famous shops.

食べログ: 西心斎橋 ゆうの、大阪市中央区西心斎橋1-10-35、四ツ橋駅から1.en: Tabelog: Nishi-Shinsaibashi Yuno, 1-10-35 Nishi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 174 m from Yotsubashi; from 18:00 (two sittings); L.O. 19:00; closed Mondays; course ¥23,880 (tax and service included); 10% service charge; cards accepted, no e-money; 16 seats; private rooms for 4, 6 and 8. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a Naniwa kaiseki omakase course; seasonal ingredients; matsutake and snapping-turtle wontons; ayu soup; grilled eel topped with sea urchin; Inaniwa udon with abalone-liver sauce; shellfish shinjo; sea-bream milt and thin udon with karasumi and firefly squid; shrimp and bamboo-shoot rice; 3 kinds of sea urchin from Hokkaido, Aomori and Awaji; depth of dashi; antique tableware matched to the season (chrysanthemum-shaped plates); sake to wine; for business entertaining too; one says a last-minute booking was accommodated.

食べログ: 谷ラーメン、千代田区丸の内3-7-11(国際フォーラム向かいのJR高.en: Tabelog: Tani Ramen, Marunouchi 3-7-11, Chiyoda-ku (under the JR elevated tracks opposite the International Forum); Mon–Fri 11:00–13:30, 17:00–19:30, closed weekends and holidays; 12 seats (tatami at lunch only); cash only; no service charge or otoshi. 2026 reviews: the ticket machine doesn't take new banknotes, so change is made inside; ramen + half fried rice ¥1,140–1,190, chashu wonton men ¥1,050, fried rice ¥800. Regulars put the founding at 1967–68.

食べログ: 豆ルンルン、大阪市浪速区難波中3-4-40 南大阪ビル 1F、南海な.en: Tabelog: Mame Runrun, Minami-Osaka Bldg 1F, 3-4-40 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nankai Namba Station; Tue–Sun 8:00–18:00; closed Mondays; cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai, au PAY) accepted, no e-money; no smoking; 12 seats (tables 8, counter 4); children and pushchairs welcome; takeaway; opened 20 November 2023. Reviews (August 2025 – June 2026): a Taiwanese-style soy-milk shop; a cute interior with bean characters; near Edion Arena; plain soy milk (hot or iced); oolong soy milk; black-sesame soy milk; mixed-berry soy milk ¥660; choose sweetness (one says 25% is just right); Taiwanese pork bun ¥320; pork bun and soy milk ¥500; tapioca kakigori in summer; free sunflower seeds; order at the till, then sit; some wanted more richness.

食べログ: 豚になる、大阪市西区江戸堀1-23-27、肥後橋から378m、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Buta ni Naru, 1-23-27 Edobori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 378 m from Higobashi; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no cards, e-money or QR; 13 counter seats; opened 24 November 2024. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): Jiro style in Tosabori; soupless 200 g ¥1,100; meal tickets, no calls; beginner-friendly; chewy noodles; a mountain of bean sprouts; mayonnaise; pork offcuts; thick chashu; raw egg; black pepper; soupless tantanmen (meat miso, onsen egg, bok choy); no garlic, extra vegetables, extra fat; no batch system, served in ticket order; hardly any wait at lunch; standard 200 g of noodles; vegetables up to double extra; a sharp shoyu; sweetness of noodles and vegetables; the fat unseasoned; smallish pork with little fat and a firm texture; chashu rice set; cold TKM; rice to finish.

食べログ: 貝出汁らぁ麺 しらはら、新橋駅前ビル1号館、月〜土11:30〜14:.en: Tabelog: Kaidashi Rāmen Shirahara, Shimbashi Ekimae Building 1; Mon–Sat 11:30–14:00, closed Sun; no cards, PayPay accepted. 2026 reviews: at night "Kaidashi Sashimi Specialist Shirahara", at lunch "Kaidashi Rāmen Shirahara". A set of oi-katsuo shellfish-dashi raamen and five pieces of red-vinegar sushi ¥1,500; ramen alone also available. A basket of katsuobushi is steeped about 10 seconds and lifted out.

食べログ: 資生堂パーラー 銀座本店(レストラン)、銀座8-8-3 東京銀座資生.en: Tabelog: Shiseido Parlour Ginza main shop (restaurant), Ginza 8-8-3, Tokyo Ginza Shiseido Building 4F–5F, 5 minutes from Shinbashi Station Ginza exit, 7 from Ginza Station exit A2; 64 seats (private room for 8); Tue–Sun 11:30–21:30 (L.O. 20:30), closed Mondays (open on holidays); 10% service charge; wheelchair accessible; official site parlour.shiseido.co.jp. October 2026 reviews: Course A ¥8,500 (amuse, tuna confit); lobster with vegetables and mushrooms; pumpkin; chocolate cake; parfait; beef curry and pork curry to pass from parent to child; omurice ¥3,000 (condiments of fukujinzuke, achar, pickled shallots and mandarin; the sauce poured in front of you; chicken rice with chicken, mushrooms and onion); got in easily around 16:00.

食べログ: 超豚骨 濃度8、大阪市中央区高津2-7-3 バーリービル1F、日本橋.en: Tabelog: Cho Tonkotsu Noudo 8, Barley Bldg 1F, 2-7-3 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Nippombashi Station exit 7; daily 11:30–1:00 next morning (L.O. 0:30; extended from 15 December 2025); no cards, e-money or QR; 11 seats (counter); no smoking; opened 11 October 2013. Reviews (September–October 2026): fill in the meal ticket and hand it over: firmness, garlic, heat; rice to finish; two noodles, thin straight and slightly thick wavy; open late; overseas solo diners too; strength 8 and limited strength 27; even 27 is only a little stronger; after a gig; not that rich; everything-on with a soup swap (double soup); easy to eat; write in noodle firmness, leek, back fat, garlic and spicy miso; lighter and creamier than it looks; thin noodles; chashu and seasoned egg; visits often; a consistent taste.

食べログ: 越後屋八十吉、銀座4-13-11、東銀座駅5番出口すぐ、70席(2名.en: Tabelog: Echigoya Yasokichi, Ginza 4-13-11, right by Higashi-Ginza Station exit 5; 70 seats (private rooms for 2 and 4, counter, tatami, sunken kotatsu); daily 11:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); open every day; 2-hour limit; no lunch reservations; booking calls after 14:00. Shop introduction: carefully chosen dried fish from all over Japan and fresh fish from the company's own Tsukiji wholesaler; charcoal grilling over high heat at a distance; salmon belly ¥890; striped atka mackerel (half) ¥890; set meals from ¥790; sashimi platter for two ¥790; nigori sake and monthly seasonal sake; also listed as open until 4 a.m. October 2026 reviews: at night too, order fish, rice and miso soup separately to make a set; marinated sablefish; makomodake; slow because made to order; a long, narrow shop; shared tables at lunch; lukewarm miso soup and pickles; saury; sashimi platter; fish skewers; omakase 5 skewers; long queues at lunch.

食べログ: 趣味焼肉ばばあ、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-17-3 Groove心斎橋.en: Tabelog: Shumi Yakiniku Babaa, Groove Shinsaibashi East 3F, 1-17-3 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Nagahoribashi and Shinsaibashi stations; Mon and Thu–Sun 17:00–5:00 next morning, Tue 17:00–24:00; closed Wednesdays; cards and QR (PayPay, d-barai) accepted, no e-money; 12 counter seats; smoking allowed; opened 16 September 2022. Reviews (September–October 2026): a sister shop exists; à la carte; many raw-meat dishes (skirt yukhoe, heart sashimi, senmai sashimi, grilled liver); thick-cut tongue (and an off-menu premium thick cut); skirt; sagari; loin; Tsunami; rare-shabu loin with sweet-savoury sauce and egg yolk, grilled by staff into a mini rice bowl; Urute no Yubiki; napa-cabbage kimchi; offal stew; Morioka reimen with sudachi to finish; ramen; skirt fried rice; choice of sauces; plenty of drinks; a lively counter; reachable even after the last train; booking recommended; good value; kind staff.

食べログ: 進化驀進 京町堀本店、大阪市西区京町堀1-3-1 京清ビル 2F、肥.en: Tabelog: Shinka Bakushin Kyomachibori main shop, Kyosei Bldg 2F, 1-3-1 Kyomachibori, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 414 m from Higobashi; Mon–Thu 11:00–16:00 and 18:00–24:00, Fri–Sun 11:00–14:30; cards (including UnionPay), transit IC, iD, QUICPay and QR (including WeChat Pay) accepted; 25 seats (counter 7, three tables for 2, three for 4); opened 20 April 2012. Reviews (May–September 2026): tonkotsu ramen; black tonkotsu is popular; free rice refills; tonkotsu ramen ¥950; self-serve rice and pickles; seems a pork and seafood soup; 2 kinds of chashu; smoky block chashu; rice sold out, but staff served what was left; one wanted garlic on the table; flashy decor; rich but not salty; gritty fat; thick, firm noodles; quiet on a Sunday lunchtime; pork aroma; change the flavour with garlic and ichimi; chewy noodles; the belly block has sweet fat, the loin meaty umami; two bowls of rice; pickles and takana; tsukudani and garlic free; lunch under ¥1,000; tsukemen too.

食べログ: 進辛正麺、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-8-5 日宝ニューグランドビル3F.en: Tabelog: Shinkara Seimen, Nippo New Grand Bldg 3F, 2-8-5 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 12 seats (counter 7, one table for 4); Mon–Sat 20:00–6:00 next morning (food L.O. 5:30); closed Sundays and holidays; separate smoking area; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 25 April 2025. Reviews (August–September 2025): soupless tantanmen; a special sauce of chili oil and Sichuan pepper; meat-miso mayo rice bowl; a dim bar-like interior; change the flavour with sansho and niboshi vinegar; pan-fried gyoza; soy-milk tantanmen (mild); gyoza-buns like pan-fried xiaolongbao (4 for ¥700); soy-milk tantanmen with soup ¥1,100; soupless tantanmen ¥1,100; meat-miso mayo rice bowl ¥450; no sign, hard to find; a popular Kita tantanmen shop come to Minami.

食べログ: 酒と肴 よしまさ、大阪市中央区日本橋2-8-16 日本橋レジデンス.en: Tabelog: Sake to Sakana Yoshimasa, Nipponbashi Residence 1F, Nipponbashi 2-8-16, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min on foot from Nipponbashi Stn, 8 min from Nankai Namba Stn; Mon–Fri 11:30–13:30 and 17:30–22:30 (food last order 21:30, drinks 22:00); Sat and holidays 17:30–22:00; closed Sunday, and at year-end, New Year and Obon; dinner ends when ingredients run out; 2-hour limit when busy; reservations accepted (the owner prefers analog ways and asks for phone bookings; online bookings get a confirmation call from the shop); no cards, e-money or QR; 19 seats (counter 6, tables 12); smoking allowed. Shop introduction: fish direct from the source and sake chosen by the owner; sashimi platter; fish sukiyaki hot pot in the cold months (2 or more); omakase four dishes ¥3,300, ¥3,850 or ¥4,400; fish sukiyaki course ¥4,400 or ¥5,500. Reviews (March 2025–August 2026): at the back of a building on Sakaisuji, near Kuromon Market; grilled fish set ¥1,200 (a different seasonal fish every day, with the head); daily set ¥1,000; daily special ¥1,300 (sashimi, grilled fish, fried dish); Irodori gozen ¥1,600; rice refill ¥200; kanpachi, Renko Tai, flatfish, Yume Kasago, Akamuromaji, Mako-Garei; 15 minutes or more to grill; one person in the kitchen; some items sold out by about 12:30; evenings: sashimi platter, simmered fish, grilled abalone, oden, fried horse mackerel, anago rice porridge, all-you-can-drink; one diner found the tempura undercooked; a slightly shy owner; regulars and locals; cash only.

食べログ: 酒パンつつみ、大阪市中央区南船場1-13-15 長堀三栄プラザ 2F.en: Tabelog: Sake Pan Tsutsumi, Nagahori San'ei Plaza 2F, 1-13-15 Minamisenba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station; Wed, Thu and Sun 18:00–24:00, Fri–Sat 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Mondays and Tuesdays; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 20 seats (including standing). Reviews (May–October 2026): a bread and drinks bar; CHE sandwich ¥800 (cheese, hash brown, egg); baguette with aosa butter; salted kombu and cream cheese; prosciutto and new-onion yukhoe ¥600; duck and cheddar; sausage pizza toast ¥800; corn-potage toast; house egg sandwich; water-aubergine and prosciutto salad ¥550; mushrooms grilled with nori mayo ¥650; namul; carrot cake ¥350; wine chosen from the fridge (bottles from ¥3,800, including Japanese ones such as Hitomi Winery); craft gin; shochu; grape beer; one person working, so it can take time.

食べログ: 酒場 音色 定食と路地裏の酒場、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-5-19 し.en: Tabelog: Sakaba Neiro Teishoku to Rojiura no Sakaba, Shinbura-gai 1F, 1-5-19 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 6; the hours table gives Tue 18:00–22:30, Wed–Sun 11:30–14:30 (L.O. 14:00) and 18:00–22:30 (food L.O. 21:45), closed Mondays; a note in the same listing also says closed Sundays and 1st and 3rd Mondays; opened 15 November 2025; 10 seats; cards, iD, QUICPay and PayPay accepted; heated tobacco only (evenings); official site. Reviews (August–October 2026): a quiet counter down an alley off the Shinsaibashisuji shopping street; the same owner as the former Wabisuke; an Okinawan atmosphere; at lunch a set meal with a choice of main (niku-dofu ¥1,100, chicken nanban with mentaiko tartare, fried horse mackerel); free rice refills; miso soup; small dish; raw egg; lunch bookable too; at night 3-obanzai platter ¥990, rafute tacos ¥550, tako-wasa and nagaimo salad ¥580, crab gratin ¥500, shrimp gyoza ¥580.

食べログ: 酒場スナフキン、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-3-5 日宝ファインプラザ2.en: Tabelog: Sakaba Snufkin, Nippo Fine Plaza 2F, 2-3-5 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 050-5869-6942; reservations accepted (call for availability); Tue–Sun and holidays 18:00–23:30 (L.O. 23:00); closed Mondays and 29 December – 5 January; cards accepted, no e-money; 14 seats. 2026 reviews (January–September): tomato oden and avocado wasabi; pork-wrapped baby corn; nanohana; risotto to finish; Italian-style oden; staff made room at a crowded counter; oden and fried oysters; gyoza platter and soy-milk sake-lees oden (not as good as hoped; a price comparison); creative dishes are the draw; light seasoning; an impressive sake list; a local feel; sake gathered from all over Japan (some brands rare in Osaka); left of the blackboard chilled sake, right room-temperature to warmed; obanzai; friendly owner and staff; the owner made it non-smoking.

食べログ: 酒肴哲、大阪市中央区日本橋2-7-27、日本橋駅 (近鉄・堺筋線).en: Tabelog: Sakana Tetsu, Nipponbashi 2-7-27, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 8 min from Nipponbashi Stn (Kintetsu, Sakaisuji Line); Mon–Sat 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30, last entry 22:00); closed Sunday; Sunday and Monday off when Monday is a holiday; other irregular closures (announced on Instagram); reservations accepted; 2-hour limit when busy; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 15 seats (counter 10, one table of 5, tables for 3 or more); non-smoking (smoking area outside); wheelchair accessible; Tabelog Izakaya WEST Top 100 2024, 2025, 2026; opened 27 February 2010. Reviews (July–October 2026): an inconspicuous shop in a narrow alley behind Nipponbashi Station; L-shaped counter; the smell of oden; oden warmed in a small pot with the broth returned to the main pot; like an oden kaiseki; daikon, potato, egg; doteyaki; potato salad; roast beef; thick-cut Spanish mackerel sashimi; sea bream, pike conger, squid, chicken liver, soft roe, tofu, yuba, octopus, tomato and cheese; udon in the oden broth to finish; beer in thin glasses; no prices on the à la carte; the staff paced dishes for a slow-eating companion; walk-ins sometimes possible at 17:00 on weekdays.

食べログ: 酒菜屋 なないろ、大阪市中央区島之内1-14-15 天野ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Sakanaya Nanairo, Amano Bldg 1F, 1-14-15 Shimanouchi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nagahoribashi Station exit 6; Tue–Sat 18:00–1:00 next morning (enter by 22:30), Sun and holidays 18:00–23:30 (enter by 21:00); closed Mondays; some days opens 17:30; entry by 21:30 includes dashi and 3 small dishes ¥1,650–2,200, later entry and courses dashi and 1 small dish ¥770; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 20 seats (counter 10, 2 low tables with a footwell); Instagram @sakanaya.nanairo. Reviews (September 2025 – October 2026): a hideaway in a quiet spot; sea-bream dashi and small dishes; sashimi platter of wild fish (bluefin tuna, seared sawara, yellowtail, sweet shrimp with salt and sudachi); autumn aubergine in hairy-crab sauce; simmered octopus and vegetables; matsutake dobin-mushi; shrimp cream croquettes; lotus-root manju with crab; oysters grilled on kombu; shrimp sake-lees gratin; duck; wagyu; winter kue hot pot with zosui; Korean reimen; horumon jjigae; sweet-and-sour pork; spring rolls; sea-bream clay-pot rice; Dewazakura; Tenpo Ichi; courteous, friendly service; fine alone; one says portions are very modest and the air quiet.

食べログ: 金久右衛門 道頓堀店、大阪市中央区道頓堀1-4-17、41席(1階カ.en: Tabelog: Kin'emon Dotonbori, 1-4-17 Dotonbori, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 41 seats (ground-floor counter 23; basement counter 6 and tables 12); Mon–Thu 11:00–8:00 next morning, open 24 hours Fri, Sat, Sun and days before holidays; closes when sold out; open every day of the year; opened 29 December 2011; official site king-emon-dotonbori.com. 2026 reviews (English edition): a 34th morning ramen with 'Osaka Kinjou Shoyu' (clear chicken-bone and light-shoyu soup, thin noodles, garlic, leek, menma, soft-boiled seasoned egg); one said a large 'Osaka Black' and pork bowl topped ¥2,000, pricey and aimed at tourists; ticket machine in front; 'Osaka Black' without egg ¥1,000; glossy black, a bittersweet shoyu with the buttery aroma of chicken fat; thin noodles recommended; noodle refills available; basic bowl ¥1,200; one found the staff curt; 'Red Shoyu'; 'King Shoyu'; one noticed a tonkotsu aroma; 'Osaka Black' with seafood umami; the shop next to Kinryu with no queue; 'Osaka Black' ¥1,200 at 5 a.m., thin noodles firm.

食べログ: 金麦 難波店、大阪市浪速区難波中2-8-91 中川ビル1F、なんば駅.en: Tabelog: Kinmugi Namba, Nakagawa Bldg 1F, 2-8-91 Nambanaka, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 200 m from Namba Station; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 17:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); cards, e-money and QR accepted; 18 seats; opened 1 September 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): ticket machine; cold corn-soup noodles ¥1,400 (sweet potato, broccoli, corn, chopped chicken, rich corn potage, thin straight noodles); tori-paitan ramen ¥1,000; mouth-watering chicken rice bowl ¥300; near Namba Parks; touch-panel ticket machine; a rich, creamy, stew-like soup; soft-boiled egg; chicken and pork chashu; tori-paitan tsukemen ¥1,100, large ¥150, seasoned egg ¥150; a light, frothy dipping soup; thick noodles chilled in cold water; 2 kinds of slightly rare chashu; a refined interior despite the back street; good service; curly noodles; a gentle, sweet chicken soup; firm noodles; overseas diners too; the second shop after Amemura; Mugikyu Co., Ltd.; PayPay.

食べログ: 金麦、大阪市西区北堀江1-2-16 おおきにサイタ・サイタビルヂング.en: Tabelog: Kinmugi, Ookini Saita Saita Bldg side building 1F, 1-2-16 Kita-Horie, Nishi-ku, Osaka; no reservations; daily 11:00–14:30 and 18:00–21:30; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 7 seats (counter); opened 7 July 2024. 2026 reviews (June–October): creamy tori paitan and mouth-watering chicken rice bowl; fine bubbles, smooth; rich yet the chicken stands out and isn't heavy; low-temperature pork-loin and chicken-breast chashu; shredded white leek; mizuna; onion; menma (thick, tender, well seasoned, superb); the ticket machine is now touch-panel; more beef dishes added; the previous owner has gone, now young staff; one says something is missing; one found the chewy medium-thick noodles underboiled; few seats, so a queue; many overseas diners; hot inside; always a queue; medium-thick straight noodles; 3 kinds of chashu; drank all of the light tori paitan; between sets at MINAMI WHEEL.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 御堂筋店、大阪市中央区難波1-7-12、なんば駅徒歩3.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Midosuji, 1-7-12 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Namba Station; open 24 hours; no reservations; smoking allowed; counter. 2026 reviews: in business for over 35 years; a simple old-fashioned flavour; help yourself to garlic, kimchi and nira; one was disappointed not to taste rich tonkotsu; self-serve garlic and spicy nira; the big dragon sign; standing; ramen ¥900; tonkotsu-based and lighter than it looks; fast turnover even at 2 a.m.; tables along the pavement and an open kitchen; free kimchi, garlic and nira; good chashu; rich yet clean; street-stall style: buy a ticket and eat standing.

食べログ: 金龍ラーメン 戎橋店、大阪市中央区難波3-3、毎日9:00〜22:0.en: Tabelog: Kinryu Ramen Ebisubashi, 3-3 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 9:00–22:00; no cards, e-money or QR payment; smoking allowed. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): ramen ¥900 (¥800 in 2025); plenty of chashu; unlimited white rice, nira kimchi and napa-cabbage kimchi; firm noodles; chairs covered in tatami fabric; only two choices on the ticket machine, ramen and chashu-men; four free extras: garlic (chopped), kimchi, spicy nira and rice; gentle tonkotsu; cloudy but not heavy; medium-thin straight noodles; thin-sliced chashu; meal ticket swapped for a number tag; some days ¥700 for the Hanshin victory sale; table seats only; one found the rice soft; 3 slices chashu; self-serve water.
