Reviews (January–October 2026): a rich dipping soup for the chicken tsukesoba; one says the fried burdock is gone, another that it's there; an 11-visit regular's favourite ramen in Osaka; 2 kinds of chashu; salt tori paitan; one found the shoyu salty and the toppings and service worse than before; one says the bok choy dilutes the rich salt; over ¥1,000; 1 person waiting before 18:00; served in 7–8 minutes; chicken and pork chashu; queues from before noon; ticket machine at the entrance; staff guide the queue; polite language from the kitchen; a frothed creamy soup; the fried burdock goes from crisp to soft as it soaks; chicken salt soba ¥1,000; large +¥150; counter only; collect your bowl from the high counter; thin noodles; frothed just before serving; 2 slices of low-temperature chashu; tori soba shoyu ¥1,000; just-right saltiness.

食べログ: 鶏soba 鶏と麺、大阪市大正区三軒家東1-18-9 2F、大正から.en: Tabelog: Tori Soba Tori to Men, 2F, 1-18-9 Sangenya-higashi, Taisho-ku, Osaka; 193 m from Taisho; daily 11:00–14:00 and 17:00–2:00 next morning; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 4 August 2023. Reviews (July 2025 – September 2026): special yuzu-salt chicken ramen ¥1,100; tori soba RED ¥950 (extra heat +¥50); chicken maze-soba ¥1,100; mini chashu rice bowl large ¥550; Akaboshi ¥660; maze-soba with lots of garlic; shredded chicken chashu; 6 waiting on the stairs; after a game at Kyocera Dome; the limited tori paitan sold out; tori soba BLACK ¥950 (garlic and black pepper); regular tori soba ¥900; D set with chicken chazuke ¥550; a light, easy soup; chicken bones; yuzu; yellow noodles rich in egg; self-serve water; one likens it to the nabeyaki ramen of Susaki, Kochi; a shoyu of old-hen bones boiled for hours; a tare of Kochi and Osaka shoyu; served piping hot; medium-thin straight noodles; one found the yuzu too strong; white pepper on the table; the tori-paitan versions with yuzu peel, chicken chashu and crunchy chicken; 2nd floor; Korean-style reimen ¥1,000 (kimchi, egg, chashu); cash only.

食べログ: 鶏か鶏以外か、大阪市大正区三軒家東1-17-20 秋月館ビル 1F、.en: Tabelog: Tori ka Tori Igai ka, Akizuki-kan Bldg 1F, 1-17-20 Sangenya-higashi, Taisho-ku, Osaka; 117 m from Taisho; Mon and Thu–Sun 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 18:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:30), Tue 11:00–15:00; closed Wednesdays; no cards or e-money; PayPay accepted; 7 counter seats; opened 17 September 2024. Reviews (December 2024 – October 2026): an anniversary ramen each year; mixed rice; two lines, tori paitan and chuka soba; coupons for registering on LINE; salt ramen; 2 kinds of chashu including rare; radish sprouts; a creamy chicken soup; thin noodles; bright and clean; one calls it the first tori paitan in Taisho; summer cold editions (cold sea-bream and hamaguri salt, cold grated-yam shoyu); the cold lunch sold out; spicy tori paitan; frothed tori paitan; rare pork-shoulder chashu and another roast pork; seasoned egg; maze-soba (limited); extra-meat tori paitan ¥1,200; mini rice ¥100; noodle refill ¥150; free takana and spicy mentaiko with rice; grilled pork-belly chashu; one found the refill salty; 6 waiting before 20:00 in August; cold salt ¥1,300 with tempura; cold shoyu with grated yam ¥1,000; cartilage tsukune ¥200; rare chashu rice bowl ¥400 (egg yolk); pork-belly chashu rice bowl ¥450; the shoyu is strongly shoyu; one found the savoury-spicy ramen salty.

食べログ: 鶏と牛のお店 火澄屋、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-4-1 オリエンタル東.en: Tabelog: Tori to Gyu no Omise Kasumiya, Oriental Higashi-Shinsaibashi Bldg 1F (107), 1-4-1 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; a restaurant building right by Nagahoribashi Station exit 7; Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 and 17:30–24:00, Sat 17:30–24:00; closed Sundays and holidays; may not answer the phone 15:00–18:00; starter ¥500; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; smoking allowed; 20 seats; semi-private rooms; Instagram. Reviews (October 2023 – June 2026): a hidden shop at the back of the building; semi-private rooms with a folk-tale feel; lunch set meals about ¥1,000 (karaage with tartare, karaage and offal, fish set meal with many sides); one says the karaage batter got thinner and better; in March 2025 curry only from ¥600 (free raw egg); chicken and beef tongue with drinks at night; small tables; cigarette smoke.

食べログ: 鶏に恋した日 寺田町店、大阪市生野区生野西2-1-37、JR寺田町駅.en: Tabelog: Tori ni Koishita Hi Teradacho, 2-1-37 Ikuno-nishi, Ikuno-ku, Osaka; 30 seconds from JR Teradacho Station north exit; daily 10:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:45) and 17:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:45); irregular closing days; cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 26 seats (ground-floor counter 10, tables upstairs); opened 1 April 2023; official site. Reviews (January–September 2026): a tori-paitan specialist; a thick, rich tori paitan (shoyu-based); thin noodles; 4 slices of house rare chashu; special tori-paitan miso ramen ¥1,200 (heat and depth, chewy medium-thick noodles); tori-paitan tsukemen 200 g ¥1,000, 300 g ¥1,100 (thick noodles, big rare chashu, radish sprouts, yuzu); summer cold editions ¥1,000 (light shellfish-dashi cold ramen; refreshing cold ramen of niboshi and kombu with chicken-fat salt; shellfish-dashi cold tsukemen, 20 a day); yuzu-kosho; niboshi vinegar on the table; karaage; fried rice; ticket machine; limited items can be ordered verbally; a new, clean shop; one found portions smallish.

食べログ: 鶏や 梅の湯、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-13-10、心斎橋駅5番出口か.en: Tabelog: Toriya Ume no Yu, 1-13-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Shinsaibashi Station exit 5; opposite a primary school's main gate; daily 18:00–23:00 (closes when sold out); irregular closing days (announced on Instagram); cards accepted, no e-money or QR; 17 counter seats; 1 November 2006. Reviews (June 2025 – May 2026): formerly a horse-meat restaurant, reopened as a yakitori shop; a public-bath theme; Showa kayokyoku; omakase yakitori set ¥2,800 (starter, 3 small dishes, 4 skewers; book ahead); Ume no Yu course ¥4,500 (8 skewers, a dish, small dish, salad, main, mini curry); 6-skewer platter; Kyoto Akadori thigh, breast, gizzard, neck; bone-in wings with rock salt; tsukune; negima; liver sashimi ¥660; Kyoto Akadori tataki ¥1,100; fried tomato with mascarpone; mozuku; potato salad; Camembert; Tochio aburage with ginger shoyu; plenty of shochu; some skewers sell out, booking recommended.

食べログ: 鶏ガラ醤油らーめん じゅうじせい、大阪市中央区南本町3-3-10、本.en: Tabelog: Torigara Shoyu Ramen Juujisei, 3-3-10 Minamihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 292 m from Hommachi Station; Mon–Fri 11:00–15:00 and 19:00–0:30 next morning, Sun 11:30–15:00 and 19:00–24:00; closed Saturdays; listed as no cards, e-money or QR; opened 5 January 2023. Reviews (August–September 2026): cold salt-shoyu ramen with lemon-juice pickles ¥800; thin straight noodles; pickled onion; prosciutto; black pepper; fried rice; white-shoyu tuna-flake ramen ¥1,030; a light shoyu of chicken bones and niboshi with bonito flakes; medium-thin straight noodles; wood-ear; leek; bean sprouts; karaage and half fried rice set ¥600; yuzu ramen; extra meat and seasoned egg; alone at 22:30; counter only; one says cards and phone payment worked at the ticket machine; add bonito flakes partway to change the flavour; not a big portion; deep chicken-bone flavour; balanced shoyu.

食べログ: 鶏白湯 大翔軒、大阪市中央区難波4-5-7、070-1736-143.en: Tabelog: Tori Paitan Daishoken, 4-5-7 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 070-1736-1434; no reservations; Tue–Sun 11:30–14:00 and 18:00–2:00 next morning; closed Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; opened 1 April 2026. 2026 reviews (September–October): a street stall in a car park in Ura-Namba; tables and chairs in front of a kitchen car; at the back of a car park under the elevated tracks; garlic shoyu tori paitan ¥1,200; extra chashu ¥500; maze-soba ¥1,200; seared chashu rice bowl ¥1,200; shoyu tori paitan ¥1,200; rich shoyu tori paitan (thick and smooth, with a clean finish); medium-thick wavy noodles; kimchi, chopped onion, vinegar and sesame on the table; a soup of hamaguri broth; shoyu tori paitan A set ¥1,350; shellfish-broth tori paitan ¥1,200; sweetish rare chashu; leek; mizuna; many regulars; open until 2 a.m.

食べログ: 鶏白湯らーめん 自由が丘蔭山 あべのＱ'sモール店、大阪市阿倍野区阿.en: Tabelog: Tori Paitan Ramen Jiyugaoka Kageyama Abeno Q's Mall, Abeno Q's Mall 4F, 1-6-1 Abenosuji, Abeno-ku, Osaka; 2 min walk from Tennoji Station exit 12; daily 11:00–23:00; closing days follow Q's Mall; cards, e-money and QR accepted; 27 seats; opened 18 May 2017; official site. Reviews (October 2025 – October 2026): tori-paitan salt soba; rich and creamy yet light; chicken aroma; medium-thick noodles; squeeze lemon halfway; yuzu at the bottom; rice into the soup to finish; the special adds vegetables, wontons, soft-boiled egg, chicken chashu, chili, greens and onion chips; lunch set until 17:00 (half ramen with Sichuan-style mapo tofu or yu lin chicken); good-value evening set (mapo rice bowl); two found the mapo tofu salty; one found it underwhelming overall; queues at holiday lunch; families and large groups too.

食べログ: 鶏白湯らーめん 麺はともあれ、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋2-7-11 日宝.en: Tabelog: Tori Paitan Ramen Men wa Tomoare, Nippo Royal Bldg, 2-7-11 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-4708-8884; 9 seats; Mon–Fri 16:00–2:30 next morning, Sat 11:00–2:30 next morning, Sun 11:00–23:00; irregular closing days; no smoking; cards and e-money accepted; opened 22 December 2022. Shop introduction: an espuma-style soup and medium-thin flat noodles, several kinds of tori-paitan ramen, rice dishes, snacks. 2026 reviews: two groups waiting even at 10 p.m.; book at the machine in front; one says it lacks character; queued Saturday 16:45, seated 19:10; order first by QR code; 5 counter seats and one table; slow turnover; a faint smell when served; chewy flat noodles; cash only (June 2026); mentaiko tori paitan; a foamy mousse-like soup; pork chashu and soft-boiled egg; no sign on the street; ground floor of a multi-tenant building; Instagram @men_wa_tomoare; special tori-paitan ramen ¥1,705 (seasoned egg, chicken chashu, pork chashu, red onion, wood-ear); chicken umami lifted by shoyu; seasoned-egg rice.

食べログ: 鹿肉料理専門店 バトックス、大阪市中央区千日前1-4-19 中島ビル.en: Tabelog: Buttocks venison specialist, Nakajima Bldg 1F, 1-4-19 Sennichimae, Chuo-ku, Osaka; Aioibashi-suji shopping street; 5 min walk from Namba Station; Mon–Sat and holidays 11:00–14:00 and 18:00–4:00 next morning, Sun 18:00–4:00 next morning (L.O. food 3:00, drinks 4:00); open every day of the year; starter/service charge ¥500 at dinner; 20 seats; private room upstairs for groups from 5; children welcome; cards, e-money and QR accepted; separate smoking. Reviews (November 2025 – October 2026): a venison specialist; several say no gamey smell and tender; venison lunch course ¥2,500 (venison cutlet, low-temperature roast, venison fried rice); venison bread (garlic toast with roast venison); venison rillettes; rillettes potato salad; carpaccio; roast eaten with salt, fried onion and sauce; pleat-less fried venison gyoza; venison maze-soba with choice of heat; carbonara; venison yaki-shabu course of 7 dishes by reservation ¥7,500; one says the cuts weren't explained; one says the wine was poured generously.

食べログ: 麓鳴館、大阪市中央区心斎橋筋1-3-12、心斎橋から206m、毎日1.en: Tabelog: Rokumeikan, 1-3-12 Shinsaibashisuji, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 206 m from Shinsaibashi; daily 14:00–19:00 (subject to change); no cards, e-money or QR; 19 seats. Reviews (November 2025 – September 2026): a nostalgic kissaten down an alley off Shinsaibashisuji; a calm, old-fashioned interior; big speakers beside the counter; cute cups; carefully brewed coffee; Rokumeikan curry ¥1,200 (European-style, tangy with faint heat, a whole potato, soft-boiled egg, sausage, knife, fork and spoon); one found the potato cold inside; over ¥1,800 with coffee; booth seats are largely self-service; one says it was a bar from 21:00 in November 2025; given two pages in a book on Osaka kissaten.

食べログ: 麺LABO 唯奏、大阪市西区江之子島1-6-2、阿波座から220m、.en: Tabelog: Men LABO Yuisou, 1-6-2 Enokojima, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 220 m from Awaza; daily 11:00–14:30 and 17:00–21:30 (L.O. 20:30); irregular closing days; reservations accepted; cards, e-money and QR accepted; opened 1 September 2022. Reviews (August–October 2026): mobile ordering; egg-on maze-soba ¥800; 2 egg yolks; a rich sauce heavy on seafood; flat medium-thick noodles; boiled firm; self-serve water; limited cold sea bream; north of Nishi Post Office; an udon shop nearby; a small, clean shop; order and pay by QR; rich chicken-pork ramen ¥950; thin or medium-thick wavy noodles; a clear, smooth soup that isn't greasy; thin-sliced pork; ¥1,150 with leek rice; log in with Apple or LINE; cash also OK; past limited editions (chicken salt, cold sea-bream salt soba, sea-bream dashi salt and shoyu, cold kombu water, noodles with Matsusaka beef fat); light chicken ramen ¥900; plenty of thin-sliced chashu; the pork comes through in the chashu, the soup is mainly chicken; straight or hand-rubbed noodles; rich tsukemen with seasoned egg; hand-rubbed noodles.

食べログ: 麺joyLife、大阪市中央区東心斎橋2-7-22 日宝シルキータワ.en: Tabelog: Men joyLife, Nippo Silky Tower 1F No. 6, 2-7-22 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 10 seats; daily 20:00–8:00 next morning; open every day of the year (long holidays announced on social media); no smoking; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; opened 24 March 2023; TikTok @men_joylife. Shop introduction: carefully made soup and house-made noodles; limited-edition ramen. 2024–2026 reviews: counter only; dark shoyu (chicken bones and bonito flakes, thin straight noodles, chicken fat); cold shellfish broth (clams, oysters, hamaguri; flat medium-thin noodles); Japanese-style maze-soba (oil of clams, oysters and shijimi); shellfish-broth ramen from ¥1,000; seared rare chashu rice bowl ¥400; ticket machine inside on the left; chicken bones with clams, shijimi and oysters; gentle flavour; house-made medium-thin straight noodles; rare shoulder-loin chashu; mizuna; menma; new onion; shredded white leek; mayo chashu rice bowl; special shellfish broth ¥1,300 (whole-wheat noodles, pork-belly chashu, soft-boiled egg, red onion); next to a club; one would not recommend the sudachi rice; shoyu and dark shoyu too.

食べログ: 麺とかき氷 ドギャン 谷四店、大阪市中央区谷町4-9-11、谷町四丁.en: Tabelog: Men to Kakigori Dogyan Taniyon, 4-9-11 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min south of Tanimachi-Yonchome Station exit 8; on the corner of the Tanimachi 5 crossing; Mon, Thu and Fri 11:30–16:00 and 18:00–21:00, Sat, Sun and holidays 11:30–20:00; closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays; temporary closures on Instagram; cards, e-money and PayPay accepted; 18 seats. Reviews (July 2025 – October 2026): a shop decorated with anime-film merchandise; seasonal cold ramen (blue-soup Yozora no Mukou gawa ¥1,200; cold corn ramen of corn and fresh cream on a salt-and-scallop base ¥1,650; white and black figs with cheese sauce; karaage); maze-soba with mayonnaise, chili oil and kombu vinegar to change the flavour; offal maze-soba; kakigori loaded with seasonal fruit (peach, fig, chestnut Mont Blanc piped in front of you, açaí); character kakigori; QR ordering; one item per person; book via Instagram; one says the combinations divide opinion.

食べログ: 麺と旨みの神隠し、大阪市中央区難波1-8-16 ナンバヒップス B1.en: Tabelog: Men to Umami no Kamikakushi, Namba Hips B1F, 1-8-16 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; daily 11:00–15:00 and 17:00–22:00; no reservations; listed as no cards, e-money or QR payment; no smoking; opened 28 December 2024. 2026 reviews: fully cashless (card and PayPay only; some couldn't pay in cash); handy when changing between OCAT and Nankai; tonkotsu ramen with tender chashu; a stylish counter; umami miso tonkotsu ¥1,550 (tang of pickled onion); back-fat shoyu ¥1,350 (black pepper, lighter than it looks); softish noodles divide opinion; large +¥150; tsukimi chashu rice bowl with special sauce ¥500; tastes like oden with daikon and konnyaku; drinks are alcohol only; in front of a pachinko parlour; one person working alone, called curt by some and kind by others; no toilet nearby; a counter along the corridor; one big slice of chashu; thin noodles; menma, pork, leek.

食べログ: 麺屋ガテンの乱 本町淀屋橋店、大阪市中央区平野町3-1-9、淀屋橋駅.en: Tabelog: Menya Gaten no Ran Hommachi Yodoyabashi, 3-1-9 Hiranomachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 5 min walk from Yodoyabashi Station exit 8 and Kitahama Station exit 6, 6 min from Hommachi Station exit 1 and Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station exit 17; no closing day (closed over Obon and New Year); last entry lunch 15:00, dinner Mon–Wed 21:30, Thu–Fri 22:00, weekends and holidays 21:00; no cards, e-money or QR; 12 seats; opened 6 October 2015. Reviews (March 2025 – October 2026): limited numbing-hot MAZE soba ¥1,100; seasoned egg ¥130; more vegetables than the 200 g of noodles; thick flat noodles; numbing Sichuan pepper; MAZE soba with extra garlic; a strong shoyu sauce; 150 g or 200 g; adjust vegetables, fat and garlic; self-serve karame; tori-paitan ramen ¥1,000; free rice with a gold card; unlimited kimchi; Taiwan maze-soba with rice ¥1,100; Taiwan maze-soba ¥1,050; extra noodles free; stamp card; chashu mayo rice bowl; MAZE soba DX; extra fat became extra garlic; large tori paitan; Jiro style too; plenty of black pepper.

食べログ: 麺屋政宗 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-18 エディ.en: Tabelog: Menya Masamune Namba Ramen Ichiza, Namba Ramen Ichiza, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; no smoking; children's menu; opened 1 December 2025. 2026 reviews (May–October): main shop in Sendai; original Sendai abura soba regular ¥1,150; extra meat ¥250; mayo ¥100; rice to finish ¥100; melting pork, half a soft-boiled egg, leek, shredded nori; light tare; vinegar and chili oil on the table (two rounds, as the sign says); black pepper or Sichuan pepper; chewy medium-thick noodles; G-style abura soba (back fat, garlic, thick noodles); Taiwan maze-soba ¥1,150; half rice ¥150; garlic ¥100; rich cheese maze-soba ¥1,200 (large +¥200); tsukimi abura soba ¥950 (egg yolk, grated yam); limited cold soy-milk tantan maze-soba ¥950; beef-tongue curry ¥400; melting-pork rice bowl; Date's salt ramen (clear salt soup); one free topping for following on Instagram; a spacious, clean shop; counter and tables.

食べログ: 麺工房 谷町店、大阪市中央区谷町5-6-3 1F、谷町六丁目駅から徒.en: Tabelog: Men Kobo Tanimachi, 1F, 5-6-3 Tanimachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 2–3 min walk from Tanimachi-Rokuchome Station; Mon–Sat 19:00–2:00 next morning, Sun lunch only; irregular closing days; no cards, e-money or QR; 22 seats. Reviews (May–September 2026): a neighbourhood Chinese and ramen shop run single-handed; diners even late at night; shoyu ramen (simple yet rich, a bowl that soaks in after drinking); miso ramen with a nostalgic taste; thick, tender chashu; at lunch shoyu ramen with half fried rice ¥900; fried rice ¥650 (with soup); fried rice with pickled ginger, with spicy miso recommended; gyoza; boiled gyoza; mapo tofu; water spinach; karaage; sobameshi; bottled Sapporo Lager Akaboshi; greeted with a smile.

食べログ: 麺通処 日加月、大阪市中央区高津2-1-25 東道頓堀双葉プラザ1F.en: Tabelog: Mentsudokoro Hikadu, Higashi-Dotonbori Futaba Plaza 1F, 2-1-25 Kozu, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 489 m from Nippombashi Station; Tue–Sun 11:00–14:30; closed Mondays; no cards, e-money or QR; no smoking; opened 29 April 2025. Reviews (August–October 2026): niboshi ¥950 (clear niboshi broth with shoyu, 2 slices chashu, menma, one whole niboshi, onion, leek); chicken aroma; salt niboshi clear broth ¥950 and egg on rice ¥300; medium-thin straight noodles; balance of oil and salt; niboshi strong at first with a clean finish; 6 basic dishes (special, shoyu, salt, niboshi clear, salt niboshi clear, old-fashioned); back-fat shoyu maze-soba (until end of November; regular 200 g, large 350 g); only pepper on the table; pay afterwards; the owner and one female staff member; carefully chosen ingredients; kind staff; a finish that shows much research; seared chashu rice bowl ¥350; an accent of umeboshi; one says the niboshi character is restrained; cold nameko; cold chuka soba ¥1,000 (bonito shoyu, thin noodles, sesame-flavoured bean sprouts, wakame, naruto); rice ¥150 to make porridge; cold niboshi clear broth; special; salt niboshi.

食べログ: 麺道部、大阪市中央区内本町2-4-10、中央線堺筋本町駅から徒歩約5.en: Tabelog: Men Dobu, 2-4-10 Uchihommachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; about 5 min walk from Chuo Line Sakaisuji-Hommachi Station, 473 m from Tanimachi-Yonchome; daily 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:00–22:00 (L.O. 21:30); no cards, e-money or QR; 10 seats; counter; no smoking; opened 1 July 2011. Reviews (July–September 2026): chashu and egg set meal large ¥1,300 (250 g chashu, large rice); ticket machine outside; large noodles or rice free at lunch; tori-paitan ramen with chashu; white-shoyu ramen; thick-cut pork-belly chashu; a tori-paitan specialist; about 10 counter seats; seasoned-egg tori-paitan ramen ¥1,000; rich yet relatively light; cramped, unsuited to groups; chashu set meal 150 g; mayonnaise; kimchi; soup; rice heaped in a dome; the ticket machine takes ¥1,000 notes only, change inside; black pepper; near closing time; Taiwan maze-soba; nostalgic ramen.

食べログ: 麻婆豆腐シン、大阪市西区新町1-25-3 8R Bld.5 1F、四.en: Tabelog: Mapo Tofu Shin, 8R Bld.5 1F, Shinmachi 1-25-3, Nishi-ku, Osaka; 3 min from Yotsubashi Stn, 4 min from Nishi-Ohashi Stn; Mon–Sat 11:30–15:00 (L.O. 14:30) and 18:30–22:00 (L.O. 21:15); closed Sunday; closed 31 December–3 January; reservations accepted; lunch cash or PayPay only, cards at dinner; 18 seats; non-smoking; children and strollers welcome; opened 2 November 2022. Reviews (December 2025–October 2026): Shin-chan's Mapo Tofu (sweet and spicy) ¥1,400 with free rice refills, soup and zha cai; a cinnamon aroma; the Sichuan-pepper numbness builds; First Love Mapo Tofu (spicy); mapo curry; house chili oil and a meat sauce cooked for four hours; at night mapo tofu topped with egg yolk; ebi mayo with nuts; yodare chicken; spicy chicken; xiao long bao; shrimp shumai; Kurobuta gyoza; sesame dumplings; some say the heat is mild; lines at lunch; a stylish, café-like exterior.

食べログ: 麻婆麺専門店 麻仁 心斎橋店、大阪市中央区東心斎橋1-6-10、06.en: Tabelog: Mabo-men Senmonten Majin Shinsaibashi, 1-6-10 Higashi-Shinsaibashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6125-5758; no reservations; Mon 18:00–24:00, Tue–Sat 0:00–6:00 and 18:00–24:00, Sun 0:00–6:00; cards, e-money and QR payment accepted; 15 seats (counter 7, two tables for 4); opened 17 January 2022. 2026 reviews (July–October): mala mapo ramen and small rice; the hell mapo ramen was too hot; an oasis after drinking; sweat from the face, neck and head; a sweetish sauce; a strong medicinal-herb flavour with a gritty texture; dim sum set and highball; a ramen shop where you can smoke; open until morning; gyoza and karaage; medicinal mapo ramen topped with coriander; mala mapo ramen ¥1,300; a story that the main shop closed and only the Shinsaibashi shop remains; thick noodles; chicken-bone base; spicy and medicinal lines; one wished the mapo had more depth.

食べログ: 黒豚とんこつ金田家 なんばラーメン一座店、大阪市中央区難波3-2-1.en: Tabelog: Kurobuta Tonkotsu Kanedaya Namba Ramen Ichiza, Edion Namba main store 9F, 3-2-18 Namba, Chuo-ku, Osaka, 06-6630-6733; no reservations; daily 11:00–22:00 (food L.O. 21:30); no cards or e-money; QR payment accepted; no smoking; opened 7 June 2019. 2026 reviews (September–October): born in Yukuhashi, Fukuoka; kurobuta ramen ¥980; B set (rice and 3 karaage) ¥460; a creamy, frothy, rich soup (like a cappuccino; explained as boiling only black-pig bones for over 20 hours); thin straight noodles (firm on request); chashu, leek, wood-ear, nori; takana and red pickled ginger partway through; chashu-men and fried rice; richer than Ichiran or Ippudo; pan-fried gyoza; 3 big slices of chashu; quiet before noon on a Sunday; one wished the soup were hotter.

食べログ: 黒門 三よ志、大阪市中央区日本橋1-16-4、日本橋駅8番出口から徒.en: Tabelog: Kuromon Miyoshi, 1-16-4 Nippombashi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 3 min walk from Nippombashi Station exit 8; Tue, Wed, Fri and Sat 17:00–23:00 (L.O. 22:00); closed Sundays, Mondays, Thursdays and holidays; 2 weeks' summer break and New Year; announced on Instagram and Google Maps; no cards, e-money or QR; 17 seats; non-smoking since April 2020. Reviews (March–October 2026): just off Kuromon Market, in front of a public bath; run by two people; a homely shop with a TV; mostly local diners; reasonable for a tourist area (just under ¥3,000 each); small, thin-skinned gyoza with sweet cabbage and garlic, 6 for ¥450, frozen to take away at the same price; pork okonomiyaki; beef-tendon, leek and egg; shrimp okonomiyaki (8 plump shrimp, ¥900); omusoba; yakisoba; tonpei-yaki with ketchup and mayo; stir-fried beef (shoyu, sauce, ponzu); dashimaki; grilled salmon; stir-fried shishito; nira and meat stir-fry; yakitori; chilled tomato; draught beer; highball; okonomiyaki crisp outside and fluffy inside, served cut; book for large groups.

食べログ: 龍、大阪市浪速区桜川3-1-28、桜川駅から徒歩1分、汐見橋駅から2.en: Tabelog: Ron, 3-1-28 Sakuragawa, Naniwa-ku, Osaka; 1 min walk from Sakuragawa Station, 2 from Shiomibashi Station; Mon and Wed–Sun 11:30–21:00; closed Tuesdays; no cards, e-money or QR; 45 seats. Reviews (August–October 2026): a Beijing-style neighbourhood Chinese diner founded 1970; facing Sennichimae-dori; a display case of food models and menus on the wall; tables and tatami; busy with office workers at lunch; fast service; gomoku fried rice (¥940); yakisoba (¥770); hand-made gyoza (6 for ¥420, half price on Fridays); curry champon or curry ramen set about ¥1,150 (thin noodles); Chinese-style katsudon with thick sauce ¥940; pork tendon; mapo harusame; lightish seasoning; cash only.

食べログ: 﨑ちゃんラーメン、大阪市中央区南本町1-5-1 安平ビル 1F、堺筋.en: Tabelog: Sakichan Ramen, 1F of a building at 1-5-1 Minamihonmachi, Chuo-ku, Osaka; 193 m from Sakaisuji-Hommachi Stn; Mon–Sat 11:00–15:00 (L.O. 14:30); closed Sundays and public holidays; no reservations; cards and PayPay accepted, no e-money; non-smoking; children welcome; opened 9 September 2024. Instagram (@sakichan.ramen): Sakichan Ramen, opened 9/9 in Sakaisuji-Hommachi. The yakiniku restaurant's Instagram (@yakiniku.kazuchan): Yakiniku Horumon Kazuchan / Sakaisuji-Hommachi. Reviews (April–September 2025): yakiniku at night, ramen by day; A5 wagyu beef tendon; BLACK (soy-based), WHITE (beef-bone broth), RED (spicy with Korean chili); beef tendon BLACK ¥780; Mashi Mashi BLACK ¥1,100 (extra beef tendon and green onion); beef tendon bokkake rice ¥350; rice set with kimchi; limited chilled lemon ramen and chilled mazesoba; menma, green onion, onion, egg yolk; a sweet aroma of seafood soy; not as heavy as it looks; medium-thick, chewy noodles (described variously as straight, flat or slightly curled); full around 12:30; the newest review is from September 2025.

食べログおよびミシュランまとめによると、2026年6月14日、西区樋の口町（名古.en: According to Tabelog and Michelin round-ups, it reopened after moving to Hinokuchi-cho, Nishi-ku (near Nagoya Castle) on 14 June 2026. Its predecessor, the izakaya Fukurou, ran for about 20 years in Aoi, Higashi-ku (Shinsakae) and earned a Plate in the Michelin Guide Aichi 2019 (seven izakaya listed in all: three Bib, four Plate). Centred on fresh-fish sashimi with sake, shōchū and wine; 18 seats.

食べログおよび名古屋焼肉セレクションによると、オーナーシェフHIRO氏は30代前.en: According to Tabelog and Nagoya Yakiniku Selection, owner-chef HIRO is in the early thirties; studied geography at university, discovered food culture while in the US (California) and turned to cooking. Deals directly with Chita beef farmers; strictly by introduction and membership, one or two groups a day. Chateaubriand rolled in nori is the signature.

食べログが2012年開業、店主一人営業、瀬戸内の刺身盛り合わせ、広島の地酒重視、.en: Tabelog confirms opening in 2012, the owner running it alone, Seto Inland Sea sashimi platters, an emphasis on Hiroshima local sake, and keywords such as mackerel curry and cheese. Retty confirms brown-rice soup curry at lunch and the owner choosing sake to suit each guest and explaining it even to beginners.

食べログが、2025年9月開業、丸の内堀江ビル（丸の内駅徒歩約2分）、女性店主、.en: Tabelog reports: opened September 2025, Marunouchi Horie Building (about 2 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station), a woman owner, counter + a private room for 4, 13 seats in all, obanzai and rolled omelette with plenty of dashi, and an atmosphere comfortable even for solo diners.

食べログがサムギョプサル・チヂミ・ケジャン・韓国ラーメン・日替わり定食を確認。運.en: Tabelog confirms samgyeopsal, chijimi, gejang, Korean ramen and a daily set meal. The operators' names are not public, so rather than asserting the owners are 'a Korean couple', it is described modestly as a family business, per reviews.

食べログが流川（歓楽街）の立地、薬研堀通り近くの黄色い看板、カウンター10席のみ.en: Tabelog confirms the Nagarekawa (entertainment district) location, a yellow sign near Yagenbori-dori, only 10 counter seats, late-night hours 21:00–03:00, meat-and-egg soba (with spring-onion topping), and cabbage and noodles cooked just right.

食べログが胡町2-12 広栄ビルB1F「てっぱん横丁」の立地、18:00-05:.en: Tabelog confirms the location at 'Teppan Yokocho', a basement in Ebisucho 2-12, late-night hours 18:00–05:00, meat-and-egg soba, offal, potato-cheese bake and Otafuku sauce.

食べログが魚新を鳥羽2-1-5の寿司店とし、最寄りは中之郷駅(約457m)と記載.en: Tabelog lists Uoshin as a sushi shop at Toba 2-1-5, nearest station Nakanogo (about 457 m). Reviews, menus and other details are not posted, so little is known about the shop.

食べログで1960年創業、南町商店街（山陽姫路駅近く）、全17席のカウンターのみ.en: Tabelog confirms: founded in 1960; Minami-machi shopping street (near Sanyo-Himeji Station); 17 counter seats only; shio ramen in a clear chicken-and-pork soup with white pepper; wonton noodles (about ¥850); old photos of Himeji. ma8coro confirms about 5 seats were lost when a fridge was installed during renovation, but the queues continue.

食べログで2022年8月5日開店、姫路市本町、山陽姫路駅から583m、10席のカ.en: Tabelog confirms: opened 5 August 2022; Honmachi, Himeji; 583 m from Sanyo-Himeji Station; a 10-seat counter; a hideaway serving organic vegetables and game (venison). The owner's name is not public.

食べログで2023年8月1日開店・西区花の木3-6-14・浄心駅徒歩約7分・食べ.en: Tabelog confirms the opening on 1 August 2023, 3-6-14 Hananoki, Nishi-ku, about 7 minutes on foot from Joshin Station, Tabelog French EAST Hyakumeiten 2025, and that the chef comes from La Vagabonde and that it is run by a married couple (chef + pâtissier). The 33inc.jp blog confirms the course's Satō Nishiki cherry × foie gras terrine, scallop and pig's trotter croquette, and venison loin. Reviews confirm an episode of the couple's child appearing. The chef's surname is not published in any outlet, so it is null.

食べログでTRIVENIは2025年6月30日オープン、丸の内、昼カレー／夜バー.en: Tabelog confirms TRIVENI opened on 30 June 2025 in Marunouchi, curry by day / bar by night, spice 0–5, free refills of naan, soup and salad, and over 30 wines. Nepalese dishes such as chicken tikka are available. The bio's 'frango (Portuguese for chicken)' was a contextual error and has been corrected.

食べログで中区丸の内1-10-17・丸の内駅徒歩2分・そば店であることを確認。た.en: Tabelog confirms 1-10-17 Marunouchi, Naka-ku, 2 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station, and that it is a soba shop. The Tanshin blog confirms the wall chart of soba prices since the Meiji era, a Showa atmosphere like 'THE SOBAYA', and the mini tendon + mini soba set.

食べログで住所（西区浅間2-8-14、旧美濃路沿い）・浅間町駅徒歩約5分・中華そ.en: Tabelog confirms the address (2-8-14 Sengen, Nishi-ku, on the old Minoji road), about 5 minutes on foot from Sengencho Station, chūka soba (yellow noodles), kishimen, miso-nikomi and katsudon. Ekiten confirms the wall-length menu and the Showa-era popular-canteen atmosphere.

食べログで姫路市魚町の素朴な炉端焼き・おでんの店（17時開店、山陽姫路駅から約3.en: Tabelog confirms a simple robata and oden shop in Uomachi, Himeji (opens 17:00, about 323 m from Sanyo-Himeji Station). ma8coro confirms a counter around the hearth suited to groups of about 8, grilled rice balls, and serving with a long robata paddle. The owner's name is not public.

食べログで西区天神山町8-2・浄心駅徒歩5分・予算1,000円未満・地元客中心の.en: Tabelog confirms the street address in Nishi-ku, 5 minutes on foot from Joshin Station, a budget under ¥1,000, and a calm coffee shop with mostly local customers, with Kaya Blend coffee + morning service (thick toast). Retty confirms a morning set with lots of extras and lunch service.

食べログとRettyが、名古屋市東区白壁（東大手駅至近）の隠れ家、ご夫妻が営むカ.en: Tabelog and Retty agree: a hideaway in Shirakabe, Higashi-ku, Nagoya (right by Higashi-Ote Station); run by a married couple with only 7–8 counter seats; open only from the autumn equinox to the spring equinox; thick-cut fugu sashimi, grilled milt, tetchiri and hire-zake; first visits by a regular's introduction only.

食べログとoinagoyaが、浄心駅近くのラーメン店「高豚」が手がける担々麺専門.en: Tabelog and oinagoya support that this is a tantanmen specialist from the ramen shop Haiton near Joshin Station, opened in spring 2025, in Kami-Nagoya, serving mala tantanmen and tantan mazesoba. The branch label "third shop" could not be confirmed, so it is described generally as an affiliated tantanmen specialist.

食べログと公式サイトが、江戸末期創業・現5代目、東大手駅徒歩約3分、備長炭で焼く.en: Tabelog and the official site support: founded at the end of the Edo period, now in its fifth generation; about 3 minutes on foot from Higashi-Ote Station; Kansai style grilled over binchōtan (split down the belly, not steamed) with a crisp texture; live eels rested in well water; ohitsumabushi and unadon. A blog (ameblo) reports thick eel from Kagoshima, autographed boards from celebrities, and no grilled liver or umaki (liver soup is included). No primary source confirming an old topped-up sauce was found, so the description was softened to 'a strong house-made sauce'.

食べログと旅館公式サイトが、母体が南知多町内海（伊勢湾に面する）の旅館しぼりやで.en: Tabelog and the ryokan's official site support that the parent business is the ryokan Shiboriya in Utsumi, Minamichita (on Ise Bay), the 13 March 2026 Marunouchi opening and the fried prawn / fried white-fish set-meal format. The owner's personal name is not published.

食べログによると、2026年5月15日、西区押切にオープンした12席（カウンター.en: According to Tabelog, a 12-seat izakaya (8 at the counter, 4 at tables) opened on 15 May 2026 in Oshikiri, Nishi-ku. The owner is from Myanmar, but the current menu has 'zero Myanmar feel'; Myanmar dishes are planned for later. Tender braised pork is the signature, and sets with a drink are the core.

食べログによると、名古屋市西区・城信駅から徒歩約10分の手打ちうどん・そばの店。.en: According to Tabelog, a hand-made udon and soba shop in Nishi-ku, Nagoya, about 10 minutes on foot from the station. 5 counter seats + 16 in a sunken-kotatsu tatami room, 21 in all. Lunch sets around ¥780. Popular for the chicken katsudon, a thick chicken cutlet with house-made soy sauce, and grated-daikon kishimen; praised for a homely atmosphere like coming home and the owner's warm service.

食べログのランチメニューと口コミが、丸の内駅徒歩5分、チョイスセット790円、ナ.en: Tabelog's lunch menu and reviews support 5 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station, a ¥790 choice set, one extra naan free, and weekday lunches full. Another review tells of its origin selling ¥500 chicken curry & naan at events in Nishi-ku, and a former shop at Kokusai Center. Hitosara says Nepalese food is also served.

食べログのレビューは1950年創業、初代・山本ユキエ、弟へ、そして甥の三代目とい.en: Tabelog reviews report founding in 1950: first owner Yamamoto Yukie, then a younger brother, then a nephew as the third generation; the shop name comes from customers marvelling that its round, hefty shape looked like a sunfish (manbo); and Kyoto's own manbo-yaki using takuan, beef tendon and spring onion.

食べログの写真キャプションで700円と確認。あずきは小麦不使用だがクリーム＝乳、.en: Confirmed at ¥700 in a Tabelog photo caption. The azuki has no wheat, but the cream = dairy; watch the wafer served with it.

食べログの口コミが、以前カラオケ店だった場所を母の死後に娘が改装しべた焼き店とし.en: Tabelog reviews record that after the mother's death the daughter renovated the former karaoke site and opened it as a betayaki shop. Respect for the mother, 'Setsuko', and the 2024 opening come from the owner's own Instagram posts. Address, tabletop griddles and menu confirmed on the Tabelog shop page.

食べログの口コミが、醤油ラーメン一本の簡素な屋台風の店であることを伝えるのみ。店.en: Tabelog reviews say only that it is a simple, stall-style shop serving shoyu ramen alone. No detailed public information, such as the owner's name, can be found.

食べログの口コミが築100年超の古民家再利用、穴子・海老天ぷら、蒸し牡蠣、揚げも.en: Tabelog reviews confirm the reuse of an old house over 100 years old, anago and prawn tempura, steamed oysters and fried momiji manjū (anago is not a mistake for hamo). The roughly two-month ageing of the dipping sauce is kept as coming from a retty review.

食べログの料理写真で確認。つけ醤油＝小麦。価格未確認。.en: Confirmed from a Tabelog food photo. Dipping soy sauce = wheat. Price unconfirmed.

食べログマガジンによると、約60年続き2015年に閉店した名店を継ぎ2016年2.en: According to Tabelog Magazine, it took over a famous shop that ran for about 60 years and closed in 2015, reopening in Funairi in February 2016. The owner was once an office worker drawing air-conditioning plans, and made the partitions and ceiling ducts by hand. Besides soy-pork-bone chūka soba, Sichuan-style items such as red spicy soba and brothless dandan noodles were added.

食べログマガジン（473277）とoinagoyaで2025年6月8日開業、厨房.en: Tabelog Magazine (473277) and oinagoya confirm the opening on 8 June 2025, two in the kitchen (3 years at popular cafés / 2 years at Erick South), chicken curry with no added stock or umami seasoning, and cardamom karaage. liverary confirms 'Hour's Wedding Reception' on 7 June (Bar Kanata, BUTTER NOTE). A claim of a renovated 'former bicycle shop' could not be supported and was removed.

食べログマガジン（magazine.tabelog.com/articles/3.en: Tabelog Magazine (magazine.tabelog.com/articles/369395), Leaf Kyoto and kyotopi (FdcL1) report that Chef Shiga was sous-chef and sommelier at the sister shop 'Pizzeria Napoletana Da Yuki', a Michelin Bib Gourmand and Tabelog 'Pizza Hyakumeiten', and opened the 18-seat Senza X on its former site (Okazaki, Sakyo-ku) on 9 February 2024. Every item uses no wheat, gluten, egg or dairy; the pasta is made from Italian corn and rice, and the bread from rice flour. Described as a 20-year dream; Da Yuki's stone oven remains.

食べログ・Rettyが、淀本町(淀駅至近・京都競馬場近く)の町中華、1000円未.en: Tabelog and Retty record a neighbourhood Chinese restaurant in Yodo-honmachi (right by Yodo Station, near Kyoto Racecourse), set meals under ¥1,000, fragrant fried rice, a menu of gyoza, karaage, sweet-and-sour pork, tenshinhan and more, and comfort and value. The owner's name is not public.

食べログ・budou-chan・ヒトサラ・家老屋敷跡公園利用者組合サイトより。2.en: From Tabelog, budou-chan, Hitosara and the chief-retainer residences park users' association site. Opened 25 March 2023 at Honmachi 68, Himeji, "I residence / chief-retainer residence building A, no. 1". Known for domestic kara-age of Banshu jidori chicken (breast and thigh, freshly fried in about 5 minutes) and whole-orange juice. "Serious spice" optional. The owner's name is not public.

食べログ・gorp・genjitsutouhiが、旧『熟豚』、伏見の熟成庫での3.en: Tabelog, gorp and genjitsutouhi record the former 'Jukuton', ageing for 3–5 weeks in an ageing room in Fushimi, double-frying in lard and rapeseed oil, Tokyo Nakaya panko, a Michelin Bib Gourmand, rare pork such as Tokyo X, Meishan and Saddleback, and several condiments including salt. About 12 seats.

食べログ・kyotopi・gcjapan・公式が、1951年創業、フレンチ出身シ.en: Tabelog, kyotopi, gcjapan and the official site record founding in 1951, a married couple with a French-trained chef, second generation, 16 seats, hand-kneaded hamburger steak blended with A5 Kuroge wagyu (fried egg + demi-glace), and Kuroge wagyu tendon curry since founding. Shinshu Premium A5 wagyu is used for the beef cutlet.

食べログ・ma8coroブログ・Rettyより。姫路市十二所前町、山陽姫路駅から.en: From Tabelog, the ma8coro blog and Retty. A detached-house Italian hideaway in Juniisho-mae-cho, Himeji, about 200 m (about 3 min walk) from Sanyo-Himeji Station. Many regulars; the counter is lively. Squid-ink risotto, fresh pasta, wood-fired pizza, carpaccio, sautéed white asparagus, prosciutto and melon, etc. The homemade basil butter and baguette are well liked. The owner-chef's name is not public.

食べログ・sun-maltによると、炭火焼西尾の店内を昼だけ間借りする昼営業限定.en: According to Tabelog and sun-malt, a lunch-only ramen that borrows the dining room of the charcoal-grill restaurant only by day. Nagarekawa / Kanayama-cho. Light, clear shoyu ramen and kombu-water tsukemen, rare in Hiroshima. A clear broth of Shiga's Omi black chicken with about 4 dried ingredients such as Ibukijima niboshi, and hand-rubbed medium-thick noodles.

食べログ・ぐるなびが、JR姫路駅南口至近（徒歩1〜2分）の炭火焼居酒屋、山上ビル.en: Tabelog and Gurunavi confirm: a charcoal-grill izakaya very close to JR Himeji Station's south exit (1–2 min walk); Yamagami Bldg 1F; a renewal opening and a lunch service started on request; seasonal seafood from the Harima-nada; yakitori and skewers. The exact years in business are unconfirmed, so it is called "long-established".

食べログ・ぐるなび・鳥羽観光協会等によると、鳥羽駅南口から徒歩約4分の海鮮食堂。.en: According to Tabelog, Gurunavi and the Toba tourism association, a seafood diner about 4 minutes' walk from the south exit of Toba Station. Shellfish and Ise lobster bought that day swim in the tank, and every set meal (about ¥1,500–1,650) comes with Ise lobster miso soup (with half a lobster). The fried shrimp set and the all-shellfish set are popular. The owner and the owner's wife are praised for a warm welcome and the homey atmosphere. Closed Thursdays.

食べログ・エキテンのレビューが、特選刺身盛り合わせ・踊り活けタコ・鯛かぶと焼き・.en: Tabelog and Ekiten reviews confirm: the special sashimi platter, live octopus, grilled sea bream head and eel with egg, sashimi described as "best in Himeji", and a hideaway location with no lit sign. The owner's name is not public. The TripAdvisor original now returns 403 and could not be rechecked.

食べログ・ヒトサラで住所（本町68-4）と2023年4月24日開店、暗めでおしゃ.en: Tabelog and Hitosara confirm the address (Honmachi 68-4), the opening on 24 April 2023, and a dim, stylish izakaya. goguynet and ameblo confirm one owner running the counter alone and a "festival bar" vibe; rrmat288 confirms nostalgic Japanese punk and new-wave music; ma8coro confirms a three-item chef's-choice plate and Koeigiku Anastasia Green sake.

食べログ・ホットペッパー: 金沢市片町2-8-16、香林坊東急スクエア裏手のせせ.en: Tabelog and Hot Pepper: 2-8-16 Katamachi, Kanazawa, along Seseragi-dori behind Korinbo Tokyu Square. A long-established soba and udon shop of over 120 years. Cold soba, inari udon, tempura udon, katsudon and more. Generous and affordable (mostly under ¥1,000). 24 seats.

食べログ・ホットペッパーが2025年10月13日開業、西区幅下（シャトル浅間1F.en: Tabelog and HotPepper confirm the opening on 13 October 2025, Habashita, Nishi-ku (1st floor of a building), 10 seats in all (6 at the counter + 2 tables for two). A first-hand Ameblo post supports the chef's name (Ishida Katsuhisa) and plates of French technique × domestic seasonal ingredients. No public information detailing the career before opening was found.

食べログ・ホットペッパーが、2025年11月16日大手前通り沿い（本町68）開業.en: Tabelog and Hot Pepper confirm: opened 16 November 2025 on Otemae-dori (Honmachi 68); café by day, izakaya by night; French technique with fresh fish and selected meat; rare salmon cutlet, seared wagyu, sea bream meunière. The owner's name is not public.

食べログ・ホットペッパーの店舗情報とレビューが、土佐備長炭、天草大王のもも・むね.en: Tabelog and HotPepper shop information and reviews confirm Tosa binchōtan, thigh and breast of Amakusa Daiō, offal of Hiroshima brand chicken, Ehime Himekko jidori and the opening on 3 April 2023.

食べログ・ホットペッパーの店舗情報とレビューで、2026年2月11日開業、久保町.en: Tabelog and Hot Pepper shop information and reviews confirm: opened 11 February 2026; a hideaway Japanese kappo for grown-ups in Kubo-cho; serves Himeji Densuke conger eel, salt-grilled sweetfish and domestic beef; about 17 seats. The signature is conger eel (anago), not pike conger (hamo).

食べログ・ラーメンWalker・kyotopiより、店主・山内健吾(和食出身)、.en: Tabelog, Ramen Walker and kyotopi confirm owner Kengo Yamauchi (from Japanese cuisine), the rename and move from 'Kobushi' on 28 March 2011, medium-thin noodles from Teigaku, Kyoto duck and nodoguro niboshi soba, and a regular in the Michelin Bib Gourmand. After a temporary closure while the owner was in hospital it reopened, with a renewal opening on 17 November 2025.

食べログ・金沢日和・観光協会・検索で、昭和32年(1957)創業、先代逝去後に息.en: Tabelog, Kanazawa Biyori, the tourism association and searches confirm: founded Shōwa 32 (1957), revived by a son after the previous owner died, going about 70 years; the proprietress Koshida Yoshie and the proprietress's son Kōta (third generation); a gentle taste without MSG; salt level measured daily; whelk; member of the Kanazawa Oden 50-Year Shops Association.

食べログ・金鯱系サイトによると、2023年6月15日、名駅近くの人気立ち食い寿司.en: According to Tabelog and Kinshachi-related sites, on 15 June 2023 the popular stand-up sushi bar Kiwami near Meieki opened Hanare, a sit-down offshoot, in Endoji Yokocho, Nishi-ku. About 10 seats (6 at the counter + small tables); Edomae nigiri built around red-vinegar rice. Reviews praise the nodoguro, kinmedai and more.

食べログ公式ページの説明文。価格帯は店の登録予算でディナー¥5,000〜¥5,9.en: Description from the official Tabelog page. Price range per the shop's registered budget: dinner ¥5,000–5,999, lunch ¥3,000–3,999. The batter is wheat.

食べログ店舗ページで2026年1月17日開店・西区那古野『＆tree』・丸の内駅.en: The Tabelog page confirms the opening on 17 January 2026, at &tree in Nagono, Nishi-ku, about 5 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station, 6 seats, a sister shop of Bistro KIZKI run by the owner's wife, serving French deli food and specialty coffee. The main bistro opened in May 2023 in Higashi-ku and was named to Tabelog French EAST Hyakumeiten 2025.

食べログ店舗ページで2026年1月7日開店・12席（2名テーブル×6）・オーナー.en: The Tabelog page confirms the opening on 7 January 2026, 12 seats (6 tables for two), the owner-chef being the former head chef of Nangoku Shuka in Nagoya Tokyu Hotel, and Saturday full houses and sell-outs. Ameblo confirms the make-up of the ¥1,500 lunch (three starters, soup, white fish, salt-sauce fried noodles, almond tofu).

食べログ店舗・メニューページで2026年4月24日開店・中区丸の内1-4-29・.en: Tabelog's shop and menu pages confirm the 24 April 2026 opening, 1-4-29 Marunouchi, Naka-ku, about 3 minutes on foot from Marunouchi Station, binchōtan robata grilling and sake, silver salmon with ikura / fatty mackerel / Kuroge wagyu / salmon-ikura bowl.

食べログ（穴子・鰻の割烹会席、カウンター9席を含む全31席、大将の丁寧な仕込み、.en: Confirmed by Tabelog (kappo set courses of conger eel and eel; 31 seats including 9 at the counter; careful preparation by the chef-owner; seasonal cooking) and Ekiten (a kappo in Shiocho; excellent seasonal dishes; conger eel and shrimp tempura; off-menu requests considered). The owner's name is not public.

食べログ（英語版店舗ページ）でオーナーシェフ飯泉雄大、実家が日本料理店、服部栄養.en: Tabelog (English shop page) confirms owner-chef Iizumi Yudai, a family Japanese restaurant, a Hattori Nutrition College graduate, top Tokyo restaurants and then training at the one-Michelin-star Sumibi Kappo Shirasaka (Akasaka), opening in June 2023, and about 14 seats (10 at the counter, 4 in a private room). sushi-blog confirms Toyohama octopus, Chita vegetables, Ichinomiya eel and Kisarazu bonito, ayu × 12-month-aged Comté, and the episode of river fish ordered via Instagram not arriving because of bad weather.

食べログ：兵庫県姫路市本町68 家老屋敷跡 ろの屋敷、姫路城前、くずもち・抹茶わ.en: Tabelog: Honmachi 68, Himeji, Hyogo, "Ro" residence in the former chief-retainer residences, in front of Himeji Castle; kuzu mochi, matcha warabi mochi, Tanba black-bean kuzu, shaved ice, dango; a sweets tea room with no reservations. Reviews praise the bouncy kuzu mochi and refined sweetness. Kuzu manju, the matcha set and others are unconfirmed, so the description was narrowed.

食べ放題は共用の鉄板で焼く＝小麦の完全な交差汚染。.en: All-you-can-eat is cooked on a shared griddle = complete wheat cross-contact.

食べ残しは追加料金いただきます.en: there's an extra charge for leftovers

食べ物を通して人を元気にしたい.en: we want to energise people through food

食べ物系サイト(food-japon)と公式店舗情報(mame-kawamura.en: A food site (food-japon) and the official shop information (mame-kawamura.com) confirm the second-floor salon: ages 6 and up, one item per person, made to order. A shaved-ice blog (momoclobiyori) confirms the hojicha shaved ice (house-made bean paste, hojicha ice cream).

食を通して笑顔になってほしい.en: we want people to smile through food

食パン＝小麦。マヨネーズ使用の可能性が高くヴィーガンは要確認。.en: Sliced bread = wheat. Very likely uses mayonnaise, so vegans should check.

食券を渡す時にお伝えください」.en: Please tell us when you hand over your ticket"

食券を置かれた際にお声かけ下さい.en: please tell us when you put down your ticket

食塩、粉末醤油、砂糖、節粉末（かつお、さば）、昆布粉末.en: salt, powdered soy sauce, sugar, dried-fish powder (bonito, mackerel), kombu powder

食後は身体に負荷はありません」.en: so it's no burden on the body after eating"

食文化とこだわりの地酒を心ゆくまで味わえます」.en: you can savor food culture and carefully chosen local sake to your heart's content"

食材ありきの、割烹のような洋食屋.en: a Western-food restaurant like a kappo, where the ingredients come first

食材がなくなり次第終了という営業スタイルが示すとおり、鮮度と素材本位を重視する姿.en: As its practice of closing when the ingredients run out shows, it has consistently put freshness and ingredients first.

食材が入荷次第販売開始.en: sold as soon as the ingredients come in

食材や調理法、空間から接客まで、お客様をおもてなしすることにこだわっています.en: We're particular about hospitality in everything, from ingredients and cooking methods to the space and service

食材を必ずお伝えください.en: ingredients you can't eat must be told to us

食材アレルギーをお持ちの方はスタッフにお申しつけください.en: If you have food allergies, please tell the staff

食物アレルギーがご心配のお客様は、当店スタッフにお申し出ください.en: Customers worried about food allergies, please tell our staff

食物繊維が豊富なスーパーフード.en: A superfood rich in dietary fiber

食記ドットコム等が富士見町・地蔵通りの人気店として紹介。名物はそば肉玉と八誠焼き.en: Shokuki.com and others introduce it as a popular shop on Jizo-dori in Fujimi-cho. Specialties are soba meat-and-egg and Hassei-yaki, plus teppan items such as grilled squid tentacles. Explains that the cabbage is steam-grilled, with kombu powder and fish powder as hidden seasonings for deeper umami.

飲み放題に生ビール＝麦芽。.en: The all-you-can-drink includes draft beer = malt.

餃子がメニューにないのに、お酢を置いているということは、店主がちゃんと京都ラーメ.en: There's no gyoza on the menu but there's vinegar on the table, which means the owner properly understands that vinegar goes with Kyoto ramen

餃子の皮＝小麦、つけだれも醤油。.en: Gyoza wrappers = wheat; the dipping sauce is soy sauce too.

餃子の皮＝小麦、タレも醤油。.en: Gyoza wrappers = wheat; the sauce is soy sauce too.

餃子の皮＝小麦。タレも数種の醤油をブレンド＝小麦。.en: Gyoza wrappers = wheat. The sauce is a blend of several soy sauces = wheat.

餃子専門店であり、すべての主力商品が小麦の皮を使用するため、厨房は小麦が常用され.en: A gyoza specialist whose main products all use wheat wrappers, so wheat is in constant use in the kitchen. No mention of gluten-free handling or separate cooking could be confirmed.

餃子皮メーカー直営.en: run directly by a gyoza-wrapper maker

餅は米だが生地・麺・ソースが小麦。乳使用。.en: The mochi is rice, but the batter, noodles and sauce are wheat. Contains dairy.

餅は米だが鍋のつゆ次第。.en: Mochi is rice, but it depends on the hot-pot broth.

餅・きなこ・砂糖。小麦不使用が普通だが焼き台の共用を要確認。2019年表示（税抜.en: Mochi, kinako, sugar. Normally no wheat, but check the shared grill. 2019 listing (before tax).

餅自体は米だが揚げ油は天ぷらと共用、つゆは小麦醤油。.en: The mochi itself is rice, but the frying oil is shared with tempura and the broth is wheat soy sauce.

餅自体は米だが衣は小麦、共用フライヤー。.en: The mochi itself is rice, but the batter is wheat and the fryer shared.

餅＝米。だし・油揚げは要確認。.en: Mochi = rice. Ask about the dashi and fried tofu.

餌に大麦を使うが、飼料の麦が肉のグルテンになるわけではない。味付けが未表示のため.en: The feed uses barley, but feed barley doesn't turn into gluten in the meat. Seasoning isn't shown, so check.

餡の調味に醤油、片栗以外に小麦澱粉の可能性。.en: Soy sauce in the filling's seasoning; possibly wheat starch besides potato starch.

餡・きな粉の内容未記載。.en: Bean paste and kinako contents not listed.

饅頭の皮は小麦粉、中はクリームチーズ、アイスは乳。.en: The manju wrapper is wheat flour, cream cheese inside, the ice cream is dairy.

香ばしさと深みのある甘味が人気.en: Popular for its toastiness and deep sweetness

香りや打ちたてにこだわって.en: particular about aroma and freshly made noodles

香味だれおかか・青さ海苔の佃煮とも醤油＝小麦。卵・かつお。.en: Both the aromatic okaka sauce and the aosa-nori tsukudani are soy sauce = wheat. Egg, bonito.

香味だれ＝醤油。卵・乳・豚肉。.en: Aromatic sauce = soy sauce. Egg, dairy, pork.

香味油で、こってりさせたラーメン.en: ramen made rich with aromatic oil

香川県丸亀市。骨付鳥は1953年（昭和28年）、丸亀の居酒屋「一鶴」の創業者・近.en: Marugame, Kagawa. Honetsuki-dori (bone-in chicken) is said to have been created in 1953 (Showa 28) by the founders of the Marugame izakaya Ikkaku, inspired by a roast-chicken scene in a Hollywood film.

香酢＝中国黒酢、小麦発酵の可能性。.en: Xiang cu = Chinese black vinegar, possibly wheat-fermented.

馬刺しのたれは甘口醤油＝小麦。.en: The horse-sashimi sauce is sweet soy sauce = wheat.

馬刺し醤油は甘口の小麦醤油。.en: Horse-sashimi soy sauce is a sweet wheat soy sauce.

馬肉自体は小麦なし、付属の甘口醤油は小麦。.en: The horse meat itself has no wheat; the sweet soy sauce that comes with it is wheat.

馬鈴薯でんぷん製のものと小麦粉製のものがある。店は原材料非公開のため要確認。.en: potato-starch and wheat-flour versions. The shop does not publish ingredients, so ask.

駅前の観光向け産直市場併設食堂で来訪者に慣れているが、英語メニューやアレルギー個.en: A diner attached to a tourist-facing farmers' market in front of the station, used to visitors, but don't expect an English menu or individual allergy handling. If you have dietary restrictions, check ahead in Japanese, or a guide or pointing helps.

驚濃とりとんこつ.r: きょうのうとりとんこつ

骨付ひね肉もも焼き.r: ほねつきひねにくももやき

骨付鳥「釜焼き」。 親鶏（180日以上の成鶏）と若鶏（60日未満）の2種を提供。.en: Kama-yaki bone-in chicken. Two kinds: mature hen (over 180 days) and young chicken (under 60 days). Seasoning, based on salt and pepper, is measured to the milligram to keep the taste the same in every shop. Slowly roasted in a dedicated oven (kama-yaki).

骨切りした鱧。湯引きなら小麦なし、粉をはたいて焼く／揚げるなら不可。.en: Hamo (pike conger) with its bones scored. Blanched has no wheat; floured and grilled or fried is not OK.

高タンパク質・低脂質であることに加え、グルテンフリーかつ主要アレルゲンフリー.en: high in protein and low in fat, plus gluten-free and free of major allergens

高畑町（ならまち東側・奈良公園寄り）.en: Takabatake-chō (east of Naramachi, towards Nara Park)

高級古民家イタリアン。日本語主体の環境だが、コース料理の流れは国際的で、英語対応.en: Upscale Italian in an old house. Mainly a Japanese-language setting, but the course follows an international flow; whether English is possible is unknown. English communication should be confirmed when booking.

高級地鶏などの銘柄鶏にはあえてこだわらず、各地域で入手できる鶏を使うことで地域ご.en: Deliberately avoids premium branded chickens and uses birds available in each region, valuing each region's take. Buying up branded chickens would "leave none for the local shops working hard there", so the policy is not to take resources away from producing areas. Each shop serves "Sanuki Cloudy", a special cloudy sake made with three times the usual white koji, as a pairing.

高級懐石コース専門店でメニューは日本語中心。スタッフは英語対応の記載なし。外国人.en: A high-end kaiseki course restaurant with a mostly Japanese menu. No mention of English-speaking staff. Menu customisation for overseas guests (e.g. a Kobe beef course) is possible on request, with advance notice.

高級白身魚。ソースのとろみの付け方を要確認。.en: A prized white-fleshed fish. Ask how the sauce is thickened.

高菜の調味に醤油の可能性。.en: The takana may be seasoned with soy sauce.

高菜漬けと炒め調味に醤油。.en: Soy sauce in the pickled takana and the stir-fry seasoning.

高菜漬けの調味に醤油・かつおだしを使う製品が多い＝要確認。.en: Many takana pickles are seasoned with soy sauce and bonito dashi = check.

魔界系ラーメン三冠馬.r: まかいけいらーめんさんかんば

魚のすり身団子はつなぎに小麦粉・でん粉を使うのが一般的。.en: Fish-paste dumplings usually use wheat flour and starch as a binder.

魚は塩焼きだが、添えの蓼酢の調味が未記載。.en: The fish is salt-grilled, but the seasoning of the water-pepper vinegar on the side isn't listed.

魚フライ＝パン粉＝小麦。お好きな麺を選べます。.en: Fried fish = breadcrumbs = wheat. Choose any noodles.

魚介と豚骨のうまみが溶け合う.en: where the savoriness of seafood and pork bones melts together

魚介（穴子・白魚）を中心とするメニュー構成で、動物性食材を使わない料理の選択肢は.en: The menu centres on seafood (conger eel, whitebait), with no dishes free of animal ingredients. The miso soup dashi is presumably animal-based too.

魚介＝煮干・鰹・鯖節など。.en: Seafood = niboshi, bonito, mackerel flakes and so on.

鰹節・しらす使用でヴィーガン不可。醤油をかけるなら小麦。2016年8月のカード。.en: Uses katsuobushi and shirasu, so not vegan. Wheat if soy sauce is poured over. Card from August 2016.

鰹節・魚介だしを使用した伝統的な日本料理店。植物性への配慮・切り替えに関する記録.en: A traditional Japanese restaurant using bonito flakes and seafood dashi. No record of any plant-based accommodation or substitution.

鰹＝非ヴィーガン、出汁の醤油含有を確認。.en: Bonito = not vegan; check whether the dashi has soy sauce.

鰻のタレ＝醤油・味醂、茶そばに小麦。.en: Eel sauce = soy sauce and mirin; wheat in the matcha soba.

鰻の伝統文化の伝承.en: passing on the traditional culture of eel

鰻の蒲焼のタレは醤油・味醂ベース＝小麦。バター＝乳。.en: Eel kabayaki tare is soy-sauce and mirin based = wheat. Butter = dairy.

鰻玉めし／鰻茶だし.en: eel and egg rice / eel tea dashi

鳥せんは浅草で30年以上続く老舎で、人情味あふれる店主と奥さんの人柄が温かく、お.en: Torisen is a long-established shop in Asakusa for over 30 years; the warm-hearted owner and the owner's wife have kind personalities, and many regulars come to see the two.

鳥刺し＝生肉。醤油使用多数。.en: Chicken sashimi = raw meat. Soy sauce used in many dishes.

鳥羽商工会議所の会員検索サイトが、みしお(鳥羽1-5-8)を令和元年新規オープン.en: The Toba Chamber of Commerce member search lists Mishio (Toba 1-5-8) as an izakaya newly opened in 2019 (Reiwa 1) and carries its opening greeting. Hitosara confirms an izakaya at ¥3,000–3,999 in the evening. The specific menu was not confirmed, so it was generalised.

鳥羽商工会議所サイト・伊勢志摩観光ナビ・ブログで確認：駅徒歩5分の寿司割烹、店名.en: Confirmed on the Toba Chamber of Commerce site, the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and blogs: a sushi and kappo restaurant 5 minutes' walk from the station; the name comes from the owner's training in Osaka; Ise-Shima seasonal fish always in the tank (winter: oysters and Ise lobster; spring: rockfish); the famous butterflied fried shrimp (looks like fried horse mackerel, the tail tells you it's shrimp); sets with 2–3 shrimp and the Umi no Zen.

鳥羽商船高専.en: Toba National College of Maritime Technology

鳥羽国際ホテル公式のシーホース紹介ページ(オーシャンウイング1階・88席・日本百.en: Each point is confirmed on the Toba Kokusai Hotel official Sea Horse page (Ocean Wing 1F, 88 seats, resort French overlooking Toba Bay, one of Japan's hundred best views) and the dinner menu page (graded courses Voyage / Signature / Terroir / Gastronomique, a bouillabaisse course and a vegan course).

鳥羽市観光協会(eat/1827)が、元海女さんが貝を焼き『焼き加減が絶妙』、海.en: The Toba tourism association (eat/1827) confirms that a former ama diver grills the shellfish with 'perfect timing' and will also talk about ama diving and how to eat the season's shellfish. A personal blog records eating turban shell grilled in the shell, oysters, hiogi scallops and Ise lobster (the claim that the oysters come from Matoya could not be verified, so it was generalised).

鳥羽市観光協会(eat/1836)がサザエストリートの焼き貝店として、さざえ・伊.en: The Toba tourism association (eat/1836) confirms a grilled-shellfish shop on Sazae Street selling turban shell, Ise lobster, abalone and other shellfish, the shop's own grilled oysters, and take-home gifts. Tabelog describes the style of choosing the shellfish you like and having it grilled on the spot.

鳥羽市観光協会と公式サイトによれば、ザ・貝屋はJR鳥羽駅前「さざえストリート」（.en: According to the Toba tourism association and the official site, The Kaiya is a grilled-shellfish specialist on 'Sazae Street' in front of JR Toba Station (where about 11 grilled-shellfish shops line up). You choose Ise lobster, abalone, turban shell, oysters and more from the tank and eat them grilled on the spot. The official site says the tank water has a sterilisation system so it can serve raw oysters. A small shop mostly of tables; the proprietress's service is well regarded, and hiogi scallops (appa-gai) are a speciality.

鳥羽市観光協会ページが、鳥羽駅前・地元漁師直送の伊勢えび/あわび/さざえ/大あさ.en: The Toba tourism association page states that, in front of Toba Station, it serves Ise lobster, abalone, turban shell, large clams, hard clams and grilled oysters sent straight from local fishermen; that 'we are the only place around Toba Station with a large range of Mie local sake' (including Jikon); and that solo diners at the counter are welcome.

鳥羽市観光協会・伊勢志摩観光ナビ・店の屋号(寿司・鰻・活魚)で確認：創業明治初年.en: Confirmed by the Toba tourism association, the Ise-Shima tourism navigator and the shop's own sign (sushi, eel, live fish): founded in the first year of Meiji, continuously at Toba Port, among the oldest in Mie Prefecture; nigiri sushi mainly of local fish, eel and live fish, local production for local consumption, house-made simmered dishes, about a 10-minute walk from the station. 'Edomae / hand rolls' are not in the sources, so corrected to nigiri sushi.

鳥羽市（鳥羽一番街・鳥羽駅前）.en: Toba City (Toba Ichiban-gai, in front of Toba Station)

鳥羽水族館公式の館内ショップページが、花さんごを大型サンゴ礁水槽に面した落ち着い.en: The Toba Aquarium official in-house shop page introduces Hanasango as a calm restaurant facing a large coral-reef tank and confirms a menu with women in mind, Mei-chan's curry (medium-hot or mild), napolitan spaghetti with octopus sausages and a walrus parfait.

鳥羽駅 + おかげ横丁 · ベジ・グルテンフリー.en: Toba Station + Okage Yokocho · vegetarian & gluten-free

鳥羽駅直結の鳥羽一番街3階にある海鮮のお店。鳥羽湾に浮かぶ答志島（漁業・観光の島.en: A seafood restaurant on the third floor of Toba Ichiban-gai, connected to Toba Station. It buys seafood from Toshijima (an island of fishing and tourism in Toba Bay) and serves it as sashimi, grilled shellfish, small fish, dried fish, simmered fish heads and more. The signature Misasa bowl is piled with eight kinds: sea bream, amberjack, tuna, squid, small fish, wakame, sweet shrimp, salmon roe and others.

鳥羽駅近くの「さざえストリート（さざえ街道）」にある、赤ちょうちんが目印の貝焼き.en: A shellfish-grill shop on 'Sazae Street' near Toba Station, marked by a red lantern. Counter and table seats, bright and lively. Tell the staff your budget and recommended dishes are prepared to match. Charcoal-grilled turban shell, plus oysters, abalone, scallops and Ise lobster, abalone and large-clam sashimi, seasonal sea urchin and more. Sake and bottled beer too. Open 8:30–17:00.

In Japan, duck has long been prized as a delicacy, so much so that the phrase 'the taste of duck' has been used as a byword for something delicious.

麦芽＝大麦。ランチプレート注文時はドリンク各500円。.en: Malt = barley. With a lunch-plate order, drinks are 500 yen each.

麩＝小麦グルテンそのもの。おでん出汁＝昆布・鰹節・醤油（小麦）。.en: Fu = wheat gluten itself. Oden broth = kombu, katsuobushi, soy sauce (wheat).

麺とつゆが小麦。.en: The noodles and broth are wheat.

麺と出汁にこだわった本格的な蕎麦。 毎日手打ちし、大きな窓越しに蕎麦打ちの姿を通.en: Proper soba, particular about noodles and dashi. Made by hand every day; the soba-making is visible from the street through a large window, showing the care that goes into it.

麺には「コシ・太さ・鮮度・打ち粉・素材」の五つのこだわりがあり、毎朝製造した生麺.en: The noodles have five points of care — 'firmness, thickness, freshness, dusting flour, ingredients' — and only fresh noodles made each morning are used, never refrigerated.

麺の打ち粉にそば粉を使用しているため、そばアレルギーの顧客には注意が必要で、成分.en: Buckwheat flour is used as the dusting flour for the noodles, so customers with buckwheat allergy need care, and ingredient guidance is provided.

麺の量を減らされるお客様は食券を買わないでお席で直接ご注文ください.en: if you want fewer noodles, don't buy a ticket; order directly at your seat

麺はバツバツの低加水で、すべての具材を絡めて食べるのが身上。卓上の四種の山椒・高.en: The noodles are firm and low-hydration, and the essence is eating with all the toppings mixed in. The shop recommends changing the flavour midway with the four kinds of sansho, ginseng vinegar and house sauce on the table.

麺は小麦、あえダレの原材料未記載。.en: Noodles are wheat; dressing-sauce ingredients not listed.

麺は小麦、芝麻醤・辣醤・かえしにも小麦由来の調味料。.en: Noodles are wheat; wheat-derived seasonings in the sesame paste, chili paste and kaeshi too.

麺は小麦。赤味噌合わせに麦味噌が入ることもある。.en: The noodles are wheat. The red-miso blend sometimes includes barley miso.

麺は小麦粉の自家製麺。スープと辛味タレも醤油ベース。.en: House noodles of wheat flour. The soup and spicy sauce are soy-sauce based too.

麺は抜けるが生地とお好みソースは小麦。.en: The noodles can be left out, but the batter and okonomi sauce are wheat.

麺は春雨かライス麺を選べるため小麦不使用。スキーのタレは発酵豆腐・醤油ベースで小.en: Choose glass or rice noodles, so no wheat. The suki sauce is fermented-tofu and soy-sauce based, very likely wheat. Wheat in toppings such as fish balls and gyoza.

麺は無いがタレが醤油＝小麦。チャーシュー入り。店は「野菜とお肉だけで楽しめるリャ.en: No noodles, but the sauce is soy sauce = wheat. Contains chāshū. The shop states, 'We also recommend the liang cai, which you can enjoy with just vegetables and meat.'

麺は生姜・明日葉・クロレラの3種だがグルテンフリー表記なし=小麦麺の想定。要確認.en: Three noodles (ginger, ashitaba, chlorella), but no gluten-free labelling, so wheat noodles are assumed. To be confirmed.

麺は米。スープの調味に醤油／トゥアナオを使う可能性。コースは季節で入れ替わる。下.en: The noodles are rice. The soup may be seasoned with soy sauce / thua nao. The course changes with the seasons. Below is the actual menu of March 18, 2026 (a photo posted on Tabelog); a review from August 2026 confirms the first three dishes.

麺は米で小麦不使用。タレのシーズニングソース・オイスターソースに小麦の可能性。卵.en: The noodles are rice, no wheat. The seasoning sauce and oyster sauce in the sauce may contain wheat. Uses egg, peanuts and dried shrimp. Rice noodles, but the sauce and the egg are the problems.

麺は製麺所に特注したもの.en: noodles custom-made by a noodle maker

麺を減らしても生地とソースは小麦。.en: Even with fewer noodles, the batter and sauce are wheat.

麺・かえしとも小麦。.en: Both the noodles and the kaeshi are wheat.

麺・つけ汁とも小麦。.en: Both the noodles and the dipping broth are wheat.

麺・つゆとも小麦、卵あり。.en: Both the noodles and broth are wheat; contains egg.

麺・つゆとも小麦。.en: Both noodles and broth are wheat.

麺・つゆとも小麦。だしは鰹。.en: Both the noodles and the broth are wheat. The dashi is bonito.

麺・つゆとも小麦・かつお。.en: Both noodles and broth are wheat and bonito.

麺・つゆとも小麦・鰹だし。.en: Both noodles and broth are wheat and bonito dashi.

麺・スープ・チャーシューすべて自家製.en: noodles, soup and chashu all made in-house

麺・スープ・味玉の漬け地すべて醤油＝小麦。.en: Noodles, soup and the seasoned egg's marinade are all soy sauce = wheat.

麺・タレとも小麦。.en: Both the noodles and the sauce are wheat.

麺屋高倉二条.r: めんやたかくらにじょう

麺無くなり次第終了.en: closes when the noodles run out

麺類と季節物に+400円または+350円でミニ丼を付けられる。.en: A mini rice bowl can be added to noodles and seasonal items for +¥400 or +¥350.

麺類のメニューはこれですべてを賄う.en: this serves all the noodle dishes

麺（うどん・きしめん）もつゆも小麦。そばに変更可（+50円）だがそばも打ち粉とつ.en: The noodles (udon, kishimen) and broth are both wheat. Can be changed to soba (+¥50), but soba is also out because of the dusting flour and broth. Large noodles +¥100.

麺＝小麦、メンマの味付けは要確認。.en: Noodles = wheat; check the menma's seasoning.

麺＝小麦、焼きおにぎりには醤油を塗る。.en: Noodles = wheat; the grilled rice balls are brushed with soy sauce.

麺＝小麦、焼きおにぎりに醤油。.en: Noodles = wheat; soy sauce on the grilled rice balls.

麺＝小麦。だしはかつお等の魚でヴィーガン不可。.en: Noodles = wheat. The dashi is fish such as bonito, so not vegan.

麺＝小麦。天ぷら・卵が入る。.en: Noodles = wheat. With tempura and egg.

麺＝小麦。辣油・辛味噌にも小麦系調味料が入ることが多い。.en: Noodles = wheat. The chili oil and spicy miso often contain wheat-based seasonings too.

麻婆の豆板醤・甜麺醤はともに小麦を含むのが通例。.en: The mapo's doubanjiang and tianmianjiang both usually contain wheat.

麻婆の豆板醤・甜麺醤は小麦を含むのが一般的、通常は豚挽肉入り。.en: The mapo's doubanjiang and tianmianjiang usually contain wheat; usually has minced pork.

麻婆春雨そのものが小麦、大根の甘酢漬けも小麦。.en: The mapo harusame itself is wheat, and the sweet-vinegar pickled daikon is wheat too.

麻辣スープの基本は豆板醤・豆豉で、いずれも小麦を含む。.en: Mala soup is based on doubanjiang and douchi, both of which contain wheat.

麻辣スープの豆板醤・甜麺醤に小麦。.en: Wheat in the doubanjiang and tianmianjiang of the mala soup.

麻辣担々麺.r: まーらーたんたんめん

黄色い看板に「昼ランチ・サービス しょう油ラーメン／チャーハン 1000円」。チ.en: The yellow sign reads 'Lunch service: shoyu ramen / fried rice ¥1,000'. The fried rice is seasoned with soy sauce too. A 2024 visitor recorded 'shoyu ramen and fried rice set ¥1,000, tax included'.

黄麹（米麹）仕込みの芋焼酎。.en: Sweet-potato shochu made with yellow koji (rice koji).

黒く焙煎した七味と千鳥酢のたれが添えられ、にんにくの匂いを抑えて食べやすいと評さ.en: Served with black-roasted shichimi and a Chidori-vinegar sauce, and described as easy to eat, with the smell of garlic held back.

黒ビールも麦芽＝グルテン。.en: Dark beer is malt too = gluten.

黒板には、お刺身をはじめ約40種類が50円〜600円台.en: On the blackboard, about 40 items starting with sashimi, from 50 yen to the 600s

黒板上、価格が「各300円」のまとめ書きの外に位置しており判読できず。.en: On the blackboard the price sits outside the "¥300 each" grouping and can't be read.

黒毛和牛肩ロース、山芋のいそべ焼き、カレー豚チーズもんじゃ（小麦粉バッター）、甘.en: Kuroge Wagyu chuck roll, yam isobe-yaki, curry pork cheese monja (wheat-flour batter), dessert

黒糖焼酎は法律上、米麹の併用が条件。麦は通常使わないが蔵の表示は未確認。.en: By law, brown-sugar shochu must also use rice koji. Barley usually isn't used, but the distillery's labeling isn't confirmed.

黒糖焼酎＝サトウキビの黒糖が原料、穀物不使用。.en: Brown-sugar shochu = made from sugarcane brown sugar, no grain.

黒酢に小麦の可能性、乳。.en: Black vinegar may contain wheat; dairy.

黒霧島は芋と米麹。麦麹は使わないが蔵の表示を要確認。だいやめ550円、赤兎馬71.en: Kuro Kirishima is sweet potato and rice koji. No barley koji, but check the distillery's label. Daiyame ¥550, Sekitoba ¥715, Tomino Hozan ¥770.

黒麹＝米麹が一般的だが未記載。.en: Black koji = usually rice koji, but not listed.

（きんぴらごぼうが小麦・ごま・大豆）。推奨のジンジャードレッシングも卵.en: (the kinpira gobo is wheat, sesame, soy). The recommended ginger dressing is also egg

（キタホナミ）、かえしは井上醤油店の生じょうゆ＝小麦。.en: (Kitahonami), and the kaeshi is Inoue Shoyu's raw soy sauce = wheat.

（年中無休、営業時間は変更となる場合あり／各店舗までご確認ください）.en: (open every day; hours may change — please check with each shop)

（玉切れ次第終了）／土日祝.en: (closes when the noodles run out) / weekends and holidays

（砂肝が小麦・ごま・大豆）。推奨のごま塩ドレッシングは小麦該当なし。.en: (the gizzard is wheat, sesame, soy). The recommended sesame-salt dressing has no wheat.
